package com.example

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/**
 * Instrumented test, which will execute on an Android device.
 *
 * See [testing documentation](http://d.android.com/tools/testing).
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class ExampleInstrumentedTest {
  @Test
  fun useAppContext() {
    // Context of the app under test.
    val appContext = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
    assertEquals(BuildConfig.APPLICATION_ID, appContext.packageName)
  }
}

class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "MainActivity"
        const val EXTRA_OPEN_TAB = "extra_open_tab"
        const val EXTRA_NOTIFICATION_HISTORY_ID = "extra_notification_history_id"
        const val EXTRA_GAME_ID = "extra_game_id"
        const val ACTION_EXIT_APP = "com.example.action.EXIT_APP"

        // 8 AutoPredictor Primary Modules
        const val TAB_HOME = 0
        const val TAB_LIVE_MONITOR = 1
        const val TAB_CRASH_HISTORY = 2
        const val TAB_PATTERNS = 3
        const val TAB_STRATEGY = 4
        const val TAB_HOURLY_ANALYSIS = 5
        const val TAB_NOTIFICATIONS = 6
        const val TAB_SETTINGS = 7
        const val TAB_RISK_MANAGER = 8

        // Compatibility aliases for deep links & existing navigation references
        const val TAB_OVERLAY = TAB_LIVE_MONITOR
        const val TAB_LOGS = TAB_CRASH_HISTORY
        const val TAB_RISK = TAB_RISK_MANAGER
        const val TAB_PROFILES = TAB_NOTIFICATIONS
    }

    private val viewModel: ScreenEarnerViewModel by viewModels()

    private fun handleAlarmStopIntent(intent: Intent?): Boolean {
        if (intent?.action == AlarmAudioController.ACTION_STOP_ALARM) {
            AlarmAudioController.stopAlarm(this)
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun handleExitIntent(intent: Intent?): Boolean {
        if (intent?.action == ACTION_EXIT_APP) {
            runCatching {
                finishAndRemoveTask()
            }.onFailure {
                finish()
            }
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    override fun onNewIntent(intent: Intent) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent)
        setIntent(intent)
        if (handleAlarmStopIntent(intent)) return
        if (handleExitIntent(intent)) return
        handleIncomingTabExtra(intent)
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        if (handleAlarmStopIntent(intent)) return
        if (handleExitIntent(intent)) return
        viewModel.refreshOverlayRunningState()
    }

    private fun handleIncomingTabExtra(intent: Intent?) {
        try {
            if (intent == null) return
            val historyId = intent.getLongExtra(EXTRA_NOTIFICATION_HISTORY_ID, -1L)
            if (historyId > 0L) {
                viewModel.markNotificationOpened(historyId)
            }
            val targetGameId = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_GAME_ID)
            if (!targetGameId.isNullOrBlank()) {
                viewModel.setSelectedGameId(targetGameId)
            }
            if (intent.hasExtra(EXTRA_OPEN_TAB)) {
                val targetTab = intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_OPEN_TAB, TAB_HOME)
                viewModel.selectTab(targetTab.coerceIn(TAB_HOME, TAB_RISK_MANAGER))
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed handling incoming tab extra", e)
        }
    }

    private fun closeCurrentEditorPanel() {
        try {
            viewModel.closeEditorScreen()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed returning from editor panel", e)
        }
    }

    @OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        if (handleAlarmStopIntent(intent)) return
        if (handleExitIntent(intent)) return
        enableEdgeToEdge()
        handleIncomingTabExtra(intent)

        setContent {
            AutoPredictorTheme(darkTheme = false) {
                val context = LocalContext.current
                val selectedTab by viewModel.selectedTab.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val strategyConfig by viewModel.strategyConfig.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val crashRecords by viewModel.crashRecords.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val sessionCrashRecords by viewModel.sessionCrashRecords.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val crashAudits by viewModel.crashCorrectionAudits.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val hourlySummaries by viewModel.hourlySummaries.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val patternOccurrences by viewModel.patternOccurrences.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val customStrategies by viewModel.customStrategies.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val notificationSettings by viewModel.notificationSettings.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val notificationHistory by viewModel.notificationHistory.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val alarmProfiles by viewModel.alarmProfiles.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val historyMetadata by viewModel.historyMetadata.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val gameState by viewModel.gameState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val automationState by viewModel.automationState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val monitoringStatus by viewModel.monitoringStatus.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val riskLimits by viewModel.riskLimits.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val lastRiskViolation by viewModel.automationEngine.lastRiskViolation.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val queuedOpportunitiesCount by viewModel.automationEngine.queuedOpportunityCount.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val isStandbyOutsideSchedule by viewModel.isStandbyOutsideSchedule.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val isCpuAwakeHeld by viewModel.isCpuAwakeHeld.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val selectedGameId by viewModel.selectedGameId.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val statisticalReport by viewModel.statisticalReport.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

                val selectedTimeRangePreset by viewModel.selectedTimeRangePreset.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val timeRangeMetrics by viewModel.timeRangeMetrics.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val smartAgentExplanation by viewModel.smartAgentExplanation.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

                                gameState = gameState,
                                automationState = automationState,
                                isOverlayServiceRunning = isOverlayRunning,

                                crashRecords = sessionCrashRecords,

                                isStandbyOutsideSchedule = isStandbyOutsideSchedule,
                                onToggleOverlayService = { viewModel.toggleOverlayService(context) },
                                onStartMonitoring = { viewModel.startMonitoring() },

                                onNavigateToTab = { viewModel.selectTab(it) },
                                monitoringStatus = monitoringStatus,
                                isAlarmRinging = isAlarmRinging,
                                activeAlarmTitle = activeAlarmTitle,
                                onStopAlarm = { AlarmAudioController.stopAlarm(context) },
                                onSnoozeAlarm = { AlarmAudioController.snoozeAlarm(5) },
                                onEndSessionAndClearData = { viewModel.endSessionAndClearSessionData() },
                                onToggleAutoBet = { viewModel.toggleAutoBet(it) },
                                onToggleAutoCashOut = { viewModel.toggleAutoCashOut(it) },
                                onToggleActionHand = { floatingHandsManager.showOrToggleUnifiedHand() },
                                onOpenHandSettings = { showHandSettingsDialog = true },
                                queuedOpportunitiesCount = queuedOpportunitiesCount,
                                onStartAutomationAssistant = { viewModel.startAutomationAssistant() },

                                onStopAutomationAssistant = { viewModel.stopAutomationAssistant() },

                                }

                            TAB_LIVE_MONITOR -> LiveMonitorScreen(

                                currentDailyLoss = sessionStateManager.getDailyLoss()

                                }
                            )
                            SheetModuleItem(
                                title = "7. Notification Center",
                                subtitle = "Android channels, POST_NOTIFICATIONS & alert delivery logs",
                                icon = Icons.Default.Notifications,
                                selected = selectedTab == TAB_NOTIFICATIONS,
                                testTag = "nav_notifications",
                                onClick = {
                                    showMoreModulesSheet = false
                                    viewModel.selectTab(TAB_NOTIFICATIONS)
                                }
                            )
                            SheetModuleItem(
                                title = "8. Settings & Awake Schedule",
                                subtitle = "Category thresholds, grid size, Keep-Awake & overnight schedule",
                                icon = Icons.Default.Settings,
                                selected = selectedTab == TAB_SETTINGS,
                                testTag = "nav_settings",
                                onClick = {
                                    showMoreModulesSheet = false
                                    viewModel.selectTab(TAB_SETTINGS)
                                }
                            )
                            SheetModuleItem(
                                title = "9. Risk Manager & Safety Locks",
                                subtitle = "Daily loss cap, sequence exposure, reserve & emergency stop",
                                icon = Icons.Default.Security,
                                selected = selectedTab == TAB_RISK_MANAGER,
                                testTag = "nav_risk_manager",
                                onClick = {
                                    showMoreModulesSheet = false
                                    viewModel.selectTab(TAB_RISK_MANAGER)
                                }
                            )
                            SheetModuleItem(
                                title = "Switch to Floating Overlay Mode",
                                subtitle = "Return to the monitored game with unified overlay navigation",
                                icon = Icons.Default.Layers,
                                selected = false,
                                testTag = "sheet_switch_overlay_mode_btn",
                                onClick = {
                                    showMoreModulesSheet = false
                                    viewModel.openInOverlayMode(context)
                                    moveTaskToBack(true)
                                }
                            )
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (showHandSettingsDialog) {
                    Dialog(
                        onDismissRequest = { showHandSettingsDialog = false },
                        properties = DialogProperties(usePlatformDefaultWidth = false)
                    ) {
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .fillMaxWidth()
                                .padding(16.dp),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                        ) {
                            DedicatedHandSettingsComposable(
                                strategyConfig = strategyConfig ?: StrategyConfig(),
                                onSaveHandSettings = { updated ->
                                    viewModel.saveStrategyConfig(updated, ensureOverlayActive = false, context = context)
                                    showHandSettingsDialog = false
                                },
                                onClose = { showHandSettingsDialog = false },
                                onToggleActionHand = { floatingHandsManager.showOrToggleUnifiedHand() },
                                onOpenGeneralSettings = {
                                    showHandSettingsDialog = false
                                    viewModel.selectTab(TAB_SETTINGS)
                                },
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxWidth()
                                    .heightIn(max = 650.dp)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SheetModuleItem(
    title: String,
    subtitle: String,
    icon: ImageVector,
    selected: Boolean,
    testTag: String,
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    Surface(
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
        color = if (selected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer.copy(alpha = 0.55f) else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.35f),
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
            .testTag(testTag)
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Icon(icon, contentDescription = title, tint = PrimaryCobalt)
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(12.dp))
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(title, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 14.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface)
                Text(subtitle, fontSize = 11.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
            }
        }
    }
}

    suspend fun getCrashRecordsForGameBetweenAsc(gameId: String, startMs: Long, endMs: Long): List<CrashRecord>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM crash_records WHERE crashTimestamp >= :sinceMs ORDER BY crashTimestamp ASC, id ASC")
    suspend fun getCrashRecordsSinceAsc(sinceMs: Long): List<CrashRecord>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM crash_records WHERE crashTimestamp BETWEEN :startMs AND :endMs ORDER BY crashTimestamp ASC, id ASC")
    suspend fun getCrashRecordsBetweenAsc(startMs: Long, endMs: Long): List<CrashRecord>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM crash_records WHERE id = :id")
    suspend fun getCrashRecordById(id: Long): CrashRecord?

    @Query("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crash_records WHERE dedupKey = :dedupKey)")
    suspend fun existsCrashByDedupKey(dedupKey: String): Boolean

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.IGNORE)
    suspend fun insertCrashRecord(record: CrashRecord): Long

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.IGNORE)
    suspend fun insertCrashRecords(records: List<CrashRecord>): List<Long>

    @Transaction
    suspend fun insertConfirmedCrashIfAbsent(
        crashRecord: CrashRecord,
        multiplierRecord: MultiplierRecord
    ): Boolean {
        if (existsCrashByDedupKey(crashRecord.dedupKey)) return false
        val rowId = insertCrashRecord(crashRecord)
        if (rowId <= 0L) return false
        insertMultiplierRecord(multiplierRecord)
        return true
    }

    @Update
    suspend fun updateCrashRecord(record: CrashRecord)

    @Query("DELETE FROM crash_records WHERE sessionId = :sessionId")
    suspend fun clearCrashRecordsForSession(sessionId: String)

    @Query("DELETE FROM crash_records WHERE gameId = :gameId")
    suspend fun clearCrashRecordsForGame(gameId: String)

    @Query("DELETE FROM crash_records WHERE gameId = :gameId AND sessionId != :activeSessionId")
    suspend fun clearArchivedCrashRecordsForGame(gameId: String, activeSessionId: String)

    @Query("DELETE FROM crash_records")
    suspend fun clearAllCrashRecords()

    @Query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crash_records WHERE sessionId = :sessionId")
    suspend fun countCrashRecordsForSession(sessionId: String): Int

    @Query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crash_records WHERE gameId = :gameId AND sessionId != :activeSessionId")
    suspend fun countArchivedCrashRecordsForGame(gameId: String, activeSessionId: String): Int

    @Query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crash_records")
    suspend fun countAllCrashRecords(): Int

    // Crash Correction Audits (retained for Room compatibility)
    @Query("SELECT * FROM crash_correction_audits ORDER BY correctedAtMs DESC LIMIT 200")
    fun getAllCrashCorrectionAudits(): Flow<List<CrashCorrectionAudit>>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertCrashCorrectionAudit(audit: CrashCorrectionAudit): Long

    @Transaction
    suspend fun applyManualCrashCorrection(
        recordId: Long,
        newMultiplier: Double,
        newColorHex: String,
        newCategory: CrashColorCategory,
        reason: String
    ): Boolean {
        val existing = getCrashRecordById(recordId) ?: return false
        insertCrashCorrectionAudit(
            CrashCorrectionAudit(
                crashRecordId = existing.id,
                gameId = existing.gameId,
                originalMultiplier = existing.multiplier,
                originalColorHex = existing.detectedColorHex,
                originalColorCategory = existing.colorCategory,
                correctedMultiplier = newMultiplier,
                correctedColorHex = newColorHex,
                correctedColorCategory = newCategory,
                reason = reason
            )
        )
        updateCrashRecord(
            existing.copy(
                multiplier = newMultiplier,
                detectedColorHex = newColorHex,
                colorCategory = newCategory,
                manuallyCorrected = true
            )
        )
        return true
    }

    // Hourly Session Summaries
    @Query("SELECT * FROM hourly_session_summaries ORDER BY hourStartTimestamp DESC LIMIT 240")
    fun getAllHourlySummaries(): Flow<List<HourlySessionSummary>>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM hourly_session_summaries WHERE gameId = :gameId ORDER BY hourStartTimestamp DESC LIMIT 120")
    fun getHourlySummariesForGame(gameId: String): Flow<List<HourlySessionSummary>>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)

    @Query("DELETE FROM hourly_session_summaries WHERE gameId = :gameId")
    suspend fun clearHourlySummariesForGame(gameId: String)

    @Query("DELETE FROM hourly_session_summaries")
    suspend fun clearAllHourlySummaries()

    // Pattern Occurrence Records (per-strategy, per-game history)
    @Query("SELECT * FROM pattern_occurrence_records ORDER BY triggerTimestampMs DESC LIMIT 500")
    fun getAllPatternOccurrences(): Flow<List<PatternOccurrenceRecord>>

    suspend fun getPatternOccurrencesForStrategyHour(strategyId: Long, hourStartMs: Long): List<PatternOccurrenceRecord>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.IGNORE)
    suspend fun insertPatternOccurrence(record: PatternOccurrenceRecord): Long

    @Query("DELETE FROM pattern_occurrence_records WHERE gameId = :gameId")
    suspend fun clearPatternOccurrencesForGame(gameId: String)

    @Query("DELETE FROM pattern_occurrence_records")
    suspend fun clearAllPatternOccurrences()

    // Custom Pattern Strategies (User-defined, ordered by sortOrder)
    @Query("SELECT * FROM custom_pattern_strategies ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, createdAtMs ASC, id ASC")
    fun getAllCustomStrategies(): Flow<List<CustomPatternStrategy>>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM custom_pattern_strategies ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, createdAtMs ASC, id ASC")
    suspend fun getCustomStrategiesOnce(): List<CustomPatternStrategy>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM alarm_profiles WHERE categoryName = :categoryName LIMIT 1")

package com.example.data.database

import android.content.Context

import androidx.room.RoomDatabase

import androidx.room.migration.Migration
import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase
import com.example.data.model.AlarmProfileEntity

import com.example.data.model.PlatformProfile
import com.example.data.model.RiskLimits
import com.example.data.model.SessionLog
import com.example.data.model.StrategyConfig

@Database(
    entities = [
        FloatingShortcut::class,
        PlatformProfile::class,
        StrategyConfig::class,
        RiskLimits::class,
        SessionLog::class,
        MultiplierRecord::class,
        CustomPatternStrategy::class,
        NotificationSettings::class,
        NotificationHistoryRecord::class,
        CrashRecord::class,
        CrashCorrectionAudit::class,
        HourlySessionSummary::class,
        PatternOccurrenceRecord::class,
        AlarmProfileEntity::class,
        MonitoringSessionEntity::class
    ],
    version = 18,
    exportSchema = false
)
@TypeConverters(ScreenEarnerTypeConverters::class)
abstract class ScreenEarnerDatabase : RoomDatabase() {
    abstract fun dao(): ScreenEarnerDao

    companion object {
        @Volatile
        private var INSTANCE: ScreenEarnerDatabase? = null

        private fun hasColumn(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase, table: String, column: String): Boolean {
            db.query("PRAGMA table_info(`$table`)").use { cursor ->
                val nameIdx = cursor.getColumnIndex("name")
                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    if (nameIdx >= 0 && cursor.getString(nameIdx) == column) {
                        return true
                    }
                }
            }
            return false
        }

        private fun addColumnIfMissing(
            db: SupportSQLiteDatabase,
            table: String,
            column: String,
            definition: String
        ) {
            if (!hasColumn(db, table, column)) {
                db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE `$table` ADD COLUMN `$column` $definition")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_10_11 = object : Migration(10, 11) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "crash_records", "sessionId", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "crash_records", "isConfirmed", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
                db.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_crash_records_sessionId` ON `crash_records` (`sessionId`)")

                addColumnIfMissing(db, "multiplier_records", "sessionId", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "multiplier_records", "isConfirmed", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
                db.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_multiplier_records_sessionId` ON `multiplier_records` (`sessionId`)")

                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "standardAlertEnabled", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "standardSoundUri", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "standardVibrationPattern", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DEFAULT'")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "standardRepeatedAlerts", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "highPriorityAlarmEnabled", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "alarmSoundUri", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "alarmVibrationPattern", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DISTINCTIVE'")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "alarmRepeated", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "alarmRepeatIntervalMinutes", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "alarmMaxDurationMinutes", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "channelConfigVersion", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")

                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_history", "gameId", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_history", "gameName", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_history", "occurrenceRecordId", "INTEGER")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_11_12 = object : Migration(11, 12) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "crash_records", "originalDetectedTitle", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "crash_records", "isConfirmed", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "crash_records", "observationOrder", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "multiplier_records", "isConfirmed", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")

                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "strategyGroup", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MULTIPLIER_INTERVAL'")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "multiplierRuleSubtype", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'STANDARD_THRESHOLD'")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "aboveThresholdX", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "aboveConsecutiveCount", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "belowThresholdY", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "belowConsecutiveCount", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "inclusiveBounds", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "postBigWaitMinutes", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "bigMultiplierThreshold", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 10.0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "specificAlertTimesCsv", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "colorMatchDirection", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'HORIZONTAL'")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "gridColumnsForVertical", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "customColorHexFilterCsv", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "repeatLimit", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "useAlarmStyle", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "vibrationEnabled", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "custom_pattern_strategies", "sortOrder", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0")

                db.execSQL(
                    """
                    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `alarm_profiles` (
                        `categoryName` TEXT NOT NULL,
                        `enabled` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                        `soundUri` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                        `soundLabel` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'No sound selected',
                        `vibrationEnabled` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                        `vibrationPattern` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DISTINCTIVE',
                        `repeatEnabled` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

                        `maxRepeatsPerEvent` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                        `useAlarmStyle` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                        PRIMARY KEY(`categoryName`)
                    )
                    """.trimIndent()
                )

                db.execSQL(
                    """
                    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `monitoring_sessions` (
                        `sessionId` TEXT NOT NULL,
                        `gameId` TEXT NOT NULL,
                        `gameName` TEXT NOT NULL,
                        `originalDetectedTitle` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                        `startedAtMs` INTEGER NOT NULL,
                        `endedAtMs` INTEGER,
                        `isActive` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                        `confirmedCrashCount` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                        `status` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',

                    """.trimIndent()
                )
                db.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_monitoring_sessions_gameId` ON `monitoring_sessions` (`gameId`)")
                db.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_monitoring_sessions_startedAtMs` ON `monitoring_sessions` (`startedAtMs`)")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_12_13 = object : Migration(12, 13) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "maxStrategyBetAttempts", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "isMartingaleEnabled", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_13_14 = object : Migration(13, 14) {

                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "bettingWindowExpiryMs", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 6000")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "dismissKeyboardBeforeBet", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "verifyStakeReadBack", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "verifyButtonStateBeforeAction", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")

                addColumnIfMissing(db, "risk_limits", "maxSequenceExposure", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 500.0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "risk_limits", "maxDailyLoss", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 500.0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "risk_limits", "safetyReserveAmount", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0")

                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "executionAlertsEnabled", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "notification_settings", "failureAlertsEnabled", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
            }
        }

            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "lossProgressionEnabled", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "lossProgressionMode", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DISABLED'")

                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "stakeEditTimeoutMs", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 500")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "autoCashOutTimeoutMs", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 500")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "betWindowTotalTimeoutMs", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3000")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "minRemainingBetWindowMs", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1200")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_15_16 = object : Migration(15, 16) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "gameAutoCashOutMode", "TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ENSURE'")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_16_17 = object : Migration(16, 17) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "platform_profiles", "minStake", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "platform_profiles", "maxStake", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000000.0")
            }
        }

        val MIGRATION_17_18 = object : Migration(17, 18) {
            override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "minStake", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "maxStake", "REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0")
                addColumnIfMissing(db, "strategy_configs", "cashOutUntrackedBets", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1")
            }
        }

        fun getDatabase(context: Context): ScreenEarnerDatabase {
            return INSTANCE ?: synchronized(this) {
                val instance = Room.databaseBuilder(
                    context.applicationContext,
                    ScreenEarnerDatabase::class.java,
                    "screen_earner_db"
                )
                    .addMigrations(MIGRATION_10_11, MIGRATION_11_12, MIGRATION_12_13, MIGRATION_13_14, MIGRATION_14_15, MIGRATION_15_16, MIGRATION_16_17, MIGRATION_17_18)
                    .fallbackToDestructiveMigration(true)
                    .build()

                INSTANCE = instance
                instance
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.data.database

import com.example.data.model.AlarmProfileCategory
import com.example.data.model.AlarmProfileEntity
import com.example.data.model.CrashColorCategory
import com.example.data.model.CrashCorrectionAudit
import com.example.data.model.CrashRecord
import com.example.data.model.CustomPatternStrategy
import com.example.data.model.FloatingShortcut
import com.example.data.model.HourlySessionSummary
import com.example.data.model.MonitoringSessionEntity
import com.example.data.model.MultiplierRecord
import com.example.data.model.NotificationHistoryRecord
import com.example.data.model.NotificationInteractionStatus
import com.example.data.model.NotificationSettings
import com.example.data.model.PatternOccurrenceRecord
import com.example.data.model.PlatformProfile
import com.example.data.model.RiskLimits
import com.example.data.model.SessionLog
import com.example.data.model.ShortcutType
import com.example.data.model.StrategyConfig
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first

enum class ClearHistoryScope {
    CURRENT_SESSION,
    SELECTED_GAME_ARCHIVED,
    ALL_HISTORY
}

class ScreenEarnerRepository(private val dao: ScreenEarnerDao) {

    val shortcuts: Flow<List<FloatingShortcut>> = dao.getAllShortcuts()
    val profiles: Flow<List<PlatformProfile>> = dao.getAllProfiles()
    val strategyConfig: Flow<StrategyConfig?> = dao.getStrategyConfig()
    val riskLimits: Flow<RiskLimits?> = dao.getRiskLimits()
    val sessionLogs: Flow<List<SessionLog>> = dao.getRecentSessionLogs()
    val multiplierRecords: Flow<List<MultiplierRecord>> = dao.getAllMultiplierRecords()
    val customStrategies: Flow<List<CustomPatternStrategy>> = dao.getAllCustomStrategies()
    val notificationSettings: Flow<NotificationSettings?> = dao.getNotificationSettings()
    val notificationHistory: Flow<List<NotificationHistoryRecord>> = dao.getAllNotificationHistory()
    val alarmProfiles: Flow<List<AlarmProfileEntity>> = dao.getAllAlarmProfiles()
    val monitoringSessions: Flow<List<MonitoringSessionEntity>> = dao.getAllMonitoringSessions()
    val crashRecords: Flow<List<CrashRecord>> = dao.getAllCrashRecords()
    val crashCorrectionAudits: Flow<List<CrashCorrectionAudit>> = dao.getAllCrashCorrectionAudits()
    val hourlySummaries: Flow<List<HourlySessionSummary>> = dao.getAllHourlySummaries()
    val patternOccurrences: Flow<List<PatternOccurrenceRecord>> = dao.getAllPatternOccurrences()

    suspend fun seedDefaultsIfEmpty() {
        val currentShortcuts = dao.getAllShortcuts().first()
        if (currentShortcuts.isEmpty()) {
            dao.insertShortcut(
                FloatingShortcut(
                    label = "LIVE HUD",
                    type = ShortcutType.BET,
                    panelId = 1,
                    visualX = 80f,
                    visualY = 320f,
                    backgroundColorHex = "#1D4ED8",
                    targetX = 0f,
                    targetY = 0f,
                    isCalibrated = false
                )
            )
        }

        val currentProfiles = dao.getAllProfiles().first()
        if (currentProfiles.isEmpty()) {
            dao.insertProfile(
                PlatformProfile(
                    id = "sportybet_aviator",
                    platformName = "SportyBet Aviator",
                    orientation = "PORTRAIT",
                    isActive = true,
                    description = "Browser & mobile observation profile for SportyBet Aviator."
                )
            )
            dao.insertProfile(
                PlatformProfile(
                    id = "betpawa_aviator",
                    platformName = "BetPawa Aviator",
                    orientation = "PORTRAIT",
                    isActive = false,
                    description = "Browser & app observation profile for BetPawa Aviator."
                )
            )
            dao.insertProfile(
                PlatformProfile(
                    id = "smartsoft_jetx",
                    platformName = "SmartSoft JetX",
                    orientation = "PORTRAIT",
                    isActive = false,
                    description = "Observation profile for JetX crash game."
                )
            )
            dao.insertProfile(
                PlatformProfile(
                    id = "pragmatic_spaceman",
                    platformName = "Pragmatic Spaceman",
                    orientation = "PORTRAIT",
                    isActive = false,
                    description = "Observation profile for Spaceman crash game."
                )
            )
        }

        if (dao.getStrategyConfig().first() == null) {
            dao.saveStrategyConfig(StrategyConfig())
        }

        if (dao.getRiskLimits().first() == null) {
            dao.saveRiskLimits(RiskLimits())
        }

        if (dao.getNotificationSettingsOnce() == null) {
            dao.saveNotificationSettings(NotificationSettings())
        }

        // Seed 5 alarm profile categories with NO pre-selected sound (manual selection only)
        dao.insertAlarmProfilesIfAbsent(AlarmProfileEntity.defaultProfiles())
        // CustomPatternStrategy table intentionally starts empty with zero hardcoded example strategies.
    }

    suspend fun insertShortcut(shortcut: FloatingShortcut) = dao.insertShortcut(shortcut)
    suspend fun updateShortcut(shortcut: FloatingShortcut) = dao.updateShortcut(shortcut)
    suspend fun deleteShortcut(id: Long) = dao.deleteShortcutById(id)
    suspend fun resetShortcutsToDefault() {
        dao.deleteAllShortcuts()
        seedDefaultsIfEmpty()
    }

    suspend fun setActiveProfile(profileId: String) = dao.setActiveProfile(profileId)
    suspend fun insertProfile(profile: PlatformProfile) = dao.insertProfile(profile)

    suspend fun saveStrategyConfig(config: StrategyConfig) = dao.saveStrategyConfig(config)
    suspend fun saveRiskLimits(limits: RiskLimits) = dao.saveRiskLimits(limits)

    suspend fun addSessionLog(log: SessionLog) = dao.insertSessionLog(log)
    suspend fun clearSessionLogs() = dao.clearSessionLogs()

    // Monitoring Sessions
    suspend fun getActiveMonitoringSession(): MonitoringSessionEntity? = dao.getActiveMonitoringSession()
    suspend fun upsertMonitoringSession(session: MonitoringSessionEntity) = dao.upsertMonitoringSession(session)
    suspend fun closeActiveMonitoringSessions(endedAtMs: Long) = dao.closeActiveMonitoringSessions(endedAtMs)

    suspend fun addMultiplierRecord(record: MultiplierRecord) = dao.insertMultiplierRecord(record)
    suspend fun addMultiplierRecords(records: List<MultiplierRecord>) {
        if (records.isNotEmpty()) {
            dao.insertMultiplierRecords(records)
        }
    }

    suspend fun getRecentChronologicalRecords(windowMinutes: Int = 30, nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): List<MultiplierRecord> {
        val cutoff = nowMs - (windowMinutes.coerceAtLeast(1) * 60_000L)
        return dao.getMultiplierRecordsSinceChronological(cutoff)
    }

    suspend fun pruneMultiplierRecordsOlderThan(cutoffTimestamp: Long) =
        dao.pruneMultiplierRecordsOlderThan(cutoffTimestamp)

    suspend fun clearMultiplierRecords() = dao.clearMultiplierRecords()
    suspend fun clearMultiplierRecordsForSession(sessionId: String) =
        dao.clearMultiplierRecordsForSession(sessionId)

    // Crash Records
    fun getCrashRecordsForGame(gameId: String): Flow<List<CrashRecord>> = dao.getCrashRecordsForGame(gameId)
    fun getCrashRecordsForSession(sessionId: String): Flow<List<CrashRecord>> = dao.getCrashRecordsForSession(sessionId)
    suspend fun getCrashRecordsForSessionOnce(sessionId: String): List<CrashRecord> =
        dao.getCrashRecordsForSessionOnce(sessionId)

    suspend fun getCrashRecordsSinceAsc(sinceMs: Long, gameId: String? = null): List<CrashRecord> {
        return if (gameId.isNullOrBlank() || gameId == "ALL") {
            dao.getCrashRecordsSinceAsc(sinceMs)
        } else {
            dao.getCrashRecordsForGameSinceAsc(gameId, sinceMs)
        }
    }

    suspend fun getCrashRecordsBetweenAsc(startMs: Long, endMs: Long, gameId: String? = null): List<CrashRecord> {
        return if (gameId.isNullOrBlank() || gameId == "ALL") {
            dao.getCrashRecordsBetweenAsc(startMs, endMs)
        } else {
            dao.getCrashRecordsForGameBetweenAsc(gameId, startMs, endMs)
        }
    }

    suspend fun insertCrashRecord(record: CrashRecord): Long = dao.insertCrashRecord(record)
    suspend fun insertCrashRecords(records: List<CrashRecord>): List<Long> =
        if (records.isEmpty()) emptyList() else dao.insertCrashRecords(records)

    suspend fun insertConfirmedCrashIfAbsent(
        crashRecord: CrashRecord,
        multiplierRecord: MultiplierRecord
    ): Boolean = dao.insertConfirmedCrashIfAbsent(crashRecord, multiplierRecord)

    suspend fun applyManualCrashCorrection(
        recordId: Long,
        newMultiplier: Double,
        newColorHex: String,
        newCategory: CrashColorCategory,
        reason: String
    ): Boolean = dao.applyManualCrashCorrection(recordId, newMultiplier, newColorHex, newCategory, reason)

    suspend fun countClearScopeRecords(
        scope: ClearHistoryScope,
        activeSessionId: String,
        selectedGameId: String
    ): Int {
        return when (scope) {
            ClearHistoryScope.CURRENT_SESSION ->
                if (activeSessionId.isBlank()) 0 else dao.countCrashRecordsForSession(activeSessionId)
            ClearHistoryScope.SELECTED_GAME_ARCHIVED -> {
                val targetGame = if (selectedGameId == "ALL" || selectedGameId.isBlank()) "unknown" else selectedGameId
                dao.countArchivedCrashRecordsForGame(targetGame, activeSessionId)
            }
            ClearHistoryScope.ALL_HISTORY -> dao.countAllCrashRecords()
        }
    }

    suspend fun clearHistoryByScope(
        scope: ClearHistoryScope,
        activeSessionId: String,
        selectedGameId: String
    ) {
        when (scope) {
            ClearHistoryScope.CURRENT_SESSION -> {
                if (activeSessionId.isNotBlank()) {
                    dao.clearCrashRecordsForSession(activeSessionId)
                    dao.clearMultiplierRecordsForSession(activeSessionId)
                }
            }
            ClearHistoryScope.SELECTED_GAME_ARCHIVED -> {
                val targetGame = if (selectedGameId == "ALL" || selectedGameId.isBlank()) "unknown" else selectedGameId
                dao.clearArchivedCrashRecordsForGame(targetGame, activeSessionId)
                dao.clearArchivedMultiplierRecordsForGame(targetGame, activeSessionId)
                dao.deleteArchivedSessionsForGame(targetGame)
                dao.clearHourlySummariesForGame(targetGame)
                dao.clearPatternOccurrencesForGame(targetGame)
            }
            ClearHistoryScope.ALL_HISTORY -> {
                dao.clearAllCrashRecords()
                dao.clearMultiplierRecords()
                dao.clearAllMonitoringSessions()
                dao.clearAllHourlySummaries()
                dao.clearAllPatternOccurrences()
                dao.clearSessionLogs()
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun clearCrashRecordsForSession(sessionId: String) = dao.clearCrashRecordsForSession(sessionId)
    suspend fun clearCrashRecordsForGame(gameId: String) = dao.clearCrashRecordsForGame(gameId)
    suspend fun clearAllCrashRecords() = dao.clearAllCrashRecords()

    // Hourly Session Summaries
    suspend fun getHourlySummary(gameId: String, hourStartMs: Long): HourlySessionSummary? =
        dao.getHourlySummary(gameId, hourStartMs)

    suspend fun upsertHourlySummary(summary: HourlySessionSummary): Long =
        dao.upsertHourlySummary(summary)

    // Pattern Occurrences
    suspend fun getPatternOccurrencesForStrategyHour(strategyId: Long, hourStartMs: Long): List<PatternOccurrenceRecord> =
        dao.getPatternOccurrencesForStrategyHour(strategyId, hourStartMs)

    suspend fun getLatestOccurrenceForStrategy(strategyId: Long): PatternOccurrenceRecord? =
        dao.getLatestOccurrenceForStrategy(strategyId)

    suspend fun insertPatternOccurrence(record: PatternOccurrenceRecord): Long =
        dao.insertPatternOccurrence(record)

    // User-defined custom pattern strategies
    suspend fun getCustomStrategiesOnce(): List<CustomPatternStrategy> = dao.getCustomStrategiesOnce()
    suspend fun insertCustomStrategy(strategy: CustomPatternStrategy): Long = dao.insertCustomStrategy(strategy)
    suspend fun updateCustomStrategy(strategy: CustomPatternStrategy) = dao.updateCustomStrategy(strategy)
    suspend fun deleteCustomStrategy(id: Long) = dao.deleteCustomStrategyById(id)

    suspend fun swapStrategyOrder(first: CustomPatternStrategy, second: CustomPatternStrategy) {
        val orderA = first.sortOrder
        val orderB = second.sortOrder
        val newOrderA = if (orderA == orderB) orderB + 1 else orderB
        val newOrderB = if (orderA == orderB) orderA else orderA
        dao.updateCustomStrategy(first.copy(sortOrder = newOrderA))
        dao.updateCustomStrategy(second.copy(sortOrder = newOrderB))
    }

    // Alarm Profiles (5 configurable categories)
    suspend fun getAlarmProfilesOnce(): List<AlarmProfileEntity> {
        val existing = dao.getAlarmProfilesOnce()
        if (existing.size < AlarmProfileCategory.entries.size) {
            dao.insertAlarmProfilesIfAbsent(AlarmProfileEntity.defaultProfiles())
            return dao.getAlarmProfilesOnce()
        }
        return existing
    }

    suspend fun getAlarmProfile(category: AlarmProfileCategory): AlarmProfileEntity {
        return dao.getAlarmProfile(category.name) ?: AlarmProfileEntity.defaultProfiles()
            .first { it.categoryName == category.name }
    }

    suspend fun upsertAlarmProfile(profile: AlarmProfileEntity) = dao.upsertAlarmProfile(profile)

    // Notification settings & history
    suspend fun getNotificationSettingsOnce(): NotificationSettings =
        dao.getNotificationSettingsOnce() ?: NotificationSettings()

    suspend fun saveNotificationSettings(settings: NotificationSettings) =
        dao.saveNotificationSettings(settings)

    suspend fun addNotificationHistory(record: NotificationHistoryRecord): Long =
        dao.insertNotificationHistory(record)

    suspend fun updateNotificationInteraction(id: Long, status: NotificationInteractionStatus) =
        dao.updateNotificationInteraction(id, status)

    suspend fun clearNotificationHistory() = dao.clearNotificationHistory()
}

package com.example.data.database

import androidx.room.TypeConverter
import com.example.data.model.CollectionSource
import com.example.data.model.ColorMatchDirection
import com.example.data.model.CrashColorCategory
import com.example.data.model.HistoryCollectionStatus
import com.example.data.model.MultiplierRuleSubtype

import com.example.data.model.StrategyGroup
import com.example.data.model.StrategyMode
import com.example.data.model.StrategyNotificationType
import com.example.data.model.TimestampSource

class ScreenEarnerTypeConverters {

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromHistoryCollectionStatus(value: HistoryCollectionStatus): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toHistoryCollectionStatus(value: String): HistoryCollectionStatus =
        runCatching { HistoryCollectionStatus.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(HistoryCollectionStatus.HISTORY_PARTIAL)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromTimestampSource(value: TimestampSource): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toTimestampSource(value: String): TimestampSource =
        runCatching { TimestampSource.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(TimestampSource.LOCAL_OBSERVATION)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromCollectionSource(value: CollectionSource): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toCollectionSource(value: String): CollectionSource =
        runCatching { CollectionSource.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(CollectionSource.LIVE_CRASH)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromCrashColorCategory(value: CrashColorCategory): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toCrashColorCategory(value: String): CrashColorCategory =
        runCatching { CrashColorCategory.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(CrashColorCategory.Other)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromStrategyMode(value: StrategyMode): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toStrategyMode(value: String): StrategyMode =
        runCatching { StrategyMode.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(StrategyMode.CUSTOM_CONDITION)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromStrategyGroup(value: StrategyGroup): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toStrategyGroup(value: String): StrategyGroup =
        runCatching { StrategyGroup.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(StrategyGroup.MULTIPLIER_INTERVAL)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromMultiplierRuleSubtype(value: MultiplierRuleSubtype): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toMultiplierRuleSubtype(value: String): MultiplierRuleSubtype =
        runCatching { MultiplierRuleSubtype.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(MultiplierRuleSubtype.STANDARD_THRESHOLD)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromColorMatchDirection(value: ColorMatchDirection): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toColorMatchDirection(value: String): ColorMatchDirection =
        runCatching { ColorMatchDirection.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(ColorMatchDirection.HORIZONTAL)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromPatternLogicOperator(value: PatternLogicOperator): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toPatternLogicOperator(value: String): PatternLogicOperator =
        runCatching { PatternLogicOperator.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(PatternLogicOperator.AND)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromNotificationPriorityLevel(value: NotificationPriorityLevel): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toNotificationPriorityLevel(value: String): NotificationPriorityLevel =
        runCatching { NotificationPriorityLevel.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(NotificationPriorityLevel.HIGH)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromRepeatNotificationPolicy(value: RepeatNotificationPolicy): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toRepeatNotificationPolicy(value: String): RepeatNotificationPolicy =
        runCatching { RepeatNotificationPolicy.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(RepeatNotificationPolicy.ONCE_PER_OCCURRENCE)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromStrategyNotificationType(value: StrategyNotificationType): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toStrategyNotificationType(value: String): StrategyNotificationType =
        runCatching { StrategyNotificationType.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromNotificationDeliveryStatus(value: NotificationDeliveryStatus): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter
    fun toNotificationDeliveryStatus(value: String): NotificationDeliveryStatus =
        runCatching { NotificationDeliveryStatus.valueOf(value) }
            .getOrDefault(NotificationDeliveryStatus.FAILED)

    @TypeConverter
    fun fromNotificationInteractionStatus(value: NotificationInteractionStatus): String = value.name

    @TypeConverter

        runCatching { NotificationInteractionStatus.valueOf(value) }

    @TypeConverter

data class PendingBetOpportunity(
    val id: String,
    val strategyId: Long,
    val strategyName: String,
    val targetGameId: String = "ALL",
    val occurrenceKey: String,
    val createdAtMs: Long,
    val expiresAtMs: Long,
    val targetWinsToFetch: Int = 2,
    val targetMultiplierOverride: Double? = null,
    val progressionMode: StakeProgressionMode? = null,
    val customAddAmount: Double? = null,
    val priorityScore: Int = 0
)

interface TargetUiInteractor {
    fun applyStake(
        newStake: Double,
        progressionMode: StakeProgressionMode,
        fallbackX: Float?,
        fallbackY: Float?,
        onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit
    )

    fun clickBet(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit)
    fun clickCashOut(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit)
    fun cancelPendingGestures(reason: String) {}
    fun dismissKeyboardIfOpen(): Boolean = false
    fun isButtonReady(expectBet: Boolean, config: StrategyConfig): Boolean = true
    val requiresPostActionVerification: Boolean get() = false
    fun refreshLiveTargets(fallbackTargets: DetectedUiTargets? = null): DetectedUiTargets? = fallbackTargets
    /** Waits until the game layout stops moving (keyboard closed, button bounds unchanged); true = settled. */
    fun awaitStableLayout(onDone: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
        onDone(true)
    }
    fun configureAutoCashOut(
        enabled: Boolean,
        targetMultiplier: Double,
        mode: String,
        onComplete: (Boolean, String?) -> Unit
    ) {
        onComplete(true, null)
    }
}

class AccessibilityTargetUiInteractor : TargetUiInteractor {
    private val actionScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)
    override val requiresPostActionVerification: Boolean = true

    override fun applyStake(
        newStake: Double,
        progressionMode: StakeProgressionMode,
        fallbackX: Float?,
        fallbackY: Float?,
        onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit
    ) {
        val controller = AccessibilityController.controllerInstance
        val service = ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService.instance
        val formatted = StrategyEngine.formatStakeAmount(newStake)

        if (controller != null) {
            controller.applyStakeToTargetApp(newStake, progressionMode, null, null) { ok ->
                onComplete(ok)
            }
            return
        }

        if (service == null) {
            onComplete(false)
            return
        }
        actionScope.launch {
            val ok = try {
                val executor = service.actionExecutor
                val fieldRes = executor.replaceFieldText("stake", formatted).let { first ->
                    if (first.success) first else executor.replaceFieldText("amount", formatted)
                }
                fieldRes.success
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
                false
            }
            onComplete(ok)
        }
    }

    override fun clickBet(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
        val controller = AccessibilityController.controllerInstance
        if (controller != null) {
            controller.clickBetTarget(null, null, onComplete)
        } else {
            onComplete(false)
        }
    }

    override fun clickCashOut(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
        val controller = AccessibilityController.controllerInstance
        if (controller != null) {
            controller.clickCashOutTarget(null, null, onComplete)
        } else {
            onComplete(false)
        }
    }

    override fun refreshLiveTargets(fallbackTargets: DetectedUiTargets?): DetectedUiTargets? {
        return AccessibilityController.controllerInstance?.refreshLiveTargetsNow() ?: fallbackTargets
    }

    override fun awaitStableLayout(onDone: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
        val controller = AccessibilityController.controllerInstance
        if (controller == null) {
            onDone(true)
        } else {
            controller.awaitStableBetLayout(onDone = onDone)
        }
    }

    override fun configureAutoCashOut(
        enabled: Boolean,
        targetMultiplier: Double,
        mode: String,
        onComplete: (Boolean, String?) -> Unit
    ) {
        val controller = AccessibilityController.controllerInstance
        if (controller == null) {
            onComplete(false, "Accessibility controller unavailable for Auto Cash Out.")
            return
        }
        controller.configureGameAutoCashOut(enabled, targetMultiplier, mode, onComplete)
    }

    override fun cancelPendingGestures(reason: String) {
        AccessibilityController.controllerInstance?.haltAllAutomationGestures(reason)
    }

    override fun dismissKeyboardIfOpen(): Boolean {
        val controller = AccessibilityController.controllerInstance
        if (controller != null) {
            return controller.dismissKeyboardIfOpen()
        }
        val service = ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService.instance
        if (service != null && service.actionExecutor.isSoftKeyboardOpen()) {
            return service.actionExecutor.dismissKeyboardSafely().success
        }
        return false
    }

    override fun isButtonReady(expectBet: Boolean, config: StrategyConfig): Boolean {
        if (!config.verifyButtonStateBeforeAction) return true
        val service = ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService.instance ?: return true
        return service.actionExecutor.isTargetButtonReady(expectBet)
    }
}

class AutomationEngine(
    val repository: ScreenEarnerRepository,
    val strategyEngine: StrategyEngine,
    val riskManager: RiskManager,
    val gameDetection: GameDetection,
    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default),
    private val targetUiInteractor: TargetUiInteractor = AccessibilityTargetUiInteractor()
) {

    private val _automationState = MutableStateFlow(AutomationState.IDLE)
    val automationState: StateFlow<AutomationState> = _automationState.asStateFlow()

    private val _lastRiskViolation = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val lastRiskViolation: StateFlow<String?> = _lastRiskViolation.asStateFlow()

    private val _sessionStats = MutableStateFlow(SessionStats(sessionStartMs = System.currentTimeMillis()))
    val sessionStats: StateFlow<SessionStats> = _sessionStats.asStateFlow()

    private val _agentStatusTicker = MutableStateFlow("Waiting for crash game window...")
    val agentStatusTicker: StateFlow<String> = _agentStatusTicker.asStateFlow()

    private val _executionState = MutableStateFlow(ActionExecutionState.IDLE)
    val executionState: StateFlow<ActionExecutionState> = _executionState.asStateFlow()

    private val _executionRecord = MutableStateFlow<ActionExecutionRecord?>(null)
    val executionRecord: StateFlow<ActionExecutionRecord?> = _executionRecord.asStateFlow()

    private val _activityLogs = MutableStateFlow<List<ActivityLogEntry>>(emptyList())
    val activityLogs: StateFlow<List<ActivityLogEntry>> = _activityLogs.asStateFlow()

    private val _isStandbyOutsideSchedule = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isStandbyOutsideSchedule: StateFlow<Boolean> = _isStandbyOutsideSchedule.asStateFlow()

    @Volatile
    private var isPausedBySchedule = false

    private val isActionInProgress = AtomicBoolean(false)
    private val actionStartedAtMs = AtomicLong(0L)
    private val liveCrashSeqCounter = AtomicLong(0L)
    var testBalanceOverride: Double? = if (targetUiInteractor !is AccessibilityTargetUiInteractor) 1000.0 else null

    @Volatile
    private var latestLimitsCache = RiskLimits()

    @Volatile
    private var latestConfigCache = StrategyConfig()

    private var activeSessionLoss = 0.0
    private var activeSessionRounds = 0
    private var activeSessionProfit = 0.0
    private var sessionWins = 0
    private var sessionLosses = 0
    private var sessionObservedCrashes = 0
    private var sessionStartTimestampMs = System.currentTimeMillis()

    // Per-round live execution tracking for BETTING_OPEN -> IN_FLIGHT -> CRASHED lifecycle
    private val _isRoundBetActive = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isRoundBetActiveState: StateFlow<Boolean> = _isRoundBetActive.asStateFlow()

    private var currentRoundBetActive = false
    private var currentRoundStake = 0.0
    private var currentRoundCashedOut = false
    private var cashOutAttemptedThisRound = false
    private var cashOutAttemptCount = 0
    private var lastCashOutAttemptWallMs = 0L
    private var sawCashOutAvailableInCurrentFlight = false
    private var inFlightWaitingNoticeEmitted = false
    private var currentRoundTriggerLabel = ""
    private var activeSequenceExposure = 0.0

    @Volatile
    private var latestUiTargets: DetectedUiTargets? = null

    @Volatile
    private var currentRoundBetAttemptLockKey: String? = null

    // Phase timing & bounded retry state
    private var lastObservedPhaseInEngine: String = ""
    private var lastBettingOpenAtMs: Long = 0L
    private var lastBettingOpenWallClockMs: Long = 0L
    private var inFlightStartedAtMs: Long = 0L
    private var activeTargetMultiplierOverride: Double? = null

    private fun setRoundBetActive(active: Boolean) {
        currentRoundBetActive = active
        _isRoundBetActive.value = active
    }

    fun updateLatestUiTargets(targets: DetectedUiTargets) {
        latestUiTargets = targets
    }

    // Executable custom strategy opportunity queue
    private val opportunityQueueLock = Any()
    private val pendingOpportunityQueue = ArrayDeque<PendingBetOpportunity>()
    private val enqueuedOccurrenceKeys = LinkedHashSet<String>()
    private val _queuedOpportunityCount = MutableStateFlow(0)
    val queuedOpportunityCount: StateFlow<Int> = _queuedOpportunityCount.asStateFlow()

    var currentDailyLossProvider: ((nowMs: Long) -> Double?)? = null
    var onDailyNetOutcomeRecorded: ((netProfit: Double, nowMs: Long) -> Double)? = null

    @Volatile
    private var lastLifecycleNoticeStage: String? = null

    @Volatile
    private var calibratedShortcuts: List<FloatingShortcut> = emptyList()

    @Volatile
    private var activePlatformName: String = "Unknown"

    var onGestureDispatchRequested: ((targetX: Float, targetY: Float, actionLabel: String) -> Unit)? = null

    var onExecutionNotification: ((
        type: StrategyNotificationType,
        title: String,
        message: String,
        occurrenceKey: String,
        priority: NotificationPriorityLevel
    ) -> Unit)? = null

    private val recentExecutionNoticeKeys = ConcurrentHashMap<String, Long>()
    @Volatile
    private var lastBetFailureEpisodeKey: String? = null

    fun resetBetFailureEpisode() {
        lastBetFailureEpisodeKey = null
    }

    fun enqueueCustomStrategyOpportunity(
        opportunity: PendingBetOpportunity,
        config: StrategyConfig = latestConfigCache,
        currentTimeMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): Boolean {
        if (currentTimeMs > opportunity.expiresAtMs) return false
        synchronized(opportunityQueueLock) {
            pruneExpiredOpportunitiesLocked(currentTimeMs)
            if (opportunity.occurrenceKey.isNotBlank() && !enqueuedOccurrenceKeys.add(opportunity.occurrenceKey)) {
                return false
            }
            pendingOpportunityQueue.addLast(opportunity)
            if (pendingOpportunityQueue.size > 1) {
                val sorted = pendingOpportunityQueue.sortedByDescending { it.priorityScore }
                pendingOpportunityQueue.clear()
                pendingOpportunityQueue.addAll(sorted)
            }
            _queuedOpportunityCount.value = pendingOpportunityQueue.size
        }
        tryActivateNextQueuedOpportunity(config, currentTimeMs)
        return true
    }

    fun tryActivateNextQueuedOpportunity(
        config: StrategyConfig = latestConfigCache,
        currentTimeMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): Boolean {
        if (strategyEngine.getState().isBettingSessionActive) return false
        val activeGameId = gameDetection.gameState.value.gameId.ifBlank { "unknown" }
        val nextOpp: PendingBetOpportunity = synchronized(opportunityQueueLock) {
            pruneExpiredOpportunitiesLocked(currentTimeMs)
            val idx = pendingOpportunityQueue.indexOfFirst { opp ->
                opp.targetGameId.isBlank() ||
                    opp.targetGameId.equals("ALL", ignoreCase = true) ||
                    activeGameId == "unknown" ||
                    opp.targetGameId.equals(activeGameId, ignoreCase = true)
            }
            if (idx < 0) return false
            val removed = pendingOpportunityQueue.removeAt(idx)
            _queuedOpportunityCount.value = pendingOpportunityQueue.size
            removed
        }
        val activated = strategyEngine.activateExternalPatternTrigger(
            strategyName = nextOpp.strategyName,
            config = config,
            currentTimeMs = currentTimeMs,
            progressionModeOverride = nextOpp.progressionMode,
            customAddAmountOverride = nextOpp.customAddAmount,
            targetWinsOverride = nextOpp.targetWinsToFetch,
            targetMultiplierOverride = nextOpp.targetMultiplierOverride
        )
        if (activated) {
            activeTargetMultiplierOverride = nextOpp.targetMultiplierOverride
            gameDetection.updateStrategyTelemetry(
                strategyEngine.getState(),
                "Pattern Triggered: ${nextOpp.strategyName}"
            )
            if (_automationState.value == AutomationState.RUNNING && config.isAutoBetEnabled) {
                notifyStrategyWaitingToBet(nextOpp.strategyName)
            }
        }
        return activated
    }

    private fun pruneExpiredOpportunitiesLocked(currentTimeMs: Long) {
        if (pendingOpportunityQueue.isEmpty()) return
        val iter = pendingOpportunityQueue.iterator()
        while (iter.hasNext()) {
            val item = iter.next()
            if (currentTimeMs > item.expiresAtMs) {
                iter.remove()
            }
        }
        if (enqueuedOccurrenceKeys.size > 200) {
            val toKeep = pendingOpportunityQueue.mapTo(HashSet()) { it.occurrenceKey }
            enqueuedOccurrenceKeys.retainAll(toKeep)
        }
        _queuedOpportunityCount.value = pendingOpportunityQueue.size
    }

    private fun clearOpportunityQueue() {
        synchronized(opportunityQueueLock) {
            pendingOpportunityQueue.clear()
            enqueuedOccurrenceKeys.clear()
            _queuedOpportunityCount.value = 0
        }
        activeTargetMultiplierOverride = null
    }

    private fun emitExecutionNotice(
        type: StrategyNotificationType,
        title: String,
        message: String,
        occurrenceKey: String,
        priority: NotificationPriorityLevel = NotificationPriorityLevel.STANDARD,
        cooldownMs: Long = 30_000L
    ) {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val last = recentExecutionNoticeKeys[occurrenceKey] ?: 0L
        if (cooldownMs > 0L && (now - last) < cooldownMs) return
        recentExecutionNoticeKeys[occurrenceKey] = now
        onExecutionNotification?.invoke(type, title, message, occurrenceKey, priority)
    }

    private fun emitEpisodeFailureNotice(
        episodeTag: String,
        title: String,
        message: String,
        priority: NotificationPriorityLevel = NotificationPriorityLevel.HIGH
    ) {
        val gs = gameDetection.gameState.value
        val roundPart = (gs.currentRoundId ?: gs.latestRoundId)?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: "live"
        val key = "${episodeTag}_${roundPart}"
        if (lastBetFailureEpisodeKey == key) return
        lastBetFailureEpisodeKey = key
        emitExecutionNotice(
            type = StrategyNotificationType.MONITORING_ERROR,
            title = title,
            message = message,
            occurrenceKey = "exec_err_${key}_${System.currentTimeMillis() / 30_000L}",
            priority = priority,
            cooldownMs = 15_000L
        )
    }

    fun recordActivityLog(
        actionId: String,
        state: ActionExecutionState,
        target: String,
        coordinates: Pair<Float, Float>?,
        gestureResult: Boolean?,
        eventObserved: String?,
        verificationResult: Boolean?,
        errorDetails: String?
    ) {
        val entry = ActivityLogEntry(
            id = System.currentTimeMillis(),
            timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis(),
            actionId = actionId,
            state = state,
            target = target,
            coordinates = coordinates,
            gestureResult = gestureResult,
            eventObserved = eventObserved,
            verificationResult = verificationResult,
            errorDetails = errorDetails
        )
        _activityLogs.value = (_activityLogs.value + entry).takeLast(100)
    }

    fun resolveEffectiveBalance(): Double {
        if (testBalanceOverride != null) return testBalanceOverride!!
        val balState = gameDetection.balanceState.value
        if ((balState.status == BalanceDetectionStatus.VERIFIED || balState.status == BalanceDetectionStatus.DETECTED) &&
            balState.amount != null && balState.amount.isFinite() && balState.amount >= 0.0
        ) {
            return balState.amount
        }
        val gs = gameDetection.gameState.value
        val liveBalance = gs.detectedBalance
        if ((gs.balanceStatus == BalanceDetectionStatus.VERIFIED || gs.balanceStatus == BalanceDetectionStatus.DETECTED) &&
            liveBalance != null && liveBalance.isFinite() && liveBalance >= 0.0
        ) {
            return liveBalance
        }
        return 0.0
    }

    fun updateCachedLimits(limits: RiskLimits) {
        latestLimitsCache = limits
    }

    fun updateCachedConfig(config: StrategyConfig) {
        latestConfigCache = config
    }

    fun publishStatusTicker(message: String) {
        if (message.isNotBlank() && _agentStatusTicker.value != message) {
            _agentStatusTicker.value = message
        }
    }

    fun updateLiveDiagnostics(
        targets: DetectedUiTargets,
        gameState: com.example.data.model.GameState,
        config: StrategyConfig
    ) {
        latestConfigCache = config
        if (_isStandbyOutsideSchedule.value || gameState.isStandbyOutsideSchedule) {
            val standbyMsg = gameState.scheduleStandbyMessage
                ?: OperatingScheduleEvaluator.evaluate(config).standbyBanner
            publishStatusTicker(standbyMsg)
            return
        }

        if (!gameState.isDetected) {
            publishStatusTicker("Scanning active windows for crash game...")
            return
        }

        val ticker = when {
            gameState.liveDetectionLost ->
                "LIVE DETECTION LOST — Check active game tab or scroll view"
            gameState.pipelineStatus == com.example.data.model.MonitoringPipelineStatus.PAUSED ->
                "MONITORING PAUSED"
            gameState.status == "IN_FLIGHT" ->
                "${gameState.displayedGameName}: Plane in flight (${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", gameState.currentMultiplier)}x)"
            gameState.status == "CRASHED" && gameState.latestCrashMultiplier != null ->
                "${gameState.displayedGameName}: Crashed at ${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", gameState.latestCrashMultiplier)}x (${gameState.latestCrashColorCategory.displayName})"
            _automationState.value == AutomationState.PAUSED || _automationState.value == AutomationState.EMERGENCY_STOP ->
                "Monitoring Live (${gameState.displayedGameName}) — Automation Paused"
            else ->
                "Monitoring ${gameState.displayedGameName} (${gameState.platformName})"
        }
        publishStatusTicker(ticker)
    }

    fun updateCalibratedShortcuts(shortcuts: List<FloatingShortcut>) {
        calibratedShortcuts = shortcuts
    }

    fun updateActivePlatform(platformName: String) {
        if (platformName.isNotBlank()) {
            activePlatformName = platformName
        }
    }

    fun findActiveShortcut(type: ShortcutType): FloatingShortcut? {
        val siteKey = GameDetection.resolveSiteKey(activePlatformName)
        val candidates = calibratedShortcuts.filter {
            it.type == type && it.isEnabled && it.isCalibrated && it.targetX > 0f && it.targetY > 0f
        }
        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return null
        if (siteKey.isNotEmpty()) {
            val siteMatch = candidates.firstOrNull { it.targetPlatform.equals(siteKey, ignoreCase = true) }
            if (siteMatch != null) return siteMatch
        }
        return candidates.first()
    }

    fun verifyReadyForMonitoring(isAccessibilityConnected: Boolean, limits: RiskLimits): StartAutomationResult {
        if (!isAccessibilityConnected) {
            return StartAutomationResult(false, "Enable Accessibility Service so Predict Manager can monitor live rounds.")
        }
        return StartAutomationResult(true, "Live monitoring started cleanly.")
    }

    fun startMonitoringWithValidation(
        config: StrategyConfig,
        limits: RiskLimits,
        isAccessibilityConnected: Boolean
    ): StartAutomationResult {
        val check = verifyReadyForMonitoring(isAccessibilityConnected, limits)
        if (!check.started) {
            _lastRiskViolation.value = check.message
            return check
        }
        if (limits.emergencyStop) {
            latestConfigCache = config
            latestLimitsCache = limits
            _automationState.value = AutomationState.EMERGENCY_STOP
            _lastRiskViolation.value = "Automation locked by Emergency Stop (Monitoring continues)."
        } else {
            startAutomation(config, limits)
        }
        return check
    }

    fun restoreMonitoringRunningPreservingSession(
        config: StrategyConfig,
        limits: RiskLimits,
        confirmedCrashCount: Int
    ) {
        latestConfigCache = config
        latestLimitsCache = limits
        sessionObservedCrashes = confirmedCrashCount.coerceAtLeast(0)
        if (limits.emergencyStop) {
            _automationState.value = AutomationState.EMERGENCY_STOP
            publishSessionStats(limitHaltReason = "Emergency Stop active (Monitoring live)")
            return
        }
        isPausedBySchedule = false
        val scheduleEval = OperatingScheduleEvaluator.evaluate(config)
        if (!scheduleEval.isWithinOperatingHours) {
            isPausedBySchedule = true
            _isStandbyOutsideSchedule.value = true
            _automationState.value = AutomationState.PAUSED
            gameDetection.updateScheduleStandby(true, scheduleEval.standbyBanner)
        } else {
            _isStandbyOutsideSchedule.value = false
            _automationState.value = AutomationState.RUNNING
            gameDetection.updateScheduleStandby(false, null)
        }
        publishSessionStats(limitHaltReason = null)
    }

    fun setObservedCrashCount(count: Int) {
        sessionObservedCrashes = count.coerceAtLeast(0)
        publishSessionStats(limitHaltReason = _sessionStats.value.limitHaltReason)
    }

    fun verifyReadyToStart(isAccessibilityConnected: Boolean, limits: RiskLimits): StartAutomationResult {
        if (limits.emergencyStop) {
            return StartAutomationResult(false, "Emergency Stop is active in Risk Settings.")
        }
        if (!isAccessibilityConnected) {
            return StartAutomationResult(false, "Enable Accessibility Service so Predict Manager can detect live targets and rounds.")
        }
        return StartAutomationResult(true, "Automation started cleanly.")
    }

    fun startAutomationWithValidation(
        config: StrategyConfig,
        limits: RiskLimits,
        isAccessibilityConnected: Boolean
    ): StartAutomationResult {
        val check = verifyReadyToStart(isAccessibilityConnected, limits)
        if (!check.started) {
            if (limits.emergencyStop) {
                _automationState.value = AutomationState.EMERGENCY_STOP
            }
            _lastRiskViolation.value = check.message
            return check
        }
        startAutomation(config, limits)
        return check
    }

    fun startAutomation(config: StrategyConfig, limits: RiskLimits) {
        latestConfigCache = config
        latestLimitsCache = limits
        if (limits.emergencyStop) {
            _automationState.value = AutomationState.EMERGENCY_STOP
            _lastRiskViolation.value = "Emergency Stop is active in Risk Settings."
            return
        }
        resetSessionStats()
        isPausedBySchedule = false
        val scheduleEval = OperatingScheduleEvaluator.evaluate(config)
        if (!scheduleEval.isWithinOperatingHours) {
            isPausedBySchedule = true
            _isStandbyOutsideSchedule.value = true
            _automationState.value = AutomationState.PAUSED
            gameDetection.updateScheduleStandby(true, scheduleEval.standbyBanner)
            publishStatusTicker(scheduleEval.standbyBanner)
        } else {
            _isStandbyOutsideSchedule.value = false
            _automationState.value = AutomationState.RUNNING
            gameDetection.updateScheduleStandby(false, null)
            publishStatusTicker("Checking strategy for current game state...")
        }
        _lastRiskViolation.value = null
        setRoundBetActive(false)
        currentRoundBetAttemptLockKey = null
        currentRoundCashedOut = false
        cashOutAttemptedThisRound = false
        sawCashOutAvailableInCurrentFlight = false
        inFlightWaitingNoticeEmitted = false
        lastLifecycleNoticeStage = null
        isActionInProgress.set(false)
        lastBetFailureEpisodeKey = null
        strategyEngine.reset(config.baseStake)
    }

    fun resetSessionStats(currentTimeMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()) {
        sessionStartTimestampMs = currentTimeMs
        activeSessionLoss = 0.0
        activeSessionRounds = 0
        activeSessionProfit = 0.0
        sessionWins = 0
        sessionLosses = 0
        sessionObservedCrashes = 0
        activeSequenceExposure = 0.0
        lastObservedPhaseInEngine = ""
        lastBettingOpenAtMs = 0L
        lastBettingOpenWallClockMs = 0L
        inFlightStartedAtMs = 0L
        currentRoundBetAttemptLockKey = null
        clearOpportunityQueue()
        _lastRiskViolation.value = null
        publishSessionStats(limitHaltReason = null)
    }

    fun syncSessionWithCrashHistory(records: List<MultiplierRecord>, limits: RiskLimits) {
        latestLimitsCache = limits
        if (_automationState.value == AutomationState.RUNNING) {
            enforceLimitsNow(limits)
        }
    }

    fun settleActiveRoundBetIfNeeded(
        crashedMultiplier: Double,
        config: StrategyConfig,
        limits: RiskLimits = latestLimitsCache,
        platformName: String = activePlatformName.ifBlank { gameDetection.gameState.value.platformName },
        currentTimeMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ) {
        cashOutAttemptedThisRound = false
        cashOutAttemptCount = 0
        lastCashOutAttemptWallMs = 0L
        sawCashOutAvailableInCurrentFlight = false
        inFlightWaitingNoticeEmitted = false
        if (_automationState.value == AutomationState.RUNNING && currentRoundBetActive) {
            settleActiveRoundBet(
