package com.example.data.engine

import com.example.data.model.CalendarHourUtils
import com.example.data.model.CrashColorCategory
import com.example.data.model.CrashRecord
import com.example.data.model.HourlySessionSummary
import com.example.data.model.StrategyConfig
import java.util.Locale

data class HourlyWindowMetrics(
    val windowLabel: String,
    val startMs: Long,
    val endMs: Long,
    val gameId: String,
    val gameName: String,
    val totalRounds: Int,
    val lowCount: Int,
    val lowPct: Double,
    val boundaryCount: Int,
    val boundaryPct: Double,
    val mediumCount: Int,
    val mediumPct: Double,
    val bigCount: Int,
    val bigPct: Double,
    val longestConsecutiveLowStreak: Int,
    val qualifyingBigIntervalsCount: Int,
    val averageMultiplier: Double,
    val medianMultiplier: Double,
    val colorDistribution: Map<CrashColorCategory, Int>,
    val isInsufficientData: Boolean
) {
    val sampleStatusLabel: String
        get() = if (isInsufficientData) "INSUFFICIENT DATA" else "$totalRounds rounds analyzed"
}

data class MultiWindowAnalysisBundle(
    val rolling30m: HourlyWindowMetrics,
    val rolling60m: HourlyWindowMetrics,
    val currentHour: HourlyWindowMetrics,
    val previousHour: HourlyWindowMetrics,
    val currentHourStartMs: Long
)

data class HourTransitionResult(
    val closedHourStartMs: Long,
    val newHourStartMs: Long,
    val savedSummaries: List<HourlySessionSummary>
)

/**
 * Computes independent 30m, 60m, Current Calendar Hour (default e.g. 14:00-14:59),
 * and Previous Completed Hour metrics, and handles clock-hour boundary finalization.
 */
object HourlyAnalysisEngine {

    private const val MIN_SAMPLE_FOR_STATS = 5

    fun computeMetricsForWindow(
        windowLabel: String,
        records: List<CrashRecord>,
        startMs: Long,
        endMs: Long,
        config: StrategyConfig = StrategyConfig(),
        minBigIntervalMinutes: Int = 5,
        maxBigIntervalMinutes: Int = 15,
        gameId: String = "ALL",
        gameName: String = "All Games"
    ): HourlyWindowMetrics {
        val filtered = records.filter { rec ->
            rec.crashTimestamp in startMs..endMs &&
                (gameId == "ALL" || rec.gameId == gameId)
        }
        val report = StatisticalAnalysisEngine.analyzeCompletedCrashes(
            records = filtered,
            config = config,
            minBigGapMinutes = minBigIntervalMinutes,
            maxBigGapMinutes = maxBigIntervalMinutes,
            gameId = gameId,
            gameName = gameName
        )

        val total = filtered.size
        fun pct(count: Int): Double = if (total == 0) 0.0 else (count * 100.0) / total
        val multsSorted = filtered.map { it.multiplier }.sorted()
        val avg = if (multsSorted.isEmpty()) 0.0 else multsSorted.average()
        val median = when {
            multsSorted.isEmpty() -> 0.0
            multsSorted.size % 2 == 1 -> multsSorted[multsSorted.size / 2]
            else -> (multsSorted[multsSorted.size / 2 - 1] + multsSorted[multsSorted.size / 2]) / 2.0
        }
        val qualifyingGaps = report.bigMultiplierGaps.count { it.isWithinQualifyingRange }

        return HourlyWindowMetrics(
            windowLabel = windowLabel,
            startMs = startMs,
            endMs = endMs,
            gameId = gameId,
            gameName = gameName,
            totalRounds = total,
            lowCount = report.lowCount,
            lowPct = pct(report.lowCount),
            boundaryCount = report.boundaryCount,
            boundaryPct = pct(report.boundaryCount),
            mediumCount = report.mediumCount,
            mediumPct = pct(report.mediumCount),
            bigCount = report.bigCount,
            bigPct = pct(report.bigCount),
            longestConsecutiveLowStreak = report.longestConsecutiveLows,
            qualifyingBigIntervalsCount = qualifyingGaps,
            averageMultiplier = avg,
            medianMultiplier = median,
            colorDistribution = report.colorDistribution,
            isInsufficientData = total < MIN_SAMPLE_FOR_STATS
        )
    }

    fun buildMultiWindowBundle(
        allRecords: List<CrashRecord>,
        config: StrategyConfig = StrategyConfig(),
        minBigIntervalMinutes: Int = 5,
        maxBigIntervalMinutes: Int = 15,
        gameId: String = "ALL",
        gameName: String = "All Games",
        nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): MultiWindowAnalysisBundle {
        val currentHourStart = CalendarHourUtils.hourStartFor(nowMs)
        val currentHourEnd = CalendarHourUtils.hourEndFor(currentHourStart)
        val prevHourStart = currentHourStart - 3_600_000L
        val prevHourEnd = currentHourStart - 1L

        val rolling30 = computeMetricsForWindow(
            windowLabel = "Rolling 30m",
            records = allRecords,
            startMs = nowMs - 30 * 60_000L,
            endMs = nowMs,
            config = config,
            minBigIntervalMinutes = minBigIntervalMinutes,
            maxBigIntervalMinutes = maxBigIntervalMinutes,
            gameId = gameId,
            gameName = gameName
        )

        val rolling60 = computeMetricsForWindow(
            windowLabel = "Rolling 60m",
            records = allRecords,
            startMs = nowMs - 60 * 60_000L,
            endMs = nowMs,
            config = config,
            minBigIntervalMinutes = minBigIntervalMinutes,
            maxBigIntervalMinutes = maxBigIntervalMinutes,
            gameId = gameId,
            gameName = gameName
        )

        val currentHour = computeMetricsForWindow(
            windowLabel = "Current Hour (${CalendarHourUtils.formatHourWindow(currentHourStart)})",
            records = allRecords,
            startMs = currentHourStart,
            endMs = currentHourEnd.coerceAtMost(nowMs),
            config = config,
            minBigIntervalMinutes = minBigIntervalMinutes,
            maxBigIntervalMinutes = maxBigIntervalMinutes,
            gameId = gameId,
            gameName = gameName
        )

        val previousHour = computeMetricsForWindow(
            windowLabel = "Previous Hour (${CalendarHourUtils.formatHourWindow(prevHourStart)})",
            records = allRecords,
            startMs = prevHourStart,
            endMs = prevHourEnd,
            config = config,
            minBigIntervalMinutes = minBigIntervalMinutes,
            maxBigIntervalMinutes = maxBigIntervalMinutes,
            gameId = gameId,
            gameName = gameName
        )

        return MultiWindowAnalysisBundle(
            rolling30m = rolling30,
            rolling60m = rolling60,
            currentHour = currentHour,
            previousHour = previousHour,
            currentHourStartMs = currentHourStart
        )
    }

    fun toHourlySummaryEntity(
        metrics: HourlyWindowMetrics,
        finalizedAtMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): HourlySessionSummary {
        val colorJson = metrics.colorDistribution.entries.joinToString(",") { (cat, count) ->
            "\"${cat.name}\":$count"
        }.let { "{$it}" }

        return HourlySessionSummary(
            gameId = metrics.gameId,
            gameName = metrics.gameName,
            hourStartTimestamp = metrics.startMs,
            hourEndTimestamp = metrics.endMs,
            totalRounds = metrics.totalRounds,
            lowCount = metrics.lowCount,
            lowPct = metrics.lowPct,
            boundaryCount = metrics.boundaryCount,
            boundaryPct = metrics.boundaryPct,
            mediumCount = metrics.mediumCount,
            mediumPct = metrics.mediumPct,
            bigCount = metrics.bigCount,
            bigPct = metrics.bigPct,
            longestConsecutiveLowStreak = metrics.longestConsecutiveLowStreak,
            qualifyingBigIntervalsCount = metrics.qualifyingBigIntervalsCount,
            averageMultiplier = metrics.averageMultiplier,
            medianMultiplier = metrics.medianMultiplier,
            colorDistributionJson = colorJson,
            sampleStatus = if (metrics.isInsufficientData) "INSUFFICIENT_DATA" else "SUFFICIENT",
            finalizedAtMs = finalizedAtMs
        )
    }

    fun finalizeClosingHourSummaries(
        allRecords: List<CrashRecord>,
        closingHourStartMs: Long,
        newHourStartMs: Long,
        config: StrategyConfig = StrategyConfig(),
        finalizedAtMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): HourTransitionResult {
        val closingEndMs = CalendarHourUtils.hourEndFor(closingHourStartMs)
        val closingRecords = allRecords.filter { it.crashTimestamp in closingHourStartMs..closingEndMs }
        val distinctGames = closingRecords.groupBy { it.gameId }
        val summaries = mutableListOf<HourlySessionSummary>()

        // Save overall + per-game summaries
        if (closingRecords.isNotEmpty()) {
            val overallMetrics = computeMetricsForWindow(
                windowLabel = CalendarHourUtils.formatHourWindow(closingHourStartMs),
                records = closingRecords,
                startMs = closingHourStartMs,
                endMs = closingEndMs,
                config = config,
                gameId = "ALL",
                gameName = "All Monitored Games"
            )
            summaries.add(toHourlySummaryEntity(overallMetrics, finalizedAtMs))

            distinctGames.forEach { (gId, gRecords) ->
                val gName = gRecords.lastOrNull()?.gameName ?: gId.replaceFirstChar { it.uppercaseChar() }
                val gameMetrics = computeMetricsForWindow(
                    windowLabel = CalendarHourUtils.formatHourWindow(closingHourStartMs),
                    records = gRecords,
                    startMs = closingHourStartMs,
                    endMs = closingEndMs,
                    config = config,
                    gameId = gId,
                    gameName = gName
                )
                summaries.add(toHourlySummaryEntity(gameMetrics, finalizedAtMs))
            }
        }

        return HourTransitionResult(
            closedHourStartMs = closingHourStartMs,
            newHourStartMs = newHourStartMs,
            savedSummaries = summaries
        )
    }

    fun formatPercent(pct: Double): String = String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f%%", pct)

    enum class TimeRangePreset(val label: String, val durationMs: Long?) {
        ONE_HOUR("1h", 1 * 3_600_000L),
        THREE_HOURS("3h", 3 * 3_600_000L),
        SIX_HOURS("6h", 6 * 3_600_000L),
        TWELVE_HOURS("12h", 12 * 3_600_000L),
        TWENTY_FOUR_HOURS("24h", 24 * 3_600_000L),
        CUSTOM("Custom", null)
    }

    fun analyzeTimeRange(
        preset: TimeRangePreset,
        records: List<CrashRecord>,
        config: StrategyConfig = StrategyConfig(),
        gameId: String = "ALL",
        gameName: String = "All Games",
        customStartMs: Long = 0L,
        customEndMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): HourlyWindowMetrics {
        val start = if (preset == TimeRangePreset.CUSTOM) {
            customStartMs.coerceAtMost(customEndMs)
        } else {
            nowMs - (preset.durationMs ?: 3_600_000L)
        }
        val end = if (preset == TimeRangePreset.CUSTOM) customEndMs else nowMs
        return computeMetricsForWindow(
            windowLabel = if (preset == TimeRangePreset.CUSTOM) "Custom Range" else "Last ${preset.label}",
            records = records,
            startMs = start,
            endMs = end,
            config = config,
            gameId = gameId,
            gameName = gameName
        )
    }
}

package com.example.data.engine

import android.util.Log

data class PendingCrashCandidate(
    val sessionId: String,
    val gameId: String,
    val gameName: String,
    val platformName: String,
    val sourcePackage: String,
    val multiplier: Double,
    val roundId: String?,
    val roundSequence: Int,
    val colorHex: String,
    val colorCategory: CrashColorCategory,
    val isPixelVerified: Boolean,
    val detectedAtMs: Long,
    val dedupKey: String
)

data class LiveCrashPipelineDiagnostics(
    val lifecycleState: RoundLifecycleState = RoundLifecycleState.WAITING_FOR_ROUND,
    val lastEventSummary: String = "WAITING_FOR_ROUND",
    val roundSequence: Int = 0,
    val duplicatesIgnoredCount: Int = 0,
    val historyBlocksCount: Int = 0
)

/**
 * Authoritative Flow-debounced Live Crash Pipeline with explicit 7-state round lifecycle.
 *
 * Strictly enforces:
 * - Only ONE confirmed record per completed live round (Flow debounce + dedupKey uniqueness).
 * - Never records rising (IN_FLIGHT) multipliers, stale values on GAME_NOT_ACCESSIBLE /
 *   GAME_SUSPENDED, or entries while the game's Round History panel is open (HISTORY_ONLY).
 * - Preserves legitimate consecutive rounds with identical multipliers (e.g. 2.10x, 2.10x)
 *   using `(sessionId, gameId, roundId or sequenceIndex)` rather than multiplier value alone.
 */
class LiveCrashPipeline(
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
    private val debounceWindowMs: Long = DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_MS,
    private val onConfirmedCrash: suspend (ConfirmedCrashEmission) -> Unit
) {
    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "LiveCrashPipeline"
        const val DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_MS = 220L
    }

    private val _lifecycleState = MutableStateFlow(RoundLifecycleState.WAITING_FOR_ROUND)
    val lifecycleState: StateFlow<RoundLifecycleState> = _lifecycleState.asStateFlow()

    private val _diagnostics = MutableStateFlow(LiveCrashPipelineDiagnostics())
    val diagnostics: StateFlow<LiveCrashPipelineDiagnostics> = _diagnostics.asStateFlow()

    private val pendingCrashFlow = MutableSharedFlow<PendingCrashCandidate>(extraBufferCapacity = 64)
    private var collectorJob: Job? = null

    private var activeSessionId: String = ""
    private var roundSequence: Int = 0
    private var lastFlightPeakMultiplier: Double? = null
    private var lastFlightColorHex: String? = null
    private var lastFlightColorVerified: Boolean = false
    private var activeRoundRecorded: Boolean = false
    private var lastRecordedRoundId: String? = null
    private var lastRecordedDedupKey: String? = null
    private val pipelineMutex = Mutex()
    private var recordedDedupKeysInSession = linkedSetOf<String>()

    private var latestPendingCandidate: PendingCrashCandidate? = null
    private var duplicatesIgnoredCount: Int = 0
    private var historyBlocksCount: Int = 0

    @Volatile
    private var currentLowThreshold: Double = 2.00

    @Volatile
    private var currentBigThreshold: Double = 10.00

    init {
        startCollector()
    }

    @OptIn(FlowPreview::class)
    private fun startCollector() {
        if (collectorJob != null) return
        collectorJob = scope.launch {
            pendingCrashFlow
                .debounce(debounceWindowMs.coerceAtLeast(0L))
                .collectLatest { candidate ->
                    pipelineMutex.withLock {
                        confirmAndEmitCandidateLocked(candidate)
                    }
                }
        }
    }

    fun configureSession(
        sessionId: String,
        initialSequence: Int = 0,
        existingDedupKeys: Collection<String> = emptyList()
    ) {
        activeSessionId = sessionId
        roundSequence = initialSequence.coerceAtLeast(0)
        recordedDedupKeysInSession = linkedSetOf<String>().apply {
            addAll(existingDedupKeys)
        }
        latestPendingCandidate = null
        lastFlightPeakMultiplier = null
        lastFlightColorHex = null
        lastFlightColorVerified = false
        activeRoundRecorded = false
        lastRecordedRoundId = null
        lastRecordedDedupKey = existingDedupKeys.lastOrNull()
        _lifecycleState.value = RoundLifecycleState.WAITING_FOR_ROUND
        updateDiagnostics("SESSION_CONFIGURED | session=$sessionId | seq=$roundSequence")
    }

    fun resetForStoppedSession() {
        activeSessionId = ""
        roundSequence = 0
        recordedDedupKeysInSession.clear()
        latestPendingCandidate = null
        lastFlightPeakMultiplier = null
        lastFlightColorHex = null
        lastFlightColorVerified = false
        activeRoundRecorded = false
        lastRecordedRoundId = null
        lastRecordedDedupKey = null
        duplicatesIgnoredCount = 0
        historyBlocksCount = 0
        _lifecycleState.value = RoundLifecycleState.WAITING_FOR_ROUND
        updateDiagnostics("SESSION_STOPPED")
    }

    suspend fun onDetectionFrame(
        detection: GameDetectionState,
        monitoringStatus: MonitoringStatus,
        lowThreshold: Double = 2.00,
        bigThreshold: Double = 10.00,
        nowMs: Long = detection.updatedAtMs.takeIf { it > 0L } ?: System.currentTimeMillis()
    ) {
        currentLowThreshold = lowThreshold
        currentBigThreshold = bigThreshold

        if (activeSessionId.isBlank()) return

        // Only collect during active Monitoring state
        if (monitoringStatus != MonitoringStatus.MONITORING &&
            monitoringStatus != MonitoringStatus.WAITING_FOR_GAME
        ) {
            return
        }

        // Strict History Panel isolation: when expanded Round History modal is visible,
        // classify as HISTORY_ONLY and NEVER record or trigger alarms.
        if (detection.uiTargets.historyPanelExpanded) {
            historyBlocksCount++
            updateDiagnostics("HISTORY_ONLY | BLOCKED (historyPanelExpanded=true)")
            safeLogD(TAG, "HISTORY_ONLY | BLOCKED while history modal is visible")
            return
        }

        // Strict accessibility/window validity gate
        val blockedByWindowAccess = detection.windowAccessStatus == MonitoringStatus.GAME_NOT_ACCESSIBLE ||
            detection.windowAccessStatus == MonitoringStatus.GAME_SUSPENDED ||
            detection.gameWindowSuspended
        if (!detection.isGameDetected || detection.liveDetectionLost || blockedByWindowAccess) {
            return
        }

        val phase = detection.gamePhase
        val mult = detection.detectedMultiplier

        when (phase) {
            "BETTING_OPEN" -> {
                // If transitioning directly from an un-settled flight, confirm that round before starting next
                val prevPeak = lastFlightPeakMultiplier ?: detection.uiTargets.ribbonMultipliers.firstOrNull()
                if (!activeRoundRecorded && prevPeak != null && prevPeak >= 1.0 &&
                    (_lifecycleState.value == RoundLifecycleState.MULTIPLIER_RISING ||
                        _lifecycleState.value == RoundLifecycleState.ROUND_STARTED)
                ) {
                    enqueueCrashCandidate(
                        detection = detection,
                        multiplier = prevPeak,
                        colorHex = lastFlightColorHex,
                        isPixelVerified = lastFlightColorVerified,
                        nowMs = nowMs
                    )
                    // Flush immediately before opening next round so consecutive rounds stay in order
                    flushPendingNow()
                } else if (latestPendingCandidate != null) {
                    // Rapid settle before next round started
                    flushPendingNow()
                }

                lastFlightPeakMultiplier = null
                lastFlightColorHex = null
                lastFlightColorVerified = false

                if (_lifecycleState.value == RoundLifecycleState.ROUND_RECORDED ||
                    _lifecycleState.value == RoundLifecycleState.FINAL_MULTIPLIER_CONFIRMED ||
                    _lifecycleState.value == RoundLifecycleState.CRASH_DETECTED
                ) {
                    _lifecycleState.value = RoundLifecycleState.WAITING_FOR_NEXT_ROUND
                    updateDiagnostics("WAITING_FOR_NEXT_ROUND")
                } else if (_lifecycleState.value == RoundLifecycleState.WAITING_FOR_ROUND ||
                    _lifecycleState.value == RoundLifecycleState.WAITING_FOR_NEXT_ROUND
                ) {
                    _lifecycleState.value = RoundLifecycleState.ROUND_STARTED
                    updateDiagnostics("ROUND_STARTED | seq=$roundSequence")
                }
            }

            "IN_FLIGHT" -> {
                // If there's still a pending candidate from previous round, flush it cleanly before new flight
                if (latestPendingCandidate != null) {
                    flushPendingNow()
                }

                val isStartingNewRound = _lifecycleState.value == RoundLifecycleState.WAITING_FOR_ROUND ||
                    _lifecycleState.value == RoundLifecycleState.WAITING_FOR_NEXT_ROUND ||
                    _lifecycleState.value == RoundLifecycleState.ROUND_STARTED ||
                    _lifecycleState.value == RoundLifecycleState.ROUND_RECORDED ||
                    activeRoundRecorded

                if (isStartingNewRound) {
                    roundSequence += 1
                    activeRoundRecorded = false
                    lastFlightPeakMultiplier = null
                    lastFlightColorHex = null
                    lastFlightColorVerified = false
                }

                _lifecycleState.value = RoundLifecycleState.MULTIPLIER_RISING
                if (mult != null && mult.isFinite() && mult >= 1.0) {
                    lastFlightPeakMultiplier = maxOf(lastFlightPeakMultiplier ?: 1.0, mult)
                    if (!detection.liveColorHex.isNullOrBlank()) {
                        lastFlightColorHex = detection.liveColorHex
                        lastFlightColorVerified = detection.isLiveColorPixelVerified
                    }
                    updateDiagnostics("MULTIPLIER_RISING | ${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", mult)} | NOT_RECORDED")
                }
            }

            "CRASHED" -> {
                val crashedValue = mult?.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 1.0 }
                    ?: lastFlightPeakMultiplier?.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 1.0 }
                    ?: detection.uiTargets.ribbonMultipliers.firstOrNull()?.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 1.0 }
                    ?: return

                val incomingRoundId = detection.roundId?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                val isDistinctRoundId = incomingRoundId != null && incomingRoundId != lastRecordedRoundId

                if (activeRoundRecorded && !isDistinctRoundId) {
                    duplicatesIgnoredCount++
                    updateDiagnostics("REPEATED_CALLBACK | DUPLICATE_IGNORED (${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", crashedValue)})")
                    safeLogD(TAG, "REPEATED_CALLBACK | DUPLICATE_IGNORED for seq=$roundSequence value=$crashedValue")
                    return
                }

                if (roundSequence == 0 || isDistinctRoundId && activeRoundRecorded) {
                    roundSequence += 1
                    activeRoundRecorded = false
                }

                _lifecycleState.value = RoundLifecycleState.CRASH_DETECTED
                updateDiagnostics("CRASH_DETECTED | ${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", crashedValue)} | DEBOUNCING")

                enqueueCrashCandidate(
                    detection = detection,
                    multiplier = crashedValue,
                    colorHex = detection.liveColorHex ?: lastFlightColorHex,
                    isPixelVerified = detection.isLiveColorPixelVerified || lastFlightColorVerified,
                    nowMs = nowMs
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private fun enqueueCrashCandidate(
        detection: GameDetectionState,
        multiplier: Double,
        colorHex: String?,
        isPixelVerified: Boolean,
        nowMs: Long
    ) {
        if (roundSequence <= 0) {
            roundSequence = 1
        }
        val cleanRoundId = detection.roundId?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
        val cleanGameId = detection.gameId.ifBlank { "unknown" }
        val cleanGameName = detection.displayedGameName.ifBlank { "Unknown" }
        val dedupKey = CrashRecord.buildLiveRoundDedupKey(
            sessionId = activeSessionId,
            gameId = cleanGameId,
            roundIdentifier = cleanRoundId,
            sequenceIndex = roundSequence
        )
        if (recordedDedupKeysInSession.contains(dedupKey)) {
            duplicatesIgnoredCount++
            updateDiagnostics("REPEATED_CALLBACK | DUPLICATE_IGNORED ($dedupKey)")
            return
        }

        val fallbackCat = ColorClassifier.fallbackCategoryForMultiplier(
            multiplier = multiplier,
            lowThreshold = currentLowThreshold,
            bigThreshold = currentBigThreshold
        )
        val resolvedHex = colorHex?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: fallbackCat.defaultHex
        val resolvedCat = if (isPixelVerified) ColorClassifier.classifyHex(resolvedHex) else fallbackCat

        val candidate = PendingCrashCandidate(
            sessionId = activeSessionId,
            gameId = cleanGameId,
            gameName = cleanGameName,
            platformName = detection.platformName.ifBlank { "Unknown" },
            sourcePackage = detection.foregroundPackage,
            multiplier = multiplier,
            roundId = cleanRoundId,
            roundSequence = roundSequence,
            colorHex = resolvedHex,
            colorCategory = resolvedCat,
            isPixelVerified = isPixelVerified,
            detectedAtMs = nowMs,
            dedupKey = dedupKey
        )
        latestPendingCandidate = candidate
        pendingCrashFlow.tryEmit(candidate)
    }

    /**
     * Flushes any pending debounced crash candidate immediately (used on clean round transition or tests).
     */
    suspend fun flushPendingNow() {
        pipelineMutex.withLock {
            val pending = latestPendingCandidate ?: return@withLock
            confirmAndEmitCandidateLocked(pending)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun confirmAndEmitCandidateLocked(candidate: PendingCrashCandidate) {
        if (candidate.sessionId != activeSessionId || activeSessionId.isBlank()) {
            return
        }
        if (recordedDedupKeysInSession.contains(candidate.dedupKey)) {
            latestPendingCandidate = null
            duplicatesIgnoredCount++
            updateDiagnostics("REPEATED_CALLBACK | DUPLICATE_IGNORED (${candidate.dedupKey})")
            return
        }

        latestPendingCandidate = null
        _lifecycleState.value = RoundLifecycleState.FINAL_MULTIPLIER_CONFIRMED

        recordedDedupKeysInSession.add(candidate.dedupKey)
        activeRoundRecorded = true
        lastRecordedRoundId = candidate.roundId
        lastRecordedDedupKey = candidate.dedupKey
        lastFlightPeakMultiplier = null
        lastFlightColorHex = null
        lastFlightColorVerified = false

        val crashRecord = CrashRecord(
            gameId = candidate.gameId,
            gameName = candidate.gameName,
            multiplier = candidate.multiplier,
            detectedColorHex = candidate.colorHex,
            colorCategory = candidate.colorCategory,
            isPixelColorVerified = candidate.isPixelVerified,
            crashTimestamp = candidate.detectedAtMs,
            hourStartTimestamp = CalendarHourUtils.hourStartFor(candidate.detectedAtMs),
            sourcePackage = candidate.sourcePackage,
            roundIdentifier = candidate.roundId ?: "#${candidate.roundSequence}",
            confidence = 0f,
            manuallyCorrected = false,
            collectionSource = CollectionSource.LIVE,
            sessionId = candidate.sessionId,
            isConfirmed = true,
            dedupKey = candidate.dedupKey
        )

        val multiplierRecord = MultiplierRecord(
            gameId = candidate.gameId,
            sessionId = candidate.sessionId,
            roundId = candidate.roundId ?: "#${candidate.roundSequence}",
            multiplier = candidate.multiplier,
            gameTimestampMs = null,
            observationTimestampMs = candidate.detectedAtMs,
            crashTimestamp = candidate.detectedAtMs,
            platform = candidate.platformName,
            isConfirmed = true,
            timestampSource = TimestampSource.LOCAL_OBSERVATION,
            collectionSource = CollectionSource.LIVE,
            collectionStatus = HistoryCollectionStatus.HISTORY_PARTIAL,
            dedupKey = candidate.dedupKey,
            sequenceIndex = candidate.roundSequence,
            hasGapBefore = false
        )

        _lifecycleState.value = RoundLifecycleState.ROUND_RECORDED
        updateDiagnostics(
            "ROUND_RECORDED | seq=${candidate.roundSequence} | ${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", candidate.multiplier)} | key=${candidate.dedupKey}"
        )
        safeLogD(TAG, "ROUND_RECORDED | ${candidate.dedupKey} | ${candidate.multiplier}x")

        onConfirmedCrash(
            ConfirmedCrashEmission(
                multiplier = candidate.multiplier,
                crashRecord = crashRecord,
                multiplierRecord = multiplierRecord
            )
        )
    }

    fun getCurrentRoundSequence(): Int = roundSequence

    private fun updateDiagnostics(summary: String) {
        _diagnostics.value = LiveCrashPipelineDiagnostics(
            lifecycleState = _lifecycleState.value,
            lastEventSummary = summary,
            roundSequence = roundSequence,
            duplicatesIgnoredCount = duplicatesIgnoredCount,
            historyBlocksCount = historyBlocksCount
        )
    }

    private fun safeLogD(tag: String, msg: String) {
        try {
            Log.d(tag, msg)
        } catch (_: RuntimeException) {
        }
    }
}

package com.example.data.engine

import com.example.data.model.MultiplierRecord
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

enum class TimeWindowFilter(val label: String, val durationMinutes: Int) {
    THIRTY_MINUTES("30m", 30),
    ONE_HOUR("1h", 60),
    THREE_HOURS("3h", 180),
    FIVE_HOURS("5h", 300);

    val durationMs: Long get() = durationMinutes * 60_000L
}

data class WindowStatistics(
    val window: TimeWindowFilter,
    val totalRounds: Int,
    val below2xCount: Int,
    val below2xRecords: List<MultiplierRecord>,
    val above50xCount: Int,
    val above50xRecords: List<MultiplierRecord>,
    val above100xCount: Int,
    val above100xRecords: List<MultiplierRecord>
)

data class BigMultiplierSpotlight(
    val highestMultiplier: Double,
    val crashTimestamp: Long,
    val platform: String
)

object MultiplierHistoryAnalyzer {

    fun filterRecordsByWindow(
        records: List<MultiplierRecord>,
        window: TimeWindowFilter,
        nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): List<MultiplierRecord> {
        val cutoff = nowMs - window.durationMs
        return records
            .filter { it.crashTimestamp in cutoff..nowMs }
            .sortedByDescending { it.crashTimestamp }
    }

    fun analyzeWindow(
        records: List<MultiplierRecord>,
        window: TimeWindowFilter,
        nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): WindowStatistics {
        val windowRecords = filterRecordsByWindow(records, window, nowMs)
        val below2x = windowRecords.filter { it.multiplier < 2.00 }
        val above50x = windowRecords.filter { it.multiplier > 50.00 }
        val above100x = windowRecords.filter { it.multiplier > 100.00 }

        return WindowStatistics(
            window = window,
            totalRounds = windowRecords.size,
            below2xCount = below2x.size,
            below2xRecords = below2x,
            above50xCount = above50x.size,
            above50xRecords = above50x,
            above100xCount = above100x.size,
            above100xRecords = above100x
        )
    }

    fun getLastHourSpotlight(
        records: List<MultiplierRecord>,
        nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): BigMultiplierSpotlight? {
        val lastHourRecords = filterRecordsByWindow(records, TimeWindowFilter.ONE_HOUR, nowMs)
        val peak = lastHourRecords.maxByOrNull { it.multiplier } ?: return null
        return BigMultiplierSpotlight(
            highestMultiplier = peak.multiplier,
            crashTimestamp = peak.crashTimestamp,
            platform = peak.platform
        )
    }

    fun formatTimestamp(timestampMs: Long): String {
        val sdf = SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault())
        return sdf.format(Date(timestampMs))
    }

    fun formatFullTimestamp(timestampMs: Long): String {
        val sdf = SimpleDateFormat("MMM dd, HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault())
        return sdf.format(Date(timestampMs))
    }
}

package com.example.data.engine

import com.example.data.model.StrategyConfig
import java.util.Calendar
import java.util.Locale

data class ScheduleEvaluation(
    val isScheduleEnabled: Boolean,
    val isWithinOperatingHours: Boolean,
    val formattedWindow: String
) {
    val standbyBanner: String
        get() = "Standby — Outside scheduled hours ($formattedWindow)"
}

object OperatingScheduleEvaluator {

    fun formatTime(hour: Int, minute: Int): String {
        val h = hour.coerceIn(0, 23)
        val m = minute.coerceIn(0, 59)
        return String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d", h, m)
    }

    fun formatWindow(startHour: Int, startMinute: Int, endHour: Int, endMinute: Int): String {
        return "${formatTime(startHour, startMinute)}–${formatTime(endHour, endMinute)}"
    }

    fun isWithinOperatingHours(
        scheduleEnabled: Boolean,
        startHour: Int,
        startMinute: Int,
        endHour: Int,
        endMinute: Int,
        currentTimeMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): Boolean {
        if (!scheduleEnabled) return true
        val cal = Calendar.getInstance().apply { timeInMillis = currentTimeMs }
        val nowMins = cal.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY) * 60 + cal.get(Calendar.MINUTE)
        return isMinuteOfDayWithinWindow(
            minuteOfDay = nowMins,
            startHour = startHour,
            startMinute = startMinute,
            endHour = endHour,
            endMinute = endMinute
        )
    }

    fun isMinuteOfDayWithinWindow(
        minuteOfDay: Int,
        startHour: Int,
        startMinute: Int,
        endHour: Int,
        endMinute: Int
    ): Boolean {
        val now = minuteOfDay.coerceIn(0, 24 * 60 - 1)
        val start = startHour.coerceIn(0, 23) * 60 + startMinute.coerceIn(0, 59)
        val end = endHour.coerceIn(0, 23) * 60 + endMinute.coerceIn(0, 59)

        return when {
            start == end -> true // Identical start/end implies 24h continuous window
            start < end -> now in start until end
            else -> now >= start || now < end // Overnight window e.g. 22:00 - 04:00
        }
    }

    fun evaluate(config: StrategyConfig, currentTimeMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): ScheduleEvaluation {
        val window = formatWindow(
            config.scheduleStartHour,
            config.scheduleStartMinute,
            config.scheduleEndHour,
            config.scheduleEndMinute
        )
        val active = isWithinOperatingHours(
            scheduleEnabled = config.scheduleEnabled,
            startHour = config.scheduleStartHour,
            startMinute = config.scheduleStartMinute,
            endHour = config.scheduleEndHour,
            endMinute = config.scheduleEndMinute,
            currentTimeMs = currentTimeMs
        )
        return ScheduleEvaluation(
            isScheduleEnabled = config.scheduleEnabled,
            isWithinOperatingHours = active,
            formattedWindow = window
        )
    }
}
