package com.example.data.engine

import com.example.data.model.RiskLimits
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.max

data class RiskCheckResult(
    val isAllowed: Boolean,
    val violationReason: String? = null
)

class RiskManager {

    /**
     * Checks session-wide Stop if Profit Reaches and Stop if Loss Reaches thresholds.
     */
    fun evaluateSessionLimits(
        currentSessionProfit: Double,
        currentSessionLoss: Double = max(0.0, -currentSessionProfit),
        limits: RiskLimits,
        currentDailyLoss: Double = 0.0
    ): RiskCheckResult {
        if (limits.emergencyStop) {
            return RiskCheckResult(false, "Emergency Stop switch is activated.")
        }

        if (limits.stopOnProfitEnabled && limits.profitTarget > 0.0 && currentSessionProfit >= limits.profitTarget) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Stop if Profit Reaches triggered (+${formatMoney(currentSessionProfit)} >= ${formatMoney(limits.profitTarget)})."
            )
        }

        val effectiveLoss = max(currentSessionLoss, max(0.0, -currentSessionProfit))
        if (limits.stopOnLossEnabled && limits.maxSessionLoss > 0.0 && effectiveLoss >= limits.maxSessionLoss) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Stop if Loss Reaches triggered (-${formatMoney(effectiveLoss)} >= ${formatMoney(limits.maxSessionLoss)})."
            )
        }

        if (limits.stopOnLossEnabled && limits.maxDailyLoss > 0.0 && currentDailyLoss >= limits.maxDailyLoss) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Daily loss limit reached (-${formatMoney(currentDailyLoss)} >= ${formatMoney(limits.maxDailyLoss)})."
            )
        }

        return RiskCheckResult(true, null)
    }

    fun validateBetExecution(
        proposedStake: Double,
        currentSessionLoss: Double,
        currentRounds: Int,
        currentProgressionLevel: Int,
        currentBalance: Double,
        limits: RiskLimits,
        currentSessionProfit: Double = 0.0,
        balanceStatus: com.example.data.model.BalanceDetectionStatus = com.example.data.model.BalanceDetectionStatus.VERIFIED,
        balanceFailureReason: String? = null,
        currentDailyLoss: Double = 0.0,
        currentSequenceExposure: Double = proposedStake
    ): RiskCheckResult {
        val sessionLimitCheck = evaluateSessionLimits(
            currentSessionProfit = currentSessionProfit,
            currentSessionLoss = currentSessionLoss,
            limits = limits,
            currentDailyLoss = currentDailyLoss
        )
        if (!sessionLimitCheck.isAllowed) {
            return sessionLimitCheck
        }

        if (balanceStatus == com.example.data.model.BalanceDetectionStatus.UNAVAILABLE) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Cannot place bet: Balance is UNAVAILABLE (${balanceFailureReason ?: "Not visible on screen"})."
            )
        }

        if (balanceStatus == com.example.data.model.BalanceDetectionStatus.SCANNING) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Cannot place bet: Balance is still SCANNING. Waiting for verified reading."
            )
        }

        if (balanceStatus == com.example.data.model.BalanceDetectionStatus.STALE) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Cannot place bet: Balance reading is STALE (${balanceFailureReason ?: "Needs refresh"})."
            )
        }

        if (balanceStatus != com.example.data.model.BalanceDetectionStatus.VERIFIED &&
            balanceStatus != com.example.data.model.BalanceDetectionStatus.DETECTED
        ) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Cannot place bet: Verified account balance is unavailable (${balanceFailureReason ?: balanceStatus.name})."
            )
        }

        if (!currentBalance.isFinite() || currentBalance < 0.0) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Cannot place bet: Verified account balance is unavailable ($currentBalance)."
            )
        }

        if (proposedStake > limits.maxSingleStake) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Proposed stake (${formatMoney(proposedStake)}) exceeds Max Single Stake (${formatMoney(limits.maxSingleStake)})."
            )
        }

        if (limits.maxSequenceExposure > 0.0 && currentSequenceExposure > limits.maxSequenceExposure) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Sequence exposure (${formatMoney(currentSequenceExposure)}) exceeds Max Sequence Exposure (${formatMoney(limits.maxSequenceExposure)})."
            )
        }

        val effectiveLoss = max(currentSessionLoss, max(0.0, -currentSessionProfit))
        if (limits.stopOnLossEnabled && limits.maxSessionLoss > 0.0 && (effectiveLoss + proposedStake) > limits.maxSessionLoss) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Potential loss exceeds Stop if Loss Reaches limit (${formatMoney(limits.maxSessionLoss)})."
            )
        }

        if (limits.stopOnLossEnabled && limits.maxDailyLoss > 0.0 && (currentDailyLoss + proposedStake) > limits.maxDailyLoss) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Potential loss exceeds Daily Loss limit (${formatMoney(limits.maxDailyLoss)})."
            )
        }

        if (currentRounds >= limits.maxTotalRounds) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Session round limit reached (${limits.maxTotalRounds} rounds max)."
            )
        }

        if (currentProgressionLevel > limits.maxProgressionLevel) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Maximum stake progression level (${limits.maxProgressionLevel}) reached."
            )
        }

        if (currentBalance < proposedStake) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Insufficient balance (${formatMoney(currentBalance)}) for required stake (${formatMoney(proposedStake)})."
            )
        }

        val requiredReserve = max(limits.minBalanceThreshold, limits.safetyReserveAmount)
        if ((currentBalance - proposedStake) < requiredReserve) {
            return RiskCheckResult(
                false,
                "Balance would drop below protected reserve (${formatMoney(requiredReserve)})."
            )
        }

        return RiskCheckResult(true, null)
    }

    private fun formatMoney(value: Double): String = CurrencyManager.formatAmount(value)
}

package com.example.data.engine

import com.example.data.model.CalendarHourUtils
import com.example.data.model.CustomPatternStrategy
import com.example.data.model.GameState
import com.example.data.model.PatternOccurrenceRecord
import com.example.data.model.StrategyConfig
import java.util.Locale

data class SmartStrategyBreakdown(
    val strategyName: String,
    val ruleExplanation: String,
    val hourlyProgressText: String,
    val streakProgressText: String,
    val timestampsSummary: String,
    val remainingToTriggerText: String
)

data class SmartAgentExplanation(
    val gameName: String,
    val liveStatusLine: String,
    val sampleConfidenceLabel: String,
    val windowComparisonText: String,
    val strategyBreakdowns: List<SmartStrategyBreakdown>,
    val integrityDisclaimer: String = "Statistical observation only — patterns summarize completed rounds and never guarantee future outcomes."
)

/**
 * Generates plain-language, strictly factual explanations of active strategies,
 * occurrence counts, exact timestamps, streaks, and 30m vs. hourly comparisons
 * purely from real saved CrashRecords and live state.
 */
object SmartAnalysisAgent {

    fun generateExplanation(
        gameState: GameState,
        strategies: List<CustomPatternStrategy>,
        report: StatisticalReport,
        hourlyBundle: MultiWindowAnalysisBundle,
        occurrences: List<PatternOccurrenceRecord>,
        config: StrategyConfig,
        nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): SmartAgentExplanation {
        val enabledStrategies = strategies.filter { it.isEnabled }
        val breakdowns = enabledStrategies.map { strat ->
            val telemetry = StatisticalAnalysisEngine.buildStrategyTelemetry(
                strategy = strat,
                occurrences = occurrences,
                report = report,
                config = config,
                nowMs = nowMs
            )

            val firstStr = telemetry.firstOccurrenceMs?.let { CalendarHourUtils.formatExactTime(it) } ?: "None yet"
            val lastStr = telemetry.mostRecentOccurrenceMs?.let { CalendarHourUtils.formatExactTime(it) } ?: "None yet"

            SmartStrategyBreakdown(
                strategyName = strat.name,
                ruleExplanation = strat.summaryDescription(),
                hourlyProgressText = "${telemetry.currentHourOccurrences} of ${telemetry.requiredPerHour} observed in current hour",
                streakProgressText = "${telemetry.currentConsecutiveSequence} of ${telemetry.targetSequenceLength} active sequence",
                timestampsSummary = "First: $firstStr · Latest: $lastStr (Total recorded: ${telemetry.totalOccurrences})",
                remainingToTriggerText = if (telemetry.remainingToTrigger == 0) {
                    "Condition threshold met in completed rounds"
                } else {
                    "${telemetry.remainingToTrigger} remaining to match rule"
                }
            )
        }

        val r30 = hourlyBundle.rolling30m
        val curHr = hourlyBundle.currentHour
        val comparisonText = buildString {
            append("30m Rolling: ${r30.totalRounds} rounds (${HourlyAnalysisEngine.formatPercent(r30.lowPct)} <${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", config.lowThreshold)}, longest chain ${r30.longestConsecutiveLowStreak}). ")
            append("Current Hour: ${curHr.totalRounds} rounds (${HourlyAnalysisEngine.formatPercent(curHr.lowPct)} low, longest chain ${curHr.longestConsecutiveLowStreak}).")
        }

        val sampleConfidence = when {
            curHr.totalRounds < 5 -> "INSUFFICIENT DATA (${curHr.totalRounds} completed rounds this hour)"
            curHr.totalRounds < 20 -> "Low sample (${curHr.totalRounds} rounds) — building hour baseline"
            curHr.totalRounds < 50 -> "Moderate sample (${curHr.totalRounds} rounds)"
            else -> "High sample (${curHr.totalRounds} completed rounds)"
        }

        val liveStatus = when {
            gameState.isStandbyOutsideSchedule -> gameState.scheduleStandbyMessage ?: "Standby — Outside scheduled hours"
            gameState.liveDetectionLost -> "LIVE DETECTION LOST — Re-scanning displayed game content"
            !gameState.isDetected -> gameState.pipelineStatus.displayLabel
            else -> "${gameState.displayedGameName} · ${gameState.pipelineStatus.displayLabel}"
        }

        return SmartAgentExplanation(
            gameName = gameState.displayedGameName,
            liveStatusLine = liveStatus,
            sampleConfidenceLabel = sampleConfidence,
            windowComparisonText = comparisonText,
            strategyBreakdowns = breakdowns
        )
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/data/engine/StatisticalAnalysisEngine.kt

package com.example.data.engine

import com.example.data.model.CalendarHourUtils
import com.example.data.model.CrashColorCategory
import com.example.data.model.CrashRecord
import com.example.data.model.CustomPatternStrategy
import com.example.data.model.PatternOccurrenceRecord
import com.example.data.model.StrategyConfig
import com.example.data.model.StrategyMode
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.abs

enum class MultiplierBucket(val label: String) {
    LOW("Low (< threshold)"),
    BOUNDARY("Boundary (== threshold)"),
    MEDIUM("Medium"),
    BIG("Big Multiplier")
}

data class BigMultiplierGap(
    val firstTimestampMs: Long,
    val firstMultiplier: Double,
    val secondTimestampMs: Long,
    val secondMultiplier: Double,
    val gapMinutes: Double,
    val isWithinQualifyingRange: Boolean
)

data class StrategyOccurrenceTelemetry(
    val strategyId: Long,
    val strategyName: String,
    val gameId: String,
    val totalOccurrences: Int,
    val currentHourOccurrences: Int,
    val requiredPerHour: Int,
    val firstOccurrenceMs: Long?,
    val mostRecentOccurrenceMs: Long?,
    val averageIntervalMs: Long?,
    val shortestIntervalMs: Long?,
    val longestIntervalMs: Long?,
    val currentConsecutiveSequence: Int,
    val targetSequenceLength: Int,
    val remainingToTrigger: Int
)

data class StatisticalReport(
    val gameId: String,
    val gameName: String,
    val totalCompletedRounds: Int,
    val lowCount: Int,
    val boundaryCount: Int,
    val mediumCount: Int,
    val bigCount: Int,
    val currentConsecutiveLows: Int,
    val longestConsecutiveLows: Int,
    val bigMultiplierCount: Int,
    val bigMultiplierClusters: Int,
    val bigMultiplierGaps: List<BigMultiplierGap>,
    val currentAlternatingLowMedLength: Int,
    val maxAlternatingLowMedLength: Int,
    val lowsBeforeBigCounts: List<Int>,
    val trailingColorCategories: List<CrashColorCategory>,
    val colorDistribution: Map<CrashColorCategory, Int>,
    val topRepeatedColorSequences: List<Pair<String, Int>>,
    val sampleSufficient: Boolean,
    val factualSummary: String
)

/**
 * Pure statistical pattern analysis engine operating exclusively on completed [CrashRecord] entries.
 * Never consumes live climbing multipliers and never makes predictive claims about future rounds.
 */
object StatisticalAnalysisEngine {

    private const val MIN_SUFFICIENT_SAMPLE = 5

    fun classifyBucket(
        multiplier: Double,
        lowThreshold: Double = 2.00,
        boundaryValue: Double = 2.00,
        bigThreshold: Double = 10.00
    ): MultiplierBucket {
        return when {
            abs(multiplier - boundaryValue) <= 0.0001 -> MultiplierBucket.BOUNDARY
            multiplier < lowThreshold -> MultiplierBucket.LOW
            multiplier >= bigThreshold -> MultiplierBucket.BIG
            else -> MultiplierBucket.MEDIUM
        }
    }

    fun analyzeCompletedCrashes(
        records: List<CrashRecord>,
        config: StrategyConfig = StrategyConfig(),
        minBigGapMinutes: Int = 5,
        maxBigGapMinutes: Int = 15,
        gameId: String = "ALL",
        gameName: String = "All Games"
    ): StatisticalReport {
        val lowTh = config.lowThreshold.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 1.01 } ?: 2.00
        val boundaryVal = config.boundaryValue.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 1.00 } ?: 2.00
        val bigTh = config.bigThreshold.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it > lowTh } ?: 10.00

        val scoped = if (gameId == "ALL") records else records.filter { it.gameId == gameId }
        val sorted = scoped.sortedWith(compareBy({ it.crashTimestamp }, { it.id }))

        if (sorted.isEmpty()) {
            return StatisticalReport(
                gameId = gameId,
                gameName = gameName,
                totalCompletedRounds = 0,
                lowCount = 0,
                boundaryCount = 0,
                mediumCount = 0,
                bigCount = 0,
                currentConsecutiveLows = 0,
                longestConsecutiveLows = 0,
                bigMultiplierCount = 0,
                bigMultiplierClusters = 0,
                bigMultiplierGaps = emptyList(),
                currentAlternatingLowMedLength = 0,
                maxAlternatingLowMedLength = 0,
                lowsBeforeBigCounts = emptyList(),
                trailingColorCategories = emptyList(),
                colorDistribution = emptyMap(),
                topRepeatedColorSequences = emptyList(),
                sampleSufficient = false,
                factualSummary = "INSUFFICIENT DATA — Waiting for completed crash rounds."
            )
        }

        var lowCount = 0
        var boundaryCount = 0
        var mediumCount = 0
        var bigCount = 0

        var runningLowStreak = 0
        var longestLowStreak = 0
        var lowsBeforeCurrentBig = 0
        val lowsBeforeBig = mutableListOf<Int>()

        var bigClusters = 0
        var prevWasBig = false
        val bigRecords = mutableListOf<CrashRecord>()

        val colorCounts = linkedMapOf<CrashColorCategory, Int>()

        // Alternating Low / Medium run tracker
        var altLength = 0
        var maxAltLength = 0
        var lastAltWasLow: Boolean? = null

        for (rec in sorted) {
            colorCounts[rec.colorCategory] = (colorCounts[rec.colorCategory] ?: 0) + 1
            val bucket = classifyBucket(rec.multiplier, lowTh, boundaryVal, bigTh)
            when (bucket) {
                MultiplierBucket.LOW -> {
                    lowCount++
                    runningLowStreak++
                    if (runningLowStreak > longestLowStreak) longestLowStreak = runningLowStreak
                    lowsBeforeCurrentBig++
                    prevWasBig = false
                    if (lastAltWasLow == false) {
                        altLength++
                    } else if (lastAltWasLow == null) {
                        altLength = 1
                    } else {
                        altLength = 1
                    }
                    lastAltWasLow = true
                    if (altLength > maxAltLength) maxAltLength = altLength
                }
                MultiplierBucket.BOUNDARY -> {
                    boundaryCount++
                    runningLowStreak = 0
                    lowsBeforeCurrentBig = 0
                    prevWasBig = false
                    altLength = 0
                    lastAltWasLow = null
                }
                MultiplierBucket.MEDIUM -> {
                    mediumCount++
                    runningLowStreak = 0
                    lowsBeforeCurrentBig = 0
                    prevWasBig = false
                    if (lastAltWasLow == true) {
                        altLength++
                    } else {
                        altLength = 1
                    }
                    lastAltWasLow = false
                    if (altLength > maxAltLength) maxAltLength = altLength
                }
                MultiplierBucket.BIG -> {
                    bigCount++
                    bigRecords.add(rec)
                    if (!prevWasBig) {
                        lowsBeforeBig.add(lowsBeforeCurrentBig)
                    } else {
                        bigClusters++
                    }
                    prevWasBig = true
                    runningLowStreak = 0
                    lowsBeforeCurrentBig = 0
                    altLength = 0
                    lastAltWasLow = null
                }
            }
        }

        val bigGaps = mutableListOf<BigMultiplierGap>()
        for (i in 1 until bigRecords.size) {
            val prev = bigRecords[i - 1]
            val curr = bigRecords[i]
            val gapMin = ((curr.crashTimestamp - prev.crashTimestamp).coerceAtLeast(0L)) / 60_000.0
            bigGaps.add(
                BigMultiplierGap(
                    firstTimestampMs = prev.crashTimestamp,
                    firstMultiplier = prev.multiplier,
                    secondTimestampMs = curr.crashTimestamp,
                    secondMultiplier = curr.multiplier,
                    gapMinutes = gapMin,
                    isWithinQualifyingRange = gapMin in minBigGapMinutes.toDouble()..maxBigGapMinutes.toDouble()
                )
            )
        }

        // Repeated 3-color motif frequency across actual color sequence
        val colorTriples = linkedMapOf<String, Int>()
        if (sorted.size >= 3) {
            for (i in 0..(sorted.size - 3)) {
                val seqKey = "${sorted[i].colorCategory.displayName}->${sorted[i + 1].colorCategory.displayName}->${sorted[i + 2].colorCategory.displayName}"
                colorTriples[seqKey] = (colorTriples[seqKey] ?: 0) + 1
            }
        }
        val topColors = colorTriples.entries
            .filter { it.value >= 1 }
            .sortedByDescending { it.value }
            .take(5)
            .map { it.key to it.value }

        val sampleOk = sorted.size >= MIN_SUFFICIENT_SAMPLE
        val summary = buildString {
            append("Observed ${sorted.size} completed rounds: ")
            append("$lowCount low (<${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", lowTh)}), ")
            append("$mediumCount medium, $bigCount big (>=${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", bigTh)}). ")
            append("Current consecutive low chain: $runningLowStreak (longest observed: $longestLowStreak).")
            if (!sampleOk) {
                append(" INSUFFICIENT DATA for stable trend baselines (< $MIN_SUFFICIENT_SAMPLE rounds).")
            }
        }

        return StatisticalReport(
            gameId = gameId,
            gameName = gameName,
            totalCompletedRounds = sorted.size,
            lowCount = lowCount,
            boundaryCount = boundaryCount,
            mediumCount = mediumCount,
            bigCount = bigCount,
            currentConsecutiveLows = runningLowStreak,
            longestConsecutiveLows = longestLowStreak,
            bigMultiplierCount = bigCount,
            bigMultiplierClusters = bigClusters,
            bigMultiplierGaps = bigGaps,
            currentAlternatingLowMedLength = altLength,
            maxAlternatingLowMedLength = maxAltLength,
            lowsBeforeBigCounts = lowsBeforeBig,
            trailingColorCategories = sorted.takeLast(8).map { it.colorCategory },
            colorDistribution = colorCounts,
            topRepeatedColorSequences = topColors,
            sampleSufficient = sampleOk,
            factualSummary = summary
        )
    }

    fun buildStrategyTelemetry(
        strategy: CustomPatternStrategy,
        occurrences: List<PatternOccurrenceRecord>,
        report: StatisticalReport,
        config: StrategyConfig,
        nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): StrategyOccurrenceTelemetry {
        val currentHourStart = CalendarHourUtils.hourStartFor(nowMs)
        val scopedOccurrences = occurrences
            .filter { it.strategyId == strategy.id && (strategy.targetGameId == "ALL" || it.gameId == strategy.targetGameId) }
            .sortedBy { it.triggerTimestampMs }

        val hourOccurrences = scopedOccurrences.count { it.hourStartTimestamp == currentHourStart }
        val firstTs = scopedOccurrences.firstOrNull()?.triggerTimestampMs
        val lastTs = scopedOccurrences.lastOrNull()?.triggerTimestampMs

        val gaps = mutableListOf<Long>()
        for (i in 1 until scopedOccurrences.size) {
            val delta = (scopedOccurrences[i].triggerTimestampMs - scopedOccurrences[i - 1].triggerTimestampMs).coerceAtLeast(0L)
            gaps.add(delta)
        }

        val targetSeq = when (strategy.strategyMode) {
            StrategyMode.STRATEGY_A_CONSECUTIVE_LOWS ->
                strategy.getConditions().firstOrNull()?.consecutiveRounds ?: 14
            StrategyMode.STRATEGY_B_BIG_INTERVALS -> 2
            StrategyMode.STRATEGY_C_COLOR_PATTERNS ->
                strategy.getColorSequence().size.coerceAtLeast(1)
            StrategyMode.CUSTOM_CONDITION ->
                strategy.getConditions().firstOrNull()?.consecutiveRounds ?: 1
        }

        val currentSeq = when (strategy.strategyMode) {
            StrategyMode.STRATEGY_A_CONSECUTIVE_LOWS -> report.currentConsecutiveLows
            StrategyMode.STRATEGY_C_COLOR_PATTERNS -> {
                val pattern = strategy.getColorSequence()
                val tail = report.trailingColorCategories
                var matched = 0
                if (pattern.isNotEmpty() && tail.isNotEmpty()) {
                    for (len in minOf(pattern.size, tail.size) downTo 1) {
                        if (tail.takeLast(len) == pattern.take(len)) {
                            matched = len
                            break
                        }
                    }
                }
                matched
            }
            StrategyMode.STRATEGY_B_BIG_INTERVALS ->
                report.bigMultiplierGaps.count {
                    it.gapMinutes in strategy.minIntervalMinutes.toDouble()..strategy.maxIntervalMinutes.toDouble()
                }.coerceAtMost(2)
            StrategyMode.CUSTOM_CONDITION -> report.currentConsecutiveLows
        }

        val remaining = (targetSeq - currentSeq).coerceAtLeast(0)

        return StrategyOccurrenceTelemetry(
            strategyId = strategy.id,
            strategyName = strategy.name,
            gameId = report.gameId,
            totalOccurrences = scopedOccurrences.size,
            currentHourOccurrences = hourOccurrences,
            requiredPerHour = strategy.requiredOccurrencesPerHour.coerceAtLeast(1),
            firstOccurrenceMs = firstTs,
            mostRecentOccurrenceMs = lastTs,
            averageIntervalMs = if (gaps.isEmpty()) null else gaps.average().toLong(),
            shortestIntervalMs = gaps.minOrNull(),
            longestIntervalMs = gaps.maxOrNull(),
            currentConsecutiveSequence = currentSeq,
            targetSequenceLength = targetSeq,
            remainingToTrigger = remaining
        )
    }
}


====================================================================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/example/data/engine/StrategyEngine.kt
====================================================================================================

package com.example.data.engine

import android.util.Log
import com.example.data.model.StakeProgressionMode
import com.example.data.model.StrategyConfig
import com.example.data.model.StrategyRuleConfig
import com.example.data.model.StrategyRuleId
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import java.util.Calendar
import java.util.Locale

sealed class StrategyTrigger {
    object None : StrategyTrigger()
    data class Strategy1Fired(val consecutiveLowRounds: Int) : StrategyTrigger()
    data class Strategy2Fired(val waitRoundsCompleted: Int, val initialHighMultiplier: Double) : StrategyTrigger()
    data class HighMultiplierLossTrigger(val multiplier: Double, val doubledStake: Double) : StrategyTrigger()
    data class LossRecoveryFired(
        val ruleConfig: StrategyRuleConfig,
        val observedLosses: Int
    ) : StrategyTrigger()
    data class RangeWaitStarted(
        val ruleConfig: StrategyRuleConfig,
        val observedMultiplier: Double,
        val waitUntilTimestamp: Long
    ) : StrategyTrigger()
    data class WaitTimerCompleted(
        val ruleConfig: StrategyRuleConfig
    ) : StrategyTrigger()
    data class SessionTimedOut(
        val previousRuleName: String,
        val elapsedMs: Long
    ) : StrategyTrigger()
}

data class StrategyState(
    val consecutiveLowCount: Int = 0,
    val consecutiveObservedLosses: Int = 0,
    val postHighWaitCount: Int = 0,
    val lastHighMultiplier: Double = 0.0,
    val isWaitingForPostHigh: Boolean = false,
    val activeTrigger: StrategyTrigger = StrategyTrigger.None,
    val activeRuleId: StrategyRuleId? = null,
    val activeRuleLabel: String? = null,
    val activeProgressionMode: StakeProgressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.DISABLED,
    val activeCustomAddAmount: Double = 10.0,
    val targetWinsToFetch: Int = 2,
    val pendingWaitRuleId: StrategyRuleId? = null,
    val pendingWaitRuleLabel: String? = null,
    val waitUntilTimestamp: Long = 0L,
    val activeWaitRemainingMs: Long = 0L,
    val isBettingSessionActive: Boolean = false,
    val sessionStartedTimestamp: Long = 0L,
    val sessionTimeoutRemainingMs: Long = 0L,
    val currentStakeLevel: Int = 1,
    val consecutiveWinsInSession: Int = 0,
    val consecutiveLossesInSession: Int = 0,
    val currentCalculatedStake: Double = 10.0,
    val highMultiplierLossesInHour: Int = 0,
    val isNearHourEndRuleActive: Boolean = false,
    val enabledRuleIds: Set<StrategyRuleId> = StrategyRuleId.entries.filter { it.defaultEnabled }.toSet()
)

enum class ActionType {
    BET,
    CASH_OUT
}

data class AutomationActionEvent(
    val actionType: ActionType,
    val amountOrMultiplier: Double = 0.0,
    val reason: String = "",
    val timestamp: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
    val eventId: Long = System.nanoTime()
)

/**
 * Snapshot of the calculated stake ready to be passed to AccessibilityController
 * and written into the target betting app UI (or stepped via 2x / + buttons).
 */
data class StakeInstruction(
    val stakeAmount: Double = 10.0,
    val formattedStake: String = "10",
    val progressionMode: StakeProgressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.DISABLED,
    val incrementAmount: Double = 10.0,
    val targetMultiplier: Double = 2.00,
    val stakeLevel: Int = 1,
    val isSessionActive: Boolean = false,
    val reason: String = "Base Stake"
)

class StrategyEngine {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "StrategyEngine"
        const val DEFAULT_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS = 180_000L // 3-minute guard

        private val _actionEvent = MutableStateFlow<AutomationActionEvent?>(null)
        val actionEvent: StateFlow<AutomationActionEvent?> = _actionEvent.asStateFlow()

        private val _latestStakeInstruction = MutableStateFlow(StakeInstruction())
        val latestStakeInstruction: StateFlow<StakeInstruction> = _latestStakeInstruction.asStateFlow()

        fun triggerAction(event: AutomationActionEvent) {
            _actionEvent.value = event
            safeLogI("Automation Action Triggered: ${event.actionType} (${event.amountOrMultiplier}) - ${event.reason}")
        }

        fun roundStake(value: Double): Double {
            return kotlin.math.round(value.coerceAtLeast(0.0) * 100.0) / 100.0
        }

        fun formatStakeAmount(stake: Double): String {
            val rounded = roundStake(stake)
            return if (rounded % 1.0 == 0.0) {
                rounded.toLong().toString()
            } else {
                String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", rounded)
            }
        }

        private fun safeLogI(message: String) {
            try {
                Log.i(TAG, message)
            } catch (_: RuntimeException) {
                // Unit test JVM without Android Log mock
            }
        }

        private fun safeLogW(message: String) {
            try {
                Log.w(TAG, message)
            } catch (_: RuntimeException) {
                // Unit test JVM without Android Log mock
            }
        }
    }

    private var state = StrategyState()
    private var currentStakeInstruction = StakeInstruction()
    private val _boundConfig = MutableStateFlow(StrategyConfig())
    val boundConfig: StateFlow<StrategyConfig> = _boundConfig.asStateFlow()

    private val highMultiplierLossTimestamps = mutableListOf<Long>()
    private var totalRounds: Int = 0
    private var totalWins: Int = 0
    private var totalLosses: Int = 0

    fun getState(): StrategyState = state

    fun getPendingStakeInstruction(): StakeInstruction = currentStakeInstruction

    /**
     * Binds the active StrategyConfig selections (from Settings or Strategy tab) directly to StrategyEngine
     * so single, multi, or all-strategy selections take effect immediately.
     */
    private fun resolveEffectiveProgression(config: StrategyConfig): Pair<StakeProgressionMode, Double> {
        val masterMode = config.resolvedMasterProgressionMode()
        return if (masterMode == StakeProgressionMode.DISABLED) {
            StakeProgressionMode.DISABLED to 0.0
        } else {
            masterMode to roundStake(config.lossProgressionAddAmount.coerceAtLeast(0.0))
        }
    }

    fun bindStrategyConfig(config: StrategyConfig) {
        _boundConfig.value = config
        val enabledIds = config.getRuleConfigs()
            .filter { it.isEnabled }
            .map { it.ruleId }
            .toSet()

        val shouldClearPendingWait = state.pendingWaitRuleId != null && state.pendingWaitRuleId !in enabledIds
        val updatedStake = if (!state.isBettingSessionActive) roundStake(config.baseStake) else state.currentCalculatedStake
        val (masterMode, masterAddAmount) = resolveEffectiveProgression(config)

        state = state.copy(
            enabledRuleIds = enabledIds,
            pendingWaitRuleId = if (shouldClearPendingWait) null else state.pendingWaitRuleId,
            pendingWaitRuleLabel = if (shouldClearPendingWait) null else state.pendingWaitRuleLabel,
            waitUntilTimestamp = if (shouldClearPendingWait) 0L else state.waitUntilTimestamp,
            activeWaitRemainingMs = if (shouldClearPendingWait) 0L else state.activeWaitRemainingMs,
            activeProgressionMode = masterMode,
            activeCustomAddAmount = masterAddAmount,
            currentCalculatedStake = updatedStake
        )

        if (!state.isBettingSessionActive) {
            publishStakeInstruction(
                stake = updatedStake,
                mode = masterMode,
                addAmount = masterAddAmount,
                targetMultiplier = config.targetMultiplier,
                stakeLevel = 1,
                isSessionActive = false,
                reason = if (enabledIds.isEmpty()) "No Recovery Rule Selected" else "${enabledIds.size} Rules Bound"
            )
        }
        safeLogI("Bound ${enabledIds.size} strategy rules to StrategyEngine: $enabledIds (progression=$masterMode)")
    }

    fun updateStrategySelection(
        selectedRuleIds: Set<StrategyRuleId>,
        isStrategy1Enabled: Boolean? = null,
        isStrategy2Enabled: Boolean? = null,
        isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled: Boolean? = null
    ): StrategyConfig {
        val current = _boundConfig.value
        val updatedRules = current.getRuleConfigs().map { rule ->
            rule.copy(isEnabled = rule.ruleId in selectedRuleIds)
        }
        val updatedConfig = current.copy(
            isStrategy1Enabled = isStrategy1Enabled ?: current.isStrategy1Enabled,
            isStrategy2Enabled = isStrategy2Enabled ?: current.isStrategy2Enabled,
            isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled ?: current.isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled
        ).withUpdatedRuleConfigs(updatedRules)
        bindStrategyConfig(updatedConfig)
        return updatedConfig
    }

    /**
     * Core stake calculation after a loss event strictly respecting master StakeProgressionMode
     * (DISABLED stays flat, ADD_AMOUNT adds configured amount, DOUBLE_AMOUNT doubles 2x).
     * Never silently doubles or overrides user settings.
     */
    fun calculateNextStakeAfterLoss(
        currentStake: Double,
        progressionMode: StakeProgressionMode,
        customAddAmount: Double,
        lossMultiplier: Double = 0.0,
        isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled: Boolean = false
    ): Double {
        val safeCurrent = currentStake.coerceAtLeast(0.0)
        val rawNext = when (progressionMode) {
            StakeProgressionMode.DISABLED -> safeCurrent
            StakeProgressionMode.ADD_AMOUNT -> safeCurrent + customAddAmount.coerceAtLeast(0.0)
            StakeProgressionMode.DOUBLE_AMOUNT -> safeCurrent * 2.0
        }
        return roundStake(rawNext)
    }

    private fun publishStakeInstruction(
        stake: Double,
        mode: StakeProgressionMode,
        addAmount: Double,
        targetMultiplier: Double,
        stakeLevel: Int,
        isSessionActive: Boolean,
        reason: String
    ) {
        val rounded = roundStake(stake)
        val instruction = StakeInstruction(
            stakeAmount = rounded,
            formattedStake = formatStakeAmount(rounded),
            progressionMode = mode,
            incrementAmount = roundStake(addAmount),
            targetMultiplier = targetMultiplier,
            stakeLevel = stakeLevel,
            isSessionActive = isSessionActive,
            reason = reason
        )
        currentStakeInstruction = instruction
        _latestStakeInstruction.value = instruction
    }

    fun cancelPatternSession(reason: String = "Pattern Expired") {
        if (!state.isBettingSessionActive) return
        val cleanBase = roundStake(_boundConfig.value.baseStake)
        val (masterMode, masterAddAmount) = resolveEffectiveProgression(_boundConfig.value)
        state = state.copy(
            isBettingSessionActive = false,
            activeRuleId = null,
            activeRuleLabel = null,
            currentCalculatedStake = cleanBase,
            currentStakeLevel = 1,
            consecutiveWinsInSession = 0,
            consecutiveLossesInSession = 0
        )
        publishStakeInstruction(
            stake = cleanBase,
            mode = masterMode,
            addAmount = masterAddAmount,
            targetMultiplier = _boundConfig.value.targetMultiplier,
            stakeLevel = 1,
            isSessionActive = false,
            reason = reason
        )
        safeLogI("Pattern session cancelled: $reason")
    }

    fun reset(baseStake: Double = _boundConfig.value.baseStake) {
        val cleanBase = roundStake(baseStake)
        val boundEnabledIds = _boundConfig.value.getRuleConfigs()
            .filter { it.isEnabled }
            .map { it.ruleId }
            .toSet()
        val (masterMode, masterAddAmount) = resolveEffectiveProgression(_boundConfig.value)
        state = StrategyState(
            activeProgressionMode = masterMode,
            activeCustomAddAmount = masterAddAmount,
            currentCalculatedStake = cleanBase,
            enabledRuleIds = boundEnabledIds
        )
        highMultiplierLossTimestamps.clear()
        totalRounds = 0
        totalWins = 0
        totalLosses = 0
        publishStakeInstruction(
            stake = cleanBase,
            mode = masterMode,
            addAmount = masterAddAmount,
            targetMultiplier = _boundConfig.value.targetMultiplier,
            stakeLevel = 1,
            isSessionActive = false,
            reason = "Reset to Base Stake"
        )
        safeLogI("Strategy engine reset.")
    }

    /**
     * Checks:
     * 1. 3-minute active session timeout guard: if an active betting session exceeds
     *    config.sessionTimeoutMinutes (default 3m), gracefully terminates the session and resets counters.
     * 2. Pending multiplier-range wait timers (e.g., 5m or 10m) — starts recovery ONLY when unlocked.
     */
    fun checkPendingTimers(
        config: StrategyConfig = _boundConfig.value,
        currentTimeMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): StrategyTrigger {
        val timeoutLimitMs = config.sessionTimeoutMinutes.coerceAtLeast(1) * 60_000L

        // 1. Enforce 3-minute grace period & auto-cancellation on active session
        if (state.isBettingSessionActive && state.sessionStartedTimestamp > 0L) {
            val elapsed = (currentTimeMs - state.sessionStartedTimestamp).coerceAtLeast(0L)
            if (elapsed >= timeoutLimitMs) {
                val timedOutLabel = state.activeRuleLabel ?: state.activeRuleId?.displayName ?: "Active Session"
                safeLogW("3-minute timeout guard triggered for '$timedOutLabel' after ${elapsed}ms. Terminating cycle.")
                val timeoutTrigger = StrategyTrigger.SessionTimedOut(timedOutLabel, elapsed)
                state = state.copy(
                    isBettingSessionActive = false,
                    sessionStartedTimestamp = 0L,
                    sessionTimeoutRemainingMs = 0L,
                    activeRuleId = null,
                    activeRuleLabel = null,
                    activeTrigger = timeoutTrigger,
                    currentStakeLevel = 1,
                    consecutiveWinsInSession = 0,
                    consecutiveLossesInSession = 0,
                    consecutiveObservedLosses = 0,
                    currentCalculatedStake = config.baseStake,
                    consecutiveLowCount = 0,
                    postHighWaitCount = 0
                )
                publishStakeInstruction(
                    stake = config.baseStake,
                    mode = state.activeProgressionMode,
                    addAmount = state.activeCustomAddAmount,
                    targetMultiplier = config.targetMultiplier,
                    stakeLevel = 1,
                    isSessionActive = false,
                    reason = "3m Guard Timed Out -> Reset to Base Stake"
                )
                return timeoutTrigger
            } else {
                state = state.copy(sessionTimeoutRemainingMs = timeoutLimitMs - elapsed)
            }
        }

        // 2. Exclusive lock: if a strategy session is already running, wait before firing another
        if (state.isBettingSessionActive) {
            return StrategyTrigger.None
        }

        // 3. Check multiplier-range wait timer
        val pendingRuleId = state.pendingWaitRuleId ?: return StrategyTrigger.None
        val waitUntil = state.waitUntilTimestamp
        if (waitUntil <= 0L) return StrategyTrigger.None

        val remaining = (waitUntil - currentTimeMs).coerceAtLeast(0L)
        if (remaining > 0L) {
            state = state.copy(activeWaitRemainingMs = remaining)
            return StrategyTrigger.None
        }

        val ruleConfig = config.getRuleConfig(pendingRuleId)
        val trigger = StrategyTrigger.WaitTimerCompleted(ruleConfig)
        val initialStake = roundStake(config.baseStake)
        val (effectiveMode, effectiveAddAmount) = resolveEffectiveProgression(config)

        state = state.copy(
            pendingWaitRuleId = null,
            pendingWaitRuleLabel = null,
            waitUntilTimestamp = 0L,
            activeWaitRemainingMs = 0L,
            activeRuleId = pendingRuleId,
            activeRuleLabel = ruleConfig.dynamicTitle(),
            activeProgressionMode = effectiveMode,
            activeCustomAddAmount = effectiveAddAmount,
            targetWinsToFetch = ruleConfig.targetWinsToFetch,
            activeTrigger = trigger,
            isBettingSessionActive = true,
            sessionStartedTimestamp = currentTimeMs,
            sessionTimeoutRemainingMs = timeoutLimitMs,
            currentCalculatedStake = initialStake,
            consecutiveWinsInSession = 0,
            consecutiveLossesInSession = 0
        )

        publishStakeInstruction(
            stake = initialStake,
            mode = effectiveMode,
            addAmount = effectiveAddAmount,
            targetMultiplier = config.targetMultiplier,
            stakeLevel = 1,
            isSessionActive = true,
            reason = "${ruleConfig.dynamicTitle()} Ready"
        )

        triggerAction(
            AutomationActionEvent(
                actionType = ActionType.BET,
                amountOrMultiplier = initialStake,
                reason = "${ruleConfig.dynamicTitle()} wait elapsed -> Fetch ${ruleConfig.targetWinsToFetch} wins",
                timestamp = currentTimeMs
            )
        )
        return trigger
    }

    /**
     * Activates a betting recovery session when an external CustomPatternStrategy rule fires,
     * respecting the exclusive lock (no-op if a session is already active).
     */
    fun activateExternalPatternTrigger(
        strategyName: String,
        config: StrategyConfig = _boundConfig.value,
        currentTimeMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        progressionModeOverride: StakeProgressionMode? = null,
        customAddAmountOverride: Double? = null,
        targetWinsOverride: Int? = null,
        targetMultiplierOverride: Double? = null
    ): Boolean {
        if (state.isBettingSessionActive) return false
        val firstEnabledRule = config.getRuleConfigs().firstOrNull { it.isEnabled }
        val (mode, addAmt) = resolveEffectiveProgression(config)
        val targetWins = (targetWinsOverride ?: firstEnabledRule?.targetWinsToFetch ?: config.stopAfterConsecutiveWins).coerceAtLeast(1)
        val effectiveTargetMult = (targetMultiplierOverride ?: config.targetMultiplier).coerceAtLeast(1.01)
        val initialStake = roundStake(config.baseStake)
        val timeoutLimitMs = config.sessionTimeoutMinutes.coerceAtLeast(1) * 60_000L

        state = state.copy(
            isBettingSessionActive = true,
            activeRuleId = null,
            activeRuleLabel = strategyName,
            activeProgressionMode = mode,
            activeCustomAddAmount = addAmt,
            targetWinsToFetch = targetWins,
            sessionStartedTimestamp = currentTimeMs,
            sessionTimeoutRemainingMs = timeoutLimitMs,
            currentCalculatedStake = initialStake,
            currentStakeLevel = 1,
            consecutiveWinsInSession = 0,
            consecutiveLossesInSession = 0
        )

        publishStakeInstruction(
            stake = initialStake,
            mode = mode,
            addAmount = addAmt,
            targetMultiplier = effectiveTargetMult,
            stakeLevel = 1,
            isSessionActive = true,
            reason = "$strategyName Triggered"
        )
        triggerAction(
            AutomationActionEvent(
                actionType = ActionType.BET,
                amountOrMultiplier = initialStake,
                reason = "$strategyName matched -> Fetch $targetWins wins",
                timestamp = currentTimeMs
            )
        )
        safeLogI("External pattern strategy '$strategyName' activated betting session (stake=$initialStake)")
        return true
    }

    /**
     * Evaluates completed round multipliers against all rules while strictly enforcing
     * exclusive non-overlapping strategy lock and 3-minute session timeout guard.
     */
    fun processCompletedRound(
        multiplier: Double,
        config: StrategyConfig = _boundConfig.value,
        currentTimeMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): StrategyTrigger {
        totalRounds++

        // Clean up high multiplier loss timestamps older than 1 hour (3600000 ms)
        highMultiplierLossTimestamps.removeAll { currentTimeMs - it > 3_600_000L }

        // Enforce 3-minute timeout guard & check elapsed wait timers first
        val timerTrigger = checkPendingTimers(config, currentTimeMs)
        val timeoutLimitMs = config.sessionTimeoutMinutes.coerceAtLeast(1) * 60_000L

        // Exclusive Lock Check: while a betting session is active, do NOT start or overlap any other strategy
        if (state.isBettingSessionActive) {
            state = state.copy(
                highMultiplierLossesInHour = highMultiplierLossTimestamps.size,
                isNearHourEndRuleActive = shouldContinueBettingBasedOnHourRule(currentTimeMs)
            )
            return StrategyTrigger.None
        }

        var consecutiveLow = state.consecutiveLowCount
        var consecutiveObservedLosses = state.consecutiveObservedLosses
        var postHighWait = state.postHighWaitCount
        var isWaiting = state.isWaitingForPostHigh
        var lastHigh = state.lastHighMultiplier

        // Track consecutive observed losses (< targetMultiplier) while unlocked
        if (multiplier < config.targetMultiplier) {
            consecutiveObservedLosses += 1
        } else {
            consecutiveObservedLosses = 0
        }

        // Strategy 1 Evaluation: Count consecutive rounds < strategy1LowThreshold
        if (config.isStrategy1Enabled && multiplier < config.strategy1LowThreshold) {
            consecutiveLow += 1
        } else {
            consecutiveLow = 0
        }

        // Strategy 2 Evaluation: Detect > strategy2HighThreshold and count wait rounds
        if (config.isStrategy2Enabled) {
            if (multiplier > config.strategy2HighThreshold && !isWaiting) {
                isWaiting = true
                postHighWait = 0
                lastHigh = multiplier
            } else if (isWaiting) {
                postHighWait += 1
            }
        }

        val allRules = config.getRuleConfigs()
        var pendingWaitRuleId = state.pendingWaitRuleId
        var pendingWaitRuleLabel = state.pendingWaitRuleLabel
        var waitUntilTimestamp = state.waitUntilTimestamp

        // Evaluate Multiplier-Range Waiting Rules using editable min/max/waitMinutes
        var rangeTrigger: StrategyTrigger? = null
        if (pendingWaitRuleId == null) {
            val matchedRangeRule = allRules.filter {
                it.isEnabled &&
                    it.ruleId.category == com.example.data.model.StrategyCategory.MULTIPLIER_WAIT &&
                    it.waitDurationMs > 0L &&
                    multiplier > it.minMultiplier &&
                    multiplier < it.maxMultiplier
            }.maxByOrNull { it.minMultiplier }

            if (matchedRangeRule != null) {
                pendingWaitRuleId = matchedRangeRule.ruleId
                pendingWaitRuleLabel = matchedRangeRule.dynamicTitle()
                waitUntilTimestamp = currentTimeMs + matchedRangeRule.waitDurationMs
                rangeTrigger = StrategyTrigger.RangeWaitStarted(
                    ruleConfig = matchedRangeRule,
                    observedMultiplier = multiplier,
                    waitUntilTimestamp = waitUntilTimestamp
                )
                safeLogI("Range rule triggered: ${matchedRangeRule.dynamicTitle()} at ${multiplier}x")
            }
        }

        // Evaluate Loss Recovery Rules using editable requiredLosses (only if unlocked & no wait timer pending)
        var triggerFired: StrategyTrigger = if (timerTrigger is StrategyTrigger.WaitTimerCompleted) {
            timerTrigger
        } else {
            StrategyTrigger.None
        }

        var activatedRule: StrategyRuleConfig? = null
        if (triggerFired is StrategyTrigger.None && pendingWaitRuleId == null) {
            val matchingLossRule = allRules
                .filter {
                    it.isEnabled &&
                        it.ruleId.category != com.example.data.model.StrategyCategory.MULTIPLIER_WAIT &&
                        it.requiredLosses > 0 &&
                        consecutiveObservedLosses >= it.requiredLosses
                }
                .minByOrNull { it.requiredLosses }

            if (matchingLossRule != null) {
                activatedRule = matchingLossRule
                triggerFired = StrategyTrigger.LossRecoveryFired(
                    ruleConfig = matchingLossRule,
                    observedLosses = consecutiveObservedLosses
                )
            } else if (config.isStrategy1Enabled && consecutiveLow >= config.strategy1RequiredLowRounds) {
                triggerFired = StrategyTrigger.Strategy1Fired(consecutiveLow)
            } else if (config.isStrategy2Enabled && isWaiting && postHighWait >= config.strategy2WaitRounds) {
                triggerFired = StrategyTrigger.Strategy2Fired(postHighWait, lastHigh)
            }
        }

        val hourRuleActive = shouldContinueBettingBasedOnHourRule(currentTimeMs)
        val sessionActive = state.isBettingSessionActive ||
            (triggerFired is StrategyTrigger.LossRecoveryFired ||
                triggerFired is StrategyTrigger.WaitTimerCompleted ||
                triggerFired is StrategyTrigger.Strategy1Fired ||
                triggerFired is StrategyTrigger.Strategy2Fired ||
                hourRuleActive)

        val initialStake = if (!state.isBettingSessionActive && sessionActive) {
            config.baseStake
        } else {
            state.currentCalculatedStake
        }

        val resolvedActiveRuleId = when {
            activatedRule != null -> activatedRule.ruleId
            triggerFired is StrategyTrigger.WaitTimerCompleted -> triggerFired.ruleConfig.ruleId
            state.isBettingSessionActive -> state.activeRuleId
            else -> null
        }

        val resolvedRuleConfig = resolvedActiveRuleId?.let { config.getRuleConfig(it) }
        val resolvedRuleLabel = when {
            resolvedRuleConfig != null -> resolvedRuleConfig.dynamicTitle()
            triggerFired is StrategyTrigger.Strategy1Fired -> "Strategy 1 (<${config.strategy1LowThreshold}x)"
            triggerFired is StrategyTrigger.Strategy2Fired -> "Strategy 2 (>${config.strategy2HighThreshold}x)"
            else -> state.activeRuleLabel
        }

        val sessionStarted = when {
            !state.isBettingSessionActive && sessionActive -> currentTimeMs
            sessionActive -> state.sessionStartedTimestamp
            else -> 0L
        }

        val (effectiveMode, effectiveAddAmount) = resolveEffectiveProgression(config)
        state = state.copy(
            consecutiveLowCount = consecutiveLow,
            consecutiveObservedLosses = consecutiveObservedLosses,
            postHighWaitCount = postHighWait,
            lastHighMultiplier = lastHigh,
            isWaitingForPostHigh = if (isWaiting && postHighWait >= config.strategy2WaitRounds) false else isWaiting,
            activeRuleId = resolvedActiveRuleId,
            activeRuleLabel = resolvedRuleLabel,
            activeProgressionMode = effectiveMode,
            activeCustomAddAmount = effectiveAddAmount,
            targetWinsToFetch = resolvedRuleConfig?.targetWinsToFetch ?: config.stopAfterConsecutiveWins,
            pendingWaitRuleId = pendingWaitRuleId,
            pendingWaitRuleLabel = pendingWaitRuleLabel,
            waitUntilTimestamp = waitUntilTimestamp,
            activeWaitRemainingMs = if (pendingWaitRuleId != null) (waitUntilTimestamp - currentTimeMs).coerceAtLeast(0L) else 0L,
            activeTrigger = when {
                triggerFired !is StrategyTrigger.None -> triggerFired
                rangeTrigger != null -> rangeTrigger
                timerTrigger is StrategyTrigger.SessionTimedOut -> timerTrigger
                else -> state.activeTrigger
            },
            isBettingSessionActive = sessionActive,
            sessionStartedTimestamp = sessionStarted,
            sessionTimeoutRemainingMs = if (sessionActive) timeoutLimitMs else 0L,
            currentCalculatedStake = initialStake,
            highMultiplierLossesInHour = highMultiplierLossTimestamps.size,
            isNearHourEndRuleActive = hourRuleActive
        )

        when (val fired = triggerFired) {
            is StrategyTrigger.LossRecoveryFired -> {
                publishStakeInstruction(
                    stake = initialStake,
                    mode = effectiveMode,
                    addAmount = effectiveAddAmount,
                    targetMultiplier = config.targetMultiplier,
                    stakeLevel = state.currentStakeLevel,
                    isSessionActive = true,
                    reason = "${fired.ruleConfig.dynamicTitle()} Triggered"
                )
                triggerAction(
                    AutomationActionEvent(
                        actionType = ActionType.BET,
                        amountOrMultiplier = initialStake,
                        reason = "${fired.ruleConfig.dynamicTitle()} (${fired.observedLosses} losses) -> Fetch ${fired.ruleConfig.targetWinsToFetch} wins",
                        timestamp = currentTimeMs
                    )
                )
            }
            is StrategyTrigger.Strategy1Fired -> {
                publishStakeInstruction(
                    stake = initialStake,
                    mode = state.activeProgressionMode,
                    addAmount = state.activeCustomAddAmount,
                    targetMultiplier = config.targetMultiplier,
                    stakeLevel = state.currentStakeLevel,
                    isSessionActive = true,
                    reason = "Strategy 1 Triggered"
                )
                triggerAction(
                    AutomationActionEvent(
                        actionType = ActionType.BET,
                        amountOrMultiplier = initialStake,
                        reason = "Strategy 1: <${config.strategy1LowThreshold}x streak ($consecutiveLow rounds)",
                        timestamp = currentTimeMs
                    )
                )
            }
            is StrategyTrigger.Strategy2Fired -> {
                publishStakeInstruction(
                    stake = initialStake,
                    mode = state.activeProgressionMode,
                    addAmount = state.activeCustomAddAmount,
                    targetMultiplier = config.targetMultiplier,
                    stakeLevel = state.currentStakeLevel,
                    isSessionActive = true,
                    reason = "Strategy 2 Triggered"
                )
                triggerAction(
                    AutomationActionEvent(
                        actionType = ActionType.BET,
                        amountOrMultiplier = initialStake,
                        reason = "Strategy 2: >${config.strategy2HighThreshold}x (${lastHigh}x) + ${config.strategy2WaitRounds} rounds wait",
                        timestamp = currentTimeMs
                    )
                )
            }
            else -> Unit
        }

        return when {
            triggerFired !is StrategyTrigger.None -> triggerFired
            rangeTrigger != null -> rangeTrigger
            timerTrigger is StrategyTrigger.SessionTimedOut -> timerTrigger
            else -> StrategyTrigger.None
        }
    }

    /**
     * Process betting outcome for an active automated bet.
     * Enforces per-strategy stake progression (Option A: Add Amount vs Option B: Double Amount),
     * target wins reset (e.g., fetch 2 wins then unlock/reset), and >13.00x loss rule,
     * publishing the next StakeInstruction ready for AccessibilityController.
     */
    fun processBetOutcome(
        isWin: Boolean,
        multiplier: Double,
        config: StrategyConfig = _boundConfig.value,
        currentTimeMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): StrategyState {
        val activeRuleConfig = state.activeRuleId?.let { config.getRuleConfig(it) }
        val targetWins = activeRuleConfig?.targetWinsToFetch ?: config.stopAfterConsecutiveWins
        val (activeMode, activeAddAmount) = resolveEffectiveProgression(config)

        if (isWin) {
            totalWins++
            val wins = state.consecutiveWinsInSession + 1
            safeLogI("Bet Won! Verified wins in recovery session: $wins / $targetWins")
            triggerAction(
                AutomationActionEvent(
                    actionType = ActionType.CASH_OUT,
                    amountOrMultiplier = multiplier,
                    reason = "Auto Cashout Won ($wins/$targetWins) @ ${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", multiplier)}x",
                    timestamp = currentTimeMs
                )
            )

            val resetBase = roundStake(config.baseStake)
            val shouldResetOnWin = (config.isMartingaleEnabled && activeMode != StakeProgressionMode.DISABLED) ||
                (wins >= targetWins && !shouldContinueBettingBasedOnHourRule(currentTimeMs))
            if (shouldResetOnWin) {
                state = state.copy(
                    isBettingSessionActive = false,
                    sessionStartedTimestamp = 0L,
                    sessionTimeoutRemainingMs = 0L,
                    activeTrigger = StrategyTrigger.None,
                    activeRuleId = null,
                    activeRuleLabel = null,
                    activeProgressionMode = activeMode,
                    activeCustomAddAmount = activeAddAmount,
                    currentStakeLevel = 1,
                    consecutiveWinsInSession = 0,
                    consecutiveLossesInSession = 0,
                    consecutiveObservedLosses = 0,
                    currentCalculatedStake = resetBase,
                    consecutiveLowCount = 0,
                    postHighWaitCount = 0
                )
                publishStakeInstruction(
                    stake = resetBase,
                    mode = activeMode,
                    addAmount = activeAddAmount,
                    targetMultiplier = config.targetMultiplier,
                    stakeLevel = 1,
                    isSessionActive = false,
                    reason = if (config.isMartingaleEnabled && activeMode != StakeProgressionMode.DISABLED) {
                        "Martingale Win -> Reset to Base Stake"
                    } else {
                        "Target $targetWins Wins Fetched -> Reset to Base Stake"
                    }
                )
            } else {
                state = state.copy(
                    consecutiveWinsInSession = wins,
                    consecutiveLossesInSession = 0
                )
                publishStakeInstruction(
                    stake = state.currentCalculatedStake,
                    mode = activeMode,
                    addAmount = activeAddAmount,
                    targetMultiplier = config.targetMultiplier,
                    stakeLevel = state.currentStakeLevel,
                    isSessionActive = true,
                    reason = "Win $wins/$targetWins Verified -> Continue Session"
                )
            }
        } else {
            totalLosses++
            val losses = state.consecutiveLossesInSession + 1

            // Strictly obey master progression setting (DISABLED stays flat regardless of Martingale or rule mode)
            val nextStake = calculateNextStakeAfterLoss(
                currentStake = state.currentCalculatedStake,
                progressionMode = activeMode,
                customAddAmount = activeAddAmount,
                lossMultiplier = multiplier,
                isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = false
            )

            safeLogI("Bet Lost. Session losses: $losses, masterMode: $activeMode, martingale: ${config.isMartingaleEnabled}, next stake: $nextStake")

            val hourRuleActive = shouldContinueBettingBasedOnHourRule(currentTimeMs)
            val newLevel = state.currentStakeLevel + 1

            state = state.copy(
                isBettingSessionActive = true,
                activeProgressionMode = activeMode,
                activeCustomAddAmount = activeAddAmount,
                currentStakeLevel = newLevel,
                consecutiveWinsInSession = 0,
                consecutiveLossesInSession = losses,
                currentCalculatedStake = nextStake,
                highMultiplierLossesInHour = highMultiplierLossTimestamps.size,
                isNearHourEndRuleActive = hourRuleActive
            )

            publishStakeInstruction(
                stake = nextStake,
                mode = activeMode,
                addAmount = activeAddAmount,
                targetMultiplier = config.targetMultiplier,
                stakeLevel = newLevel,
                isSessionActive = true,
                reason = "Loss #$losses (${activeMode.label}) -> Next Stake ${formatStakeAmount(nextStake)}"
            )
        }

        return state
    }

    /**
     * Checks if 3 high-multiplier losses occurred in the current hour and if it is
     * within 10 minutes of the hour ending (minute >= 50).
     */
    private fun shouldContinueBettingBasedOnHourRule(currentTimeMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): Boolean {
        if (highMultiplierLossTimestamps.size < 3) return false
        val calendar = Calendar.getInstance().apply { timeInMillis = currentTimeMs }
        val minute = calendar.get(Calendar.MINUTE)
        return minute >= 50
    }
}

package com.example.data.model

import com.example.data.engine.CurrencyManager
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Explicit states for account balance detection from the game interface.
 */
enum class BalanceDetectionStatus {
    SCANNING,
    DETECTED,
    VERIFIED,
    UNAVAILABLE,
    STALE
}

/**
 * Tracks the live account balance parsed directly from the Aviator header node.
 */
data class BalanceState(
    val status: BalanceDetectionStatus = BalanceDetectionStatus.SCANNING,
    val amount: Double? = null,
    val currency: String? = null,
    val lastReadTimestampMs: Long = 0L,
    val failureReason: String? = null
) {
    val lastUpdatedMs: Long
        get() = lastReadTimestampMs
    val isUsableForBet: Boolean
        get() = (status == BalanceDetectionStatus.VERIFIED || status == BalanceDetectionStatus.DETECTED) &&
            amount != null &&
            amount.isFinite() &&
            amount >= 0.0

    val isStale: Boolean
        get() = status == BalanceDetectionStatus.STALE

    fun formattedDisplay(): String {
        return when (status) {
            BalanceDetectionStatus.VERIFIED -> {
                val amt = amount ?: 0.0
                "${CurrencyManager.formatAmount(amt)} [VERIFIED]"
            }
            BalanceDetectionStatus.DETECTED -> {
                val amt = amount ?: 0.0
                "${CurrencyManager.formatAmount(amt)} [DETECTED]"
            }
            BalanceDetectionStatus.SCANNING -> "SCANNING..."
            BalanceDetectionStatus.UNAVAILABLE -> "UNAVAILABLE${failureReason?.let { " ($it)" } ?: ""}"
            BalanceDetectionStatus.STALE -> "STALE (Needs refresh)"
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Centralized action execution state machine states.
 */
enum class ActionExecutionState {
    IDLE,
    SCANNING,
    READING_BALANCE,
    DETECTING_CONTROLS,
    VALIDATING_GAME_STATE,
    EXECUTING_ACTION,
    VERIFYING_ACTION,
    COMPLETED,
    FAILED,
    PAUSED
}

/**
 * Detailed record of a single atomic automation action (Set Stake, Place Bet, Cash Out).
 */
data class ActionExecutionRecord(
    val actionId: String = "act_${System.currentTimeMillis()}_${(1000..9999).random()}",
    val operationName: String, // "APPLY_STAKE", "PLACE_BET", "CASH_OUT"
    val state: ActionExecutionState = ActionExecutionState.IDLE,
    val startTimestampMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
    val completionTimestampMs: Long? = null,
    val targetCoordinates: Pair<Float, Float>? = null,
    val isSuccess: Boolean? = null,
    val failureReason: String? = null,
    val gestureDispatched: Boolean = false,
    val interfaceResponded: Boolean = false,
    val stateConfirmed: Boolean = false,
    val details: String = ""
) {
    val durationMs: Long
        get() = (completionTimestampMs ?: System.currentTimeMillis()) - startTimestampMs
}

/**
 * Structured diagnostic log entry for every important operation in Screen Earner.
 */
data class ActivityLogEntry(
    val id: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
    val timestamp: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
    val actionId: String,
    val state: ActionExecutionState,
    val target: String,
    val coordinates: Pair<Float, Float>?,
    val gestureResult: Boolean?,
    val eventObserved: String?,
    val verificationResult: Boolean?,
    val errorDetails: String?
) {
    fun formattedTime(): String {
        val sdf = SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss.SSS", Locale.US)
        return sdf.format(Date(timestamp))
    }

    fun formattedSummary(): String {
        val coordStr = coordinates?.let { " @ (${it.first.toInt()}, ${it.second.toInt()})" } ?: ""
        val resStr = when {
            verificationResult == true -> "[VERIFIED]"
            verificationResult == false -> "[UNVERIFIED]"
            gestureResult == true -> "[DISPATCHED]"
            gestureResult == false -> "[DISPATCH FAILED]"
            else -> "[${state.name}]"
        }
        val errStr = errorDetails?.let { " - $it" } ?: ""
        return "${formattedTime()} $target$coordStr $resStr$errStr"
    }
}

enum class CrashColorCategory(
    val displayName: String,
    val defaultHex: String
) {
    Pink("Pink", "#EC4899"),
    Red("Red", "#DC2626"),
    Purple("Purple", "#7C3AED"),
    Blue("Blue", "#2563EB"),
    Green("Green", "#16A34A"),
    Yellow("Yellow", "#CA8A04"),
    Orange("Orange", "#EA580C"),
    Other("Other", "#64748B")
}

data class CustomColorPaletteRule(
    val label: String,
    val hex: String,
    val category: CrashColorCategory = CrashColorCategory.Other,
    val minMultiplier: Double? = null,
    val maxMultiplier: Double? = null
)

object ColorClassifier {

    fun formatArgbHex(argb: Int): String {
        val r = (argb ushr 16) and 0xFF
        val g = (argb ushr 8) and 0xFF
        val b = argb and 0xFF
        return String.format(Locale.US, "#%02X%02X%02X", r, g, b)
    }

    fun parseHexToArgb(hex: String?): Int? {
        if (hex.isNullOrBlank()) return null
        val clean = hex.trim().removePrefix("#")
        return when (clean.length) {
            6 -> clean.toLongOrNull(16)?.let { (0xFF000000L or it).toInt() }
            8 -> clean.toLongOrNull(16)?.toInt()
            else -> null
        }
    }

    fun normalizeHex(hex: String?): String {
        val argb = parseHexToArgb(hex) ?: return CrashColorCategory.Other.defaultHex
        return formatArgbHex(argb)
    }

    fun classifyArgb(argb: Int): CrashColorCategory {
        val r = ((argb ushr 16) and 0xFF) / 255f
        val g = ((argb ushr 8) and 0xFF) / 255f
        val b = (argb and 0xFF) / 255f

        val maxC = maxOf(r, g, b)
        val minC = minOf(r, g, b)
        val delta = maxC - minC
        val saturation = if (maxC <= 0f) 0f else delta / maxC
        val brightness = maxC

        if (saturation < 0.16f || brightness < 0.12f) {
            return CrashColorCategory.Other
        }

        val hue = when {
            delta <= 0.0001f -> 0f
            maxC == r -> 60f * (((g - b) / delta) % 6f)
            maxC == g -> 60f * (((b - r) / delta) + 2f)
            else -> 60f * (((r - g) / delta) + 4f)
        }.let { if (it < 0f) it + 360f else it }

        return when {
            hue in 312f..348f -> CrashColorCategory.Pink
            hue >= 348f || hue < 15f -> {
                if (b > 0.45f && r > 0.7f && g < 0.45f) CrashColorCategory.Pink else CrashColorCategory.Red
            }
            hue in 15f..38f -> CrashColorCategory.Orange
            hue in 38f..70f -> CrashColorCategory.Yellow
            hue in 70f..165f -> CrashColorCategory.Green
            hue in 165f..252f -> CrashColorCategory.Blue
            hue in 252f..312f -> CrashColorCategory.Purple
            else -> CrashColorCategory.Other
        }
    }

    fun classifyHex(hex: String?): CrashColorCategory {
        val argb = parseHexToArgb(hex) ?: return CrashColorCategory.Other
        return classifyArgb(argb)
    }

    fun fallbackCategoryForMultiplier(
        multiplier: Double,
        lowThreshold: Double = 2.00,
        bigThreshold: Double = 10.00
    ): CrashColorCategory {
        return when {
            multiplier < lowThreshold -> CrashColorCategory.Blue
            abs(multiplier - lowThreshold) < 0.0001 -> CrashColorCategory.Purple
            multiplier < bigThreshold -> CrashColorCategory.Purple
            else -> CrashColorCategory.Pink
        }
    }
}

    tableName = "crash_records",
    indices = [

data class CrashRecord(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true)
    val id: Long = 0,
    val sessionId: String = "",
    val gameId: String,
    val gameName: String,
    val originalDetectedTitle: String = "",
    val multiplier: Double,
    val detectedColorHex: String,
    val colorCategory: CrashColorCategory,
    val isPixelColorVerified: Boolean = false,
    val crashTimestamp: Long,
    val hourStartTimestamp: Long,
    val sourcePackage: String = "",
    val roundIdentifier: String? = null,
    val confidence: Float = 0.85f,
    val manuallyCorrected: Boolean = false,
    val isConfirmed: Boolean = true,
    val observationOrder: Int = 0,
    val collectionSource: CollectionSource = CollectionSource.LIVE_CRASH,
    val dedupKey: String
) {
    companion object {
        fun buildDedupKey(
            gameId: String,
            roundIdentifier: String?,
            crashTimestamp: Long,
            multiplier: Double,
            sequenceIndex: Int = 0
        ): String {
            val cleanGame = gameId.lowercase(Locale.US).replace(Regex("[^a-z0-9_]"), "_")
            val multStr = String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", multiplier)
            if (!roundIdentifier.isNullOrBlank()) {
                return "${cleanGame}_rid_${roundIdentifier.trim()}"
            }
            return "${cleanGame}_ts_${crashTimestamp}_${multStr}_s$sequenceIndex"
        }

        fun buildLiveRoundDedupKey(
            sessionId: String,
            gameId: String,
            roundIdentifier: String?,
            sequenceIndex: Int
        ): String {
            val cleanSess = sessionId.ifBlank { "default" }.lowercase(Locale.US).replace(Regex("[^a-z0-9_]"), "_")
            val cleanGame = gameId.ifBlank { "unknown" }.lowercase(Locale.US).replace(Regex("[^a-z0-9_]"), "_")
            if (!roundIdentifier.isNullOrBlank()) {
                return "${cleanSess}_${cleanGame}_rid_${roundIdentifier.trim()}"
            }
            return "${cleanSess}_${cleanGame}_seq_$sequenceIndex"
        }
    }
}

object CalendarHourUtils {
    fun hourStartFor(timestampMs: Long): Long {
        val cal = Calendar.getInstance()
        cal.timeInMillis = timestampMs
        cal.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0)
        cal.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0)
        cal.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0)
        return cal.timeInMillis
    }

    fun hourEndFor(hourStartMs: Long): Long = hourStartMs + 3_600_000L - 1L

    fun formatHourWindow(hourStartMs: Long): String {
        val startFmt = SimpleDateFormat("HH:00", Locale.getDefault())
        val endFmt = SimpleDateFormat("HH:59", Locale.getDefault())
        val hourNum = SimpleDateFormat("H", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date(hourStartMs))
        return "${startFmt.format(Date(hourStartMs))}–${endFmt.format(Date(hourStartMs))} (Hour $hourNum)"
    }

    fun formatExactTime(timestampMs: Long): String {
        return if (timestampMs <= 0L) "--:--:--"
        else SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date(timestampMs))
    }

    fun formatDateTime(timestampMs: Long): String {
        return if (timestampMs <= 0L) "--"
        else SimpleDateFormat("dd MMM HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date(timestampMs))
    }
}

package com.example.data.model

/**
 * Authoritative lifecycle states for traceable bet transactions.
 * Every bet must transition cleanly through these states.
 */
enum class BetTransactionLifecycleState {
    INTENT_RECORDED,
    STAKE_VERIFIED,
    AUTO_CASHOUT_VERIFIED,
    BET_DISPATCHED,
    BET_ACCEPTED,
    BET_UNCONFIRMED,
    CASHOUT_DISPATCHED,
    CASHOUT_CONFIRMED,
    ROUND_LOST,
    OUTCOME_UNKNOWN,
    SETTLEMENT_RECORDED
}

/**
 * Granular evidence entry associated with a transaction state transition.
 */
data class TransactionEvidence(
    val stage: String,
    val timestampMs: Long,
    val details: String,
    val success: Boolean = true
)

/**
 * Authoritative record of a single bet transaction across its entire lifecycle.
 */
data class BetTransactionRecord(
    val transactionId: String,
    val gameId: String,
    val roundId: String,
    val intendedStake: Double,
    var acceptedStake: Double? = null,
    val targetMultiplier: Double,
    var state: BetTransactionLifecycleState = BetTransactionLifecycleState.INTENT_RECORDED,

package com.example.data.model

import androidx.room.Entity
import androidx.room.Index
import androidx.room.PrimaryKey
import java.util.Locale

enum class HistoryCollectionStatus(val displayLabel: String) {
    HISTORY_NOT_STARTED("Not Started"),
    COLLECTING_VISIBLE_HISTORY("Reading Visible Ribbon"),
    EXPANDING_HISTORY("Expanding History Panel"),
    SCROLLING_HISTORY("Scrolling History Panel"),
    HISTORY_PARTIAL("Partial History"),
    HISTORY_COMPLETE("30m History Complete"),
    HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE("History Unavailable"),
    HISTORY_ERROR("Collection Error")
}

enum class TimestampSource(val displayLabel: String) {
    GAME_PROVIDED("Game Time"),
    LOCAL_OBSERVATION("Observed Time")
}

enum class CollectionSource(val displayLabel: String) {
    VISIBLE_RIBBON("Visible Ribbon"),
    EXPANDED_PANEL("Expanded Panel"),
    SCROLLED_HISTORY("Scrolled History"),
    LIVE_CRASH("Live Crash"),
    LIVE("Live"),
    HISTORY_IMPORT("History Import")
}

@Entity(
    tableName = "multiplier_records",
    indices = [
        Index(value = ["dedupKey"], unique = true),
        Index(value = ["sessionId"]),
        Index(value = ["crashTimestamp"])
    ]
)
data class MultiplierRecord(
    @PrimaryKey(autoGenerate = true)
    val id: Long = 0,
    val sessionId: String = "",
    val gameId: String = "unknown",
    val roundId: String? = null,
    val multiplier: Double,
    val gameTimestampMs: Long? = null,
    val observationTimestampMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
    val crashTimestamp: Long = gameTimestampMs ?: observationTimestampMs,
    val platform: String = "Unknown",
    val isConfirmed: Boolean = true,
    val timestampSource: TimestampSource = if (gameTimestampMs != null) {
        TimestampSource.GAME_PROVIDED
    } else {
        TimestampSource.LOCAL_OBSERVATION
    },
    val collectionSource: CollectionSource = CollectionSource.LIVE_CRASH,
    val collectionStatus: HistoryCollectionStatus = HistoryCollectionStatus.HISTORY_PARTIAL,
    val dedupKey: String = buildFallbackDedupKey(
        gameId = gameId,
        platform = platform,
        roundId = roundId,
        gameTimestampMs = gameTimestampMs,
        observationTimestampMs = observationTimestampMs,
        crashTimestamp = crashTimestamp,
        multiplier = multiplier,
        sequenceIndex = 0
    ),
    val sequenceIndex: Int = 0,
    val hasGapBefore: Boolean = false
) {
    companion object {
        fun buildFallbackDedupKey(
            gameId: String,
            platform: String,
            roundId: String?,
            gameTimestampMs: Long?,
            observationTimestampMs: Long,
            crashTimestamp: Long,
            multiplier: Double,
            sequenceIndex: Int
        ): String {
            val cleanPlatform = platform.lowercase(Locale.US).replace(Regex("[^a-z0-9]"), "_")
            val multStr = String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", multiplier)
            if (!roundId.isNullOrBlank()) {
                return "${gameId}_${cleanPlatform}_rid_${roundId.trim()}"
            }
            if (gameTimestampMs != null && gameTimestampMs > 0L) {
                return "${gameId}_${cleanPlatform}_gt_${gameTimestampMs}_${multStr}_s$sequenceIndex"
            }
            val effectiveTs = if (crashTimestamp > 0L) crashTimestamp else observationTimestampMs
            return "${gameId}_${cleanPlatform}_obs_${effectiveTs}_${multStr}_s$sequenceIndex"
        }
    }
}
