package com.example.service

import android.util.Log
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityEvent
import com.example.data.engine.GameAdapterRegistry
import com.example.data.engine.GameDetection
import com.example.data.model.MonitoringStatus
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow

data class GameDetectionState(
    val isGameDetected: Boolean = false,
    val platformName: String = "Unknown",
    val displayedGameName: String = "",
    val gameId: String = "",
    val roundId: String? = null,
    val detectedRoundId: String? = null,
    val originalDetectedTitle: String = "",
    val supportedPlatforms: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val isReady: Boolean = false,
    val gamePhase: String = "WAITING_FOR_GAME",
    val missingElements: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val detectedMultiplier: Double? = null,
    val foregroundPackage: String = "",
    val liveColorHex: String? = null,
    val isLiveColorPixelVerified: Boolean = false,
    val liveDetectionLost: Boolean = false,
    val detectionConfidence: Float = 1f,
    val windowAccessStatus: MonitoringStatus = MonitoringStatus.MONITORING,
    val gameWindowAccessible: Boolean = true,
    val gameWindowSuspended: Boolean = false,
    val uiTargets: DetectedUiTargets = DetectedUiTargets(),
    val updatedAtMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

class ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService : AccessibilityController() {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "PredictManagerA11ySvc"
        @Volatile
        var instance: ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService? = null
            private set

        private val _connectionStatus = MutableStateFlow(AccessibilityConnectionStatus.DISCONNECTED)
        val connectionStatus: StateFlow<AccessibilityConnectionStatus> = _connectionStatus.asStateFlow()

        fun isServiceConnected(): Boolean =
            _connectionStatus.value == AccessibilityConnectionStatus.CONNECTED && instance != null

        fun markConnecting() {
            if (_connectionStatus.value != AccessibilityConnectionStatus.CONNECTED) {
                _connectionStatus.value = AccessibilityConnectionStatus.CONNECTING
            }
        }

        private val _detectionState = MutableStateFlow(GameDetectionState())
        val detectionState: StateFlow<GameDetectionState> = _detectionState.asStateFlow()

        fun buildAndPublishFusedState(
            rawTargets: DetectedUiTargets,
            packageName: String,
            ocrSnapshot: OcrFrameSnapshot? = ScreenOcrAnalyzer.latestOcrSnapshot.value,
            nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
        ): GameDetectionState {
            val ocrHints = ocrSnapshot?.elements?.map { it.text }.orEmpty()
            val combinedRawTitles = (rawTargets.visibleRawTitles + ocrHints).distinct()
            val hasMultiplierSignals = rawTargets.detectedMultiplier != null ||
                rawTargets.ribbonMultipliers.isNotEmpty() ||
                rawTargets.isBetBtnDetected ||
                rawTargets.isCashOutBtnDetected ||
                rawTargets.isCancelBtnDetected ||
                ocrHints.isNotEmpty()

            val resolvedAdapter = GameAdapterRegistry.resolveAdapter(
                packageName = packageName,
                url = rawTargets.detectedUrl,
                pageHints = rawTargets.pageTextHints,
                rawTexts = combinedRawTitles,
                hasMultiplierSignals = hasMultiplierSignals
            )

            val fusedResult = ScreenOcrAnalyzer.fuseAccessibilityAndOcr(
                a11yTargets = rawTargets.copy(
                    foregroundPackage = packageName.ifBlank { rawTargets.foregroundPackage }
                ),
                ocrSnapshot = ocrSnapshot,
                adapter = resolvedAdapter,
                nowMs = nowMs
            )
            val targets = fusedResult.fusedTargets

            val platformName = GameAdapterRegistry.resolvePlatformDisplay(
                packageName = packageName,
                url = targets.detectedUrl,
                pageHints = targets.pageTextHints
            )

            val resolvedGameTitle = resolvedAdapter?.displayedGameName
                ?: fusedResult.ocrParsed?.detectedGameName
                ?: GameDetection.resolvePlatformFromSignals(
                    packageName = packageName,
                    detectedUrl = targets.detectedUrl,
                    pageHints = targets.pageTextHints
                )
                ?: platformName.takeIf { it != "Unknown" }
                ?: "Detected Game"

            val resolvedGameId = resolvedAdapter?.gameId?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it != "unknown" }
                ?: fusedResult.ocrParsed?.detectedGameId?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                ?: resolvedGameTitle.lowercase().replace(Regex("[^a-z0-9]+"), "_").trim('_').ifBlank { "unknown" }

            var confidence = 0f
            if (resolvedAdapter != null && resolvedAdapter.gameId != "unknown") confidence += 0.45f
            else if (resolvedAdapter != null) confidence += 0.25f
            if (!targets.detectedUrl.isNullOrBlank() || platformName != "Unknown") confidence += 0.20f
            if (targets.detectedMultiplier != null) confidence += 0.15f
            if (targets.ribbonMultipliers.isNotEmpty()) confidence += 0.10f
            if (targets.isBetBtnDetected || targets.isCashOutBtnDetected || targets.isCancelBtnDetected || targets.isStakeInputDetected) {
                confidence += 0.15f
            }
            if (fusedResult.hasConflict || fusedResult.isOcrUncertain) {
                confidence = (confidence * 0.5f).coerceAtMost(0.45f)
            }
            val boundedConfidence = confidence.coerceIn(0f, 1f)

            val hasGameControls = targets.isBetBtnDetected || targets.isCancelBtnDetected || targets.isCashOutBtnDetected
            // A browser package, a visible balance or arbitrary OCR text is NOT a crash game. Require a recognised
            // game adapter, or real crash-game controls/numbers on screen (live multiplier, history ribbon,
            // Bet / Cancel / Cash Out control).
            val hasCrashGameSignals = targets.detectedMultiplier != null ||
                targets.ribbonMultipliers.size >= 3 ||
                targets.isBetBtnDetected ||
                targets.isCashOutBtnDetected ||
                targets.isCancelBtnDetected
            val gameDetected = (resolvedAdapter != null && resolvedAdapter.gameId != "unknown") || hasCrashGameSignals

            val missing = buildList {
                if (!targets.isBetBtnDetected && !targets.isCancelBtnDetected &&
                    !targets.isCashOutBtnDetected
                ) add("Bet Control Target")
                if (!targets.isCashOutBtnDetected) add("Cash Out Target")
                if (!targets.isStakeInputDetected && !targets.isDoubleBtnDetected &&
                    !targets.isAddBtnDetected
                ) add("Stake Input Control")
                if (fusedResult.hasConflict) add("A11y/OCR Conflict")
                if (fusedResult.isOcrUncertain) add("OCR Uncertain")
            }

            val allSupportedPlatforms = (resolvedAdapter?.supportedPlatforms
                ?: GameAdapterRegistry.allAdapters().flatMap { it.supportedPlatforms }).distinct()

            val nextState = GameDetectionState(
                isGameDetected = gameDetected,
                platformName = platformName,
                displayedGameName = resolvedGameTitle,
                gameId = resolvedGameId,
                roundId = targets.detectedCurrentRoundId,
                detectedRoundId = targets.detectedCurrentRoundId,
                originalDetectedTitle = resolvedGameTitle,
                supportedPlatforms = allSupportedPlatforms,
                isReady = gameDetected && hasMultiplierSignals && hasGameControls && !fusedResult.hasConflict && !fusedResult.isOcrUncertain && boundedConfidence >= 0.50f,
                gamePhase = targets.gamePhase,
                missingElements = missing,
                detectedMultiplier = targets.detectedMultiplier,
                foregroundPackage = packageName,
                detectionConfidence = boundedConfidence,
                gameWindowAccessible = true,
                uiTargets = targets,
                updatedAtMs = nowMs
            )
            _detectionState.value = nextState
            return nextState
        }

        fun recomputeWithLatestOcr(
            ocrSnapshot: OcrFrameSnapshot,
            nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
        ): GameDetectionState? {
            if (!isServiceConnected()) return null
            val current = _detectionState.value
            val pkg = current.foregroundPackage.ifBlank { current.uiTargets.foregroundPackage }
            if (pkg.isBlank() && !current.isGameDetected) return null
            val rawTargets = instance?.getLatestUiTargets() ?: current.uiTargets
            return buildAndPublishFusedState(
                rawTargets = rawTargets,
                packageName = pkg,
                ocrSnapshot = ocrSnapshot,
                nowMs = nowMs
            )
        }
    }

    /** Shared action executor. StrategyEngine remains the authority for strategy decisions. */
    val actionExecutor: ScreenEarnerActionExecutor by lazy(LazyThreadSafetyMode.NONE) {
        ScreenEarnerActionExecutor(this)
    }

    /** Optional ordered UI macro runner; it does not collect multipliers or create strategies. */
    val macroRunner: ScreenEarnerMacroRunner by lazy(LazyThreadSafetyMode.NONE) {
        ScreenEarnerMacroRunner(actionExecutor)
    }

    override fun onServiceConnected() {
        try {
            super.onServiceConnected()
            instance = this
            _connectionStatus.value = AccessibilityConnectionStatus.CONNECTED
            Log.i(TAG, "ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService connected successfully.")
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            _connectionStatus.value = AccessibilityConnectionStatus.ERROR
            Log.e(TAG, "Error in ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService.onServiceConnected", t)
        }
    }

    override fun onAccessibilityEvent(event: AccessibilityEvent?) {
        try {
            if (event == null) return

            val packageName = runCatching { event.packageName?.toString().orEmpty() }
                .getOrDefault("")
            val ownPkg = runCatching { applicationContext?.packageName }.getOrNull()

            // Ignore Predict Manager's own overlay events; do not let its controls become game targets.
            if (!ownPkg.isNullOrBlank() && packageName == ownPkg) return

            super.onAccessibilityEvent(event)

            buildAndPublishFusedState(
                rawTargets = detectedTargets.value,
                packageName = packageName,
                ocrSnapshot = ScreenOcrAnalyzer.latestOcrSnapshot.value,
                nowMs = System.currentTimeMillis()
            )
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error processing accessibility event", t)
        }
    }

    fun performClickAtCoordinates(
        x: Float,
        y: Float,
        onComplete: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null
    ) {
        dispatchTouchGesture(x, y, onComplete)
    }

    override fun onInterrupt() {
        try {
            _connectionStatus.value = AccessibilityConnectionStatus.ERROR
            macroRunner.stop()
            super.onInterrupt()
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error in onInterrupt", t)
        }
    }

    override fun onUnbind(intent: android.content.Intent?): Boolean {
        return try {
            macroRunner.stop()
            if (instance === this) instance = null
            _connectionStatus.value = AccessibilityConnectionStatus.DISCONNECTED
            super.onUnbind(intent)
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            _connectionStatus.value = AccessibilityConnectionStatus.ERROR
            Log.e(TAG, "Error in onUnbind", t)
            false
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        try {
            macroRunner.stop()
            super.onDestroy()
            if (instance === this) instance = null
            _connectionStatus.value = AccessibilityConnectionStatus.DISCONNECTED
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            _connectionStatus.value = AccessibilityConnectionStatus.ERROR
            Log.e(TAG, "Error in onDestroy", t)
        }
    }
}


====================================================================================================

package com.example.service
import java.util.Locale

import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService
import android.accessibilityservice.GestureDescription
import android.graphics.Path
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityNodeInfo
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityWindowInfo
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlin.coroutines.resume

/**
 * Reusable UI-action layer for Predict Manager (Screen Earner).
 *
 * This is deliberately separate from multiplier collection and StrategyEngine:
 * it performs one requested UI action and reports whether Android accepted it.
 * It does not assume that a dispatched gesture means the game accepted a bet.
 */
class ScreenEarnerActionExecutor(
    private val service: ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService
) {
    data class Result(
        val success: Boolean,
        val message: String,
        val observedValue: String? = null
    )

    suspend fun tap(x: Float, y: Float): Result =
        dispatchGesture(x, y, x, y, 70L)

    suspend fun doubleTap(x: Float, y: Float): Result {
        val first = tap(x, y)
        if (!first.success) return first
        kotlinx.coroutines.delay(100L)
        return tap(x, y)
    }

    suspend fun longPress(x: Float, y: Float, durationMs: Long = 800L): Result =
        dispatchGesture(x, y, x, y, durationMs.coerceIn(300L, 10_000L))

    suspend fun swipe(
        startX: Float,
        startY: Float,
        endX: Float,
        endY: Float,
        durationMs: Long = 300L
    ): Result = dispatchGesture(
        startX, startY, endX, endY, durationMs.coerceIn(80L, 10_000L)
    )

    suspend fun clickText(query: String): Result {
        val root = service.rootInActiveWindow
            ?: return Result(false, "No active accessibility window")
        val node = findNode(root, query, requireEditable = false)
            ?: return Result(false, "Element not found: $query")
        var clickable: AccessibilityNodeInfo? = null
        return try {
            clickable = clickableAncestor(node)
            val target = clickable ?: if (node.isClickable) node else null
            if (target == null) {
                return Result(false, "Element found for '$query' but neither element nor ancestors are clickable")
            }
            val clicked = target.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_CLICK)
            if (clicked) {
                Result(true, "Android accepted click on '$query'")
            } else {
                val lowerQuery = query.lowercase(Locale.US)
                val isSensitive = lowerQuery.contains("bet") || lowerQuery.contains("cash") ||
                    lowerQuery.contains("pay") || lowerQuery.contains("deposit") ||
                    lowerQuery.contains("withdraw") || lowerQuery.contains("stake")
                if (isSensitive) {
                    Result(false, "ACTION_CLICK failed and coordinate tap rejected for sensitive control '$query'")
                } else {
                    val bounds = android.graphics.Rect()
                    target.getBoundsInScreen(bounds)
                    if (bounds.isEmpty) Result(false, "Element has no usable screen bounds: $query")
                    else tap(bounds.exactCenterX(), bounds.exactCenterY())
                }
            }
        } finally {
            clickable?.let { runCatching { it.recycle() } }
            recycleTreeNode(node, root)
            runCatching { root.recycle() }
        }
    }

    suspend fun focusField(label: String): Result {
        val root = service.rootInActiveWindow
            ?: return Result(false, "No active accessibility window")
        val node = findNode(root, label, requireEditable = true)
            ?: return Result(false, "Editable field not found: $label")
        return try {
            val focused = node.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_FOCUS) ||
                node.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_CLICK)
            val inputFocused = node.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_ACCESSIBILITY_FOCUS)
            if (focused || inputFocused) Result(true, "Field focus action accepted: '$label'")
            else Result(false, "Android rejected focus action for '$label'")
        } finally {
            recycleTreeNode(node, root)
            runCatching { root.recycle() }
        }
    }

    /** Replace text in a named editable field (clearing existing text first) and read it back before reporting success. */
    suspend fun replaceFieldText(label: String, value: String): Result {
        val root = service.rootInActiveWindow
            ?: return Result(false, "No active accessibility window")
        val node = findNode(root, label, requireEditable = true)
            ?: return Result(false, "Editable field not found: $label")
        return try {
            node.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_FOCUS)
            setNodeTextAndVerify(node, value)
        } finally {
            recycleTreeNode(node, root)
            runCatching { root.recycle() }
        }
    }

    suspend fun typeIntoFocusedField(value: String): Result {
        val root = service.rootInActiveWindow
            ?: return Result(false, "No active accessibility window")
        val node = findFocusedEditable(root)
            ?: return Result(false, "No focused editable field")
        return try {
            setNodeTextAndVerify(node, value)
        } finally {
            recycleTreeNode(node, root)
            runCatching { root.recycle() }
        }
    }

    suspend fun appendToFocusedField(value: String): Result {
        val root = service.rootInActiveWindow
            ?: return Result(false, "No active accessibility window")
        val node = findFocusedEditable(root)
            ?: return Result(false, "No focused editable field")
        return try {
            val current = node.text?.toString().orEmpty()
            setNodeTextAndVerify(node, current + value)
        } finally {
            recycleTreeNode(node, root)
            runCatching { root.recycle() }
        }
    }

    suspend fun clearFocusedField(): Result = typeIntoFocusedField("")

    fun pressBack(): Result = globalAction(AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK, "Back")
    fun pressHome(): Result = globalAction(AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME, "Home")
    fun openRecents(): Result = globalAction(AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_RECENTS, "Recent Apps")
    fun openNotifications(): Result =
        globalAction(AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_NOTIFICATIONS, "Notifications")

    fun launchApp(packageName: String): Result {
        val pkg = packageName.trim()
        if (pkg.isEmpty()) return Result(false, "Package name is empty")
        return try {
            val intent = service.packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(pkg)
                ?: return Result(false, "No launchable activity for package: $pkg")
            intent.addFlags(android.content.Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
            service.startActivity(intent)
            Result(true, "Launch request sent for $pkg")
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Result(false, "Could not launch $pkg: ${t.message}")
        }
    }

    fun isSoftKeyboardOpen(): Boolean {
        return runCatching {
            service.windows?.any { it.type == AccessibilityWindowInfo.TYPE_INPUT_METHOD } ?: false
        }.getOrDefault(false)
    }

    /** Dismisses the IME ONLY if AccessibilityWindowInfo confirms an active soft keyboard window. */
    fun dismissKeyboardSafely(): Result {
        if (!isSoftKeyboardOpen()) {
            return Result(true, "No active soft keyboard window")
        }
        return pressBack()
    }

    fun isTargetButtonReady(expectBet: Boolean): Boolean {
        val targets = service.getLatestUiTargets()
        return if (expectBet) {
            targets.gamePhase == "BETTING_OPEN" ||
                targets.siteButtonState == com.example.data.model.SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET ||
                targets.betButtonBounds != null
        } else {
            targets.siteButtonState == com.example.data.model.SiteButtonState.CASH_OUT_AVAILABLE ||
                targets.cashOutButtonBounds != null
        }
    }

    private suspend fun setNodeTextAndVerify(
        node: AccessibilityNodeInfo,
        value: String
    ): Result {
        if (!node.isEditable) return Result(false, "Focused node is not editable")
        val existing = runCatching { node.text?.toString().orEmpty() }.getOrDefault("")
        if (existing.isNotEmpty() && value.isNotEmpty()) {
            val clearArgs = Bundle().apply {
                putCharSequence(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_ARGUMENT_SET_TEXT_CHARSEQUENCE, "")
            }
            runCatching { node.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_SET_TEXT, clearArgs) }
        }
        val args = Bundle().apply {
            putCharSequence(
                AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_ARGUMENT_SET_TEXT_CHARSEQUENCE,
                value
            )
        }
        val accepted = node.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_SET_TEXT, args)
        runCatching { node.refresh() }
        val readBack = runCatching { node.text?.toString() }.getOrNull()
        val verified = accepted && readBack != null && normalize(readBack) == normalize(value)
        return if (verified) Result(true, "Text verified", readBack)
        else Result(false, "Text action not verified (observed=${readBack ?: "unavailable"})", readBack)
    }

    suspend fun pressEnter(): Result {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            return Result(false, "IME Enter action requires Android 11 or newer")
        }
        val root = service.rootInActiveWindow
            ?: return Result(false, "No active accessibility window")
        val node = findFocusedEditable(root)
            ?: return Result(false, "No focused editable field")
        return try {
            val accepted = node.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.AccessibilityAction.ACTION_IME_ENTER.id)
            if (accepted) Result(true, "Keyboard Enter action accepted")
            else Result(false, "Keyboard Enter action was rejected")
        } finally {
            recycleTreeNode(node, root)
            runCatching { root.recycle() }
        }
    }

    private fun globalAction(action: Int, label: String): Result =
        if (service.performGlobalAction(action)) Result(true, "$label action accepted")
        else Result(false, "$label action rejected by Android")

    private suspend fun dispatchGesture(
        startX: Float,
        startY: Float,
        endX: Float,
        endY: Float,
        durationMs: Long
    ): Result {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
            return Result(false, "Gesture dispatch requires Android 7.0 or newer")
        }
        val metrics = service.resources.displayMetrics
        val maxX = metrics.widthPixels.toFloat()
        val maxY = metrics.heightPixels.toFloat()
        if (!startX.isFinite() || !startY.isFinite() ||
            !endX.isFinite() || !endY.isFinite() ||
            startX < 0f || startY < 0f || endX < 0f || endY < 0f ||
            startX >= maxX || endX >= maxX || startY >= maxY || endY >= maxY
        ) {
            return Result(false, "Gesture coordinates are outside the current display")
        }

        AccessibilityController.notifyOverlayPassThrough(true)
        kotlinx.coroutines.delay(45L)
        return suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation ->
            val path = Path().apply {
                moveTo(startX, startY)
                lineTo(endX, endY)
            }
            val gesture = GestureDescription.Builder()
                .addStroke(
                    GestureDescription.StrokeDescription(
                        path, 0L, durationMs.coerceAtLeast(1L)
                    )
                )
                .build()

            val dispatched = service.dispatchGesture(
                gesture,
                object : AccessibilityService.GestureResultCallback() {
                    override fun onCompleted(gestureDescription: GestureDescription?) {
                        AccessibilityController.notifyOverlayPassThrough(false)
                        if (continuation.isActive) {
                            continuation.resume(Result(true, "Gesture dispatched"))
                        }
                    }

                    override fun onCancelled(gestureDescription: GestureDescription?) {
                        AccessibilityController.notifyOverlayPassThrough(false)
                        if (continuation.isActive) {
                            continuation.resume(Result(false, "Gesture cancelled by Android"))
                        }
                    }
                },
                null
            )
            if (!dispatched) {
                AccessibilityController.notifyOverlayPassThrough(false)
                if (continuation.isActive) {
                    continuation.resume(Result(false, "Android rejected gesture dispatch"))
                }
            }
            continuation.invokeOnCancellation {
                AccessibilityController.notifyOverlayPassThrough(false)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun findFocusedEditable(root: AccessibilityNodeInfo): AccessibilityNodeInfo? {
        val focused = runCatching {
            root.findFocus(AccessibilityNodeInfo.FOCUS_INPUT)
        }.getOrNull()
        if (focused != null && runCatching { focused.isEditable && focused.isEnabled }.getOrDefault(false)) {
            return focused
        }
        focused?.let { runCatching { it.recycle() } }
        return null
    }

    private fun findNode(
        root: AccessibilityNodeInfo,
        query: String,
        requireEditable: Boolean,
        depth: Int = 0
    ): AccessibilityNodeInfo? {
        if (depth > 35) return null
        val q = query.trim().lowercase()
        val text = runCatching { root.text?.toString().orEmpty() }.getOrDefault("")
        val desc = runCatching { root.contentDescription?.toString().orEmpty() }.getOrDefault("")
        val hint = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            runCatching { root.hintText?.toString().orEmpty() }.getOrDefault("")
        } else ""
        val id = runCatching { root.viewIdResourceName.orEmpty() }.getOrDefault("")
        val editable = runCatching { root.isEditable }.getOrDefault(false)
        val enabled = runCatching { root.isEnabled }.getOrDefault(false)
        val lowerText = text.trim().lowercase()
        val lowerDesc = desc.trim().lowercase()
        val lowerId = id.lowercase()
        val metadata = "$text $desc $hint $id".lowercase()

        val isBrowserChrome = lowerId.contains("url_bar") || lowerId.contains("omnibox") || lowerId.contains("location_bar")
        val isMisleadingActionMatch = !requireEditable && (q == "bet" || q == "cash out") && (
            metadata.contains("betpawa") || metadata.contains("sportybet") ||
                metadata.contains("all bets") || metadata.contains("my bets") ||
                metadata.contains("top bets") || metadata.contains("betslip") ||
                metadata.contains("bet history") || metadata.contains("auto") ||
                metadata.contains("cancel")
            )

        val matches = q.isNotEmpty() && !isBrowserChrome && !isMisleadingActionMatch &&
            (lowerText == q || lowerDesc == q ||
                (q == "bet" && lowerText.startsWith("bet") && !lowerText.contains("bets")) ||
                (q != "bet" && metadata.contains(q)))
        if (matches && enabled && (!requireEditable || editable)) {
            return AccessibilityNodeInfo.obtain(root)
        }

        for (index in 0 until root.childCount.coerceAtMost(100)) {
            val child = runCatching { root.getChild(index) }.getOrNull() ?: continue
            val found = findNode(child, query, requireEditable, depth + 1)
            runCatching { child.recycle() }
            if (found != null) return found
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun clickableAncestor(node: AccessibilityNodeInfo): AccessibilityNodeInfo? {
        var current: AccessibilityNodeInfo? = AccessibilityNodeInfo.obtain(node)
        repeat(8) {
            val candidate = current ?: return null
            if (candidate.isClickable && candidate.isEnabled) return candidate
            val parent = runCatching { candidate.parent }.getOrNull()
            runCatching { candidate.recycle() }
            current = parent
        }
        current?.let { runCatching { it.recycle() } }
        return null
    }

    private fun recycleTreeNode(node: AccessibilityNodeInfo, root: AccessibilityNodeInfo) {
        if (node !== root) runCatching { node.recycle() }
    }

    private fun normalize(value: String): String =
        value.trim().replace(",", "").replace(" ", "")
}


====================================================================================================

package com.example.service

import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock

/**
 * Small, explicit macro language for Predict Manager (Screen Earner)'s reusable UI actions.
 *
 * StrategyEngine remains responsible for deciding WHEN to act. This class only executes a
 * requested ordered sequence and stops on the first failed action.
 */
class ScreenEarnerMacroRunner(
    private val executor: ScreenEarnerActionExecutor,
    private val scope: CoroutineScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)
) {
    enum class State { IDLE, RUNNING, PAUSED, STOPPED, FAILED }

    data class StepResult(
        val lineNumber: Int,
        val command: String,
        val success: Boolean,
        val message: String,
        val observedValue: String? = null
    )

    private val lock = Mutex()
    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(State.IDLE)
    val state: StateFlow<State> = _state.asStateFlow()

    private val _lastResult = MutableStateFlow<StepResult?>(null)
    val lastResult: StateFlow<StepResult?> = _lastResult.asStateFlow()

    private val _isPaused = MutableStateFlow(false)
    private var runningJob: Job? = null

    fun start(
        script: String,
        repeatCount: Int = 1,
        stepDelayMs: Long = 150L,
        onStep: (StepResult) -> Unit = {},
        onFinished: (State) -> Unit = {}
    ): Boolean {
        if (runningJob?.isActive == true) return false
        val lines = script.lines().mapIndexedNotNull { index, raw ->
            val line = raw.trim()
            if (line.isBlank() || line.startsWith("#")) null else (index + 1) to line
        }
        if (lines.isEmpty()) {
            _state.value = State.FAILED
            _lastResult.value = StepResult(0, "", false, "Script is empty")
            onFinished(State.FAILED)
            return false
        }

        val loops = if (repeatCount <= 0) Int.MAX_VALUE else repeatCount.coerceAtMost(10_000)
        _isPaused.value = false
        _state.value = State.RUNNING
        runningJob = scope.launch {
            var finalState = State.STOPPED
            try {
                lock.withLock {
                    loop@ for (loopIndex in 0 until loops) {
                        for ((lineNumber, line) in lines) {
                            if (!awaitResume()) break@loop
                            val result = executeLine(lineNumber, line)
                            _lastResult.value = result
                            onStep(result)
                            if (!result.success) {
                                finalState = State.FAILED
                                break@loop
                            }
                            if (stepDelayMs > 0L) delay(stepDelayMs.coerceAtMost(10_000L))
                        }
                        if (repeatCount <= 0 && !runningJobActive()) break
                    }
                }
                if (_state.value != State.FAILED) finalState = State.STOPPED
            } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
                finalState = State.STOPPED
                throw cancelled
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                finalState = State.FAILED
                _lastResult.value = StepResult(0, "", false, "Runner error: ${t.message}")
            } finally {
                _state.value = finalState
                _isPaused.value = false
                onFinished(finalState)
            }
        }
        return true
    }

    fun pause() {
        if (_state.value == State.RUNNING) {
            _isPaused.value = true
            _state.value = State.PAUSED
        }
    }

    fun resume() {
        if (_state.value == State.PAUSED) {
            _isPaused.value = false
            _state.value = State.RUNNING
        }
    }

    fun stop() {
        runningJob?.cancel()
        runningJob = null
        _isPaused.value = false
        if (_state.value != State.IDLE) _state.value = State.STOPPED
    }

    private suspend fun awaitResume(): Boolean {
        if (_state.value == State.STOPPED || _state.value == State.FAILED) return false
        _isPaused.first { paused -> !paused }
        return _state.value == State.RUNNING
    }

    private fun runningJobActive(): Boolean = runningJob?.isActive == true

    private suspend fun executeLine(lineNumber: Int, line: String): StepResult {
        val parsed = parse(line)
            ?: return StepResult(lineNumber, line, false, "Invalid command syntax")
        val result = try {
            when (parsed.name) {
                "tap" -> executor.tap(parsed.numbers[0], parsed.numbers[1])
                "doubletap" -> executor.doubleTap(parsed.numbers[0], parsed.numbers[1])
                "longpress" -> executor.longPress(
                    parsed.numbers[0], parsed.numbers[1],
                    parsed.numbers.getOrElse(2) { 800f }.toLong()
                )
                "swipe" -> executor.swipe(
                    parsed.numbers[0], parsed.numbers[1],
                    parsed.numbers[2], parsed.numbers[3],
                    parsed.numbers.getOrElse(4) { 300f }.toLong()
                )
                "click" -> executor.clickText(parsed.text)
                "focus" -> executor.focusField(parsed.text)
                "setfield" -> executor.replaceFieldText(parsed.label, parsed.value)
                "type" -> executor.typeIntoFocusedField(parsed.text)
                "append" -> executor.appendToFocusedField(parsed.text)
                "clear" -> executor.clearFocusedField()
                "typeslow" -> {
                    var last = ScreenEarnerActionExecutor.Result(true, "No characters")
                    val interval = parsed.numbers.firstOrNull()?.toLong()?.coerceIn(0L, 2_000L) ?: 100L
                    for (character in parsed.text) {
                        last = executor.appendToFocusedField(character.toString())
                        if (!last.success) break
                        if (interval > 0) delay(interval)
                    }
                    last
                }
                "wait", "sleep", "delay" -> {
                    delay(parsed.numbers[0].toLong().coerceIn(0L, 60_000L))
                    ScreenEarnerActionExecutor.Result(true, "Wait completed")
                }
                "back" -> executor.pressBack()
                "home" -> executor.pressHome()
                "recents" -> executor.openRecents()
                "notifications" -> executor.openNotifications()
                "enter" -> executor.pressEnter()
                "open" -> executor.launchApp(parsed.text)
                else -> ScreenEarnerActionExecutor.Result(false, "Unsupported command")
            }
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            ScreenEarnerActionExecutor.Result(false, "Action exception: ${t.message}")
        }
        return StepResult(
            lineNumber, line, result.success, result.message, result.observedValue
        )
    }

    private data class Parsed(
        val name: String,
        val numbers: List<Float> = emptyList(),
        val text: String = "",
        val label: String = "",
        val value: String = ""
    )

    private fun parse(line: String): Parsed? {
        val name = line.substringBefore(' ').lowercase()
        val rest = line.substringAfter(' ', "").trim()
        fun floats(count: Int, optional: Boolean = false): List<Float>? {
            val parts = rest.split(Regex("\\s+"))
            if ((!optional && parts.size != count) || (optional && parts.size !in (count - 1)..count)) return null
            return parts.mapNotNull { it.toFloatOrNull() }.takeIf { it.size == parts.size }
        }
        fun textArg(): String? = unquote(rest).takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }

        return when (name) {
            "tap", "doubletap" -> floats(2)?.let { Parsed(name, numbers = it) }
            "longpress" -> floats(3, optional = true)?.let { Parsed(name, numbers = it) }
            "swipe" -> floats(5, optional = true)?.let { values ->
                if (values.size >= 4) Parsed(name, numbers = values) else null
            }
            "wait", "sleep", "delay" -> floats(1)?.let { Parsed(name, numbers = it) }
            "click", "focus", "type", "append", "open" ->
                textArg()?.let { Parsed(name, text = it) }
            "typeslow" -> {
                val match = Regex("""^(\d+)\s+(.+)$""").matchEntire(rest) ?: return null
                val text = unquote(match.groupValues[2])
                Parsed(name, numbers = listOf(match.groupValues[1].toFloat()), text = text)
            }
            "setfield" -> {
                val parts = quotedParts(rest) ?: return null
                if (parts.size != 2) null else Parsed(name, label = parts[0], value = parts[1])
            }
            "clear", "back", "home", "recents", "notifications", "enter" ->
                if (rest.isBlank()) Parsed(name) else null
            else -> null
        }
    }

    private fun unquote(value: String): String {
        val trimmed = value.trim()
        return if (trimmed.length >= 2 &&
            ((trimmed.first() == '"' && trimmed.last() == '"') ||
                (trimmed.first() == '\'' && trimmed.last() == '\''))
        ) trimmed.substring(1, trimmed.length - 1) else trimmed
    }

    private fun quotedParts(value: String): List<String>? {
        val matches = Regex(""""([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'""").findAll(value).toList()
        if (matches.isEmpty()) return null
        return matches.map { it.groups[1]?.value ?: it.groups[2]?.value.orEmpty() }
    }
}

/**
 * Lightweight observation-only floating utility service for Predict Manager.
 * Provides a freely draggable "PM" bubble, compact live HUD pill (last crash + round ID),
 * resizable & compact/expanded live monitor card, FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON management,
 * and bounded CPU WakeLock lifecycle.
 */
open class ScreenEarnerOverlayService : Service(), LifecycleOwner, ViewModelStoreOwner, SavedStateRegistryOwner {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "PredictManagerOverlay"
        const val CHANNEL_ID = "monitoring_service"
        const val NOTIFICATION_ID = 1001
        const val PREFS_NAME = "screen_earner_prefs"
        const val PREF_BUBBLE_OPACITY = "bubble_opacity"
        const val PREF_BUBBLE_SIZE_DP = "bubble_size_dp"
        const val PREF_HAPTICS_ENABLED = "haptics_enabled"
        const val ACTION_OPEN_OVERLAY_SETTINGS = "ACTION_OPEN_OVERLAY_SETTINGS"
        const val ACTION_OPEN_OVERLAY_ROUTE = "ACTION_OPEN_OVERLAY_ROUTE"
        const val ACTION_SHOW_HAND_SETTINGS = "ACTION_SHOW_HAND_SETTINGS"
        const val EXTRA_OVERLAY_ROUTE = "extra_overlay_route"

        var isRunning = false
            private set

        private val _isScreenHeldState = MutableStateFlow(false)
        val isScreenHeldState: StateFlow<Boolean> = _isScreenHeldState

        private val _isCpuActiveState = MutableStateFlow(false)
        val isCpuActiveState: StateFlow<Boolean> = _isCpuActiveState

        private val _awakeErrorState = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
        val awakeErrorState: StateFlow<String?> = _awakeErrorState

        fun clampOverlayPosition(
            x: Int,
            y: Int,
            viewWidthPx: Int,
            viewHeightPx: Int,
            safeBounds: Rect
        ): Pair<Int, Int> {
            val maxX = (safeBounds.right - viewWidthPx).coerceAtLeast(safeBounds.left)
            val maxY = (safeBounds.bottom - viewHeightPx).coerceAtLeast(safeBounds.top)
            return x.coerceIn(safeBounds.left, maxX) to y.coerceIn(safeBounds.top, maxY)
        }
    }

    private var windowManager: WindowManager? = null
    private var bubbleView: View? = null
    private var bubbleParams: WindowManager.LayoutParams? = null

    private var sessionHudView: View? = null
    private var sessionHudParams: WindowManager.LayoutParams? = null

    private var panelView: View? = null
    private var panelParams: WindowManager.LayoutParams? = null

    private var settingsOverlayView: View? = null
    private var settingsOverlayParams: WindowManager.LayoutParams? = null

    private var handSettingsOverlayView: View? = null
    private var handSettingsOverlayParams: WindowManager.LayoutParams? = null

    private var isPanelVisible = false
    private var isSettingsOverlayVisible = false
    private var isHandSettingsVisible = false
    private var statusBannerMessage = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    private val overlayRouteStack = MutableStateFlow(listOf(AppRoute.SETTINGS))
    private var floatingHandsManager: FloatingHandsOverlayManager? = null
    private var wakeLock: PowerManager.WakeLock? = null
    private var isKeepAwakeEngaged = false
    private var lastToastTicker: String = ""
    private var lastToastTimestampMs: Long = 0L

    private val serviceScope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Main + SupervisorJob())

    private val lifecycleRegistry = LifecycleRegistry(this)
    private val store = ViewModelStore()
    private val savedStateRegistryController = SavedStateRegistryController.create(this)

    override val lifecycle: Lifecycle get() = lifecycleRegistry
    override val viewModelStore: ViewModelStore get() = store
    override val savedStateRegistry: SavedStateRegistry get() = savedStateRegistryController.savedStateRegistry

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null

    private fun isMonitoringStatusActive(status: MonitoringStatus): Boolean =
        status == MonitoringStatus.MONITORING ||
            status == MonitoringStatus.WAITING_FOR_GAME ||
            status == MonitoringStatus.GAME_NOT_ACCESSIBLE ||
            status == MonitoringStatus.GAME_SUSPENDED

    private fun getOrCreateFloatingHandsManager(): FloatingHandsOverlayManager? {
        floatingHandsManager?.let { return it }
        val repo = AutomationController.repository ?: return null
        val eng = AutomationController.engine ?: return null
        return FloatingHandsOverlayManager(
            context = this,
            repository = repo,
            automationEngine = eng,
            onOpenHandSettings = { showDedicatedHandSettingsOverlay() }
        ).also { floatingHandsManager = it }
    }

    private fun toggleUnifiedActionHand() {
        val manager = getOrCreateFloatingHandsManager()
        if (manager == null) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Overlay Action Hand initializing...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        manager.showOrToggleUnifiedHand()
    }

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        when (intent?.action) {
            "ACTION_STOP_MONITORING" -> {
                AutomationController.stopMonitoringSession()
                runCatching {
                    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
                        stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE)
                    } else {
                        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                        stopForeground(true)
                    }
                }
                stopSelf()
                return START_NOT_STICKY
            }
            ACTION_OPEN_OVERLAY_SETTINGS -> {
                removeCompactControlPanel()
                showSettingsOverlayPanel(AppRoute.SETTINGS)
            }
            ACTION_SHOW_HAND_SETTINGS -> {
                removeCompactControlPanel()
                showDedicatedHandSettingsOverlay()
            }
            ACTION_OPEN_OVERLAY_ROUTE -> {
                val routeName = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_OVERLAY_ROUTE)
                val targetRoute = AppRoute.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == routeName } ?: AppRoute.HOME
                removeCompactControlPanel()
                showSettingsOverlayPanel(targetRoute)
            }
        }
        return START_STICKY
    }

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        createNotificationChannel()
        isRunning = true
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.UPSIDE_DOWN_CAKE) {
                startForeground(
                    NOTIFICATION_ID,
                    createNotification(),
                    android.content.pm.ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SPECIAL_USE
                )
            } else {
                startForeground(NOTIFICATION_ID, createNotification())
            }
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to start foreground service in ScreenEarnerOverlayService", t)
            isRunning = false
            stopSelf()
            return
        }

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M && !android.provider.Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Display over other apps permission (canDrawOverlays) is missing.")
            try {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Display over other apps permission is recommended for overlay UI.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            } catch (_: Throwable) {
            }
        }

        savedStateRegistryController.performRestore(null)
        lifecycleRegistry.handleLifecycleEvent(Lifecycle.Event.ON_CREATE)
        lifecycleRegistry.handleLifecycleEvent(Lifecycle.Event.ON_START)
        lifecycleRegistry.handleLifecycleEvent(Lifecycle.Event.ON_RESUME)

        AutomationController.ensureInitialized(applicationContext)

        windowManager = getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as? WindowManager

        setupFloatingBubbleOverlay()
        setupSessionStatsHudOverlay()
        registerGesturePassThroughListener()
        observeKeepAwakeAndDiagnostics()
    }

    private fun registerGesturePassThroughListener() {
        AccessibilityController.gestureOverlayPassThroughListener = { isDispatching ->
            FloatingHandsOverlayManager.setAllPassThrough(isDispatching)
            val wm = windowManager
            if (wm != null) {
                fun updateTouchable(view: View?, params: WindowManager.LayoutParams?) {
                    if (view == null || params == null || !view.isAttachedToWindow) return
                    val nextFlags = if (isDispatching) {
                        params.flags or WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE
                    } else {
                        params.flags and WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE.inv()
                    }
                    if (params.flags != nextFlags) {
                        params.flags = nextFlags
                        runCatching { wm.updateViewLayout(view, params) }
                    }
                }
                updateTouchable(bubbleView, bubbleParams)
                updateTouchable(sessionHudView, sessionHudParams)
                updateTouchable(panelView, panelParams)
                updateTouchable(settingsOverlayView, settingsOverlayParams)
                updateTouchable(handSettingsOverlayView, handSettingsOverlayParams)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun observeKeepAwakeAndDiagnostics() {
        val engine = AutomationController.engine

        // Req 5: Acquire FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON and bounded CPU wake lock while Monitoring Engine is active (independent of Automation)
        serviceScope.launch {
            if (engine != null) {
                combine(
                    AutomationController.latestConfig,
                    AutomationController.monitoringStatus,
                    engine.isStandbyOutsideSchedule
                ) { cfg, monStatus, standby ->
                    cfg.keepScreenAwake && isMonitoringStatusActive(monStatus) && !standby
                }.distinctUntilChanged().collect { shouldHold ->
                    isKeepAwakeEngaged = shouldHold
                    applyScreenAwakeFlag(shouldHold)
                    applyCpuWakeLock(shouldHold)
                    engine.gameDetection.updateScreenAwakeState(
                        wakeLockActive = _isCpuActiveState.value,
                        keepScreenOnApplied = _isScreenHeldState.value
                    )
                }
            } else {
                isKeepAwakeEngaged = false
                applyScreenAwakeFlag(false)
                applyCpuWakeLock(false)
            }
        }

        serviceScope.launch {
            engine?.agentStatusTicker?.collect { ticker ->
                val cfg = AutomationController.latestConfig.value
                val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
                if (cfg.diagnosticToastsEnabled &&
                    ticker.isNotBlank() &&
                    ticker != lastToastTicker &&
                    now - lastToastTimestampMs >= 2500L
                ) {
                    lastToastTimestampMs = now
                    lastToastTicker = ticker
                    try {
                        Toast.makeText(this@ScreenEarnerOverlayService, ticker, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    } catch (_: Throwable) {
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun applyScreenAwakeFlag(keepOn: Boolean) {
        val wm = windowManager ?: run {
            _isScreenHeldState.value = false
            if (keepOn) _awakeErrorState.value = "WindowManager not ready"
            return
        }

        var anyUpdated = false
        fun applyToView(view: View?, params: WindowManager.LayoutParams?): Boolean {
            if (view == null || params == null) return false
            val updated = if (keepOn) {
                params.flags or WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON
            } else {
                params.flags and WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON.inv()
            }
            if (params.flags != updated) {
                params.flags = updated
            }
            if (view.isAttachedToWindow) {
                return try {
                    wm.updateViewLayout(view, params)
                    true
                } catch (t: Throwable) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "Error updating FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON on overlay", t)
                    false
                }
            }
            return false
        }

        try {
            if (applyToView(bubbleView, bubbleParams)) anyUpdated = true
            if (applyToView(sessionHudView, sessionHudParams)) anyUpdated = true
            if (applyToView(panelView, panelParams)) anyUpdated = true
            if (applyToView(settingsOverlayView, settingsOverlayParams)) anyUpdated = true
            if (applyToView(handSettingsOverlayView, handSettingsOverlayParams)) anyUpdated = true

            if (keepOn) {
                if (anyUpdated) {
                    _isScreenHeldState.value = true
                    _awakeErrorState.value = null
                } else {
                    _isScreenHeldState.value = false
                    _awakeErrorState.value = "No attached overlay window"
                }
            } else {
                _isScreenHeldState.value = false
                _awakeErrorState.value = null
            }
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed applying keep screen awake flag", t)
            _isScreenHeldState.value = false
            _awakeErrorState.value = "Awake error: ${t.localizedMessage ?: "Unknown"}"
        }
    }

    @Suppress("WakelockTimeout")
    private fun applyCpuWakeLock(shouldHoldCpu: Boolean) {
        try {
            if (shouldHoldCpu) {
                if (wakeLock == null) {
                    val pm = getSystemService(Context.POWER_SERVICE) as? PowerManager
                    wakeLock = pm?.newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK, "PredictManager:CpuWakeLock")?.apply {
                        setReferenceCounted(false)
                    }
                }
                if (wakeLock?.isHeld == false) {
                    wakeLock?.acquire(4 * 60 * 60 * 1000L)
                }
                _isCpuActiveState.value = wakeLock?.isHeld == true
            } else {
                releaseWakeLockSafely()
                _isCpuActiveState.value = false
            }
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed updating CPU wake lock", t)
            _isCpuActiveState.value = false
        }
    }

    private fun releaseWakeLockSafely() {
        try {
            if (wakeLock?.isHeld == true) {
                wakeLock?.release()
            }
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed releasing wake lock", t)
        }
        _isCpuActiveState.value = false
    }

    /**
     * Draggable overlay container supporting unclamped off-screen edge parking via FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS.
     * Passes scroll gestures inside `excludedScrollRect` cleanly to the bounded crash history grid.
     */
    private inner class DraggableOverlayLayout(
        context: Context,
        private val layoutParams: WindowManager.LayoutParams,
        private val onPositionSaved: ((Int, Int) -> Unit)? = null,
        private val onBackPressed: (() -> Unit)? = null
    ) : FrameLayout(context) {
        private val touchSlop = ViewConfiguration.get(context).scaledTouchSlop
        private var initialX = 0
        private var initialY = 0
        private var initialTouchX = 0f
        private var initialTouchY = 0f
        private var downInsideScrollZone = false
        private var isDragging = false

        var excludedScrollRect: RectF? = null

        init {
            setViewTreeLifecycleOwner(this@ScreenEarnerOverlayService)
            setViewTreeViewModelStoreOwner(this@ScreenEarnerOverlayService)
            setViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner(this@ScreenEarnerOverlayService)
        }

        override fun dispatchKeyEvent(event: KeyEvent): Boolean {
            if (onBackPressed != null &&
                event.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK &&
                event.action == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP
            ) {
                onBackPressed.invoke()
                return true
            }
            return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event)
        }

        override fun onInterceptTouchEvent(ev: MotionEvent): Boolean {
            when (ev.actionMasked) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    initialX = layoutParams.x
                    initialY = layoutParams.y
                    initialTouchX = ev.rawX
                    initialTouchY = ev.rawY
                    isDragging = false
                    val headerThresholdPx = 55f * context.resources.displayMetrics.density
                    downInsideScrollZone = ev.y > headerThresholdPx
                    return false
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    if (downInsideScrollZone) return false
                    val dx = kotlin.math.abs(ev.rawX - initialTouchX)
                    val dy = kotlin.math.abs(ev.rawY - initialTouchY)
                    if (dx > touchSlop || dy > touchSlop) {
                        isDragging = true
                        return true
                    }
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                    isDragging = false
                    downInsideScrollZone = false
                }
            }
            return false
        }

        override fun onTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
            when (event.actionMasked) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    initialX = layoutParams.x
                    initialY = layoutParams.y
                    initialTouchX = event.rawX
                    initialTouchY = event.rawY
                    isDragging = false
                    return true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    val dx = event.rawX - initialTouchX
                    val dy = event.rawY - initialTouchY
                    if (isDragging || kotlin.math.abs(dx) > touchSlop || kotlin.math.abs(dy) > touchSlop) {
                        isDragging = true
                        layoutParams.x = initialX + dx.toInt()
                        layoutParams.y = initialY + dy.toInt()
                        try {
                            windowManager?.updateViewLayout(this, layoutParams)
                        } catch (_: Throwable) {
                        }
                    }
                    return true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                    if (isDragging) {
                        onPositionSaved?.invoke(layoutParams.x, layoutParams.y)
                    }
                    isDragging = false
                    downInsideScrollZone = false
                    return true
                }
            }
            return super.onTouchEvent(event)
        }
    }

    private fun overlayLayoutType(): Int {
        return if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_PHONE
        }
    }

    private fun createNotificationChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            val channel = NotificationChannel(
                CHANNEL_ID,
                "Predict Manager Floating Monitor",
                NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
            ).apply {
                description = "Runs the floating live game observer bubble and background telemetry service."
            }
            val manager = getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)
            manager?.createNotificationChannel(channel)
        }
    }

    private fun createNotification(): Notification {
        val pendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            this,
            0,
            Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE or PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
        )

        val stopIntent = Intent(this, ScreenEarnerOverlayService::class.java).apply {
            action = "ACTION_STOP_MONITORING"
        }
        val stopPendingIntent = PendingIntent.getService(
            this,
            1,
            stopIntent,
            PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE or PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
        )

        return NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
            .setContentTitle("PREDICT MANAGER — MONITORING ACTIVE")
            .setContentText("Observing live crash game history ribbon & background windows.")
            .setSmallIcon(R.mipmap.ic_launcher_round)
            .setContentIntent(pendingIntent)
            .addAction(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_close_clear_cancel, "Stop Monitoring", stopPendingIntent)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_LOW)
            .build()
    }

    private fun setupFloatingBubbleOverlay() {
        val prefs = getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val bubbleDp = prefs.getFloat(PREF_BUBBLE_SIZE_DP, 58f).coerceIn(44f, 80f)
        val bubbleOpacity = prefs.getFloat(PREF_BUBBLE_OPACITY, 0.95f).coerceIn(0.3f, 1.0f)

        val containerDp = (bubbleDp + 16f).toInt()
        val bubbleSizePx = (containerDp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

        bubbleParams = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
            bubbleSizePx,
            bubbleSizePx,
            overlayLayoutType(),
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS or
                (if (isKeepAwakeEngaged) WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON else 0),
            PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
        ).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
            x = 24
            y = 240
        }

        val container = FrameLayout(this).apply {
            setViewTreeLifecycleOwner(this@ScreenEarnerOverlayService)
            setViewTreeViewModelStoreOwner(this@ScreenEarnerOverlayService)
            setViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner(this@ScreenEarnerOverlayService)
        }

        val monitoringStatusFlow = AutomationController.monitoringStatus

        val composeView = ComposeView(this).apply {
            setContent {
                AutoPredictorTheme(darkTheme = false) {
                    val monStatus by monitoringStatusFlow.collectAsState()
                    FloatingMonitorBubbleComposable(
                        coreSizeDp = bubbleDp,
                        opacity = bubbleOpacity,
                        isRunningActive = isMonitoringStatusActive(monStatus)
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        container.addView(composeView)
        bubbleView = container

        val touchSlop = ViewConfiguration.get(this).scaledTouchSlop
        var initialX = 0
        var initialY = 0
        var initialTouchX = 0f
        var initialTouchY = 0f
        var isMoved = false

        container.setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    initialX = bubbleParams?.x ?: 0
                    initialY = bubbleParams?.y ?: 0
                    initialTouchX = event.rawX
                    initialTouchY = event.rawY
                    isMoved = false
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    val diffX = kotlin.math.abs(event.rawX - initialTouchX)
                    val diffY = kotlin.math.abs(event.rawY - initialTouchY)
                    if (diffX > touchSlop || diffY > touchSlop) {
                        isMoved = true
                        // Unclamped FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS drag
                        bubbleParams?.x = initialX + (event.rawX - initialTouchX).toInt()
                        bubbleParams?.y = initialY + (event.rawY - initialTouchY).toInt()
                        bubbleParams?.let { params ->
                            try {
                                windowManager?.updateViewLayout(bubbleView, params)
                            } catch (e: Exception) {
                                Log.e(TAG, "Failed updating bubble position", e)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                    if (!isMoved) {
                        toggleCompactControlPanel()
                    }
                    true
                }
                else -> false
            }
        }

        try {
            windowManager?.addView(bubbleView, bubbleParams)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed adding bubble view", e)
        }
    }

    private fun setupSessionStatsHudOverlay() {
        val prefs = getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val hudOpacity = prefs.getFloat(PREF_BUBBLE_OPACITY, 0.95f).coerceIn(0.45f, 1.0f)
        val sessionMgr = SessionStateManager(this)
        val defaultX = (20 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
        val defaultY = (36 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
        val (savedX, savedY) = sessionMgr.loadTopPillPosition(defaultX, defaultY)

        val params = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
            overlayLayoutType(),
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS or
                (if (isKeepAwakeEngaged) WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON else 0),
            PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
        ).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
            x = savedX
            y = savedY
        }
        sessionHudParams = params

        val container = FrameLayout(this).apply {
            setViewTreeLifecycleOwner(this@ScreenEarnerOverlayService)
            setViewTreeViewModelStoreOwner(this@ScreenEarnerOverlayService)
            setViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner(this@ScreenEarnerOverlayService)
        }

        val engine = AutomationController.engine
        val statsFlow = engine?.sessionStats ?: MutableStateFlow(SessionStats())
        val automationFlow = engine?.automationState ?: MutableStateFlow(AutomationState.IDLE)
        val monitoringFlow = AutomationController.monitoringStatus
        val gameStateFlow = engine?.gameDetection?.gameState ?: MutableStateFlow(GameState())
        val sessionCrashRecordsFlow = AutomationController.activeSessionCrashRecords

        val composeView = ComposeView(this).apply {
            setContent {
                AutoPredictorTheme(darkTheme = false) {
                    val stats by statsFlow.collectAsState()
                    val autoState by automationFlow.collectAsState()
                    val monStatus by monitoringFlow.collectAsState()
                    val gs by gameStateFlow.collectAsState()
                    val sessionCrashes by sessionCrashRecordsFlow.collectAsState()
                    val latestCrashVal = sessionCrashes.firstOrNull()?.multiplier ?: gs.latestCrashMultiplier
                    FloatingSessionStatsHudComposable(
                        stats = stats,
                        observedRounds = sessionCrashes.size,
                        automationState = autoState,
                        opacity = hudOpacity,
                        gameName = if (gs.isDetected) gs.displayedGameName else "Predict Manager",
                        liveMultiplier = gs.currentMultiplier,
                        liveDetectionLost = gs.liveDetectionLost,
                        latestCrashMultiplier = latestCrashVal,
                        latestRoundId = gs.latestRoundId,
                        monitoringStatus = monStatus
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        container.addView(composeView)
        sessionHudView = container

        val touchSlop = ViewConfiguration.get(this).scaledTouchSlop
        var initialX = 0
        var initialY = 0
        var initialTouchX = 0f
        var initialTouchY = 0f
        var isDragged = false

        container.setOnTouchListener { v, event ->
            when (event.actionMasked) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    initialX = params.x
                    initialY = params.y
                    initialTouchX = event.rawX
                    initialTouchY = event.rawY
                    isDragged = false
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    val diffX = kotlin.math.abs(event.rawX - initialTouchX)
                    val diffY = kotlin.math.abs(event.rawY - initialTouchY)
                    if (diffX > touchSlop || diffY > touchSlop) {
                        isDragged = true
                        // Unclamped drag so user can park pill freely anywhere
                        params.x = initialX + (event.rawX - initialTouchX).toInt()
                        params.y = initialY + (event.rawY - initialTouchY).toInt()
                        try {
                            windowManager?.updateViewLayout(v, params)
                        } catch (_: Throwable) {
                        }
                    }
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                    if (isDragged) {
                        sessionMgr.saveTopPillPosition(params.x, params.y)
                    } else {
                        toggleCompactControlPanel()
                    }
                    true
                }
                else -> false
            }
        }

        try {
            windowManager?.addView(container, params)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed adding session HUD view", e)
        }
    }

    private fun toggleCompactControlPanel() {
        if (isPanelVisible) {
            removeCompactControlPanel()
        } else {
            showCompactControlPanel()
        }
    }

    /**
     * Resizable, repositionable Compact/Expanded Predict Manager Live Monitor floating card.
     * Hiding the panel keeps foreground monitoring active; provides quick navigation to
     * Strategies, History, Hourly, and Settings without interrupting background capture.
     */
    private fun showCompactControlPanel() {
        if (isPanelVisible) return

        val sessionMgr = SessionStateManager(this)
        val bx = bubbleParams?.x ?: 24
        val by = bubbleParams?.y ?: 240
        val (savedPanelX, savedPanelY) = sessionMgr.loadPanelPosition(bx + 48, (by - 20).coerceAtLeast(32))
        val (initialWidthDp, initialHeightDp) = sessionMgr.loadPanelSize(defaultWidthDp = 280, defaultHeightDp = 360)
        val initialCompact = sessionMgr.isPanelCompactMode()

        val basePanelFlags = WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL or
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS or
            (if (isKeepAwakeEngaged) WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON else 0)

        val params = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
            overlayLayoutType(),
            basePanelFlags,
            PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
        ).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
            x = savedPanelX
            y = savedPanelY
        }
        panelParams = params

        val container = DraggableOverlayLayout(
            context = this,
            layoutParams = params,
            onPositionSaved = { px, py -> sessionMgr.savePanelPosition(px, py) }
        )

        val engine = AutomationController.engine
        val repo = AutomationController.repository
        val gameStateFlow = engine?.gameDetection?.gameState ?: MutableStateFlow(GameState())
        val automationStateFlow = engine?.automationState ?: MutableStateFlow(AutomationState.IDLE)
        val tickerFlow = engine?.agentStatusTicker ?: MutableStateFlow("Scanning for crash game...")
        val standbyFlow = engine?.isStandbyOutsideSchedule ?: MutableStateFlow(false)
        val sessionCrashRecordsFlow = AutomationController.activeSessionCrashRecords
        val density = resources.displayMetrics.density

        val composeView = ComposeView(this).apply {
            setContent {
                AutoPredictorTheme(darkTheme = false) {
                    val gameState by gameStateFlow.collectAsState()
                    val automationState by automationStateFlow.collectAsState()
                    val monitoringStatus by AutomationController.monitoringStatus.collectAsState()
                    val agentTicker by tickerFlow.collectAsState()
                    val isStandby by standbyFlow.collectAsState()
                    val activeConfig by AutomationController.latestConfig.collectAsState()
                    val agentExplanation by AutomationController.smartAgentExplanation.collectAsState()
                    val allCrashRecords by sessionCrashRecordsFlow.collectAsState()
                    val selectedGameId by AutomationController.selectedGameId.collectAsState()
                    val bannerMsg by statusBannerMessage.collectAsState()
                    val isScreenHeld by isScreenHeldState.collectAsState()
                    val awakeError by awakeErrorState.collectAsState()
                    val isAlarmRinging by AlarmAudioController.isAlarmRinging.collectAsState()
                    val activeAlarmTitle by AlarmAudioController.activeAlarmTitle.collectAsState()
                    var showExitConfirmation by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
                    var panelWidthDp by remember { mutableStateOf(initialWidthDp) }
                    var panelHeightDp by remember { mutableStateOf(initialHeightDp) }
                    var isCompact by remember { mutableStateOf(initialCompact) }

                    val scopedCrashes = remember(allCrashRecords, gameState.isDetected, gameState.gameId, selectedGameId) {
                        val targetId = if (gameState.isDetected) gameState.gameId else selectedGameId
                        if (targetId == "ALL") allCrashRecords else allCrashRecords.filter { it.gameId == targetId }
                    }
                    val isRunningMonitor = isMonitoringStatusActive(monitoringStatus)
                    val isAutoRunning = automationState == AutomationState.RUNNING

                    Card(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .width(panelWidthDp.dp)
                            .heightIn(max = if (isCompact) 240.dp else panelHeightDp.dp)
                            .shadow(14.dp, RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                            .border(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant, RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
                            .testTag("overlay_monitor_panel"),
                        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
                    ) {
                        Column(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                                .padding(10.dp),
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                        ) {
                            // Header bar with drag grip, Compact/Expand toggle & Close (hide panel only)
                            Row(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                            ) {
                                Row(
                                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                                ) {
                                    Icon(
                                        imageVector = Icons.Default.DragIndicator,
                                        contentDescription = "Drag Utility Panel",
                                        tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                        modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                                    )

                                        modifier = Modifier
                                            .size(8.dp)

                                                CircleShape

                                    )
                                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                                    Text(
                                        text = "PREDICT MANAGER MONITOR",
                                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                                        letterSpacing = 0.4.sp,
                                        maxLines = 1,
                                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                                    )
