/**
 * Properly managed audio & vibration controller for active signal alarms and settings tests.
 * Respects system Do Not Disturb, audio focus / volume, and configured max duration;
 * stops and releases MediaPlayer resources immediately upon Stop, Snooze, or timeout.
 */
object AlarmAudioController {
    private const val TAG = "AlarmAudioController"
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default + SupervisorJob())

    private val _isAlarmRinging = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isAlarmRinging: StateFlow<Boolean> = _isAlarmRinging.asStateFlow()

    private val _activeAlarmTitle = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val activeAlarmTitle: StateFlow<String?> = _activeAlarmTitle.asStateFlow()

    private val _snoozedUntilMs = MutableStateFlow(0L)
    val snoozedUntilMs: StateFlow<Long> = _snoozedUntilMs.asStateFlow()

    private val _lastAudioStatus = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val lastAudioStatus: StateFlow<String?> = _lastAudioStatus.asStateFlow()

    private var mediaPlayer: MediaPlayer? = null
    private var autoStopJob: Job? = null
    private var activeVibrator: Vibrator? = null
    @Volatile
    private var lastAppContext: Context? = null

    fun vibrationTimingsFor(patternKey: String): LongArray = when (patternKey.uppercase()) {
        "SHORT_PULSE" -> longArrayOf(0L, 120L, 100L, 120L)
        "DISTINCTIVE" -> longArrayOf(0L, 350L, 150L, 350L, 150L, 600L)
        "LONG_CONTINUOUS" -> longArrayOf(0L, 800L, 250L, 800L)
        "NONE" -> longArrayOf(0L)
        else -> longArrayOf(0L, 220L, 120L, 220L)
    }

    /**
     * Resolves a user-selected Android sound URI ONLY.
     * Never silently auto-assigns a sound when customUriString is empty.
     */
    fun resolveSoundUri(customUriString: String, isAlarm: Boolean): Uri? {
        if (customUriString.isBlank()) return null
        return runCatching { Uri.parse(customUriString.trim()) }.getOrNull()
    }

    fun previewSoundUri(context: Context, uriString: String, asAlarmStream: Boolean = true) {
        val uri = resolveSoundUri(uriString, isAlarm = asAlarmStream)
        if (uri == null) {
            _lastAudioStatus.value = "No sound selected — tap Choose Sound to pick one."
            return
        }
        stopAlarm()
        runCatching {
            val usage = if (asAlarmStream) AudioAttributes.USAGE_ALARM else AudioAttributes.USAGE_NOTIFICATION_EVENT
            val player = MediaPlayer().apply {
                setAudioAttributes(
                    AudioAttributes.Builder()
                        .setUsage(usage)
                        .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
                        .build()
                )
                setDataSource(context.applicationContext, uri)
                isLooping = false
                setOnCompletionListener { mp ->
                    runCatching { mp.release() }
                    if (mediaPlayer === mp) mediaPlayer = null
                }
                prepare()
                start()
            }
            mediaPlayer = player
            _lastAudioStatus.value = "Previewing selected sound."
        }.onFailure {
            _lastAudioStatus.value = "Unable to play selected sound URI."
        }
    }

    fun testAlarmProfile(context: Context, profile: AlarmProfileEntity) {
        val settings = NotificationSettings(
            highPriorityAlarmEnabled = true,
            alarmSoundUri = profile.soundUri,
            alarmVibrationPattern = if (profile.vibrationEnabled) profile.vibrationPattern else "NONE",
            alarmRepeated = profile.repeatEnabled,
            alarmMaxDurationMinutes = 1
        )
        clearSnooze()
        if (profile.soundUri.isBlank() && !profile.vibrationEnabled) {
            _lastAudioStatus.value = "Profile '${profile.category().displayTitle}' has no sound or vibration selected."
            return
        }
        startAlarm(context, settings, "Test: ${profile.category().displayTitle}")
    }

    fun isAlarmSnoozed(nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): Boolean =
        _snoozedUntilMs.value > nowMs

    const val ALARM_NOTIFICATION_ID = 9999
    const val ACTION_STOP_ALARM = "com.example.action.STOP_ALARM"

    fun startAlarm(
        context: Context?,
        settings: NotificationSettings,
        title: String = "Signal Detected — Pattern Match",
        nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ) {
        if (!settings.highPriorityAlarmEnabled) {
            _lastAudioStatus.value = "Signal alarm disabled in profile."
            return
        }
        if (isAlarmSnoozed(nowMs)) {
            _lastAudioStatus.value = "Signal alarm snoozed."
            return
        }
        if (context == null) {
            _isAlarmRinging.value = true
            _activeAlarmTitle.value = title
            return
        }
        if (AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.isDoNotDisturbBlocking(context, NotificationPriorityLevel.URGENT)) {
            _lastAudioStatus.value = "Do Not Disturb active on device; alarm audio suppressed."
            return
        }

        val audioManager = context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE) as? AudioManager
        val alarmVol = audioManager?.getStreamVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_ALARM) ?: 1
        if (alarmVol <= 0) {
            _lastAudioStatus.value = "Device alarm volume is muted (0); triggering vibration only."
        }

        lastAppContext = context.applicationContext
        stopAlarm(context)
        _isAlarmRinging.value = true
        _activeAlarmTitle.value = title

        runCatching {
            val nm = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.ensureAllChannels(context, settings)
            }
            val stopIntent = Intent(context, AlarmStopReceiver::class.java).apply {
                action = ACTION_STOP_ALARM
            }
            val stopActionPendingIntent = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
                context,
                2002,
                stopIntent,
                PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
            )
            val stopTapPendingIntent = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
                context,
                2003,
                stopIntent,
                PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
            )
            val stopDeletePendingIntent = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
                context,
                2004,
                stopIntent,
                PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
            )

            val channelId = AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.resolveVersionedChannelId(
                AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.CHANNEL_ALARM, settings
            )
            val builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, channelId)
                .setSmallIcon(R.mipmap.ic_launcher_round)
                .setContentTitle(title)
                .setContentText("Alarm ringing — tap STOP ALARM or swipe away to silence.")
                .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_MAX)
                .setAutoCancel(true)
                .setSilent(true)
                .setContentIntent(stopTapPendingIntent)
                .setDeleteIntent(stopDeletePendingIntent)
                .addAction(R.mipmap.ic_launcher_round, "STOP ALARM", stopActionPendingIntent)

            nm?.notify(ALARM_NOTIFICATION_ID, builder.build())
        }

        val uri = resolveSoundUri(settings.alarmSoundUri, isAlarm = true)
        if (uri != null && alarmVol > 0) {
            runCatching {
                val player = MediaPlayer().apply {
                    setAudioAttributes(
                        AudioAttributes.Builder()
                            .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_ALARM)
                            .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
                            .build()
                    )
                    setDataSource(context.applicationContext, uri)
                    isLooping = settings.alarmRepeated
                    setOnCompletionListener {
                        if (!settings.alarmRepeated) {
                            stopAlarm(context)
                        }
                    }
                    setOnErrorListener { _, _, _ ->
                        stopAlarm(context)
                        true
                    }
                    prepare()
                    start()
                }
                mediaPlayer = player
            }.onFailure {
                Log.w(TAG, "Alarm MediaPlayer failed; keeping UI alarm state", it)
                _lastAudioStatus.value = "Unable to play alarm URI on this device."
            }
        }

        if (settings.alarmVibrationPattern != "NONE") {
            triggerVibration(context, settings.alarmVibrationPattern, repeat = settings.alarmRepeated)
        }

        val maxDurationMs = settings.alarmMaxDurationMinutes.coerceIn(1, 30) * 60_000L
        autoStopJob?.cancel()
        autoStopJob = scope.launch {
            delay(maxDurationMs)
            stopAlarm(context)
        }
    }

    fun stopAlarm(context: Context? = null) {
        autoStopJob?.cancel()
        autoStopJob = null
        runCatching {
            mediaPlayer?.apply {
                if (isPlaying) stop()
                reset()
                release()
            }
        }
        mediaPlayer = null
        runCatching { activeVibrator?.cancel() }
        activeVibrator = null
        _isAlarmRinging.value = false
        _activeAlarmTitle.value = null

        val ctx = context ?: lastAppContext ?: com.example.service.ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService.instance?.applicationContext
        if (ctx != null) {
            runCatching {
                val nm = ctx.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager
                nm?.cancel(ALARM_NOTIFICATION_ID)
            }
        }
    }

    fun snoozeAlarm(snoozeMinutes: Int = 5, nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()) {
        stopAlarm()
        val mins = snoozeMinutes.coerceIn(1, 30)
        _snoozedUntilMs.value = nowMs + mins * 60_000L
        _lastAudioStatus.value = "Signal alarm snoozed for ${mins}m."
    }

    fun clearSnooze() {
        _snoozedUntilMs.value = 0L
    }

    fun testStandardSound(context: Context, settings: NotificationSettings) {
        if (AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.isDoNotDisturbBlocking(context, NotificationPriorityLevel.STANDARD)) {
            _lastAudioStatus.value = "Do Not Disturb active; sound suppressed by Android."
            return
        }
        val uri = resolveSoundUri(settings.standardSoundUri, isAlarm = false)
        if (uri == null) {
            _lastAudioStatus.value = "No sound selected for Standard Alerts."
            return
        }
        stopAlarm()
        runCatching {
            val player = MediaPlayer().apply {
                setAudioAttributes(
                    AudioAttributes.Builder()
                        .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_NOTIFICATION_EVENT)
                        .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
                        .build()
                )
                setDataSource(context.applicationContext, uri)
                isLooping = false
                setOnCompletionListener { mp ->
                    runCatching { mp.release() }
                    if (mediaPlayer === mp) mediaPlayer = null
                }
                prepare()
                start()
            }
            mediaPlayer = player
            _lastAudioStatus.value = "Playing standard alert test sound."
        }.onFailure {
            _lastAudioStatus.value = "Could not play standard alert sound."
        }
    }

    fun testVibration(context: Context, patternKey: String) {
        triggerVibration(context, patternKey, repeat = false)
        _lastAudioStatus.value = "Triggered $patternKey vibration test."
    }

    fun testSignalAlarm(context: Context, settings: NotificationSettings) {
        clearSnooze()
        startAlarm(context, settings.copy(highPriorityAlarmEnabled = true, alarmMaxDurationMinutes = 1), "Test Signal Alarm (Pattern Match)")
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun triggerVibration(context: Context, patternKey: String, repeat: Boolean) {
        if (patternKey == "NONE") return
        val timings = vibrationTimingsFor(patternKey)
        if (timings.size <= 1) return
        val vibrator = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
            val vm = context.getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_MANAGER_SERVICE) as? VibratorManager
            vm?.defaultVibrator
        } else {
            context.getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_SERVICE) as? Vibrator
        } ?: return
        activeVibrator = vibrator
        runCatching {
            val repeatIndex = if (repeat) 0 else -1
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                vibrator.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createWaveform(timings, repeatIndex))
            } else {
                vibrator.vibrate(timings, repeatIndex)
            }
        }
    }

    fun openChannelSettings(context: Context, channelId: String) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_CHANNEL_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS).apply {
                putExtra(Settings.EXTRA_APP_PACKAGE, context.packageName)
                putExtra(Settings.EXTRA_CHANNEL_ID, channelId)
                addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
            }
            runCatching { context.startActivity(intent) }.onFailure {
                openAppNotificationSettings(context)
            }
        } else {
            openAppNotificationSettings(context)
        }
    }

    fun openAppNotificationSettings(context: Context) {
        val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_APP_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS).apply {
            putExtra(Settings.EXTRA_APP_PACKAGE, context.packageName)
            addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
        }
        runCatching { context.startActivity(intent) }
    }
}

object AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher : SystemNotificationDispatcher {
    const val CHANNEL_STANDARD = "monitoring_standard"
    const val CHANNEL_ALARM = "monitoring_alarm"
    const val CHANNEL_SERVICE = "monitoring_service"
    const val CHANNEL_HOURLY = "ap_hourly_analysis"

    // Compatibility constants kept for existing callers/tests
    const val STRATEGY_CHANNEL_ID = CHANNEL_ALARM
    const val CHANNEL_CRITICAL_PATTERNS = CHANNEL_ALARM
    const val CHANNEL_GAME_DETECTION = CHANNEL_STANDARD
    const val CHANNEL_MONITORING_ERRORS = CHANNEL_SERVICE
    const val CHANNEL_HOURLY_ANALYSIS = CHANNEL_HOURLY

    fun resolveVersionedChannelId(baseId: String, settings: NotificationSettings): String {
        val v = settings.channelConfigVersion.coerceAtLeast(1)
        return if (v <= 1 || baseId == CHANNEL_SERVICE || baseId == CHANNEL_HOURLY) baseId else "${baseId}_v$v"
    }

    override fun hasNotificationPermission(context: Context): Boolean {
        return if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                context,
                Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
            ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        } else {
            true
        }
    }

    override fun isDoNotDisturbBlocking(context: Context, priorityLevel: NotificationPriorityLevel): Boolean {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.M) return false
        val nm = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager ?: return false
        return when (nm.currentInterruptionFilter) {
            NotificationManager.INTERRUPTION_FILTER_NONE -> true
            NotificationManager.INTERRUPTION_FILTER_ALARMS -> true
            NotificationManager.INTERRUPTION_FILTER_PRIORITY -> priorityLevel != NotificationPriorityLevel.URGENT
            else -> false
        }
    }

    fun resolveChannelId(
        type: StrategyNotificationType,
        settings: NotificationSettings = NotificationSettings()
    ): String {
        val base = when (type) {
            StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED,
            StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_APPROACHING -> CHANNEL_ALARM
            StrategyNotificationType.HOURLY_SUMMARY,
            StrategyNotificationType.NEW_HOUR_STARTED -> CHANNEL_HOURLY
            StrategyNotificationType.GAME_DETECTED,
            StrategyNotificationType.AUTOMATION_ACTION -> CHANNEL_STANDARD
            StrategyNotificationType.HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE,
            StrategyNotificationType.MONITORING_ERROR,
            StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_PAUSED,
            StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_INVALIDATED -> CHANNEL_SERVICE
        }
        return resolveVersionedChannelId(base, settings)
    }

    fun resolveTargetTab(type: StrategyNotificationType): Int = when (type) {
        StrategyNotificationType.HOURLY_SUMMARY,
        StrategyNotificationType.NEW_HOUR_STARTED -> MainActivity.TAB_HOURLY_ANALYSIS
        StrategyNotificationType.GAME_DETECTED,
        StrategyNotificationType.HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE,
        StrategyNotificationType.MONITORING_ERROR,
        StrategyNotificationType.AUTOMATION_ACTION -> MainActivity.TAB_LIVE_MONITOR
        StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED,
        StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_APPROACHING,
        StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_INVALIDATED,
        StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_PAUSED -> MainActivity.TAB_PATTERNS
    }

    fun ensureStrategyChannel(context: Context, settings: NotificationSettings) {
        ensureAllChannels(context, settings)
    }

    fun ensureAllChannels(context: Context, settings: NotificationSettings) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return
        val nm = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager ?: return

        val alarmAttrs = AudioAttributes.Builder()
            .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_ALARM)
            .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
            .build()
        val alarmUri = AlarmAudioController.resolveSoundUri(settings.alarmSoundUri, isAlarm = true)

        val notifAttrs = AudioAttributes.Builder()
            .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_NOTIFICATION_EVENT)
            .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
            .build()
        val standardUri = AlarmAudioController.resolveSoundUri(settings.standardSoundUri, isAlarm = false)

        val standardChannelId = resolveVersionedChannelId(CHANNEL_STANDARD, settings)
        val alarmChannelId = resolveVersionedChannelId(CHANNEL_ALARM, settings)

        val standard = NotificationChannel(
            standardChannelId,
            "Standard Alerts",
            NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT
        ).apply {
            description = "Standard notifications for game detection, monitoring updates, and resumption."
            val vibEnabled = settings.vibrationEnabled && settings.standardVibrationPattern != "NONE"
            enableVibration(vibEnabled)
            if (vibEnabled) {
                vibrationPattern = AlarmAudioController.vibrationTimingsFor(settings.standardVibrationPattern)
            }
            if (!settings.soundEnabled || !settings.standardAlertEnabled) {
                setSound(null, null)
            } else {
                setSound(standardUri, notifAttrs)
            }
        }

        val alarm = NotificationChannel(
            alarmChannelId,
            "Pattern Match Signal Alarm",
            NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_HIGH
        ).apply {
            description = "Distinctive alarm notifications when a configured pattern or condition matches."
            val vibEnabled = settings.alarmVibrationPattern != "NONE"
            enableVibration(vibEnabled)
            if (vibEnabled) {
                vibrationPattern = AlarmAudioController.vibrationTimingsFor(settings.alarmVibrationPattern)
            }
            setSound(alarmUri, alarmAttrs)
            enableLights(true)
        }

        val service = NotificationChannel(
            CHANNEL_SERVICE,
            "Persistent Monitoring Service",
            NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
        ).apply {
            description = "Persistent notification ensuring overlay and background monitoring remain active."
        }

        val hourly = NotificationChannel(
            CHANNEL_HOURLY,
            "Hourly Analysis",
            NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT
        ).apply {
            description = "Hour transition summaries and statistical digests."
            enableVibration(false)
        }

        nm.createNotificationChannels(listOf(standard, alarm, service, hourly))
    }

    override fun postSystemNotification(
        context: Context,
        notificationId: Int,
        title: String,
        message: String,
        priorityLevel: NotificationPriorityLevel,
        soundEnabled: Boolean,
        vibrationEnabled: Boolean,
        historyRecordId: Long
    ): Boolean = postChannelNotification(
        context = context,
        channelId = CHANNEL_CRITICAL_PATTERNS,
        notificationId = notificationId,
        title = title,
        message = message,
        priorityLevel = priorityLevel,
        soundEnabled = soundEnabled,
        vibrationEnabled = vibrationEnabled,
        historyRecordId = historyRecordId
    )

    override fun postChannelNotification(
        context: Context,
        channelId: String,
        notificationId: Int,
        title: String,
        message: String,
        priorityLevel: NotificationPriorityLevel,
        soundEnabled: Boolean,
        vibrationEnabled: Boolean,
        historyRecordId: Long,
        targetTab: Int,
        targetGameId: String?
    ): Boolean {
        return try {
            val nm = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager
                ?: return false
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O && nm.getNotificationChannel(channelId) == null) {
                ensureAllChannels(
                    context,
                    NotificationSettings(soundEnabled = soundEnabled, vibrationEnabled = vibrationEnabled)
                )
            }

            val openIntent = Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java).apply {
                flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP
                putExtra(MainActivity.EXTRA_OPEN_TAB, targetTab)
                putExtra(MainActivity.EXTRA_NOTIFICATION_HISTORY_ID, historyRecordId)
                if (!targetGameId.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    putExtra(MainActivity.EXTRA_GAME_ID, targetGameId)
                }
            }
            val pendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
                context,
                notificationId,
                openIntent,
                PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
            )

            val compatPriority = when (priorityLevel) {
                NotificationPriorityLevel.URGENT -> NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_MAX
                NotificationPriorityLevel.HIGH -> NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_HIGH
                NotificationPriorityLevel.STANDARD -> NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_DEFAULT
            }

            val builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, channelId)
                .setSmallIcon(R.mipmap.ic_launcher_round)
                .setContentTitle(title)
                .setContentText(message)
                .setStyle(NotificationCompat.BigTextStyle().bigText(message))
                .setPriority(compatPriority)
                .setAutoCancel(true)
                .setContentIntent(pendingIntent)

            val isAlarmChannel = channelId.startsWith(CHANNEL_ALARM)
            if (!soundEnabled || !isAlarmChannel) {
                builder.setSilent(!soundEnabled)
            }
            if (vibrationEnabled && isAlarmChannel) {
                builder.setVibrate(longArrayOf(0L, 250L, 120L, 250L))
            }
            if (isAlarmChannel) {
                val stopIntent = Intent(context, AlarmStopReceiver::class.java).apply {
                    action = AlarmAudioController.ACTION_STOP_ALARM
                }
                val stopPi = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
                    context,
                    2005,
                    stopIntent,
                    PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
                )
                builder.addAction(R.mipmap.ic_launcher_round, "STOP ALARM", stopPi)
            }

            nm.notify(notificationId, builder.build())
            true
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.e("StrategyNotifMgr", "Failed posting Android notification", t)
            false
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Central Android System Notification Center controller.
 * Routes alerts to Pattern Match Signal Alarm, Standard Alerts, Hourly Analysis, or Persistent Service;
 * respects Android 13+ POST_NOTIFICATIONS, Do Not Disturb, quiet hours, cooldowns, and deduplication.
 */
class StrategyNotificationManager(
    private val context: Context?,
    private val repository: ScreenEarnerRepository,
    private val dispatcher: SystemNotificationDispatcher = AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher
) {
    private val lastDeliveredOccurrences = ConcurrentHashMap<String, Long>()
    private val lastStrategyDispatchTimes = ConcurrentHashMap<Long, Long>()
    private val strategyHourDispatchCounts = ConcurrentHashMap<Pair<Long, Long>, Int>()
    private val notificationIdSeq = AtomicInteger(2100)

    companion object {
        fun isWithinQuietHours(settings: NotificationSettings, nowMs: Long): Boolean {
            if (!settings.quietHoursEnabled) return false
            val cal = Calendar.getInstance().apply { timeInMillis = nowMs }
            val currentMinutes = cal.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY) * 60 + cal.get(Calendar.MINUTE)
            val startMinutes = settings.quietStartHour.coerceIn(0, 23) * 60 + settings.quietStartMinute.coerceIn(0, 59)
            val endMinutes = settings.quietEndHour.coerceIn(0, 23) * 60 + settings.quietEndMinute.coerceIn(0, 59)

            return if (startMinutes == endMinutes) {
                false
            } else if (startMinutes < endMinutes) {
                currentMinutes in startMinutes until endMinutes
            } else {
                currentMinutes >= startMinutes || currentMinutes < endMinutes
            }
        }
    }

    fun evaluateSuppressionReason(
        event: PatternAlertEvent,
        settings: NotificationSettings,
        nowMs: Long
    ): NotificationDeliveryStatus? {
        if (!settings.masterEnabled) {
            return NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_MASTER_OFF
        }
        val isSignalAlarmEvent = event.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED ||
            event.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_APPROACHING
        if (isSignalAlarmEvent && !settings.highPriorityAlarmEnabled && !settings.standardAlertEnabled) {
            return NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_TYPE_OFF
        }
        if (!isSignalAlarmEvent &&
            event.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.GAME_DETECTED &&
            !settings.standardAlertEnabled
        ) {
            return NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_TYPE_OFF
        }

        val typeEnabled = when (event.notificationType) {
            StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_APPROACHING -> settings.approachingEnabled
            StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED -> settings.reachedEnabled
            StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_INVALIDATED -> settings.invalidatedEnabled
            StrategyNotificationType.HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE ->
                settings.historyUnavailableEnabled && settings.failureAlertsEnabled
            StrategyNotificationType.MONITORING_ERROR ->
                (settings.monitoringErrorsEnabled || settings.historyUnavailableEnabled) && settings.failureAlertsEnabled
            StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_PAUSED -> settings.pausedEnabled
            StrategyNotificationType.HOURLY_SUMMARY,
            StrategyNotificationType.NEW_HOUR_STARTED -> settings.hourlySummaryEnabled
            StrategyNotificationType.GAME_DETECTED -> settings.gameDetectionEnabled
            StrategyNotificationType.AUTOMATION_ACTION ->
                settings.standardAlertEnabled && settings.executionAlertsEnabled
        }
        if (!typeEnabled) {
            return NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_TYPE_OFF
        }
        if (event.strategy.id > 0L && !event.strategy.notificationEnabled) {
            return NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_STRATEGY_OFF
        }
        if (isWithinQuietHours(settings, nowMs)) {
            return NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_QUIET_HOURS
        }
        if (context != null && dispatcher.isDoNotDisturbBlocking(context, event.strategy.notificationLevel)) {
            return NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_QUIET_HOURS
        }
        if (lastDeliveredOccurrences.containsKey(event.occurrenceKey)) {
            return NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_DUPLICATE
        }
        val effectiveStrategyKey = if (event.strategy.id > 0L) {
            event.strategy.id
        } else {
            event.strategy.name.hashCode().toLong()
        }
        val effectiveCooldownMin = maxOf(
            if (isSignalAlarmEvent && settings.alarmRepeated) settings.alarmRepeatIntervalMinutes else settings.repeatIntervalMinutes,
            event.strategy.repeatCooldownMinutes
        ).coerceAtLeast(0)
        if (event.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED && effectiveCooldownMin > 0) {
            val lastTime = lastStrategyDispatchTimes[effectiveStrategyKey] ?: 0L
            if (lastTime > 0L && (nowMs - lastTime) < effectiveCooldownMin * 60_000L) {
                return NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_COOLDOWN
            }
        }
        val hourBucket = nowMs / 3_600_000L
        val repeatCap = event.strategy.repeatLimit
        if (event.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED && repeatCap > 0) {
            val sentThisHour = strategyHourDispatchCounts[effectiveStrategyKey to hourBucket] ?: 0
            if (sentThisHour >= repeatCap) {
                return NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_COOLDOWN
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    suspend fun dispatchPatternAlert(
        event: PatternAlertEvent,
        settings: NotificationSettings,
        nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        gameId: String? = event.strategy.targetGameId.takeIf { it != "ALL" },
        occurrenceRecordId: Long? = null
    ): NotificationHistoryRecord {
        val channelId = AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.resolveChannelId(event.notificationType, settings)

        val suppression = evaluateSuppressionReason(event, settings, nowMs)
        if (suppression != null) {
            val suppressedRecord = NotificationHistoryRecord(
                strategyId = event.strategy.id,
                strategyName = event.strategy.name,
                gameId = gameId.orEmpty(),
                occurrenceRecordId = occurrenceRecordId,
                channelId = channelId,
                notificationType = event.notificationType,
                title = event.title,
                message = event.message,
                triggeringRecordKey = event.triggeringRecordKey,
                triggeringMultiplier = event.triggeringMultiplier,
                timestampMs = nowMs,
                deliveryStatus = suppression,
                interactionStatus = NotificationInteractionStatus.UNREAD
            )
            val savedId = repository.addNotificationHistory(suppressedRecord)
            return suppressedRecord.copy(id = savedId)
        }

        val appCtx = context
        val hasPermission = appCtx != null && dispatcher.hasNotificationPermission(appCtx)
        if (!hasPermission) {
            val deniedRecord = NotificationHistoryRecord(
                strategyId = event.strategy.id,
                strategyName = event.strategy.name,
                gameId = gameId.orEmpty(),
                occurrenceRecordId = occurrenceRecordId,
                channelId = channelId,
                notificationType = event.notificationType,
                title = event.title,
                message = event.message,
                triggeringRecordKey = event.triggeringRecordKey,
                triggeringMultiplier = event.triggeringMultiplier,
                timestampMs = nowMs,
                deliveryStatus = NotificationDeliveryStatus.PERMISSION_DENIED,
                interactionStatus = NotificationInteractionStatus.UNREAD
            )
            val savedId = repository.addNotificationHistory(deniedRecord)
            return deniedRecord.copy(id = savedId)
        }

        val pendingRecord = NotificationHistoryRecord(
            strategyId = event.strategy.id,
            strategyName = event.strategy.name,
            gameId = gameId.orEmpty(),
            occurrenceRecordId = occurrenceRecordId,
            channelId = channelId,
            notificationType = event.notificationType,
            title = event.title,
            message = event.message,
            triggeringRecordKey = event.triggeringRecordKey,
            triggeringMultiplier = event.triggeringMultiplier,
            timestampMs = nowMs,
            deliveryStatus = NotificationDeliveryStatus.DELIVERED,
            interactionStatus = NotificationInteractionStatus.UNREAD
        )
        val recordId = repository.addNotificationHistory(pendingRecord)

        val uniqueSeed = (event.occurrenceKey.hashCode() and 0x0FFFFFFF)
        val notifId = if (uniqueSeed > 0) uniqueSeed else notificationIdSeq.incrementAndGet()
        if (dispatcher === AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher) {
            AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.ensureAllChannels(appCtx, settings)
        }
        val posted = dispatcher.postChannelNotification(
            context = appCtx,
            channelId = channelId,
            notificationId = notifId,
            title = event.title,
            message = event.message,
            priorityLevel = event.strategy.notificationLevel,
            soundEnabled = settings.soundEnabled,
            vibrationEnabled = settings.vibrationEnabled,
            historyRecordId = recordId,
            targetTab = AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.resolveTargetTab(event.notificationType),
            targetGameId = gameId
        )

        if (posted &&
            event.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED &&
            event.strategy.useAlarmStyle &&
            settings.highPriorityAlarmEnabled &&
            dispatcher === AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher
        ) {
            val activeProfile = runCatching {
                repository.getAlarmProfile(event.strategy.resolveAlarmProfileCategory())
            }.getOrNull()
            if (activeProfile == null || activeProfile.enabled) {
                val effectiveSettings = if (activeProfile != null) {
                    settings.copy(
                        alarmSoundUri = activeProfile.soundUri.ifBlank { settings.alarmSoundUri },
                        alarmVibrationPattern = if (event.strategy.vibrationEnabled && activeProfile.vibrationEnabled) {
                            activeProfile.vibrationPattern
                        } else {
                            "NONE"
                        },
                        alarmRepeated = activeProfile.repeatEnabled && settings.alarmRepeated
                    )
                } else {
                    settings.copy(
                        alarmVibrationPattern = if (event.strategy.vibrationEnabled) settings.alarmVibrationPattern else "NONE"
                    )
                }
                AlarmAudioController.startAlarm(
                    context = appCtx,
                    settings = effectiveSettings,
                    title = "SIGNAL DETECTED: ${event.strategy.name}",
                    nowMs = nowMs
                )
            }
        }

        val effectiveStrategyKey = if (event.strategy.id > 0L) {
            event.strategy.id
        } else {
            event.strategy.name.hashCode().toLong()
        }
        val finalStatus = if (posted) {
            lastDeliveredOccurrences[event.occurrenceKey] = nowMs
            if (event.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED) {
                lastStrategyDispatchTimes[effectiveStrategyKey] = nowMs
                val hourBucket = nowMs / 3_600_000L
                val key = effectiveStrategyKey to hourBucket
                strategyHourDispatchCounts[key] = (strategyHourDispatchCounts[key] ?: 0) + 1
            }
            NotificationDeliveryStatus.DELIVERED
        } else {
            NotificationDeliveryStatus.FAILED
        }

        val finalRecord = pendingRecord.copy(id = recordId, deliveryStatus = finalStatus)
        if (!posted) {
            repository.addNotificationHistory(finalRecord)
        }
        return finalRecord
    }

    suspend fun dispatchSystemNotice(
        strategyName: String = "Predict Manager Monitor",
        type: StrategyNotificationType,
        title: String,
        message: String,
        occurrenceKey: String,
        settings: NotificationSettings,
        nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        gameId: String? = null
    ): NotificationHistoryRecord {
        val dummyStrategy = CustomPatternStrategy(id = 0L, name = strategyName)
        val event = PatternAlertEvent(
            strategy = dummyStrategy,
            notificationType = type,
            title = title,
            message = message,
            occurrenceKey = occurrenceKey,
            timestampMs = nowMs
        )
        return dispatchPatternAlert(event, settings, nowMs, gameId = gameId)
    }

    suspend fun dispatchHourlyBoundaryNotice(
        gameId: String,
        gameName: String,
        closedHourLabel: String,
        newHourLabel: String,
        summaryLine: String,
        settings: NotificationSettings,
        nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): NotificationHistoryRecord = dispatchSystemNotice(
        strategyName = "$gameName Hourly Digest",
        type = StrategyNotificationType.NEW_HOUR_STARTED,
        title = "New Hour $newHourLabel — $closedHourLabel Finalized",
        message = summaryLine,
        occurrenceKey = "hour_${gameId}_${newHourLabel}_${nowMs / 3_600_000L}",
        settings = settings,
        nowMs = nowMs,
        gameId = gameId
    )

    fun clearSessionCache() {
        lastDeliveredOccurrences.clear()
        lastStrategyDispatchTimes.clear()
        strategyHourDispatchCounts.clear()
    }
}

package com.example.service

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.PixelFormat
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.VibrationEffect
import android.os.Vibrator
import android.util.Log
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import com.example.R

class WindowManagerHelper(private val context: Context) {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "WindowManagerHelper"
    }

    private val windowManager: WindowManager? =
        context.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as? WindowManager

    private var mainBubbleView: View? = null
    private var mainBubbleParams: WindowManager.LayoutParams? = null

    private var expandedMenuView: View? = null
    private var expandedMenuParams: WindowManager.LayoutParams? = null
    private var isMenuExpanded = false

    private val independentRobotViews = mutableListOf<View>()

    private val density: Float = context.resources.displayMetrics.density

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * density).toInt()

    fun createOverlayLayoutParams(widthPx: Int, heightPx: Int, initialX: Int, initialY: Int): WindowManager.LayoutParams {
        val layoutType = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_PHONE
        }

        return WindowManager.LayoutParams(
            widthPx,
            heightPx,
            layoutType,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL or
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
        ).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
            x = initialX
            y = initialY
        }
    }

    fun createMainBubble(
        onSingleTap: (x: Int, y: Int) -> Unit,
        onLongPress: () -> Unit
    ) {
        if (mainBubbleView != null) return

        val sizePx = dpToPx(56)
        val params = createOverlayLayoutParams(sizePx, sizePx, 100, 200)
        mainBubbleParams = params

        val bubbleLayout = FrameLayout(context).apply {
            setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_floating_bubble)
            elevation = dpToPx(8).toFloat()
        }

        val imageView = ImageView(context).apply {
            setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_se_logo)
            scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_INSIDE
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), dpToPx(12), dpToPx(12), dpToPx(12))
        }
        bubbleLayout.addView(
            imageView,
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
        )

        var initialX = 0
        var initialY = 0
        var initialTouchX = 0f
        var initialTouchY = 0f
        var isMoved = false
        var isLongPressed = false

        val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
        val longPressRunnable = Runnable {
            isLongPressed = true
            triggerHapticVibration()
            onLongPress()
        }

        bubbleLayout.setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    initialX = params.x
                    initialY = params.y
                    initialTouchX = event.rawX
                    initialTouchY = event.rawY
                    isMoved = false
                    isLongPressed = false
                    handler.postDelayed(longPressRunnable, 800)
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    val dx = (event.rawX - initialTouchX).toInt()
                    val dy = (event.rawY - initialTouchY).toInt()
                    if (Math.abs(dx) > 6 || Math.abs(dy) > 6) {
                        isMoved = true
                        handler.removeCallbacks(longPressRunnable)
                        params.x = initialX + dx
                        params.y = initialY + dy
                        try {
                            windowManager?.updateViewLayout(mainBubbleView, params)
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            Log.e(TAG, "Failed updating main bubble layout", e)
                        }
                    }
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                    handler.removeCallbacks(longPressRunnable)
                    if (!isMoved && !isLongPressed) {
                        onSingleTap(params.x, params.y)
                    }
                    true
                }
                else -> false
            }
        }

        mainBubbleView = bubbleLayout
        try {
            windowManager?.addView(mainBubbleView, params)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed adding main bubble", e)
        }
    }

    fun toggleExpandedMenu(
        bubbleX: Int,
        bubbleY: Int,
        onAddBetClicked: () -> Unit,
        onAddCashOutClicked: () -> Unit,
        onStartClicked: () -> Unit,
        onPauseClicked: () -> Unit,
        onQuitClicked: () -> Unit
    ) {
        if (isMenuExpanded) {
            closeExpandedMenu()
        } else {
            openExpandedMenu(bubbleX, bubbleY, onAddBetClicked, onAddCashOutClicked, onStartClicked, onPauseClicked, onQuitClicked)
        }
    }

    fun openExpandedMenu(
        bubbleX: Int,
        bubbleY: Int,
        onAddBetClicked: () -> Unit,
        onAddCashOutClicked: () -> Unit,
        onStartClicked: () -> Unit,
        onPauseClicked: () -> Unit,
        onQuitClicked: () -> Unit
    ) {
        if (expandedMenuView != null) return

        val widthPx = dpToPx(260)
        val params = createOverlayLayoutParams(widthPx, WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, bubbleX + 70, bubbleY)
        expandedMenuParams = params

        val menuContainer = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            setBackgroundColor(0xEE1D2026.toInt()) // Dark MD3 Surface
            setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(16))
            elevation = dpToPx(12).toFloat()
        }

        val titleText = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "PREDICT MANAGER"
            setTextColor(0xFFE4E1E9.toInt())
            textSize = 14f
            setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
        }
        menuContainer.addView(titleText)

        val statusText = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "1.00x | BETTING OPEN"
            setTextColor(0xFF16A34A.toInt())
            textSize = 12f
            setPadding(0, dpToPx(4), 0, dpToPx(12))
        }
        menuContainer.addView(statusText)

        fun addMenuActionButton(label: String, bgColor: Int, onClick: () -> Unit) {
            val btn = TextView(context).apply {
                text = label
                setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF.toInt())
                setBackgroundColor(bgColor)
                setPadding(dpToPx(12), dpToPx(10), dpToPx(12), dpToPx(10))
                textSize = 12f
                setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
                setOnClickListener { onClick() }
            }
            val lp = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            ).apply { setMargins(0, dpToPx(3), 0, dpToPx(3)) }
            menuContainer.addView(btn, lp)
        }

        addMenuActionButton("ADD BET", 0xFF16A34A.toInt()) {
            onAddBetClicked()
            closeExpandedMenu()
        }
        addMenuActionButton("ADD CASH OUT", 0xFFF59E0B.toInt()) {
            onAddCashOutClicked()
            closeExpandedMenu()
        }
        addMenuActionButton("START AUTOMATION", 0xFF059669.toInt()) {
            onStartClicked()
        }
        addMenuActionButton("PAUSE / RESUME", 0xFFD97706.toInt()) {
            onPauseClicked()
        }
        addMenuActionButton("QUIT UTILITY", 0xFFDC2626.toInt()) {
            onQuitClicked()
        }

        expandedMenuView = menuContainer
        try {
            windowManager?.addView(expandedMenuView, params)
            isMenuExpanded = true
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed adding expanded menu", e)
        }
    }

    fun closeExpandedMenu() {
        expandedMenuView?.let {
            try {
                windowManager?.removeView(it)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Failed removing expanded menu", e)
            }
            expandedMenuView = null
        }
        isMenuExpanded = false
    }

    fun createIndependentRobotButton(label: String, bgColor: Int, onTaskRobotTapped: (View) -> Unit) {
        val sizePx = dpToPx(48)
        val initialX = 140 + (independentRobotViews.size * 65)
        val initialY = 400
        val params = createOverlayLayoutParams(sizePx, sizePx, initialX, initialY)

        val buttonView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = if (label.contains("BET", ignoreCase = true)) "B" else "C"
            setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF.toInt())
            setBackgroundColor(bgColor)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            textSize = 14f
            setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
            elevation = dpToPx(6).toFloat()
        }

        var initialXPos = 0
        var initialYPos = 0
        var initialTouchX = 0f
        var initialTouchY = 0f
        var isMoved = false

        buttonView.setOnTouchListener { v, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    initialXPos = params.x
                    initialYPos = params.y
                    initialTouchX = event.rawX
                    initialTouchY = event.rawY
                    isMoved = false
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    val dx = (event.rawX - initialTouchX).toInt()
                    val dy = (event.rawY - initialTouchY).toInt()
                    if (Math.abs(dx) > 5 || Math.abs(dy) > 5) {
                        isMoved = true
                        params.x = initialXPos + dx
                        params.y = initialYPos + dy
                        try {
                            windowManager?.updateViewLayout(v, params)
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            Log.e(TAG, "Failed updating robot button layout", e)
                        }
                    }
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                    if (!isMoved) {
                        onTaskRobotTapped(v)
                    }
                    true
                }
                else -> false
            }
        }

        independentRobotViews.add(buttonView)
        try {
            windowManager?.addView(buttonView, params)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed adding robot button", e)
        }
    }

    private fun triggerHapticVibration() {
        try {
            val vibrator = context.getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_SERVICE) as? Vibrator
            if (vibrator?.hasVibrator() == true) {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                    vibrator.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createOneShot(50, VibrationEffect.DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE))
                } else {
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    vibrator.vibrate(50)
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Haptic vibration failed", e)
        }
    }

    fun removeAllOverlays() {
        closeExpandedMenu()
        mainBubbleView?.let {
            try { windowManager?.removeView(it) } catch (e: Exception) { Log.e(TAG, "Failed removing main bubble", e) }
            mainBubbleView = null
        }
        independentRobotViews.forEach {
            try { windowManager?.removeView(it) } catch (e: Exception) { Log.e(TAG, "Failed removing robot button", e) }
        }
        independentRobotViews.clear()
    }
}

    val smartAgentExplanation: StateFlow<SmartAgentExplanation> = AutomationController.smartAgentExplanation

    private val _selectedTimeRangePreset = MutableStateFlow(HourlyAnalysisEngine.TimeRangePreset.ONE_HOUR)
    val selectedTimeRangePreset: StateFlow<HourlyAnalysisEngine.TimeRangePreset> = _selectedTimeRangePreset.asStateFlow()

    private val _customRangeStartMs = MutableStateFlow(System.currentTimeMillis() - 6 * 3_600_000L)

    ) { records, gameId, cfg, preset, customPair ->

            gameId == "ALL" -> "All Games"
            gameId == "unknown" -> "Unknown"

            preset = preset,

            gameName = resolvedName,
            customStartMs = customPair.first,
            customEndMs = customPair.second
        )

        scope = viewModelScope,
        started = SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000),
        initialValue = HourlyAnalysisEngine.analyzeTimeRange(
            preset = HourlyAnalysisEngine.TimeRangePreset.ONE_HOUR,
            records = emptyList()
        )

    val activeRoute: StateFlow<AppRoute> = _activeRoute.asStateFlow()

    private val _previousTab = MutableStateFlow(MainActivity.TAB_HOME)
    val previousTab: StateFlow<Int> = _previousTab.asStateFlow()

    private val _isOverlayServiceRunning = MutableStateFlow(ScreenEarnerOverlayService.isRunning)
    val isOverlayServiceRunning: StateFlow<Boolean> = _isOverlayServiceRunning.asStateFlow()

    private val _userMessage = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val userMessage: StateFlow<String?> = _userMessage.asStateFlow()

    fun refreshOverlayRunningState() {
        _isOverlayServiceRunning.value = ScreenEarnerOverlayService.isRunning
    }

    fun setSelectedGameId(gameId: String) {
        AutomationController.setSelectedGameId(gameId)
    }

    fun navigateToRoute(route: AppRoute) {
        selectTab(route.tabIndex)
    }

    fun selectTab(index: Int) {
        val current = _selectedTab.value
        val coerced = index.coerceIn(MainActivity.TAB_HOME, MainActivity.TAB_RISK_MANAGER)
        if (coerced != current) {
            if (current == MainActivity.TAB_HOME ||
                current == MainActivity.TAB_LIVE_MONITOR ||
                current == MainActivity.TAB_CRASH_HISTORY ||
                current == MainActivity.TAB_PATTERNS ||
                current == MainActivity.TAB_HOURLY_ANALYSIS ||
                current == MainActivity.TAB_NOTIFICATIONS
            ) {
                _previousTab.value = current
            }
            _selectedTab.value = coerced
            _activeRoute.value = AppRoute.fromTabIndex(coerced)
        }
    }

    fun closeEditorScreen() {
        val current = _selectedTab.value
        val candidatePrev = _previousTab.value
        val target = if (candidatePrev != current &&
            candidatePrev != MainActivity.TAB_STRATEGY &&
            candidatePrev != MainActivity.TAB_SETTINGS &&
            candidatePrev != MainActivity.TAB_RISK_MANAGER
        ) {
            candidatePrev
        } else {
            MainActivity.TAB_HOME
        }
        _selectedTab.value = target
        _activeRoute.value = AppRoute.fromTabIndex(target)
    }

    fun openInOverlayMode(context: Context, route: AppRoute = _activeRoute.value) {
        try {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(context)) {
                toggleOverlayService(context)
                return
            }
            val intent = Intent(context, ScreenEarnerOverlayService::class.java).apply {
                action = ScreenEarnerOverlayService.ACTION_OPEN_OVERLAY_ROUTE
                putExtra(ScreenEarnerOverlayService.EXTRA_OVERLAY_ROUTE, route.name)
            }
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                context.startForegroundService(intent)
            } else {
                context.startService(intent)
            }
            _isOverlayServiceRunning.value = true
            _userMessage.value = "Switched to Floating Overlay (${route.shortLabel})"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed switching to overlay mode", e)
            _userMessage.value = "Unable to open overlay container"
        }
    }

    /**
     * Starts observation-only Live Game Monitoring (does NOT require calibrated Bet hand).
     */
    fun startAutomation() {
        startMonitoring()
    }

    fun startMonitoring() {
        try {
            val result = AutomationController.startMonitoringSession(
                isAccessibilityConnected = ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService.isServiceConnected()
            )
            _userMessage.value = if (result.started) {
                "Predict Manager Live Monitor STARTED"
            } else {
                result.message
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to start monitoring", e)
            _userMessage.value = "Failed to start monitoring"
        }
    }

    fun pauseAutomation() {
        try {
            AutomationController.pauseMonitoringSession()
            _userMessage.value = "Monitoring PAUSED"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to pause monitoring", e)
        }
    }

    fun resumeAutomation() {
        try {
            val result = AutomationController.startMonitoringSession(
                isAccessibilityConnected = ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService.isServiceConnected()
            )
            _userMessage.value = if (result.started) "Monitoring RESUMED" else result.message
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to resume monitoring", e)
        }
    }

    fun quitAutomation() {
        try {
            AutomationController.stopMonitoringSession()
            _userMessage.value = "Monitoring STOPPED"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to stop monitoring", e)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Independent Automation Assistant controls (never stops or interrupts live Monitoring Engine).
     */
    fun startAutomationAssistant() {
        try {
            val result = AutomationController.startAutomationAssistant(
                isAccessibilityConnected = ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService.isServiceConnected()
            )
            _userMessage.value = if (result.started) "Automation Assistant ACTIVE" else result.message
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed starting automation assistant", e)
            _userMessage.value = "Unable to start Automation Assistant"
        }
    }

    fun pauseAutomationAssistant() {
        try {
            AutomationController.pauseAutomationAssistant()
            _userMessage.value = "Automation Assistant PAUSED (Monitoring continues)"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed pausing automation assistant", e)
        }
    }

    fun stopAutomationAssistant() {
        try {
            AutomationController.stopAutomationAssistant()
            _userMessage.value = "Automation Assistant STOPPED (Monitoring continues)"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed stopping automation assistant", e)
        }
    }

    fun endSessionAndClearSessionData() {
        try {
            AutomationController.requestEndSessionAndClearSessionData()
            _userMessage.value = "Session ended & current session data cleared"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed clearing current session data", e)
        }
    }

    fun exitUtility(context: Context) {
        try {
            AutomationController.stopMonitoringSession()
            BatteryOptimizationWorker.cancel(context)
            val nm = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? android.app.NotificationManager
            nm?.cancelAll()
            context.stopService(Intent(context, ScreenEarnerOverlayService::class.java))
            context.stopService(Intent(context, FloatingOverlayService::class.java))
            context.stopService(Intent(context, ScreenCaptureProjectionService::class.java))
            _isOverlayServiceRunning.value = false
            _userMessage.value = "Predict Manager floating utility stopped."
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed exiting overlay utility", e)
        }
    }

    private fun sanitizeStrategyConfig(config: StrategyConfig): StrategyConfig {
        val sanitizedRules = config.getRuleConfigs().map { rule ->
            rule.copy(
                customAddAmount = rule.customAddAmount.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 } ?: 10.0,
                targetWinsToFetch = rule.targetWinsToFetch.coerceAtLeast(1),
                requiredLosses = rule.requiredLosses.coerceAtLeast(0),
                waitMinutes = rule.waitMinutes.coerceAtLeast(0),
                minMultiplier = rule.minMultiplier.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 } ?: 0.0,
                maxMultiplier = rule.maxMultiplier.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 } ?: 1000.0
            )
        }
        val safeLow = config.lowThreshold.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 1.01 } ?: 2.00
        val safeBoundary = config.boundaryValue.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 1.01 } ?: safeLow
        val safeBig = config.bigThreshold.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it > safeLow } ?: 10.00
        return config.copy(
            lowThreshold = safeLow,
            boundaryValue = safeBoundary,
            bigThreshold = safeBig,
            gridRows = config.gridRows.coerceIn(4, 5),
            gridColumns = config.gridColumns.coerceIn(7, 8),
            strategy1LowThreshold = config.strategy1LowThreshold.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 1.01 } ?: 2.00,
            strategy1RequiredLowRounds = config.strategy1RequiredLowRounds.coerceAtLeast(1),
            strategy2HighThreshold = config.strategy2HighThreshold.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 1.01 } ?: 10.00,
            strategy2WaitRounds = config.strategy2WaitRounds.coerceAtLeast(1),
            baseStake = config.baseStake.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it > 0.0 } ?: 10.0,
            multiplierProgression = config.multiplierProgression.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 1.0 } ?: 2.0,
            stopAfterConsecutiveWins = config.stopAfterConsecutiveWins.coerceAtLeast(1),
            targetMultiplier = config.targetMultiplier.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 1.01 } ?: 2.00,
            sessionTimeoutMinutes = config.sessionTimeoutMinutes.coerceAtLeast(1),
            scheduleStartHour = config.scheduleStartHour.coerceIn(0, 23),
            scheduleStartMinute = config.scheduleStartMinute.coerceIn(0, 59),
            scheduleEndHour = config.scheduleEndHour.coerceIn(0, 23),
            scheduleEndMinute = config.scheduleEndMinute.coerceIn(0, 59),
            minDetectionConfidence = config.minDetectionConfidence.takeIf { it.isFinite() }?.coerceIn(0f, 1f) ?: 0.5f,
            preferredGameId = config.preferredGameId.ifBlank { "ALL" },
            minFlightTimeBeforeCashOutMs = config.minFlightTimeBeforeCashOutMs.coerceIn(0L, 60_000L),
            maxBetRetries = config.maxBetRetries.coerceIn(0, 10),
            retryDelayMs = config.retryDelayMs.coerceIn(100L, 5_000L),
            bettingWindowExpiryMs = config.bettingWindowExpiryMs.coerceIn(1_000L, 120_000L),
            lossProgressionAddAmount = config.lossProgressionAddAmount.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 } ?: 10.0,
            gameAutoCashOutTarget = config.gameAutoCashOutTarget.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 1.01 } ?: 2.00,
            stakeEditTimeoutMs = config.stakeEditTimeoutMs.coerceIn(150L, 5_000L),
            autoCashOutTimeoutMs = config.autoCashOutTimeoutMs.coerceIn(150L, 5_000L),
            betWindowTotalTimeoutMs = config.betWindowTotalTimeoutMs.coerceIn(500L, 15_000L),
            minRemainingBetWindowMs = config.minRemainingBetWindowMs.coerceIn(300L, 10_000L),
            minStake = config.minStake.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 } ?: 0.0,
            maxStake = config.maxStake.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 } ?: 0.0
        ).withUpdatedRuleConfigs(sanitizedRules)
    }

    private fun sanitizeRiskLimits(limits: RiskLimits): RiskLimits {
        return limits.copy(
            maxSingleStake = limits.maxSingleStake.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it > 0.0 } ?: 500.0,
            maxSessionLoss = limits.maxSessionLoss.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 } ?: 1000.0,
            maxTotalRounds = limits.maxTotalRounds.coerceAtLeast(1),
            maxProgressionLevel = limits.maxProgressionLevel.coerceAtLeast(1),
            profitTarget = limits.profitTarget.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 } ?: 1500.0,
            minBalanceThreshold = limits.minBalanceThreshold.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 } ?: 50.0,
            maxSequenceExposure = limits.maxSequenceExposure.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 } ?: 500.0,
            maxDailyLoss = limits.maxDailyLoss.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 } ?: 500.0,
            safetyReserveAmount = limits.safetyReserveAmount.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 } ?: 0.0
        )
    }

    fun applyStrategySelection(config: StrategyConfig) {
        try {
            val safeConfig = sanitizeStrategyConfig(config)
            strategyEngine.bindStrategyConfig(safeConfig)
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    repository.saveStrategyConfig(safeConfig)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "Save failed while applying config", e)
                    _userMessage.value = "Failed to save settings, please check input"
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Save failed while binding config", e)
            _userMessage.value = "Failed to save settings, please check input"
        }
    }

    fun saveStrategyConfig(config: StrategyConfig, ensureOverlayActive: Boolean = false, context: Context? = null) {
        try {
            val safeConfig = sanitizeStrategyConfig(config)
            strategyEngine.bindStrategyConfig(safeConfig)
            if (ensureOverlayActive && context != null) {
                ensureOverlayServiceRunning(context)
            }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    repository.saveStrategyConfig(safeConfig)
                    _userMessage.value = "Settings Saved"
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "Save failed for config", e)
                    _userMessage.value = "Failed to save settings, please check input"
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Save failed for config", e)
            _userMessage.value = "Failed to save settings, please check input"
        }
    }

    fun saveRiskLimits(limits: RiskLimits, ensureOverlayActive: Boolean = false, context: Context? = null) {
        try {
            val safeLimits = sanitizeRiskLimits(limits)
            if (ensureOverlayActive && context != null) {
                ensureOverlayServiceRunning(context)
            }
            viewModelScope.launch {
                try {
                    repository.saveRiskLimits(safeLimits)
                    _userMessage.value = "Safety Locks Saved"
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "Save failed for limits", e)
                    _userMessage.value = "Failed to save settings, please check input"
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Save failed for limits", e)
            _userMessage.value = "Failed to save settings, please check input"
        }
    }

    fun updateGridDimensions(rows: Int, cols: Int) {
        val current = strategyConfig.value ?: StrategyConfig()
        applyStrategySelection(current.copy(gridRows = rows.coerceIn(4, 5), gridColumns = cols.coerceIn(7, 8)))
    }

    fun updateBaseStake(newBaseStake: Double) {
        if (!newBaseStake.isFinite() || newBaseStake < 1.0) {
            _userMessage.value = "Base stake must be at least 1.0"
            return
        }
        val current = strategyConfig.value ?: StrategyConfig()
        saveStrategyConfig(current.copy(baseStake = newBaseStake))
    }

    fun updateTargetMultiplier(newMultiplier: Double) {
        if (!newMultiplier.isFinite() || newMultiplier < 1.01) {
            _userMessage.value = "Target multiplier must be at least 1.01x"
            return
        }
        val current = strategyConfig.value ?: StrategyConfig()
        saveStrategyConfig(current.copy(targetMultiplier = newMultiplier))
    }

    fun toggleAutoBet(enabled: Boolean) {
        val current = strategyConfig.value ?: StrategyConfig()
        saveStrategyConfig(current.copy(isAutoBetEnabled = enabled))
        _userMessage.value = if (enabled) "Automatic Bet enabled" else "Manual Bet mode active (Tap Hand to Bet)"
    }

    fun toggleAutoCashOut(enabled: Boolean) {
        val current = strategyConfig.value ?: StrategyConfig()
        saveStrategyConfig(current.copy(isAutoCashOutEnabled = enabled))
        _userMessage.value = if (enabled) "Automatic Cash Out enabled" else "Manual Cash Out mode active (Tap Hand to Cash Out)"
    }

    fun updateLossProgression(enabled: Boolean, mode: StakeProgressionMode, addAmount: Double) {
        val current = strategyConfig.value ?: StrategyConfig()
        saveStrategyConfig(
            current.copy(
                lossProgressionEnabled = enabled,
                lossProgressionMode = mode,
                lossProgressionAddAmount = addAmount
            )
        )
    }

    fun updateCategoryThresholds(low: Double, boundary: Double, big: Double) {
        if (!low.isFinite() || !boundary.isFinite() || !big.isFinite() || low < 1.01 || big <= low) {
            _userMessage.value = "Failed to save settings, please check input"
            return
        }
        val current = strategyConfig.value ?: StrategyConfig()
        saveStrategyConfig(current.copy(lowThreshold = low, boundaryValue = boundary, bigThreshold = big))
    }

    fun applyManualCrashCorrection(
        recordId: Long,
        newMultiplier: Double,
        newCategory: CrashColorCategory,
        reason: String
    ) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                if (!newMultiplier.isFinite() || newMultiplier < 1.0) {
                    _userMessage.value = "Failed to save settings, please check input"
                    return@launch
                }
                val ok = repository.applyManualCrashCorrection(
                    recordId = recordId,
                    newMultiplier = newMultiplier,
                    newColorHex = newCategory.defaultHex,
                    newCategory = newCategory,
                    reason = reason.ifBlank { "Manual operator verification" }
                )
                _userMessage.value = if (ok) {
                    "Crash record updated with audit trail."
                } else {
                    "Crash record not found."
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Manual crash correction failed", e)
                _userMessage.value = "Failed to save correction"
            }
        }
    }

    fun saveCustomStrategy(strategy: CustomPatternStrategy) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                if (strategy.name.isBlank()) {
                    _userMessage.value = "Failed to save settings, please check input"
                    return@launch
                }
                if (strategy.id == 0L) {
                    repository.insertCustomStrategy(strategy)
                    _userMessage.value = "Strategy '${strategy.name}' created"
                } else {
                    repository.updateCustomStrategy(strategy)
                    _userMessage.value = "Strategy '${strategy.name}' updated"
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Save failed for custom strategy", e)
                _userMessage.value = "Failed to save settings, please check input"
            }
        }
    }

    fun toggleCustomStrategyEnabled(strategy: CustomPatternStrategy, enabled: Boolean) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                repository.updateCustomStrategy(
                    strategy.copy(
                        isEnabled = enabled,
                        currentlyApproaching = if (!enabled) false else strategy.currentlyApproaching,
                        currentlyReached = if (!enabled) false else strategy.currentlyReached
                    )
                )
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Failed toggling strategy", e)
            }
        }
    }

    fun toggleCustomStrategyNotifications(strategy: CustomPatternStrategy, enabled: Boolean) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                repository.updateCustomStrategy(strategy.copy(notificationEnabled = enabled))
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Failed toggling strategy notifications", e)
            }
        }
    }

    fun stopPixelColorCapture(context: Context) {
        try {
            context.stopService(Intent(context, ScreenCaptureProjectionService::class.java))
            val current = strategyConfig.value ?: StrategyConfig()
            applyStrategySelection(current.copy(pixelColorCaptureEnabled = false))
            _userMessage.value = "Pixel color capture stopped."
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed stopping pixel capture", e)
        }
    }

    fun onPixelColorConsentResult(context: Context, resultCode: Int, data: Intent?) {
        if (resultCode != android.app.Activity.RESULT_OK || data == null) {
            _userMessage.value = "Pixel color capture permission declined."
            return
        }
        try {
            val intent = ScreenCaptureProjectionService.createStartIntent(context, resultCode, data)
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                context.startForegroundService(intent)
            } else {
                context.startService(intent)
            }
            val current = strategyConfig.value ?: StrategyConfig()
            applyStrategySelection(current.copy(pixelColorCaptureEnabled = true))
            _userMessage.value = "Pixel color capture active."
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed starting pixel capture service", e)
            _userMessage.value = "Unable to start pixel color capture."
        }
    }

    fun ensureOverlayServiceRunning(context: Context) {
        try {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(context) || ScreenEarnerOverlayService.isRunning) {
                _isOverlayServiceRunning.value = ScreenEarnerOverlayService.isRunning
                return
            }
            val intent = Intent(context, ScreenEarnerOverlayService::class.java)
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                context.startForegroundService(intent)
            } else {
                context.startService(intent)
            }
            _isOverlayServiceRunning.value = true
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to ensure overlay service running", e)
        }
    }

    fun triggerEmergencyStop() {
        try {
            val limits = (riskLimits.value ?: RiskLimits()).copy(emergencyStop = true)
            saveRiskLimits(limits)
            quitAutomation()
            _userMessage.value = "MONITORING LOCK ENGAGED"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to lock monitoring", e)
        }
    }

    fun clearEmergencyStop() {
        try {
            val limits = (riskLimits.value ?: RiskLimits()).copy(emergencyStop = false)
            saveRiskLimits(limits)
            _userMessage.value = "Monitoring Lock Cleared"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to clear monitoring lock", e)
        }
    }

    fun toggleOverlayService(context: Context) {
        try {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(context)) {
                val intent = Intent(
                    Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION,
                    android.net.Uri.parse("package:${context.packageName}")
                ).apply {
                    flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                }
                context.startActivity(intent)
                _userMessage.value = "Please grant Display Over Other Apps permission."
                _isOverlayServiceRunning.value = false
                return
            }

            val intent = Intent(context, ScreenEarnerOverlayService::class.java)
            if (ScreenEarnerOverlayService.isRunning) {
                context.stopService(intent)
                _isOverlayServiceRunning.value = false
                _userMessage.value = "Floating Monitor Stopped."
            } else {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                    context.startForegroundService(intent)
                } else {
                    context.startService(intent)
                }
                android.os.Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed({
                    _isOverlayServiceRunning.value = ScreenEarnerOverlayService.isRunning
                }, 200L)
                _isOverlayServiceRunning.value = true
                _userMessage.value = "Floating Monitor Started."
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to toggle overlay service", e)
            _isOverlayServiceRunning.value = ScreenEarnerOverlayService.isRunning
            _userMessage.value = "Unable to start overlay service: ${e.localizedMessage ?: "Check permissions"}"
        }
    }

    fun clearUserMessage() {
        _userMessage.value = null
    }

    fun clearSessionLogs() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                repository.clearSessionLogs()
                _userMessage.value = "Logs cleared"
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Failed clearing session logs", e)
            }
        }
    }

    fun clearMultiplierRecords() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                repository.clearMultiplierRecords()
                repository.clearAllCrashRecords()
                _userMessage.value = "Crash history cleared"
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Failed clearing crash records", e)
            }
        }
    }

    fun setActiveProfile(profileId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                repository.setActiveProfile(profileId)
                _userMessage.value = "Profile activated: $profileId"
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Save failed activating profile", e)
                _userMessage.value = "Failed to save settings, please check input"
            }
        }
    }

    // Legacy compatibility stubs so nothing breaks if older composables call them
    fun insertShortcut(shortcut: FloatingShortcut) {
        viewModelScope.launch { runCatching { repository.insertShortcut(shortcut) } }
    }
    fun updateShortcut(shortcut: FloatingShortcut) {
        viewModelScope.launch { runCatching { repository.updateShortcut(shortcut) } }
    }
    fun deleteShortcut(id: Long) {
        viewModelScope.launch { runCatching { repository.deleteShortcut(id) } }
    }
    fun addNewShortcut(label: String, type: ShortcutType, colorHex: String) {}
    fun updateShortcutVisualPosition(shortcutId: Long, visualX: Float, visualY: Float) {}
}
