@OptIn(ExperimentalLayoutApi::class)
@Composable
fun LiveMonitorScreen(
    gameState: GameState,
    automationState: AutomationState,
    strategyConfig: StrategyConfig?,
    crashRecords: List<CrashRecord>,
    historyMetadata: HistoryCollectionMetadata,
    selectedGameId: String,
    isPixelCaptureActive: Boolean,
    onSelectGameId: (String) -> Unit,
    onStartMonitoring: () -> Unit,
    onPauseMonitoring: () -> Unit,
    onCollectHistory: () -> Unit,
    onRequestPixelCapture: () -> Unit,
    onStopPixelCapture: () -> Unit,
    onEndSessionAndClear: () -> Unit = {},
    monitoringStatus: MonitoringStatus = gameState.monitoringStatus,
    queuedOpportunitiesCount: Int = 0,
    onStartAutomationAssistant: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    onPauseAutomationAssistant: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    onStopAutomationAssistant: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    onToggleBetHand: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    onToggleCashOutHand: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    onToggleActionHand: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    onOpenHandSettings: (() -> Unit)? = null
) {
    val config = strategyConfig ?: StrategyConfig()
    val scrollState = rememberScrollState()
    val isRunning = monitoringStatus == MonitoringStatus.MONITORING ||
        monitoringStatus == MonitoringStatus.WAITING_FOR_GAME ||
        monitoringStatus == MonitoringStatus.GAME_NOT_ACCESSIBLE ||
        monitoringStatus == MonitoringStatus.GAME_SUSPENDED
    val adapters = remember { GameAdapterRegistry.allAdapters() }
    val activeGameRecords = remember(crashRecords, gameState.isDetected, gameState.gameId, selectedGameId) {
        val target = if (gameState.isDetected && gameState.gameId.isNotBlank()) gameState.gameId else selectedGameId
        if (target == "ALL") crashRecords else crashRecords.filter { it.gameId == target }
    }

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background)
            .verticalScroll(scrollState)
            .padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
    ) {
        Text(
            text = "LIVE GAME MONITOR",
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            color = PrimaryCobalt
        )

        // Dynamic Game Selector Pills (including Unknown)
        val dynamicGames = remember(crashRecords, adapters) {
            val map = linkedMapOf<String, String>()
            map["unknown"] = "Unknown"
            adapters.forEach { map[it.gameId] = it.displayedGameName }
            crashRecords.forEach { rec ->
                if (rec.gameId.isNotBlank() && !map.containsKey(rec.gameId)) {
                    map[rec.gameId] = rec.gameName.ifBlank { "Unknown" }
                }
            }
            map.entries.toList()
        }
        FlowRow(
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
        ) {
            FilterChip(
                selected = selectedGameId == "ALL",
                onClick = { onSelectGameId("ALL") },
                label = { Text("All Games", fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }
            )
            dynamicGames.forEach { (gId, gName) ->
                val activeHere = gameState.isDetected && gameState.gameId == gId
                FilterChip(
                    selected = selectedGameId == gId || activeHere,
                    onClick = { onSelectGameId(gId) },
                    label = {
                        Text(
                            text = if (activeHere) "$gName (LIVE)" else gName,
                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        )
                    }
                )
            }
        }

        // Real-time Detection State Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .testTag("live_monitor_telemetry_card"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant)
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                LiveCrashHeaderCard(gameState = gameState, automationState = automationState)

                if (gameState.liveDetectionLost) {
                    Surface(
                        color = Color(0xFFFEE2E2),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    ) {
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(10.dp),
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                        ) {
                            Icon(Icons.Default.Warning, contentDescription = "Lost Signal", tint = ActionStopRed)
                            Text(
                                text = "LIVE DETECTION LOST — Stale multiplier suppressed. Return the active crash game onto the viewport.",
                                color = ActionStopRed,
                                fontSize = 12.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Truthful Pipeline State & Current Session Telemetry (zero fabricated confidence %)
                Surface(
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer.copy(alpha = 0.35f),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .testTag("live_pipeline_status_badge")
                ) {
                    Column(
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(10.dp),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                    ) {
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = gameState.pipelineStatus.displayLabel,
                                fontSize = 12.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                                color = PrimaryCobalt
                            )
                            Text(
                                text = if (gameState.lastDetectionTimestampMs > 0L) {
                                    "Updated: ${MultiplierHistoryAnalyzer.formatTimestamp(gameState.lastDetectionTimestampMs)}"
                                } else {
                                    "Awaiting signal"
                                },
                                fontSize = 11.sp,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                            )
                        }
                        Text(
                            text = gameState.pipelineDiagnosticReason,
                            fontSize = 11.sp,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                        )
                        Text(
                            text = "Session Crashes: ${gameState.activeSessionCrashCount} · Latest Crash: ${gameState.latestCrashMultiplier?.let { String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", it) } ?: "—"} · Round: ${gameState.latestRoundId ?: "—"}",
                            fontSize = 11.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
                        )
                    }
                }

                // Supported platforms tags
                if (gameState.supportedPlatforms.isNotEmpty()) {
                    Text(
                        text = "Supported Platforms: ${gameState.supportedPlatforms.joinToString(" • ")}",
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                }

                // Action controls
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                    Button(
                        onClick = { if (isRunning) onPauseMonitoring() else onStartMonitoring() },
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                            containerColor = if (isRunning) ActionStopRed else ActionStartEmerald,
                            contentColor = Color.White
                        ),
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .weight(1f)
                            .height(48.dp)
                    ) {
                        Icon(if (isRunning) Icons.Default.Pause else Icons.Default.PlayArrow, contentDescription = null)
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                        Text(if (isRunning) "PAUSE" else "START MONITOR", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                    }
                    OutlinedButton(
                        onClick = onCollectHistory,
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .weight(1f)
                            .height(48.dp)
                    ) {
                        Icon(Icons.Default.Refresh, contentDescription = "Sync Ribbon")
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                        Text("SYNC RIBBON", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                    }
                }

                OutlinedButton(
                    onClick = onEndSessionAndClear,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .height(48.dp)
                        .testTag("end_session_clear_btn")
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.DeleteSweep, contentDescription = "End Session and Clear Session Data", tint = ActionStopRed)
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = "END SESSION & CLEAR SESSION DATA",
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = ActionStopRed
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        if (onStartAutomationAssistant != null || onToggleBetHand != null) {
            Card(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .testTag("live_automation_assistant_card"),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
                colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant)
            ) {
                Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            Text("AUTOMATION ASSISTANT", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp, color = PrimaryCobalt)
                            Text(
                                text = "State: ${automationState.name} · Queued Strategies: $queuedOpportunitiesCount",
                                fontSize = 11.sp,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    if (onStartAutomationAssistant != null && onPauseAutomationAssistant != null && onStopAutomationAssistant != null) {
                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                            Button(
                                onClick = onStartAutomationAssistant,
                                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = ActionStartEmerald, contentColor = Color.White),
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(44.dp).testTag("live_start_auto_btn")
                            ) {
                                Icon(Icons.Default.PlayArrow, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                                Text("AUTO ON", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                            }
                            OutlinedButton(
                                onClick = onPauseAutomationAssistant,
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(44.dp).testTag("live_pause_auto_btn")
                            ) {
                                Icon(Icons.Default.Pause, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                                Text("PAUSE", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                            }
                            OutlinedButton(
                                onClick = onStopAutomationAssistant,
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(44.dp).testTag("live_stop_auto_btn")
                            ) {
                                Icon(Icons.Default.Stop, contentDescription = null, tint = ActionStopRed, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                                Text("STOP", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = ActionStopRed)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    val effectiveActionHand = onToggleActionHand ?: onToggleBetHand
                    if (effectiveActionHand != null || onOpenHandSettings != null) {
                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                            if (effectiveActionHand != null) {
                                OutlinedButton(
                                    onClick = effectiveActionHand,
                                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(44.dp).testTag("live_toggle_action_hand_btn")
                                ) {
                                    Icon(Icons.Default.TouchApp, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(15.dp))
                                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                                    Text("ACTION HAND", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                                }
                            }
                            if (onOpenHandSettings != null) {
                                OutlinedButton(
                                    onClick = onOpenHandSettings,
                                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(44.dp).testTag("live_open_hand_settings_btn")
                                ) {
                                    Icon(Icons.Default.Settings, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(15.dp))
                                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                                    Text("HAND SETTINGS", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Consent-Gated Pixel Color Sampling Card (MediaProjection)
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant)
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Icon(Icons.Default.ColorLens, contentDescription = "Pixel Color Capture", tint = PrimaryCobalt)
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        Column {
                            Text("Actual Game Color Capture", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 14.sp)
                            Text(
                                text = if (isPixelCaptureActive) {
                                    "Pixel HEX verification active for canvas & ribbon badges"
                                } else {
                                    "Optional MediaProjection consent to read exact UI badge colors"
                                },
                                fontSize = 11.sp,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                gameState.latestCrashColorHex?.let { hex ->
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .size(14.dp)
                                .background(parseSafeCrashColor(hex, gameState.latestCrashMultiplier ?: 1.0), CircleShape)
                                .border(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline, CircleShape)
                        )
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = "Latest Crash Color: ${gameState.latestCrashColorCategory.displayName} ($hex) • ${if (gameState.isLatestCrashColorVerified) "Pixel-Verified" else "Normalized"}",
                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
                        )
                    }
                }

                Button(
                    onClick = { if (isPixelCaptureActive) onStopPixelCapture() else onRequestPixelCapture() },
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                        containerColor = if (isPixelCaptureActive) ActionStopRed else PrimaryCobalt,
                        contentColor = Color.White
                    ),
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .height(48.dp)
                        .testTag("toggle_pixel_capture_btn")
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Sensors, contentDescription = null)
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = if (isPixelCaptureActive) "STOP PIXEL COLOR CAPTURE" else "ENABLE PIXEL COLOR CAPTURE",
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontSize = 12.sp
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // Bounded Live Crash Grid
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant)
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Text(
                    text = "LIVE CRASH GRID (${config.gridRows}×${config.gridColumns}) — ${activeGameRecords.size} RECORDED",
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                    color = PrimaryCobalt
                )
                BoundedCrashHistoryGrid(
                    crashRecords = activeGameRecords,
                    gridRows = config.gridRows,
                    gridColumns = config.gridColumns
                )
                Text(
                    text = "Ribbon Status: ${historyMetadata.status.name.replace('_', ' ')} — ${historyMetadata.statusReason}",
                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                )
            }
        }

        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
    }
}

package com.example.ui.screens

private enum class HistoryScopeFilter(val label: String) {
    CURRENT_SESSION("Current Session"),
    ARCHIVED_SESSIONS("Archived Sessions"),
    FULL_HISTORY("Full History")
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalLayoutApi::class)
@Composable
fun LogsAnalyticsScreen(
    crashRecords: List<CrashRecord> = emptyList(),
    @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER")
    crashAudits: List<CrashCorrectionAudit> = emptyList(),
    historyMetadata: HistoryCollectionMetadata = HistoryCollectionMetadata(),
    strategyConfig: StrategyConfig? = null,
    selectedGameId: String = "ALL",
    allCrashRecords: List<CrashRecord> = emptyList(),
    onSelectGameId: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onUpdateGridDimensions: (Int, Int) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
    @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER")
    onApplyManualCorrection: (recordId: Long, newMultiplier: Double, newCategory: CrashColorCategory, reason: String) -> Unit = { _, _, _, _ -> },
    onClearCrashHistory: () -> Unit = {},
    onEndSessionAndClear: () -> Unit = {},
    onCollectHistory: () -> Unit = {},
    onCountClearScopeRecords: (suspend (ClearHistoryScope, String) -> Int)? = null,
    onClearHistoryByScope: ((ClearHistoryScope, String) -> Unit)? = null
) {
    val config = strategyConfig ?: StrategyConfig()
    var scopeFilter by remember { mutableStateOf(HistoryScopeFilter.CURRENT_SESSION) }
    var expandedRecordKey by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var showClearScopeDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var pendingClearScope by remember { mutableStateOf(ClearHistoryScope.CURRENT_SESSION) }
    var previewDeleteCount by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }

    val currentSessionKeys = remember(crashRecords) {
        crashRecords.map { it.dedupKey }.toSet()
    }
    val archivedRecords = remember(allCrashRecords, currentSessionKeys) {
        allCrashRecords.filter { it.dedupKey !in currentSessionKeys }
    }

    val sourceRecords = when (scopeFilter) {
        HistoryScopeFilter.CURRENT_SESSION -> crashRecords
        HistoryScopeFilter.ARCHIVED_SESSIONS -> archivedRecords
        HistoryScopeFilter.FULL_HISTORY -> if (allCrashRecords.isNotEmpty()) allCrashRecords else crashRecords
    }

    val dynamicGames = remember(allCrashRecords, crashRecords) {
        val map = linkedMapOf<String, String>()
        map["unknown"] = "Unknown"
        GameAdapterRegistry.allAdapters().forEach { adapter ->
            map[adapter.gameId] = adapter.displayedGameName
        }
        (allCrashRecords + crashRecords).forEach { rec ->
            if (rec.gameId.isNotBlank() && !map.containsKey(rec.gameId)) {
                map[rec.gameId] = rec.gameName.ifBlank { "Unknown" }
            }
        }
        map.entries.toList()
    }

    val filteredRecords = remember(sourceRecords, selectedGameId) {
        val base = if (selectedGameId == "ALL") sourceRecords else sourceRecords.filter { it.gameId == selectedGameId }
        base.sortedWith(compareByDescending<CrashRecord> { it.crashTimestamp }.thenByDescending { it.id })
    }

    LaunchedEffect(showClearScopeDialog, pendingClearScope, selectedGameId, crashRecords.size, allCrashRecords.size) {
        if (showClearScopeDialog) {
            previewDeleteCount = if (onCountClearScopeRecords != null) {
                runCatching { onCountClearScopeRecords(pendingClearScope, selectedGameId) }.getOrDefault(0)
            } else {
                when (pendingClearScope) {
                    ClearHistoryScope.CURRENT_SESSION -> crashRecords.size
                    ClearHistoryScope.SELECTED_GAME_ARCHIVED -> {
                        val target = if (selectedGameId == "ALL") "unknown" else selectedGameId
                        archivedRecords.count { it.gameId == target }
                    }
                    ClearHistoryScope.ALL_HISTORY -> if (allCrashRecords.isNotEmpty()) allCrashRecords.size else crashRecords.size
                }
            }
        }
    }

    val isOverlayHost = LocalActivityResultRegistryOwner.current == null
    val hasBackOwner = LocalOnBackPressedDispatcherOwner.current != null

    Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background)
            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        item {
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = "CRASH HISTORY",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    color = PrimaryCobalt
                )
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    OutlinedButton(
                        onClick = onCollectHistory,
                        modifier = Modifier.testTag("history_sync_btn")
                    ) {
                        Icon(Icons.Default.Refresh, contentDescription = "Sync", modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                        Text("Sync", fontSize = 11.sp)
                    }
                    OutlinedButton(
                        onClick = { showClearScopeDialog = true },
                        modifier = Modifier.testTag("history_clear_scope_btn")
                    ) {
                        Icon(Icons.Default.Delete, contentDescription = "Clear History", tint = ActionStopRed, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                        Text("Clear", fontSize = 11.sp, color = ActionStopRed)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 3-Scope Session & Per-Game Isolation Filters
        item {
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                FlowRow(
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                ) {
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = scopeFilter == HistoryScopeFilter.CURRENT_SESSION,
                        onClick = { scopeFilter = HistoryScopeFilter.CURRENT_SESSION },
                        label = { Text("Current Session (${crashRecords.size})", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) },
                        modifier = Modifier.testTag("history_scope_current_chip")
                    )
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = scopeFilter == HistoryScopeFilter.ARCHIVED_SESSIONS,
                        onClick = { scopeFilter = HistoryScopeFilter.ARCHIVED_SESSIONS },
                        label = { Text("Archived Sessions (${archivedRecords.size})", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) },
                        modifier = Modifier.testTag("history_scope_archived_chip")
                    )
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = scopeFilter == HistoryScopeFilter.FULL_HISTORY,
                        onClick = { scopeFilter = HistoryScopeFilter.FULL_HISTORY },
                        label = {
                            val total = if (allCrashRecords.isNotEmpty()) allCrashRecords.size else crashRecords.size
                            Text("Full History ($total)", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        },
                        modifier = Modifier.testTag("history_scope_full_chip")
                    )
                }
                FlowRow(
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                ) {
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = selectedGameId == "ALL",
                        onClick = { onSelectGameId("ALL") },
                        label = { Text("All Games", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }
                    )
                    dynamicGames.forEach { (gameId, gameName) ->
                        FilterChip(
                            selected = selectedGameId == gameId,
                            onClick = { onSelectGameId(gameId) },
                            label = { Text(gameName, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) },
                            modifier = Modifier.testTag("history_game_chip_$gameId")
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Bounded Multiplier Grid (strictly observational, zero edit/fix controls)
        item {
            Card(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
                colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant)
            ) {
                Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = "BOUNDED GRID (${config.gridRows}×${config.gridColumns})",
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                            color = PrimaryCobalt
                        )
                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                            listOf(4 to 7, 4 to 8, 5 to 7, 5 to 8).forEach { (r, c) ->
                                FilterChip(
                                    selected = config.gridRows == r && config.gridColumns == c,
                                    onClick = { onUpdateGridDimensions(r, c) },
                                    label = { Text("${r}×$c", fontSize = 10.sp) }
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    BoundedCrashHistoryGrid(
                        crashRecords = filteredRecords,
                        gridRows = config.gridRows,
                        gridColumns = config.gridColumns
                    )

                    Text(
                        text = "Tap any cell or row below to inspect timestamp, Round ID, observed HEX color, and session metadata.",
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // Recent Confirmed Crash Log (tap row to expand metadata downwards)
        item {
            Text(
                text = "CONFIRMED CRASHES (${filteredRecords.size}) · ${historyMetadata.status.name.replace('_', ' ')}",
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontSize = 12.sp,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
            )
        }

        if (filteredRecords.isEmpty()) {
            item {
                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = "INSUFFICIENT DATA — No confirmed crash multipliers recorded for the current filter yet.",
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)
                    )
                }
            }
        } else {
            items(filteredRecords.take(100), key = { "${it.id}_${it.dedupKey}" }) { rec ->
                val chipColor = parseSafeCrashColor(rec.detectedColorHex, rec.multiplier)
                val rowKey = "${rec.id}_${rec.dedupKey}"
                val isExpanded = expandedRecordKey == rowKey

                Surface(
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface,
                    border = BorderStroke(
                        width = 1.dp,
                        color = if (isExpanded) PrimaryCobalt else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant
                    ),
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .clickable {
                            expandedRecordKey = if (isExpanded) null else rowKey
                        }
                        .testTag("crash_history_row_${rec.id}")
                ) {
                    Column(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 10.dp),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                    ) {
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                        ) {
                            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .size(12.dp)
                                        .background(chipColor, CircleShape)
                                        .border(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline, CircleShape)
                                )
                                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(10.dp))
                                Column {
                                    Text(
                                        text = "${rec.gameName.ifBlank { "Unknown" }} • ${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", rec.multiplier)} (${rec.colorCategory.displayName})",
                                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                        fontSize = 13.sp,
                                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
                                    )
                                    Text(
                                        text = "${CalendarHourUtils.formatDateTime(rec.crashTimestamp)} · ${rec.detectedColorHex}${if (rec.isPixelColorVerified) " (Pixel)" else ""}",
                                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                            Icon(
                                imageVector = if (isExpanded) Icons.Default.ExpandLess else Icons.Default.ExpandMore,
                                contentDescription = if (isExpanded) "Collapse crash details" else "Expand crash details",
                                tint = PrimaryCobalt
                            )
                        }

                        AnimatedVisibility(
                            visible = isExpanded,
                            enter = expandVertically(),
                            exit = shrinkVertically()
                        ) {
                            Surface(
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.4f),
                                shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxWidth()
                                    .testTag("crash_history_detail_${rec.id}")
                            ) {
                                Column(
                                    modifier = Modifier.padding(10.dp),
                                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)
                                ) {
                                    HorizontalDivider(color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                                    val roundText = rec.roundIdentifier?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: "Unknown"
                                    Text("Round ID: $roundText", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                                    Text("Game ID: ${rec.gameId.ifBlank { "unknown" }} (${rec.gameName.ifBlank { "Unknown" }})", fontSize = 11.sp)
                                    Text("Session ID: ${rec.sessionId.ifBlank { "Archived" }}", fontSize = 11.sp)
                                    Text(
                                        text = "Color HEX: ${rec.detectedColorHex} · Verified: ${if (rec.isPixelColorVerified) "Yes (Pixel)" else "No (Range-normalized)"}",
                                        fontSize = 11.sp
                                    )
                                    Text(
                                        text = "Source: ${rec.collectionSource.name} · App: ${rec.sourcePackage.ifBlank { "Unknown" }}",
                                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        item { Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(88.dp)) }
    }

    if (showClearScopeDialog) {
        if (hasBackOwner) {
            BackHandler { showClearScopeDialog = false }
        }
        val clearScopeBody: @Composable () -> Unit = {
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                Text(
                    text = "Choose which records to delete cleanly from local Room storage:",
                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                )
                listOf(
                    ClearHistoryScope.CURRENT_SESSION to "Current Session Only (resets session count to 0)",
                    ClearHistoryScope.SELECTED_GAME_ARCHIVED to "Archived History for Selected Game (${if (selectedGameId == "ALL") "unknown" else selectedGameId})",
                    ClearHistoryScope.ALL_HISTORY to "All History (all sessions, stats, & hourly summaries)"
                ).forEach { (scopeOpt, desc) ->
                    Surface(
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                        color = if (pendingClearScope == scopeOpt) PrimaryCobalt.copy(alpha = 0.12f) else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.4f),
                        border = BorderStroke(
                            1.dp,
                            if (pendingClearScope == scopeOpt) PrimaryCobalt else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant
                        ),
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .clickable { pendingClearScope = scopeOpt }
                            .testTag("clear_scope_option_${scopeOpt.name}")
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = desc,
                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                            fontWeight = if (pendingClearScope == scopeOpt) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(10.dp)
                        )
                    }
                }
                Surface(
                    color = Color(0xFFFEE2E2),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = "Records to delete: $previewDeleteCount crash record(s)",
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        color = ActionStopRed,
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .padding(10.dp)
                            .testTag("clear_scope_preview_count")
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        val onConfirmClearScope = {
            showClearScopeDialog = false
            if (onClearHistoryByScope != null) {
                onClearHistoryByScope(pendingClearScope, selectedGameId)
            } else {
                when (pendingClearScope) {
                    ClearHistoryScope.CURRENT_SESSION -> onEndSessionAndClear()
                    ClearHistoryScope.SELECTED_GAME_ARCHIVED,
                    ClearHistoryScope.ALL_HISTORY -> onClearCrashHistory()
                }
            }
        }

        if (isOverlayHost) {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.45f))
                    .clickable { showClearScopeDialog = false }
                    .padding(16.dp),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clickable(enabled = false) {},
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface)
                ) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                        Text("Clear Local History", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 16.sp)
                        clearScopeBody()
                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                            OutlinedButton(
                                onClick = { showClearScopeDialog = false },
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                            ) { Text("CANCEL") }
                            Button(
                                onClick = onConfirmClearScope,
                                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = ActionStopRed, contentColor = Color.White),
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).testTag("confirm_clear_scope_btn")
                            ) { Text("DELETE ($previewDeleteCount)", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            AlertDialog(
                onDismissRequest = { showClearScopeDialog = false },
                title = { Text("Clear Local History", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) },
                text = clearScopeBody,
                confirmButton = {
                    Button(
                        onClick = onConfirmClearScope,
                        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = ActionStopRed, contentColor = Color.White),
                        modifier = Modifier.testTag("confirm_clear_scope_btn")
                    ) {
                        Text("DELETE ($previewDeleteCount)", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    }
                },
                dismissButton = {
                    TextButton(onClick = { showClearScopeDialog = false }) {
                        Text("CANCEL")
                    }
                }
            )
        }
    }
    }
}

package com.example.ui.screens

import android.Manifest

@OptIn(ExperimentalLayoutApi::class)
@Composable
fun NotificationCenterScreen(
    notificationSettings: NotificationSettings?,
    notificationHistory: List<NotificationHistoryRecord>,
    onUpdateSettings: (NotificationSettings) -> Unit,
    onClearHistory: () -> Unit,
    onOpenRecordTarget: (NotificationHistoryRecord) -> Unit
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val settings = notificationSettings ?: NotificationSettings()
    var selectedChannelFilter by remember { mutableStateOf("ALL") }

    var hasNotifPermission by remember {
        mutableStateOf(
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
                ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
            } else true
        )
    }

    val isAlarmRinging by AlarmAudioController.isAlarmRinging.collectAsState()
    val activeAlarmTitle by AlarmAudioController.activeAlarmTitle.collectAsState()

    val hasActivityRegistry = LocalActivityResultRegistryOwner.current != null
    val permLauncher = if (hasActivityRegistry) {
        rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
            contract = ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission()
        ) { granted ->
            hasNotifPermission = granted
        }
    } else null

    val filteredHistory = remember(notificationHistory, selectedChannelFilter) {
        if (selectedChannelFilter == "ALL") {
            notificationHistory
        } else {
            notificationHistory.filter {
                it.channelId == selectedChannelFilter || it.channelId.startsWith("${selectedChannelFilter}_v")
            }
        }
    }

    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background)
            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        item {
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = "NOTIFICATION CENTER",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    color = PrimaryCobalt
                )
                OutlinedButton(onClick = onClearHistory) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Delete, contentDescription = "Clear", tint = ActionStopRed, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                    Text("Clear", fontSize = 11.sp, color = ActionStopRed)
                }
            }
        }

        if (isAlarmRinging) {
            item {
                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .testTag("notif_center_active_alarm_card"),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = Color(0xFFFEE2E2)),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, ActionStopRed)
                ) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            Icon(Icons.Default.Alarm, contentDescription = "Active Alarm", tint = ActionStopRed)
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                            Text(
                                text = activeAlarmTitle ?: "SIGNAL DETECTED — PATTERN MATCH",
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                                fontSize = 13.sp,
                                color = ActionStopRed
                            )
                        }
                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                            Button(
                                onClick = { AlarmAudioController.stopAlarm(context) },
                                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = ActionStopRed, contentColor = Color.White),
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(48.dp)
                            ) {
                                Icon(Icons.Default.NotificationsOff, contentDescription = null)
                                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                                Text("STOP ALARM", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                            }
                            OutlinedButton(
                                onClick = { AlarmAudioController.snoozeAlarm(5) },
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(48.dp)
                            ) {
                                Icon(Icons.Default.Snooze, contentDescription = null)
                                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                                Text("SNOOZE 5M", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Android 13+ POST_NOTIFICATIONS Permission Banner
        if (!hasNotifPermission) {
            item {
                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .testTag("notif_permission_denied_banner"),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = Color(0xFFFEE2E2)),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, ActionStopRed)
                ) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            Icon(Icons.Default.Warning, contentDescription = "Denied", tint = ActionStopRed)
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                            Text(
                                text = "System Notification Permission Required",
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                fontSize = 13.sp,
                                color = ActionStopRed
                            )
                        }
                        Text(
                            text = "Android blocked notifications (POST_NOTIFICATIONS denied). Alerts are logged below until notification permission is granted.",
                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                            color = Color(0xFF7F1D1D)
                        )
                        Button(
                            onClick = {
                                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU && permLauncher != null) {
                                    permLauncher.launch(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
                                } else {
                                    runCatching {
                                        context.startActivity(
                                            Intent(Settings.ACTION_APP_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS).apply {
                                                putExtra(Settings.EXTRA_APP_PACKAGE, context.packageName)
                                                flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                                            }
                                        )
                                    }
                                }
                            },
                            colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = ActionStopRed, contentColor = Color.White),
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(48.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text("GRANT NOTIFICATION PERMISSION", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Notification Controls & Channels Card
        item {
            Card(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
                colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant)
            ) {
                Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            Text("Master System Alerts", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 14.sp)
                            Text("Delivers alerts outside the app via 4 Android channels", fontSize = 11.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                        }
                        Switch(
                            checked = settings.masterEnabled,
                            onCheckedChange = { onUpdateSettings(settings.copy(masterEnabled = it)) },
                            modifier = Modifier.testTag("notif_center_master_switch")
                        )
                    }
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Text("Sound & Vibration", fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                        Switch(
                            checked = settings.soundEnabled,
                            onCheckedChange = { onUpdateSettings(settings.copy(soundEnabled = it, vibrationEnabled = it)) }
                        )
                    }
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            Text("Bet & Cash-Out Execution Alerts", fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                            Text("Notify on automated stake entry, bet placement & cash-out", fontSize = 10.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                        }
                        Switch(
                            checked = settings.executionAlertsEnabled,
                            onCheckedChange = { onUpdateSettings(settings.copy(executionAlertsEnabled = it)) },
                            modifier = Modifier.testTag("notif_execution_alerts_switch")
                        )
                    }
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            Text("Failure & History Unavailable Alerts", fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                            Text("Alert if Accessibility disconnects or ribbon history stops updating", fontSize = 10.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                        }
                        Switch(
                            checked = settings.failureAlertsEnabled,
                            onCheckedChange = { onUpdateSettings(settings.copy(failureAlertsEnabled = it)) },
                            modifier = Modifier.testTag("notif_failure_alerts_switch")
                        )
                    }
                    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                        OutlinedButton(
                            onClick = {
                                context.startActivity(
                                    Intent(Settings.ACTION_APP_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS).apply {
                                        putExtra(Settings.EXTRA_APP_PACKAGE, context.packageName)
                                        flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                                    }
                                )
                            },
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                        ) {
                            Icon(Icons.Default.Notifications, contentDescription = "Channels", modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                            Text("MANAGE ANDROID NOTIFICATION CHANNELS", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Channel Filters
        item {
            FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                listOf(
                    "ALL" to "All",
                    AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.CHANNEL_ALARM to "Signal Alarm",
                    AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.CHANNEL_STANDARD to "Standard Alerts",
                    AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.CHANNEL_HOURLY to "Hourly",
                    AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.CHANNEL_SERVICE to "Service"
                ).forEach { (id, label) ->
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = selectedChannelFilter == id,
                        onClick = { selectedChannelFilter = id },
                        label = { Text(label, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        if (filteredHistory.isEmpty()) {
            item {
                Card(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                    colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = "No notifications recorded in this channel yet. Triggered pattern alerts, hour transitions, and system notices appear here.",
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)
                    )
                }
            }
        } else {
            items(filteredHistory.take(60), key = { it.id }) { item ->
                val isDelivered = item.deliveryStatus == NotificationDeliveryStatus.DELIVERED
                Surface(
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface,
                    border = BorderStroke(
                        1.dp,
                        if (isDelivered) ActionStartEmerald.copy(alpha = 0.4f) else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant
                    ),
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .clickable { onOpenRecordTarget(item) }
                ) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(12.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = item.title,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                fontSize = 13.sp,
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                            )
                            Surface(
                                color = if (isDelivered) ActionStartEmerald.copy(alpha = 0.14f) else Color(0xFFFEF3C7),
                                shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp)
                            ) {
                                Text(
                                    text = item.deliveryStatus.name,
                                    color = if (isDelivered) ActionStartEmerald else Color(0xFF92400E),
                                    fontSize = 9.sp,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                                    modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                                )
                            }
                        }
                        Text(item.message, fontSize = 12.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                        val meta = buildString {
                            append(com.example.data.model.CalendarHourUtils.formatDateTime(item.timestampMs))
                            item.gameId?.let { append(" · Game: $it") }
                            item.occurrenceRecordId?.let { append(" · Occurrence #$it") }
                        }
                        Text(meta, fontSize = 10.sp, color = PrimaryCobalt, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        item { Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp)) }
    }
}

@Composable
fun OverlayManagerScreen(

    calibratingShortcutId: Long?,
    onSetEditMode: (Boolean) -> Unit,

    onPauseAutomation: () -> Unit,

    onAddCashOutShortcut: () -> Unit,
    onUpdateShortcutPos: (id: Long, x: Float, y: Float) -> Unit,
    onSetCalibratedTarget: (x: Float, y: Float) -> Unit,
    onStartCalibration: (id: Long) -> Unit,

) {
    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(16.dp),

    ) {

        Card(

            ) {

                            contentDescription = "Mode Icon",
                            tint = if (isEditMode) Color(0xFFF59E0B) else ActionBetGreen
                        )

                        Text(

                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            fontSize = 16.sp
                        )
                    }
                    Text(
                        text = if (isEditMode) "Add independent floating task buttons & calibrate targets" else "Target coordinates locked for gameplay",
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = Color.Gray
                    )

                    modifier = Modifier.testTag("edit_mode_switch")
                )

            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary

        LazyColumn(

                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

                        Row(

                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                        ) {

                                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                                    color = Color.LightGray,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
                                )
                                Text(
                                    text = "Platform: ${shortcut.targetPlatform} | ${if (isBet) "Stake: $${shortcut.stakeAmount}" else "Multiplier: ${shortcut.targetMultiplier}x"}",
                                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                                    color = Color.Gray
                                )
                            }

                            Button(
                                onClick = { onStartCalibration(shortcut.id) },
                                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = PrimaryIndigo),
                                shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                                modifier = Modifier.testTag("calibrate_${shortcut.id}")

                                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                                Text("CALIBRATE", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                            }
                        }

                }

package com.example.ui.screens

import androidx.compose.foundation.BorderStroke
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.ExperimentalLayoutApi

@OptIn(ExperimentalLayoutApi::class)
@Composable
fun PatternRecognitionScreen(
    report: StatisticalReport,
    agentExplanation: SmartAgentExplanation,
    selectedGameId: String,
    onSelectGameId: (String) -> Unit
) {
    val scrollState = rememberScrollState()

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background)
            .verticalScroll(scrollState)
            .padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
    ) {
        Text(
            text = "PATTERN RECOGNITION & SMART AGENT",
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            color = PrimaryCobalt
        )

        FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            FilterChip(
                selected = selectedGameId == "ALL",
                onClick = { onSelectGameId("ALL") },
                label = { Text("All Games", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }
            )
            FilterChip(
                selected = selectedGameId == "unknown",
                onClick = { onSelectGameId("unknown") },
                label = { Text("Unknown", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }
            )
            GameAdapterRegistry.allAdapters().forEach { adapter ->
                FilterChip(
                    selected = selectedGameId == adapter.gameId,
                    onClick = { onSelectGameId(adapter.gameId) },
                    label = { Text(adapter.displayedGameName, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }
                )
            }
        }

        // Prompt 9: Smart Analysis Agent Factual Breakdown
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .testTag("smart_agent_card"),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer.copy(alpha = 0.35f)),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.copy(alpha = 0.35f))
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Psychology, contentDescription = "Smart Agent", tint = PrimaryCobalt)
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = "SMART ANALYSIS AGENT (OBSERVATIONAL)",
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = PrimaryCobalt
                    )
                }
                Text(
                    text = agentExplanation.liveStatusLine,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = 14.sp,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
                )
                agentExplanation.strategyBreakdowns.forEach { item ->
                    Surface(
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface,
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant),
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    ) {
                        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(10.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
                            Row(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                            ) {
                                Text(item.strategyName, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 13.sp)
                                Text(
                                    text = item.hourlyProgressText,
                                    color = PrimaryCobalt,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                                    fontSize = 11.sp
                                )
                            }
                            Text(item.ruleExplanation, fontSize = 11.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                            Text(
                                text = "${item.streakProgressText} · ${item.remainingToTriggerText}",
                                fontSize = 11.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                                color = ActionStartEmerald
                            )
                            Text(
                                text = item.timestampsSummary,
                                fontSize = 10.sp,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
                HorizontalDivider(color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant.copy(alpha = 0.6f))
                Text(
                    text = agentExplanation.windowComparisonText,
                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
                )
                Text(
                    text = "${agentExplanation.sampleConfidenceLabel}. ${agentExplanation.integrityDisclaimer}",
                    fontSize = 10.sp,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                )
            }
        }

        // Consecutive Lows & Alternating Runs
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant)
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Analytics, contentDescription = "Streaks", tint = PrimaryCobalt)
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = "CONSECUTIVE LOWS & ALTERNATING SEQUENCES",
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = PrimaryCobalt
                    )
                }
                if (!report.sampleSufficient && report.totalCompletedRounds == 0) {
                    Text(
                        text = "INSUFFICIENT DATA — Waiting for completed crash rounds.",
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                } else {
                    Text(
                        text = "Current Consecutive Low Chain: ${report.currentConsecutiveLows} rounds • Longest Chain: ${report.longestConsecutiveLows} rounds",
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontSize = 13.sp
                    )
                    Text(
                        text = "Distribution (${report.totalCompletedRounds} completed rounds): Low ${report.lowCount} • ==Boundary ${report.boundaryCount} • Med ${report.mediumCount} • Big ${report.bigCount}",
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                    val avgLowsBeforeBig = if (report.lowsBeforeBigCounts.isEmpty()) 0.0 else report.lowsBeforeBigCounts.average()
                    Text(
                        text = "Lows before Big (>=10x): Avg ${String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", avgLowsBeforeBig)} rounds (${report.lowsBeforeBigCounts.size} big hits observed)",
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                    Text(
                        text = "Alternating Low/Med Sequences: Current ${report.currentAlternatingLowMedLength} · Longest ${report.maxAlternatingLowMedLength} rounds",
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                    Text(
                        text = "Back-to-Back Big Clusters: ${report.bigMultiplierClusters} cluster(s)",
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // Big Multiplier Minute Intervals
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant)
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Text(
                    text = "BIG MULTIPLIER INTERVALS & COLOR MOTIFS",
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                    color = PrimaryCobalt
                )
                if (report.bigMultiplierGaps.isEmpty()) {
                    Text(
                        text = "Need at least 2 big multipliers to compute time intervals.",
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                } else {
                    report.bigMultiplierGaps.takeLast(8).reversed().forEach { gap ->
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = "${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", gap.firstMultiplier)} -> ${String.format(Locale.US, "%.2fx", gap.secondMultiplier)}",
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                                fontSize = 12.sp
                            )
                            Text(
                                text = "${String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f min", gap.gapMinutes)}${if (gap.isWithinQualifyingRange) " (In Range)" else ""} @ ${CalendarHourUtils.formatExactTime(gap.secondTimestampMs)}",
                                fontSize = 11.sp,
                                color = if (gap.isWithinQualifyingRange) ActionStartEmerald else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                HorizontalDivider(modifier = Modifier.padding(vertical = 4.dp))
                Text("Observed 3-Color Motifs:", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
                if (report.topRepeatedColorSequences.isEmpty()) {
                    Text(
                        text = "No repeated 3-color motifs recorded yet.",
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                } else {
                    report.topRepeatedColorSequences.take(5).forEach { (seqLabel, count) ->
                        Text(
                            text = "$seqLabel: Observed $count times",
                            fontSize = 11.sp,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
    }
}
