@Composable
fun PermissionsScreen(scrollable: Boolean = true) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val scrollState = rememberScrollState()

    val isDrawOverAppsGranted = Settings.canDrawOverlays(context)
    val isAccessibilityConnected = ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService.isServiceConnected()
    val powerManager = context.getSystemService(Context.POWER_SERVICE) as? PowerManager
    val isBatteryUnrestricted = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
        powerManager?.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations(context.packageName) == true
    } else {
        true
    }

    var isNotificationGranted by remember {
        mutableStateOf(
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
                ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                    context,
                    Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
                ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
            } else {
                true
            }
        )
    }

    val hasActivityRegistry = LocalActivityResultRegistryOwner.current != null
    val notificationPermissionLauncher = if (hasActivityRegistry) {
        rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
            contract = ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission()
        ) { granted ->
            isNotificationGranted = granted
        }
    } else null

    val containerModifier = if (scrollable) {
        Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .verticalScroll(scrollState)
            .padding(16.dp)
    } else {
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
    }

    Column(
        modifier = containerModifier,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant)
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Default.Security,
                        contentDescription = "Permissions Header",
                        tint = PrimaryCobalt,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp)
                    )
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = "SYSTEM PERMISSIONS & BACKGROUND HEALTH",
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall,
                        color = PrimaryCobalt
                    )
                }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
                Text(
                    text = "Predict Manager uses Accessibility multi-window inspection, Overlay rendering, Unrestricted Battery, and System Notifications to monitor games reliably.",
                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                )
            }
        }

        PermissionActionCard(
            icon = Icons.Default.Layers,
            title = "Display Over Other Apps",
            description = "Renders the unclamped floating AP bubble and bounded crash grid over Chrome or game apps.",
            granted = isDrawOverAppsGranted,
            grantedLabel = "GRANTED",
            missingLabel = "REQUIRED",
            buttonLabel = if (isDrawOverAppsGranted) "OVERLAY AUTHORIZED (MANAGE)" else "ALLOW DISPLAY OVER APPS",
            buttonTestTag = "open_overlay_settings_btn",
            onClick = {
                val intent = Intent(
                    Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION,
                    Uri.parse("package:${context.packageName}")
                ).apply { flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK }
                context.startActivity(intent)
            }
        )

        PermissionActionCard(
            icon = Icons.Default.AccessibilityNew,
            title = "Accessibility Live Monitor",
            description = "Reads multi-window crash game interfaces, split-screen tabs, and completed round multipliers without modifying or clicking game controls.",
            granted = isAccessibilityConnected,
            grantedLabel = "CONNECTED",
            missingLabel = "DISCONNECTED",
            buttonLabel = if (isAccessibilityConnected) "ACCESSIBILITY CONNECTED (MANAGE)" else "OPEN ACCESSIBILITY SETTINGS",
            buttonTestTag = "open_accessibility_settings_btn",
            onClick = {
                val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_ACCESSIBILITY_SETTINGS).apply {
                    flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                }
                context.startActivity(intent)
            }
        )

        PermissionActionCard(
            icon = Icons.Default.Notifications,
            title = "Android System Notifications",
            description = "Delivers Critical Pattern Alerts, Hourly Analysis digests, Game Detection notices, and Monitoring Error alerts.",
            granted = isNotificationGranted,
            grantedLabel = "GRANTED",
            missingLabel = "DENIED",
            buttonLabel = if (isNotificationGranted) "NOTIFICATIONS GRANTED (MANAGE)" else "ALLOW SYSTEM NOTIFICATIONS",
            buttonTestTag = "request_notification_permission_btn",
            cardTestTag = "notification_permission_card",
            onClick = {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU && !isNotificationGranted && notificationPermissionLauncher != null) {
                    notificationPermissionLauncher.launch(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
                } else if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                    val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_APP_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS).apply {
                        putExtra(Settings.EXTRA_APP_PACKAGE, context.packageName)
                        flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                    }
                    context.startActivity(intent)
                }
            }
        )

        PermissionActionCard(
            icon = Icons.Default.BatteryChargingFull,
            title = "Unrestricted Background Activity",
            description = "Prevents Android from putting live game tracking, hourly transitions, and Keep-Awake monitoring to sleep during multitasking.",
            granted = isBatteryUnrestricted,
            grantedLabel = "UNRESTRICTED",
            missingLabel = "RESTRICTED",
            buttonLabel = if (isBatteryUnrestricted) "BATTERY UNRESTRICTED (MANAGE)" else "DISABLE BATTERY OPTIMIZATION",
            buttonTestTag = "open_battery_optimization_btn",
            onClick = {
                try {
                    val req = Intent(
                        Settings.ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS,
                        Uri.parse("package:${context.packageName}")
                    ).apply { flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK }
                    context.startActivity(req)
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    try {
                        val fallback = Intent(Settings.ACTION_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION_SETTINGS).apply {
                            flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                        }
                        context.startActivity(fallback)
                    } catch (_: Exception) {
                    }
                }
            }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun PermissionActionCard(
    icon: androidx.compose.ui.graphics.vector.ImageVector,
    title: String,
    description: String,
    granted: Boolean,
    grantedLabel: String,
    missingLabel: String,
    buttonLabel: String,
    buttonTestTag: String,
    cardTestTag: String? = null,
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    Card(
        modifier = (if (cardTestTag != null) Modifier.testTag(cardTestTag) else Modifier).fillMaxWidth(),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
        border = BorderStroke(
            1.dp,
            if (granted) ActionStartEmerald.copy(alpha = 0.45f) else Color(0xFFF59E0B).copy(alpha = 0.6f)
        )
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = icon,
                        contentDescription = title,
                        tint = if (granted) ActionStartEmerald else Color(0xFFD97706)
                    )
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = title,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontSize = 14.sp,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
                    )
                }
                PermissionStatusBadge(
                    granted = granted,
                    grantedLabel = grantedLabel,
                    missingLabel = missingLabel
                )
            }
            Text(
                text = description,
                fontSize = 12.sp,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
            )
            Button(
                onClick = onClick,
                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                    containerColor = if (granted) ActionStartEmerald else PrimaryCobalt,
                    contentColor = Color.White
                ),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(48.dp)
                    .testTag(buttonTestTag)
            ) {
                Text(text = buttonLabel, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 12.sp)
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun PermissionStatusBadge(
    granted: Boolean,
    grantedLabel: String,
    missingLabel: String
) {
    Surface(
        color = if (granted) ActionStartEmerald.copy(alpha = 0.14f) else ActionStopRed.copy(alpha = 0.12f),
        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (granted) ActionStartEmerald else ActionStopRed),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 3.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Icon(
                imageVector = if (granted) Icons.Default.CheckCircle else Icons.Default.Warning,
                contentDescription = if (granted) grantedLabel else missingLabel,
                tint = if (granted) ActionStartEmerald else ActionStopRed,
                modifier = Modifier.size(12.dp)
            )
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
            Text(
                text = if (granted) grantedLabel else missingLabel,
                color = if (granted) ActionStartEmerald else ActionStopRed,
                fontSize = 10.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
            )
        }
    }
}

                            }
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                            Text(
                                text = profile.description,
                                fontSize = 12.sp,
                                color = Color.Gray
                            )
                        }

                        if (profile.isActive) {
                            Surface(
                                color = ActionBetGreen,
                                shape = androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
                            ) {
                                Row(
                                    modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
                                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                                ) {
                                    Icon(Icons.Default.CheckCircle, contentDescription = "Active", tint = Color.White, modifier = Modifier.padding(end = 4.dp))
                                    Text("ACTIVE", color = Color.White, fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)

package com.example.ui.screens

import android.util.Log
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Spacer

import androidx.compose.material3.ButtonDefaults
import androidx.compose.material3.Card

import androidx.compose.material3.Text

import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.testTag
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.KeyboardType
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import com.example.data.model.RiskLimits

@Composable
fun RiskManagerScreen(
    currentLimits: RiskLimits?,
    lastViolation: String?,
    onSaveLimits: (RiskLimits) -> Unit,
    onTriggerEmergencyStop: () -> Unit,
    onClearEmergencyStop: () -> Unit,
    currentDailyLoss: Double = 0.0
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val limits = currentLimits ?: RiskLimits()

    var maxSingleStake by remember(limits.maxSingleStake) { mutableStateOf(limits.maxSingleStake.toString()) }
    var maxSessionLoss by remember(limits.maxSessionLoss) { mutableStateOf(limits.maxSessionLoss.toString()) }
    var maxTotalRounds by remember(limits.maxTotalRounds) { mutableStateOf(limits.maxTotalRounds.toString()) }
    var maxProgressionLevel by remember(limits.maxProgressionLevel) { mutableStateOf(limits.maxProgressionLevel.toString()) }
    var profitTarget by remember(limits.profitTarget) { mutableStateOf(limits.profitTarget.toString()) }
    var minBalanceThreshold by remember(limits.minBalanceThreshold) { mutableStateOf(limits.minBalanceThreshold.toString()) }
    var maxSequenceExposure by remember(limits.maxSequenceExposure) { mutableStateOf(limits.maxSequenceExposure.toString()) }
    var maxDailyLoss by remember(limits.maxDailyLoss) { mutableStateOf(limits.maxDailyLoss.toString()) }
    var safetyReserveAmount by remember(limits.safetyReserveAmount) { mutableStateOf(limits.safetyReserveAmount.toString()) }
    var emergencyStop by remember(limits.emergencyStop) { mutableStateOf(limits.emergencyStop) }

    val scrollState = rememberScrollState()

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .verticalScroll(scrollState)
            .padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)
    ) {
        // Violation Warning Banner
        if (lastViolation != null) {
            Surface(
                color = Color(0xFFFEF2F2),
                border = androidx.compose.foundation.BorderStroke(1.dp, Color.Red),
                shape = androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            ) {
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(12.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Warning, contentDescription = "Alert", tint = Color.Red)
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = "RISK STOP TRIGGERED: $lastViolation",
                        color = Color.Red,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontSize = 12.sp
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // Emergency Stop Master Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
                containerColor = if (emergencyStop) Color(0xFFFEF2F2) else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface
            )
        ) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(16.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Column {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Icon(
                            Icons.Default.Security,
                            contentDescription = "Security",
                            tint = if (emergencyStop) Color.Red else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                        )
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = "EMERGENCY STOP SWITCH",
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            fontSize = 16.sp,
                            color = if (emergencyStop) Color.Red else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
                        )
                    }
                    Text(
                        text = "Immediately halts all active automation & cancels pending bets",
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = Color.Gray
                    )
                }
                Switch(
                    checked = emergencyStop,
                    onCheckedChange = {
                        emergencyStop = it
                        if (it) onTriggerEmergencyStop() else onClearEmergencyStop()
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier.testTag("emergency_switch")
                )
            }
        }

        // Hard Risk Limits Card
        Card(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface)
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
                Text(
                    text = "HARD RISK SAFETY LIMITS",
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = 14.sp,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                )
                Text(
                    text = "Automation automatically pauses if any limit is reached.",
                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                    color = Color.Gray
                )
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))

                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = maxSingleStake,
                        onValueChange = { maxSingleStake = it },
                        label = { Text("Max Single Stake") },
                        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).testTag("max_stake_input")
                    )
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = maxSessionLoss,
                        onValueChange = { maxSessionLoss = it },
                        label = { Text("Max Session Loss") },
                        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).testTag("max_loss_input")
                    )
                }

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))

                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = maxTotalRounds,
                        onValueChange = { maxTotalRounds = it },
                        label = { Text("Max Total Rounds") },
                        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).testTag("max_rounds_input")
                    )
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = maxProgressionLevel,
                        onValueChange = { maxProgressionLevel = it },
                        label = { Text("Max Progression Level") },
                        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).testTag("max_prog_level_input")
                    )
                }

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))

                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = profitTarget,
                        onValueChange = { profitTarget = it },
                        label = { Text("Session Profit Target") },
                        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).testTag("profit_target_input")
                    )
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = minBalanceThreshold,
                        onValueChange = { minBalanceThreshold = it },
                        label = { Text("Min Balance Threshold") },
                        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).testTag("min_balance_input")
                    )
                }

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))

                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = maxSequenceExposure,
                        onValueChange = { maxSequenceExposure = it },
                        label = { Text("Max Seq Exposure") },
                        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).testTag("max_sequence_exposure_input")
                    )
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = maxDailyLoss,
                        onValueChange = { maxDailyLoss = it },
                        label = { Text("Max Daily Loss") },
                        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).testTag("max_daily_loss_input")
                    )
                }

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))

                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = safetyReserveAmount,
                    onValueChange = { safetyReserveAmount = it },
                    label = { Text("Safety Balance Reserve") },
                    keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("safety_reserve_input")
                )

                if (currentDailyLoss > 0.0) {
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = "Today's Recorded Loss: ${String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%.2f", currentDailyLoss)}",
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        var isSaving by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
        Button(
            enabled = !isSaving,
            onClick = {
                if (isSaving) return@Button
                try {
                    val parsedMaxStake = maxSingleStake.trim().toDoubleOrNull()
                    val parsedMaxLoss = maxSessionLoss.trim().toDoubleOrNull()
                    val parsedMaxRounds = maxTotalRounds.trim().toIntOrNull()
                    val parsedMaxProg = maxProgressionLevel.trim().toIntOrNull()
                    val parsedProfitTarget = profitTarget.trim().toDoubleOrNull()
                    val parsedMinBalance = minBalanceThreshold.trim().toDoubleOrNull()
                    val parsedSeqExposure = maxSequenceExposure.trim().toDoubleOrNull()
                    val parsedDailyLoss = maxDailyLoss.trim().toDoubleOrNull()
                    val parsedReserve = safetyReserveAmount.trim().toDoubleOrNull()

                    val invalid = parsedMaxStake == null || !parsedMaxStake.isFinite() || parsedMaxStake <= 0.0 ||
                        parsedMaxLoss == null || !parsedMaxLoss.isFinite() || parsedMaxLoss < 0.0 ||
                        parsedMaxRounds == null || parsedMaxRounds < 1 ||
                        parsedMaxProg == null || parsedMaxProg < 1 ||
                        parsedProfitTarget == null || !parsedProfitTarget.isFinite() || parsedProfitTarget < 0.0 ||
                        parsedMinBalance == null || !parsedMinBalance.isFinite() || parsedMinBalance < 0.0 ||
                        parsedSeqExposure == null || !parsedSeqExposure.isFinite() || parsedSeqExposure < 0.0 ||
                        parsedDailyLoss == null || !parsedDailyLoss.isFinite() || parsedDailyLoss < 0.0 ||
                        parsedReserve == null || !parsedReserve.isFinite() || parsedReserve < 0.0

                    if (invalid) {
                        Toast.makeText(
                            context,
                            "Failed to save settings, please check input",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                        ).show()
                        return@Button
                    }

                    isSaving = true
                    onSaveLimits(
                        limits.copy(
                            maxSingleStake = parsedMaxStake!!,
                            maxSessionLoss = parsedMaxLoss!!,
                            maxTotalRounds = parsedMaxRounds!!,
                            maxProgressionLevel = parsedMaxProg!!,
                            profitTarget = parsedProfitTarget!!,
                            minBalanceThreshold = parsedMinBalance!!,
                            maxSequenceExposure = parsedSeqExposure!!,
                            maxDailyLoss = parsedDailyLoss!!,
                            safetyReserveAmount = parsedReserve!!,
                            emergencyStop = emergencyStop
                        )
                    )
                    isSaving = false
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    isSaving = false
                    Log.e("RiskManagerScreen", "Save failed", e)
                    Toast.makeText(
                        context,
                        "Failed to save settings, please check input",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show()
                }
            },
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(52.dp).testTag("save_risk_limits_btn")
        ) {
            Icon(Icons.Default.Save, contentDescription = "Save Limits")
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
            Text("SAVE & CLOSE", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
        }
    }
}

        // Optional 3-Scope Clear History Shortcut Card
        if (onClearHistoryByScope != null) {
            Card(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
                colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant)

        var isSaving by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
        Button(
            enabled = !isSaving,
            onClick = {
                if (isSaving) return@Button
                try {
                    val safeOpacity = opacityValue.takeIf { it.isFinite() }?.coerceIn(0.3f, 1.0f) ?: 0.95f
                    val safeBubbleSize = bubbleSizeDp.takeIf { it.isFinite() }?.coerceIn(40f, 80f) ?: 56f

                    val parsedLow = lowThreshText.trim().toDoubleOrNull()
                    val parsedBoundary = boundaryText.trim().toDoubleOrNull()
                    val parsedBig = bigThreshText.trim().toDoubleOrNull()

                    val parsedRepeat = repeatIntervalText.trim().toIntOrNull()
                    val parsedAlarmRepeat = alarmRepeatIntervalText.trim().toIntOrNull()
                    val parsedAlarmDuration = alarmMaxDurationText.trim().toIntOrNull()
                    val parsedQuietStart = quietStartHourText.trim().toIntOrNull()
                    val parsedQuietEnd = quietEndHourText.trim().toIntOrNull()

                    val startPair = parseHourMinute(startTimeText)
                    val stopPair = parseHourMinute(stopTimeText)

                    val thresholdsInvalid = parsedLow == null || !parsedLow.isFinite() || parsedLow < 1.01 ||
                        parsedBoundary == null || !parsedBoundary.isFinite() || parsedBoundary < 1.01 ||
                        parsedBig == null || !parsedBig.isFinite() || parsedBig <= parsedLow

                    val scheduleInvalid = localConfig.scheduleEnabled && (startPair == null || stopPair == null)
                    val notifInvalid = (parsedRepeat == null || parsedRepeat < 0) ||
                        (parsedAlarmRepeat == null || parsedAlarmRepeat < 0) ||
                        (parsedAlarmDuration == null || parsedAlarmDuration !in 1..30) ||
                        (localNotifSettings.quietHoursEnabled &&
                            (parsedQuietStart == null || parsedQuietStart !in 0..23 ||
                                parsedQuietEnd == null || parsedQuietEnd !in 0..23))

                    if (thresholdsInvalid || scheduleInvalid || notifInvalid) {
                        Toast.makeText(
                            context,
                            "Failed to save settings, please check input",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                        ).show()
                        return@Button
                    }

                    isSaving = true
                    prefs.edit()
                        .putFloat(ScreenEarnerOverlayService.PREF_BUBBLE_OPACITY, safeOpacity)
                        .putFloat(ScreenEarnerOverlayService.PREF_BUBBLE_SIZE_DP, safeBubbleSize)
                        .putBoolean(ScreenEarnerOverlayService.PREF_HAPTICS_ENABLED, hapticFeedbackEnabled)
                        .apply()

                    val finalizedConfig = incomingConfig.copy(
                        autoGameRecognitionEnabled = localConfig.autoGameRecognitionEnabled,
                        historyCollectionEnabled = localConfig.historyCollectionEnabled,
                        automationMasterEnabled = localConfig.automationMasterEnabled,
                        verifyButtonStateBeforeAction = localConfig.verifyButtonStateBeforeAction,
                        keepScreenAwake = localConfig.keepScreenAwake,
                        scheduleEnabled = localConfig.scheduleEnabled,
                        gridRows = localConfig.gridRows,
                        gridColumns = localConfig.gridColumns,
                        lowThreshold = parsedLow!!,
                        boundaryValue = parsedBoundary!!,
                        bigThreshold = parsedBig!!,
                        strategy1LowThreshold = parsedLow,
                        strategy2HighThreshold = parsedBig,
                        scheduleStartHour = startPair?.first ?: localConfig.scheduleStartHour,
                        scheduleStartMinute = startPair?.second ?: localConfig.scheduleStartMinute,
                        scheduleEndHour = stopPair?.first ?: localConfig.scheduleEndHour,
                        scheduleEndMinute = stopPair?.second ?: localConfig.scheduleEndMinute,
                        minDetectionConfidence = minConfText.trim().toFloatOrNull()?.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                            ?: localConfig.minDetectionConfidence,
                        maxBetRetries = maxBetRetriesText.trim().toIntOrNull()?.coerceIn(0, 10)
                            ?: localConfig.maxBetRetries,
                        retryDelayMs = retryDelayText.trim().toLongOrNull()?.coerceIn(100L, 5_000L)
                            ?: localConfig.retryDelayMs,
                        bettingWindowExpiryMs = bettingWindowExpiryText.trim().toLongOrNull()?.coerceIn(1_000L, 120_000L)
                            ?: localConfig.bettingWindowExpiryMs
                    )

                    val finalizedNotif = localNotifSettings.copy(
                        repeatIntervalMinutes = parsedRepeat!!,
                        alarmRepeatIntervalMinutes = parsedAlarmRepeat!!,
                        alarmMaxDurationMinutes = parsedAlarmDuration!!,
                        quietStartHour = parsedQuietStart ?: localNotifSettings.quietStartHour,
                        quietEndHour = parsedQuietEnd ?: localNotifSettings.quietEndHour
                    )

                    onNotificationSettingsChanged(finalizedNotif)
                    onSaveAndReturn(finalizedConfig)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    isSaving = false
                    Log.e("SettingsAppearance", "Save failed", e)
                    Toast.makeText(
                        context,
                        "Failed to save settings, please check input",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show()
                }
            },
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .height(52.dp)
                .testTag("save_appearance_settings_btn")
        ) {
            Icon(Icons.Default.Save, contentDescription = "Save Settings")
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
            Text("SAVE & CLOSE", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
        }
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(80.dp))
        }

        if (showConfirmEndSessionDialog && onEndSessionAndClearData != null) {
            if (LocalOnBackPressedDispatcherOwner.current != null) {
                BackHandler { showConfirmEndSessionDialog = false }
            }
            if (hasActivityRegistry) {
                AlertDialog(
                    onDismissRequest = { showConfirmEndSessionDialog = false },
                    title = { Text("End Session & Clear Session Data?", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) },
                    text = {
                        Text("This stops monitoring, resets session crashes to 0, clears the current round indicator, stops any active alarm, and removes records logged during this session.")
                    },
                    confirmButton = {
                        Button(
                            onClick = {
                                showConfirmEndSessionDialog = false
                                onEndSessionAndClearData()
                            },
                            colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = ActionStopRed, contentColor = Color.White)
                        ) {
                            Text("END & CLEAR", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                        }
                    },
                    dismissButton = {
                        TextButton(onClick = { showConfirmEndSessionDialog = false }) {
                            Text("CANCEL")
                        }
                    }
                )
            } else {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.45f))
                        .padding(16.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Card(
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
                        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    ) {
                        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                            Text("End Session & Clear Session Data?", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 15.sp)
                            Text(
                                "This stops monitoring, resets session crashes to 0, clears the current round indicator, stops any active alarm, and removes records logged during this session.",
                                fontSize = 12.sp,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                            )
                            Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                                TextButton(onClick = { showConfirmEndSessionDialog = false }, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                                    Text("CANCEL")
                                }
                                Button(
                                    onClick = {
                                        showConfirmEndSessionDialog = false
                                        onEndSessionAndClearData()
                                    },
                                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = ActionStopRed, contentColor = Color.White),
                                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                                ) {
                                    Text("END & CLEAR", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalLayoutApi::class)
@Composable
private fun CategoryAlarmProfileCard(
    category: AlarmProfileCategory,
    profile: AlarmProfileEntity,
    onUpdateProfile: (AlarmProfileEntity) -> Unit,
    onPickSound: () -> Unit,
    onClearSound: () -> Unit,
    onPreviewSound: () -> Unit,
    onTestProfile: () -> Unit
) {
    Surface(
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.35f),
        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant),
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .testTag("alarm_profile_card_${category.name}")
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(12.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text(category.displayTitle, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 13.sp)
                    Text(category.subtitle, fontSize = 10.sp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                }
                Switch(
                    checked = profile.enabled,
                    onCheckedChange = { onUpdateProfile(profile.copy(enabled = it)) },
                    modifier = Modifier.testTag("alarm_profile_enable_${category.name}")
                )
            }

            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = "Sound: ${if (profile.soundUri.isBlank()) "No sound selected" else profile.soundLabel}",
                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
                if (profile.soundUri.isNotBlank()) {
                    OutlinedButton(onClick = onClearSound, modifier = Modifier.padding(end = 4.dp)) {
                        Text("Clear", fontSize = 10.sp)
                    }
                }
                OutlinedButton(
                    onClick = onPickSound,
                    modifier = Modifier.testTag("alarm_profile_pick_${category.name}")
                ) {
                    Text("Choose", fontSize = 10.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }

            FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                OutlinedButton(
                    onClick = onPreviewSound,
                    modifier = Modifier.testTag("alarm_profile_preview_${category.name}")
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.PlayArrow, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                    Text("Preview", fontSize = 10.sp)
                }
                OutlinedButton(
                    onClick = onTestProfile,
                    modifier = Modifier.testTag("alarm_profile_test_${category.name}")
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.VolumeUp, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(4.dp))
                    Text("Test Playback", fontSize = 10.sp)
                }
                FilterChip(
                    selected = profile.vibrationEnabled,
                    onClick = { onUpdateProfile(profile.copy(vibrationEnabled = !profile.vibrationEnabled)) },
                    label = { Text(if (profile.vibrationEnabled) "Vibrate ON" else "Vibrate OFF", fontSize = 10.sp) }
                )
                FilterChip(
                    selected = profile.repeatEnabled,
                    onClick = { onUpdateProfile(profile.copy(repeatEnabled = !profile.repeatEnabled)) },
                    label = { Text(if (profile.repeatEnabled) "Repeat ON" else "Once", fontSize = 10.sp) }
                )
            }

            FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                listOf("DEFAULT", "SHORT_PULSE", "DISTINCTIVE", "LONG_CONTINUOUS", "NONE").forEach { pattern ->
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = profile.vibrationPattern == pattern,
                        onClick = { onUpdateProfile(profile.copy(vibrationPattern = pattern)) },
                        label = { Text(pattern.replace('_', ' '), fontSize = 9.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

private fun parseHourMinute(raw: String): Pair<Int, Int>? {
    val parts = raw.trim().split(":")
    if (parts.size != 2) return null
    val h = parts[0].trim().toIntOrNull() ?: return null
    val m = parts[1].trim().toIntOrNull() ?: return null
    if (h !in 0..23 || m !in 0..59) return null
    return h to m
}
