    private fun setupIsolatedControllerWithFakeInteractor(
        onApplyStake: (Double, StakeProgressionMode) -> Boolean = { _, _ -> true },
        onClickBet: (Float?, Float?) -> Boolean = { _, _ -> true },
        onClickCashOut: (Float?, Float?) -> Boolean = { _, _ -> true }
    ): Triple<Context, ScreenEarnerRepository, AutomationEngine> {
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        SessionStateManager(context).clearSessionRuntimeState()
        AutomationController.resetTestState()
        AutomationController.bypassMonitoringGuardForTest = true
        AutomationController.engine = null
        AutomationController.repository = null

        val database = Room.inMemoryDatabaseBuilder(context, ScreenEarnerDatabase::class.java)
            .allowMainThreadQueries()
            .build()
        db = database
        val repo = ScreenEarnerRepository(database.dao())

        val fakeInteractor = object : TargetUiInteractor {
            override fun applyStake(
                newStake: Double,
                progressionMode: StakeProgressionMode,
                fallbackX: Float?,
                fallbackY: Float?,
                onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit
            ) {
                onComplete(onApplyStake(newStake, progressionMode))
            }

            override fun clickBet(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
                onComplete(onClickBet(fallbackX, fallbackY))
            }

            override fun clickCashOut(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
                onComplete(onClickCashOut(fallbackX, fallbackY))
            }
        }

        AutomationController.initialize(repo, context)
        val wiredEngine = AutomationEngine(
            repository = repo,
            strategyEngine = StrategyEngine(),
            riskManager = RiskManager(),
            gameDetection = GameDetection(),
            targetUiInteractor = fakeInteractor
        ).also { eng ->
            eng.testBalanceOverride = null
            eng.onExecutionNotification = AutomationController.engine?.onExecutionNotification
        }
        AutomationController.engine = wiredEngine
        return Triple(context, repo, wiredEngine)
    }

    private fun buildDetection(
        phase: String,
        buttonState: SiteButtonState,
        liveMult: Double? = null,
        ribbon: List<Double> = listOf(1.25, 1.35, 3.10),
        balance: Double? = 500.0,
        currency: String = "TZS",
        roundId: String = "R-100",
        nowMs: Long = 1_700_000_000_000L
    ): GameDetectionState {
        val items = ribbon.mapIndexed { idx, value ->
            ExtractedHistoryItem(
                multiplier = value,
                orderIndex = idx,
                source = CollectionSource.VISIBLE_RIBBON,
                displayText = "${RibbonHistoryCollector.formatMultKey(value)}x"
            )
        }
        return GameDetectionState(
            isGameDetected = true,
            gameId = "aviator",
            displayedGameName = "BetPawa Aviator",
            platformName = "BetPawa Aviator",
            isReady = true,
            gamePhase = phase,
            detectedMultiplier = liveMult,
            liveDetectionLost = false,
            detectionConfidence = 0.95f,
            detectedRoundId = roundId,
            roundId = roundId,
            foregroundPackage = "com.android.chrome",
            uiTargets = DetectedUiTargets(
                detectedMultiplier = liveMult,
                ribbonMultipliers = ribbon,
                ribbonItems = items,
                gamePhase = phase,
                siteButtonState = buttonState,
                isFlewAwayDetected = phase == "CRASHED",
                isCancelBtnDetected = buttonState == SiteButtonState.BET_QUEUED,
                detectedUrl = "https://www.betpawa.co.tz/casino/game/aviator",
                detectedCurrentRoundId = roundId,
                betButtonBounds = Rect(400, 1100, 800, 1280),
                cashOutButtonBounds = Rect(400, 1100, 800, 1280),
                detectedBalance = balance,
                detectedCurrency = currency
            ),
            updatedAtMs = nowMs
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `manifest declares ScreenCaptureProjectionService and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION`() {
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        val pkgInfo = context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(
            context.packageName,
            PackageManager.GET_SERVICES or PackageManager.GET_PERMISSIONS
        )

        val permissions = pkgInfo.requestedPermissions?.toSet().orEmpty()
        assertTrue(
            "FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION permission must be declared",
            permissions.contains(android.Manifest.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION)
        )

        val services = pkgInfo.services?.toList().orEmpty()
        val projectionService = services.firstOrNull {
            it.name == "com.example.service.ScreenCaptureProjectionService"
        }
        assertNotNull("ScreenCaptureProjectionService must be declared in AndroidManifest.xml", projectionService)
        assertTrue(
            (projectionService!!.foregroundServiceType and ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MEDIA_PROJECTION) != 0
        )

        val a11yService = services.firstOrNull {
            it.name == "com.example.service.ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService"
        }
        assertNotNull("ScreenEarnerAccessibilityService must be declared in AndroidManifest.xml", a11yService)
    }

    @Test
    fun `writeAndVerifyStakeNode strictly rejects silent failures and passes only when readback matches`() {
        val controller = Robolectric.buildService(TestableAccessibilityController::class.java).create().get()
        val rootNode = AccessibilityNodeInfo.obtain()
        val stakeNode = AccessibilityNodeInfo.obtain()
        stakeNode.isEditable = true
        stakeNode.text = "1.00"

        // Case 1: Site rejects text replacement -> read-back remains "1.00" instead of "20.00"
        Shadows.shadowOf(stakeNode).setOnPerformActionListener { _, _ -> false }
        assertFalse(
            "Must return false when ACTION_SET_TEXT & ACTION_PASTE do not update readback",
            controller.testWriteAndVerifyStake(stakeNode, 20.0, "20.00", rootNode)
        )

        // Case 2: Android reports true for ACTION_SET_TEXT, but React/WebView ignores it and keeps "1.00"
        Shadows.shadowOf(stakeNode).setOnPerformActionListener { action, _ ->
            action == AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_SET_TEXT
        }
        assertFalse(
            "Must NOT report success when ACTION_SET_TEXT returns true but text stays unchanged",
            controller.testWriteAndVerifyStake(stakeNode, 20.0, "20.00", rootNode)
        )

        // Case 3: Site actually updates editable text to "20.00"
        Shadows.shadowOf(stakeNode).setOnPerformActionListener { action, args ->
            if (action == AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_SET_TEXT) {
                val updated = args?.getCharSequence(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_ARGUMENT_SET_TEXT_CHARSEQUENCE)
                stakeNode.text = updated
                true
            } else {
                false
            }
        }
        assertTrue(
            "Must return true once read-back verifies exact new stake",
            controller.testWriteAndVerifyStake(stakeNode, 20.0, "20.00", rootNode)
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `balance detected as zero reports Insufficient balance and emits non-spammy notification`() = runBlocking {
        val appliedStakes = mutableListOf<Double>()
        var betClicks = 0
        val (_, repo, engine) = setupIsolatedControllerWithFakeInteractor(
            onApplyStake = { stake, _ -> appliedStakes.add(stake); true },
            onClickBet = { _, _ -> betClicks++; true }
        )
        val emittedNotifications = mutableListOf<Pair<StrategyNotificationType, String>>()
        engine.onExecutionNotification = { type, _, msg, _, _ ->
            emittedNotifications.add(type to msg)
        }

        val config = StrategyConfig(
            isStrategy1Enabled = false,
            isStrategy2Enabled = false,
            isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = false,
            baseStake = 10.0,
            targetMultiplier = 2.00,
            isAutoBetEnabled = true,
            isAutoCashOutEnabled = true
        ).withUpdatedRule(
            StrategyRuleConfig(ruleId = StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES, isEnabled = true, requiredLosses = 2)
        )
        repo.saveStrategyConfig(config)
        repo.saveRiskLimits(RiskLimits())
        repo.saveNotificationSettings(NotificationSettings(monitoringErrorsEnabled = true, standardAlertEnabled = true))
        delay(50L)

        AutomationController.startMonitoringSession(isAccessibilityConnected = true, nowMs = 1_700_000_000_000L)
        engine.updateCalibratedShortcuts(
            listOf(FloatingShortcut(id = 1, label = "BET", type = ShortcutType.BET, targetPlatform = "BetPawa", targetX = 600f, targetY = 1190f, isCalibrated = true))
        )

        // Baseline capture + two crashes < 2.0x to activate AFTER_2_LOSSES
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("BETTING_OPEN", SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET, ribbon = listOf(3.00, 4.00, 5.00), balance = 0.0, roundId = "R-0", nowMs = 1_700_000_001_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_001_000L
        )
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("CRASHED", SiteButtonState.CRASHED, liveMult = 1.15, ribbon = listOf(1.15, 3.00, 4.00, 5.00), balance = 0.0, roundId = "R-1", nowMs = 1_700_000_005_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_005_000L
        )
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("CRASHED", SiteButtonState.CRASHED, liveMult = 1.40, ribbon = listOf(1.40, 1.15, 3.00, 4.00), balance = 0.0, roundId = "R-2", nowMs = 1_700_000_010_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_010_000L
        )

        assertEquals(BalanceDetectionStatus.VERIFIED, engine.gameDetection.balanceState.value.status)
        assertEquals(0.0, engine.resolveEffectiveBalance(), 0.001)
        assertTrue(engine.strategyEngine.getState().isBettingSessionActive)

        // Direct RiskManager + resolveEffectiveBalance verification for DETECTED status as well
        val detectedCheck = engine.riskManager.validateBetExecution(
            proposedStake = 10.0,
            currentSessionLoss = 0.0,
            currentRounds = 0,
            currentProgressionLevel = 1,
            currentBalance = 0.0,
            limits = RiskLimits(),
            currentSessionProfit = 0.0,
            balanceStatus = BalanceDetectionStatus.DETECTED
        )
        assertFalse(detectedCheck.isAllowed)
        assertTrue(
            "DETECTED balance 0.0 must report Insufficient balance, got: ${detectedCheck.violationReason}",
            detectedCheck.violationReason.orEmpty().contains("Insufficient balance", ignoreCase = true)
        )

        // Now BETTING_OPEN arrives with balance == 0.0 -> must NOT say "balance is unavailable", must say "Insufficient balance"
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("BETTING_OPEN", SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET, ribbon = listOf(1.40, 1.15, 3.00, 4.00), balance = 0.0, roundId = "R-3", nowMs = 1_700_000_012_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_012_000L
        )

        assertEquals(0, betClicks)
        assertTrue(appliedStakes.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(AutomationState.PAUSED, engine.automationState.value)
        val violation = engine.lastRiskViolation.value.orEmpty()
        assertTrue("Expected Insufficient balance message, got: $violation", violation.contains("Insufficient balance", ignoreCase = true))
        assertEquals(1, emittedNotifications.count { it.first == StrategyNotificationType.MONITORING_ERROR })
    }

    @Test
    fun `end to end detection triggers bet, cashout when autoCashOut enabled, and settles loss double and win reset`() = runBlocking {
        val appliedStakes = mutableListOf<Pair<Double, StakeProgressionMode>>()
        var betClicks = 0
        var cashOutClicks = 0
        val (_, repo, engine) = setupIsolatedControllerWithFakeInteractor(
            onApplyStake = { stake, mode ->
                appliedStakes.add(stake to mode)
                true
            },
            onClickBet = { _, _ -> betClicks++; true },
            onClickCashOut = { _, _ -> cashOutClicks++; true }
        )
        val executionNotices = mutableListOf<Pair<StrategyNotificationType, String>>()
        engine.onExecutionNotification = { type, title, _, _, _ ->
            executionNotices.add(type to title)
        }

        val config = StrategyConfig(
            isStrategy1Enabled = false,
            isStrategy2Enabled = false,
            isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = false,
            lossProgressionEnabled = true,
            lossProgressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.DOUBLE_AMOUNT,
            baseStake = 5.0,
            targetMultiplier = 2.00,
            isAutoBetEnabled = true,
            isAutoCashOutEnabled = true
        ).withUpdatedRule(
            StrategyRuleConfig(
                ruleId = StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES,
                isEnabled = true,
                progressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.DOUBLE_AMOUNT,
                requiredLosses = 2,
                targetWinsToFetch = 1
            )
        )
        repo.saveStrategyConfig(config)
        repo.saveRiskLimits(RiskLimits())
        repo.saveNotificationSettings(NotificationSettings(standardAlertEnabled = true, monitoringErrorsEnabled = true))
        delay(60L)

        AutomationController.startMonitoringSession(isAccessibilityConnected = true, nowMs = 1_700_000_000_000L)
        engine.updateCalibratedShortcuts(
            listOf(
                FloatingShortcut(id = 1, label = "BP BET", type = ShortcutType.BET, targetPlatform = "BetPawa", targetX = 600f, targetY = 1190f, isCalibrated = true),
                FloatingShortcut(id = 2, label = "BP CASHOUT", type = ShortcutType.CASH_OUT, targetPlatform = "BetPawa", targetX = 600f, targetY = 1190f, isCalibrated = true)
            )
        )

        // 1. Baseline capture -> 2 consecutive low crashes -> Strategy activates
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("BETTING_OPEN", SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET, ribbon = listOf(2.50, 3.10, 4.20), balance = 1000.0, roundId = "R-10", nowMs = 1_700_000_001_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_001_000L
        )
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("CRASHED", SiteButtonState.CRASHED, liveMult = 1.20, ribbon = listOf(1.20, 2.50, 3.10), balance = 1000.0, roundId = "R-11", nowMs = 1_700_000_004_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_004_000L
        )
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("CRASHED", SiteButtonState.CRASHED, liveMult = 1.45, ribbon = listOf(1.45, 1.20, 2.50), balance = 1000.0, roundId = "R-12", nowMs = 1_700_000_008_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_008_000L
        )
        assertTrue(engine.strategyEngine.getState().isBettingSessionActive)
        assertEquals(5.0, engine.strategyEngine.getState().currentCalculatedStake, 0.001)

        // 2. Round R-13 BETTING_OPEN -> applies stake 5.0 and clicks BET; repeats on BET_QUEUED do not double-bet
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("BETTING_OPEN", SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET, ribbon = listOf(1.45, 1.20, 2.50), balance = 1000.0, roundId = "R-13", nowMs = 1_700_000_010_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_010_000L
        )
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("BETTING_OPEN", SiteButtonState.BET_QUEUED, ribbon = listOf(1.45, 1.20, 2.50), balance = 995.0, roundId = "R-13", nowMs = 1_700_000_011_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_011_000L
        )
        assertEquals(1, betClicks)
        assertEquals(5.0, appliedStakes.last().first, 0.001)

        // 3. Round R-13 crashes early at 1.35x -> settles LOSS, doubles next stake to 10.0
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("IN_FLIGHT", SiteButtonState.CASH_OUT_AVAILABLE, liveMult = 1.20, ribbon = listOf(1.45, 1.20, 2.50), balance = 995.0, roundId = "R-13", nowMs = 1_700_000_012_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_012_000L
        )
        assertEquals(0, cashOutClicks)
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("CRASHED", SiteButtonState.CRASHED, liveMult = 1.35, ribbon = listOf(1.35, 1.45, 1.20), balance = 995.0, roundId = "R-13", nowMs = 1_700_000_015_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_015_000L
        )
        assertEquals(1, engine.sessionStats.value.lossCount)
        assertEquals(-5.0, engine.sessionStats.value.totalProfit, 0.001)
        assertEquals(10.0, engine.strategyEngine.getState().currentCalculatedStake, 0.001)

        // 4. Round R-14 BETTING_OPEN -> applies doubled stake 10.0 & clicks BET
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("BETTING_OPEN", SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET, ribbon = listOf(1.35, 1.45, 1.20), balance = 995.0, roundId = "R-14", nowMs = 1_700_000_017_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_017_000L
        )
        assertEquals(2, betClicks)
        assertEquals(10.0, appliedStakes.last().first, 0.001)

        // 5. Round R-14 IN_FLIGHT hits 2.15x -> clicks CASH OUT once
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("IN_FLIGHT", SiteButtonState.CASH_OUT_AVAILABLE, liveMult = 2.15, ribbon = listOf(1.35, 1.45, 1.20), balance = 985.0, roundId = "R-14", nowMs = 1_700_000_020_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_020_000L
        )
        assertEquals(1, cashOutClicks)

        // 6. Round R-14 crashes at 2.80x -> settles WIN, profit = -5 + 10 = +5.0, stake resets to base 5.0
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("CRASHED", SiteButtonState.CRASHED, liveMult = 2.80, ribbon = listOf(2.80, 1.35, 1.45), balance = 1005.0, roundId = "R-14", nowMs = 1_700_000_023_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_023_000L
        )
        delay(60L)
        assertEquals(1, engine.sessionStats.value.winCount)
        assertEquals(1, engine.sessionStats.value.lossCount)
        assertEquals(5.0, engine.sessionStats.value.totalProfit, 0.001)
        assertEquals(5.0, engine.strategyEngine.getState().currentCalculatedStake, 0.001)
        assertFalse(engine.strategyEngine.getState().isBettingSessionActive)

        val logs = repo.sessionLogs.first()
        assertEquals(2, logs.size)
        assertTrue(executionNotices.any { it.first == StrategyNotificationType.AUTOMATION_ACTION && it.second.contains("Bet Placed") })
        assertTrue(executionNotices.any { it.first == StrategyNotificationType.AUTOMATION_ACTION && it.second.contains("Cash Out Confirmed") })
        // Routine balance/amount reads must NOT generate notification noise
        assertTrue(executionNotices.none { it.second.contains("Balance", ignoreCase = true) })
    }

    @Test
    fun `custom pattern strategy match unlocks active betting session when Auto Bet is enabled`() = runBlocking {
        var betClicks = 0
        val (_, repo, engine) = setupIsolatedControllerWithFakeInteractor(
            onApplyStake = { _, _ -> true },
            onClickBet = { _, _ -> betClicks++; true }
        )

        val customStrategy = CustomPatternStrategy(
            id = 1L,
            name = "2 Low Custom Alert",
            strategyMode = StrategyMode.STRATEGY_A_CONSECUTIVE_LOWS,
            isEnabled = true,
            targetGameId = "aviator",
            requiredOccurrencesPerHour = 1,
            analysisWindowMinutes = 60,
            conditionsJson = CustomPatternStrategy.serializeConditions(
                listOf(PatternCondition(comparator = PatternComparator.LESS_THAN, threshold = 2.0, consecutiveRounds = 2))
            )
        )
        repo.insertCustomStrategy(customStrategy)

        val config = StrategyConfig(
            isStrategy1Enabled = false,
            isStrategy2Enabled = false,
            isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = false,
            baseStake = 15.0,
            targetMultiplier = 2.00,
            isAutoBetEnabled = true,
            isAutoCashOutEnabled = true
        ).withUpdatedRuleConfigs(
            StrategyRuleId.entries.map { StrategyRuleConfig(ruleId = it, isEnabled = false) }
        )
        repo.saveStrategyConfig(config)
        repo.saveRiskLimits(RiskLimits())
        delay(60L)

        val baseNow = System.currentTimeMillis()
        AutomationController.startMonitoringSession(isAccessibilityConnected = true, nowMs = baseNow)
        engine.updateCalibratedShortcuts(
            listOf(FloatingShortcut(id = 1, label = "BET", type = ShortcutType.BET, targetPlatform = "BetPawa", targetX = 600f, targetY = 1190f, isCalibrated = true))
        )

        // Baseline + 2 consecutive low crashes -> CustomPatternStrategy matches
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("BETTING_OPEN", SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET, ribbon = listOf(4.20, 5.10), balance = 500.0, roundId = "R-20", nowMs = baseNow + 1_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = baseNow + 1_000L
        )
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("CRASHED", SiteButtonState.CRASHED, liveMult = 1.25, ribbon = listOf(1.25, 4.20, 5.10), balance = 500.0, roundId = "R-21", nowMs = baseNow + 4_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = baseNow + 4_000L
        )
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("CRASHED", SiteButtonState.CRASHED, liveMult = 1.55, ribbon = listOf(1.55, 1.25, 4.20), balance = 500.0, roundId = "R-22", nowMs = baseNow + 8_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = baseNow + 8_000L
        )
        // Wait briefly for evaluatePatternStrategies coroutine launched inside processDetectionEvent
        delay(200L)

        assertTrue(
            "CustomPatternStrategy match should activate StrategyEngine betting session",
            engine.strategyEngine.getState().isBettingSessionActive
        )

        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("BETTING_OPEN", SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET, ribbon = listOf(1.55, 1.25, 4.20), balance = 500.0, roundId = "R-23", nowMs = baseNow + 10_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = baseNow + 10_000L
        )
        assertEquals(1, betClicks)
    }

    @Test
    fun `manual bet with auto cashout enabled does not fire below 1_20x on transient frames and cashes out at 2_00x`() = runBlocking {
        var cashOutClicks = 0
        val requestedGestures = mutableListOf<String>()
        val (_, repo, engine) = setupIsolatedControllerWithFakeInteractor(
            onClickCashOut = { _, _ -> cashOutClicks++; true }
        )
        engine.onGestureDispatchRequested = { _, _, label ->
            requestedGestures.add(label)
        }
        val notices = mutableListOf<Pair<StrategyNotificationType, String>>()
        engine.onExecutionNotification = { type, title, _, _, _ ->
            notices.add(type to title)
        }

        val config = StrategyConfig(
            baseStake = 10.0,
            targetMultiplier = 2.00,
            isAutoBetEnabled = false,
            isAutoCashOutEnabled = true
        )
        repo.saveStrategyConfig(config)
        repo.saveRiskLimits(RiskLimits())
        delay(60L)

        AutomationController.startMonitoringSession(isAccessibilityConnected = true, nowMs = 1_700_000_000_000L)
        engine.updateCalibratedShortcuts(
            listOf(FloatingShortcut(id = 2, label = "CASH OUT HAND", type = ShortcutType.CASH_OUT, targetPlatform = "BetPawa", targetX = 720f, targetY = 1200f, targetMultiplier = 2.00, isCalibrated = true))
        )

        // Prior round crashed at 3.50x so currentMultiplier in state would have been 3.50x if stale fallback existed;
        // IN_FLIGHT with null liveMult + 1.15x must NEVER trigger cash-out at < 1.20x when target is 2.00x.
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("CRASHED", SiteButtonState.CRASHED, liveMult = 3.50, ribbon = listOf(3.50, 1.80), balance = 1000.0, roundId = "R-40", nowMs = 1_700_000_001_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_001_000L
        )
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("IN_FLIGHT", SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET, liveMult = null, ribbon = listOf(3.50, 1.80), balance = 990.0, roundId = "R-41", nowMs = 1_700_000_003_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_003_000L
        )
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("IN_FLIGHT", SiteButtonState.CASH_OUT_AVAILABLE, liveMult = 1.15, ribbon = listOf(3.50, 1.80), balance = 990.0, roundId = "R-41", nowMs = 1_700_000_004_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_004_000L
        )
        assertEquals(0, cashOutClicks)

        // Reaches 2.02x with manual bet's CASH_OUT_AVAILABLE visible -> cashes out and notifies
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("IN_FLIGHT", SiteButtonState.CASH_OUT_AVAILABLE, liveMult = 2.02, ribbon = listOf(3.50, 1.80), balance = 990.0, roundId = "R-41", nowMs = 1_700_000_007_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_007_000L
        )
        assertEquals(1, cashOutClicks)
        assertTrue(requestedGestures.contains("CASH OUT"))
        assertTrue(notices.any { it.second.contains("Waiting for Cash Out", ignoreCase = true) })
        assertTrue(notices.any { it.second.contains("Cashing Out", ignoreCase = true) })
        assertTrue(notices.any { it.second.contains("Cash Out Confirmed", ignoreCase = true) })
    }

    @Test
    fun `emits full action lifecycle notifications from waiting to bet through round settlement`() = runBlocking {
        val (_, repo, engine) = setupIsolatedControllerWithFakeInteractor(
            onApplyStake = { _, _ -> true },
            onClickBet = { _, _ -> true },
            onClickCashOut = { _, _ -> true }
        )
        val actionTitles = mutableListOf<String>()
        engine.onExecutionNotification = { type, title, _, _, _ ->
            if (type == StrategyNotificationType.AUTOMATION_ACTION) {
                actionTitles.add(title)
            }
        }

        val config = StrategyConfig(
            isStrategy1Enabled = false,
            isStrategy2Enabled = false,
            isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = false,
            baseStake = 5.0,
            targetMultiplier = 2.00,
            isAutoBetEnabled = true,
            isAutoCashOutEnabled = true
        ).withUpdatedRule(
            StrategyRuleConfig(
                ruleId = StrategyRuleId.AFTER_3_LOSSES,
                isEnabled = true,
                progressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.DOUBLE_AMOUNT,
                requiredLosses = 3,
                targetWinsToFetch = 1
            )
        )
        repo.saveStrategyConfig(config)
        repo.saveRiskLimits(RiskLimits())
        delay(60L)

        AutomationController.startMonitoringSession(isAccessibilityConnected = true, nowMs = 1_700_000_000_000L)
        engine.updateCalibratedShortcuts(
            listOf(
                FloatingShortcut(id = 1, label = "BET HAND", type = ShortcutType.BET, targetPlatform = "BetPawa", targetX = 500f, targetY = 1200f, isCalibrated = true),
                FloatingShortcut(id = 2, label = "CASH OUT HAND", type = ShortcutType.CASH_OUT, targetPlatform = "BetPawa", targetX = 720f, targetY = 1200f, targetMultiplier = 2.00, isCalibrated = true)
            )
        )

        // Baseline + waiting to bet before 3 consecutive lows
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("BETTING_OPEN", SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET, ribbon = listOf(3.10, 4.20), balance = 1000.0, roundId = "R-50", nowMs = 1_700_000_001_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_001_000L
        )
        val ribbons = listOf(
            listOf(1.10, 3.10, 4.20),
            listOf(1.25, 1.10, 3.10),
            listOf(1.40, 1.25, 1.10)
        )
        listOf(1.10 to "R-51", 1.25 to "R-52", 1.40 to "R-53").forEachIndexed { idx, (mult, rid) ->
            AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
                buildDetection("CRASHED", SiteButtonState.CRASHED, liveMult = mult, ribbon = ribbons[idx], balance = 1000.0, roundId = rid, nowMs = 1_700_000_003_000L + idx * 3_000L),
                isAccessibilityConnected = true,
                nowMs = 1_700_000_003_000L + idx * 3_000L
            )
        }
        assertTrue(engine.strategyEngine.getState().isBettingSessionActive)

        // Next round: BETTING_OPEN -> IN_FLIGHT -> 2.10x -> CRASHED
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("BETTING_OPEN", SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET, ribbon = listOf(1.40, 1.25, 1.10), balance = 1000.0, roundId = "R-54", nowMs = 1_700_000_015_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_015_000L
        )
        // Transient IN_FLIGHT frame with IDLE_READY_TO_BET must NOT prematurely settle before CASH_OUT_AVAILABLE appears
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("IN_FLIGHT", SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET, liveMult = 1.05, ribbon = listOf(1.40, 1.25, 1.10), balance = 995.0, roundId = "R-54", nowMs = 1_700_000_016_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_016_000L
        )
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("IN_FLIGHT", SiteButtonState.CASH_OUT_AVAILABLE, liveMult = 2.10, ribbon = listOf(1.40, 1.25, 1.10), balance = 995.0, roundId = "R-54", nowMs = 1_700_000_019_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_019_000L
        )
        AutomationController.processDetectionEvent(
            buildDetection("CRASHED", SiteButtonState.CRASHED, liveMult = 2.40, ribbon = listOf(2.40, 1.40, 1.25), balance = 1005.0, roundId = "R-54", nowMs = 1_700_000_021_000L),
            isAccessibilityConnected = true,
            nowMs = 1_700_000_021_000L
        )

        assertTrue(actionTitles.any { it.contains("Waiting to Bet", ignoreCase = true) })
        assertTrue(actionTitles.any { it.contains("Placing Bet", ignoreCase = true) })
        assertTrue(actionTitles.any { it.contains("Bet Placed", ignoreCase = true) })
        assertTrue(actionTitles.any { it.contains("Waiting for Cash Out", ignoreCase = true) })
        assertTrue(actionTitles.any { it.contains("Cashing Out", ignoreCase = true) })
        assertTrue(actionTitles.any { it.contains("Cash Out Confirmed", ignoreCase = true) })
        assertTrue(actionTitles.any { it.contains("Round Won", ignoreCase = true) })
        assertTrue(actionTitles.none { it.contains("Balance", ignoreCase = true) })
    }
}

package com.example

import android.content.Context

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(sdk = [36])
class ExampleRobolectricTest {

    @get:Rule
    val composeRule = createComposeRule()

    @Test
    fun `read Predict Manager app name from context`() {
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        val appName = context.getString(R.string.app_name)
        assertEquals("Predict Manager", appName)
    }

    @Test
    fun `room v10 persists crash records, multiplier records, and strategy config`() = runTest {
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        val db = Room.inMemoryDatabaseBuilder(context, ScreenEarnerDatabase::class.java)
            .allowMainThreadQueries()
            .build()
        try {
            val dao = db.dao()
            dao.saveStrategyConfig(StrategyConfig(gridRows = 4, gridColumns = 7))
            dao.insertMultiplierRecord(MultiplierRecord(multiplier = 112.40, crashTimestamp = 1_700_000_000_000L, platform = "SportyBet Aviator"))
            dao.insertCrashRecord(
                CrashRecord(
                    gameId = "aviator",
                    gameName = "Aviator",
                    multiplier = 112.40,
                    detectedColorHex = "#EC4899",
                    colorCategory = CrashColorCategory.Pink,
                    isPixelColorVerified = true,
                    crashTimestamp = 1_700_000_000_000L,
                    hourStartTimestamp = 1_699_999_200_000L,
                    sourcePackage = "com.android.chrome",
                    dedupKey = "aviator_11240_1"
                )
            )

            val records = dao.getAllMultiplierRecords().first()
            assertEquals(1, records.size)
            assertEquals(112.40, records.first().multiplier, 0.001)

            val crashes = dao.getAllCrashRecords().first()
            assertEquals(1, crashes.size)
            assertEquals("#EC4899", crashes.first().detectedColorHex)

            val savedConfig = dao.getStrategyConfig().first()
            assertEquals(4, savedConfig?.gridRows)
            assertEquals(7, savedConfig?.gridColumns)
        } finally {
            db.close()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `settings screen updates grid dimensions, keep awake, schedule switches and validates inputs`() {
        var saveReturnedCount = 0
        val configUpdates = mutableListOf<StrategyConfig>()
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()

        composeRule.setContent {
            val currentConfigState = remember { mutableStateOf(StrategyConfig()) }
            AutoPredictorTheme {
                Column {
                    FloatingSessionStatsHudComposable(
                        stats = SessionStats(
                            observedCrashCount = 12,
                            limitHaltReason = null
                        ),
                        observedRounds = 12,
                        automationState = AutomationState.RUNNING,
                        gameName = "Aviator",
                        latestCrashMultiplier = 1.53
                    )
                    SettingsAppearanceScreen(
                        strategyConfig = currentConfigState.value,
                        onStrategyConfigChanged = { updated ->
                            currentConfigState.value = updated
                            configUpdates.add(updated)
                        },
                        onSaveAndReturn = {
                            saveReturnedCount++
                        }
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // Toggle 4x7 grid chips
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("settings_grid_rows_4").performScrollTo().performClick()
        composeRule.waitForIdle()
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("settings_grid_cols_7").performScrollTo().performClick()
        composeRule.waitForIdle()

        assertTrue(configUpdates.isNotEmpty())
        assertEquals(4, configUpdates.last().gridRows)
        assertEquals(7, configUpdates.last().gridColumns)
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("settings_grid_rows_4").assertIsSelected()
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("settings_grid_cols_7").assertIsSelected()

        // Toggle Keep Screen Awake off then back on
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("settings_keep_awake_switch").performScrollTo().performClick()
        composeRule.waitForIdle()
        assertFalse(configUpdates.last().keepScreenAwake)

        // Invalid Low threshold blocks save and shows Toast
        val lowInput = composeRule.onNodeWithTag("settings_low_threshold_input")
        lowInput.performScrollTo()
        lowInput.performTextClearance()

        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("save_appearance_settings_btn").performScrollTo().performClick()
        composeRule.waitForIdle()
        assertEquals(0, saveReturnedCount)
        assertEquals("Failed to save settings, please check input", ShadowToast.getTextOfLatestToast())

        // Restore valid threshold -> Save & Close succeeds & writes overlay SharedPreferences
        lowInput.performScrollTo()
        lowInput.performTextReplacement("2.00")
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("save_appearance_settings_btn").performScrollTo().performClick()
        composeRule.waitForIdle()
        assertEquals(1, saveReturnedCount)

        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(ScreenEarnerOverlayService.PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        assertTrue(prefs.contains(ScreenEarnerOverlayService.PREF_BUBBLE_OPACITY))
    }

    @Test
    fun `clicking Save with empty or invalid inputs shows Toast without crashing or saving bad state`() {
        var strategySavedCount = 0
        var riskSavedCount = 0
        val showRisk = mutableStateOf(false)

        composeRule.setContent {
            AutoPredictorTheme {
                if (!showRisk.value) {
                    StrategyScreen(
                        currentConfig = StrategyConfig(),
                        onSaveConfig = { strategySavedCount++ }
                    )
                } else {
                    RiskManagerScreen(
                        currentLimits = RiskLimits(),
                        lastViolation = null,
                        onSaveLimits = { riskSavedCount++ },
                        onTriggerEmergencyStop = {},
                        onClearEmergencyStop = {}
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // Clear Low Threshold input in StrategyScreen so it becomes invalid empty string, then tap Save
        val lowThreshNode = composeRule.onNodeWithTag("strategy_low_threshold_input")
        lowThreshNode.performScrollTo()
        lowThreshNode.performTextClearance()
        composeRule.onNode(hasScrollAction()).performScrollToNode(hasTestTag("save_strategy_btn"))
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("save_strategy_btn").performClick()
        composeRule.waitForIdle()

        assertEquals(0, strategySavedCount)
        assertEquals("Failed to save settings, please check input", ShadowToast.getTextOfLatestToast())

        // Also test RiskManagerScreen with malformed input
        showRisk.value = true
        composeRule.waitForIdle()
        val maxStakeNode = composeRule.onNodeWithTag("max_stake_input")
        maxStakeNode.performScrollTo()
        maxStakeNode.performTextReplacement("NaN")
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("save_risk_limits_btn").performScrollTo().performClick()
        composeRule.waitForIdle()

        assertEquals(0, riskSavedCount)
        assertEquals("Failed to save settings, please check input", ShadowToast.getTextOfLatestToast())
    }
}

import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(sdk = [36])
class LivePipelineAndOverlayTest {

    @get:Rule
    val composeRule = createComposeRule()

    private lateinit var app: Application

    @Before
    fun setUp() {
        app = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext()
        AlarmAudioController.stopAlarm()
        AlarmAudioController.clearSnooze()
    }

    @After
    fun tearDown() {
        AlarmAudioController.stopAlarm()
        AlarmAudioController.clearSnooze()
        AutomationController.endSessionAndClearData(app)
    }

    private fun fakeDetection(
        phase: String,
        multiplier: Double?,
        roundId: String? = null,
        historyExpanded: Boolean = false,
        windowAccessStatus: MonitoringStatus = MonitoringStatus.MONITORING,
        liveDetectionLost: Boolean = false,
        gameWindowSuspended: Boolean = false,
        updatedAtMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
    ): GameDetectionState {
        return GameDetectionState(
            isGameDetected = !liveDetectionLost && !gameWindowSuspended,
            gameId = "aviator",
            displayedGameName = "Aviator",
            platformName = "BetPawa Aviator",
            isReady = true,
            gamePhase = phase,
            detectedMultiplier = multiplier,
            liveColorHex = null,
            isLiveColorPixelVerified = false,
            liveDetectionLost = liveDetectionLost,
            detectionConfidence = 0f,
            foregroundPackage = "com.android.chrome",
            uiTargets = DetectedUiTargets(
                detectedMultiplier = multiplier,
                historyPanelExpanded = historyExpanded,
                gamePhase = phase,
                isFlewAwayDetected = phase == "CRASHED",
                roundId = roundId
            ),
            roundId = roundId,
            updatedAtMs = updatedAtMs,
            windowAccessStatus = windowAccessStatus,
            gameWindowAccessible = windowAccessStatus == MonitoringStatus.MONITORING,
            gameWindowSuspended = gameWindowSuspended
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `flow debounce collapses rapid repeated CRASHED events to single confirmed emission`() = runBlocking {
        val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default + SupervisorJob())
        val emissions = mutableListOf<ConfirmedCrashEmission>()
        try {
            val pipeline = LiveCrashPipeline(scope, debounceWindowMs = 60L) {
                emissions.add(it)
            }
            pipeline.configureSession("sess_debounce_1")

            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("BETTING_OPEN", null, roundId = "R-100"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("IN_FLIGHT", 1.25, roundId = "R-100"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("IN_FLIGHT", 2.40, roundId = "R-100"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)

            // No emissions during rising phase
            delay(90L)
            assertEquals(0, emissions.size)
            assertEquals(RoundLifecycleState.MULTIPLIER_RISING, pipeline.lifecycleState.value)

            // Burst of repeated CRASHED accessibility callbacks for the exact same round
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("CRASHED", 3.18, roundId = "R-100"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            delay(20L)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("CRASHED", 3.18, roundId = "R-100"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            delay(20L)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("CRASHED", 3.18, roundId = "R-100"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)

            // Wait past debounce window
            delay(130L)
            assertEquals(1, emissions.size)
            assertEquals(3.18, emissions.first().multiplier, 0.001)
            assertEquals(RoundLifecycleState.ROUND_RECORDED, pipeline.lifecycleState.value)

            // Late duplicate callback for the same round is ignored
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("CRASHED", 3.18, roundId = "R-100"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            delay(100L)
            assertEquals(1, emissions.size)
            assertTrue(pipeline.diagnostics.value.duplicatesIgnoredCount >= 1)
        } finally {
            scope.cancel()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `historyPanelExpanded classifies as HISTORY_ONLY and never records crashes`() = runBlocking {
        val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default + SupervisorJob())
        val emissions = mutableListOf<ConfirmedCrashEmission>()
        try {
            val pipeline = LiveCrashPipeline(scope, debounceWindowMs = 40L) {
                emissions.add(it)
            }
            pipeline.configureSession("sess_hist_only")

            // User opens Round History modal displaying historical crashed multipliers
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(
                fakeDetection("CRASHED", 12.50, roundId = "OLD-9", historyExpanded = true),
                MonitoringStatus.MONITORING
            )
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(
                fakeDetection("CRASHED", 1.05, roundId = "OLD-8", historyExpanded = true),
                MonitoringStatus.MONITORING
            )
            delay(100L)

            assertEquals(0, emissions.size)
            assertTrue(pipeline.diagnostics.value.historyBlocksCount >= 2)
            assertTrue(pipeline.diagnostics.value.lastEventSummary.contains("HISTORY_ONLY"))
        } finally {
            scope.cancel()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `back to back legitimate identical multipliers across distinct rounds are both recorded`() = runBlocking {
        val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default + SupervisorJob())
        val emissions = mutableListOf<ConfirmedCrashEmission>()
        try {
            val pipeline = LiveCrashPipeline(scope, debounceWindowMs = 35L) {
                emissions.add(it)
            }
            pipeline.configureSession("sess_same_mult")

            // Round 1 -> 2.10x
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("IN_FLIGHT", 1.50), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("CRASHED", 2.10), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            delay(85L)

            // Round 2 transition -> 2.10x again
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("BETTING_OPEN", null), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("IN_FLIGHT", 1.40), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("CRASHED", 2.10), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            delay(85L)

            assertEquals(2, emissions.size)
            assertEquals(2.10, emissions[0].multiplier, 0.001)
            assertEquals(2.10, emissions[1].multiplier, 0.001)
            assertNotEquals(emissions[0].crashRecord.dedupKey, emissions[1].crashRecord.dedupKey)
        } finally {
            scope.cancel()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `suspended or inaccessible window blocks recording without discarding session`() = runBlocking {
        val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default + SupervisorJob())
        val emissions = mutableListOf<ConfirmedCrashEmission>()
        try {
            val pipeline = LiveCrashPipeline(scope, debounceWindowMs = 35L) {
                emissions.add(it)
            }
            pipeline.configureSession("sess_suspend")

            // Window goes to Settings or becomes inaccessible
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(
                fakeDetection(
                    phase = "CRASHED",
                    multiplier = 4.44,
                    windowAccessStatus = MonitoringStatus.GAME_NOT_ACCESSIBLE,
                    liveDetectionLost = true
                ),
                MonitoringStatus.GAME_NOT_ACCESSIBLE
            )
            delay(85L)
            assertEquals(0, emissions.size)

            // Window returns -> recording resumes normally into same session
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("IN_FLIGHT", 1.80), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("CRASHED", 2.55), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            delay(85L)
            assertEquals(1, emissions.size)
            assertEquals("sess_suspend", emissions.first().crashRecord.sessionId)
        } finally {
            scope.cancel()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `fresh session starts at zero despite historical rows and endSessionAndClearData cleans only active session`() = runBlocking {
        AutomationController.ensureInitialized(app)
        val dao = ScreenEarnerDatabase.getDatabase(app).dao()

        // Seed an old archive crash record from a prior day/session
        val oldTs = System.currentTimeMillis() - 3_600_000L
        dao.insertCrashRecord(
            CrashRecord(
                gameId = "aviator",
                gameName = "Aviator",
                multiplier = 9.99,
                detectedColorHex = "#9333EA",
                colorCategory = CrashColorCategory.Purple,
                isPixelColorVerified = false,
                crashTimestamp = oldTs,
                hourStartTimestamp = CalendarHourUtils.hourStartFor(oldTs),
                sourcePackage = "com.android.chrome",
                sessionId = "old_archive_session",
                isConfirmed = true,
                dedupKey = "old_archive_session_999"
            )
        )

        // Start a brand-new monitoring session
        val sessId = AutomationController.startNewOrResumeMonitoring(app)
        assertTrue(sessId.isNotBlank())
        assertEquals(0, AutomationController.sessionCrashesRecorded.value)
        assertTrue(AutomationController.sessionCrashRecords.value.isEmpty())
        assertNotEquals(MonitoringStatus.STOPPED, AutomationController.monitoringStatus.value)

        // Feed one live round (IN_FLIGHT -> CRASHED) through controller
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        AutomationController.processDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("IN_FLIGHT", 1.50, roundId = "LIVE-1", updatedAtMs = now))
        AutomationController.processDetectionFrame(fakeDetection("CRASHED", 3.33, roundId = "LIVE-1", updatedAtMs = now + 50L))
        delay(320L)

        assertEquals(1, AutomationController.sessionCrashesRecorded.value)
        assertEquals(1, AutomationController.sessionCrashRecords.value.size)
        assertEquals("LIVE-1", AutomationController.engine!!.gameDetection.gameState.value.currentRoundId)
        assertEquals(3.33, AutomationController.engine!!.gameDetection.gameState.value.latestCrashMultiplier!!, 0.001)

        // Verify persisted SharedPreferences session restoration fields
        val prefs = app.getSharedPreferences(AutomationController.PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        assertEquals(sessId, prefs.getString(AutomationController.KEY_ACTIVE_SESSION_ID, ""))
        assertEquals(MonitoringStatus.MONITORING.name, prefs.getString(AutomationController.KEY_MONITORING_DESIRED_STATE, ""))

        // Pause then resume retains same sessionId without duplicating rounds
        AutomationController.pauseMonitoring(app)
        assertEquals(MonitoringStatus.PAUSED, AutomationController.monitoringStatus.value)
        val resumedId = AutomationController.startNewOrResumeMonitoring(app)
        assertEquals(sessId, resumedId)
        assertEquals(1, AutomationController.sessionCrashesRecorded.value)

        // End session & clear session data -> deletes active session rows but preserves old_archive_session
        AutomationController.endSessionAndClearData(app)
        delay(200L)

        assertEquals(MonitoringStatus.STOPPED, AutomationController.monitoringStatus.value)
        assertEquals("", AutomationController.activeSessionId.value)
        assertEquals(0, AutomationController.sessionCrashesRecorded.value)
        assertTrue(AutomationController.sessionCrashRecords.value.isEmpty())
        assertNull(AutomationController.engine!!.gameDetection.gameState.value.latestCrashMultiplier)
        assertNull(AutomationController.engine!!.gameDetection.gameState.value.currentRoundId)

        val remainingAll = dao.getAllCrashRecords().first()
        assertTrue("Active session row should be deleted", remainingAll.none { it.sessionId == sessId })
        assertTrue("Archive row from prior session must remain preserved", remainingAll.any { it.sessionId == "old_archive_session" })
    }

    @Test
    fun `overlay clampOverlayPosition constrains HUD, bubble, and panel inside safeBounds`() {
        val safeBounds = Rect(0, 80, 1080, 2260)

        // Dragged negative off top-left
        val (leftX, topY) = ScreenEarnerOverlayService.clampOverlayPosition(
            x = -250,
            y = -120,
            viewWidthPx = 240,
            viewHeightPx = 120,
            safeBounds = safeBounds
        )
        assertEquals(0, leftX)
        assertEquals(80, topY)

        // Dragged beyond bottom-right navigation bar
        val (rightX, bottomY) = ScreenEarnerOverlayService.clampOverlayPosition(
            x = 1400,
            y = 2900,
            viewWidthPx = 300,
            viewHeightPx = 400,
            safeBounds = safeBounds
        )
        assertEquals(1080 - 300, rightX)
        assertEquals(2260 - 400, bottomY)
    }

    @Test
    fun `AlarmAudioController manages ringing, Stop, Snooze, and versioned notification channels without High-Probability`() {
        val settings = NotificationSettings(
            highPriorityAlarmEnabled = true,
            alarmVibrationPattern = "DISTINCTIVE",
            alarmMaxDurationMinutes = 5,
            channelConfigVersion = 3
        )

        // Versioned channel ID resolution
        assertEquals(
            "monitoring_alarm_v3",
            AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.resolveVersionedChannelId(AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.CHANNEL_ALARM, settings)
        )
        assertEquals(
            "monitoring_standard_v3",
            AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.resolveVersionedChannelId(AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.CHANNEL_STANDARD, settings)
        )
        assertEquals(
            "monitoring_service",
            AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.resolveVersionedChannelId(AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.CHANNEL_SERVICE, settings)
        )

        // Start -> ringing
        AlarmAudioController.startAlarm(context = null, settings = settings, title = "PATTERN MATCH — Strategy A")
        assertTrue(AlarmAudioController.isAlarmRinging.value)
        assertEquals("PATTERN MATCH — Strategy A", AlarmAudioController.activeAlarmTitle.value)

        // Stop -> releases & clears
        AlarmAudioController.stopAlarm()
        assertFalse(AlarmAudioController.isAlarmRinging.value)
        assertNull(AlarmAudioController.activeAlarmTitle.value)

        // Snooze -> suppresses subsequent alarm within snooze window
        val t0 = 1_700_000_000_000L
        AlarmAudioController.snoozeAlarm(snoozeMinutes = 5, nowMs = t0)
        assertTrue(AlarmAudioController.isAlarmSnoozed(nowMs = t0 + 60_000L))
        AlarmAudioController.startAlarm(context = null, settings = settings, title = "Should Suppress", nowMs = t0 + 60_000L)
        assertFalse(AlarmAudioController.isAlarmRinging.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun `AlarmStopReceiver stops ringing alarm in background without launching activity`() {
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Application>()
        val settings = NotificationSettings(highPriorityAlarmEnabled = true)
        AlarmAudioController.clearSnooze()
        AlarmAudioController.startAlarm(context = null, settings = settings, title = "Background Stop Test")
        assertTrue(AlarmAudioController.isAlarmRinging.value)

        val receiver = AlarmStopReceiver()
        receiver.onReceive(context, Intent(AlarmAudioController.ACTION_STOP_ALARM))

        assertFalse(AlarmAudioController.isAlarmRinging.value)
        assertNull(AlarmAudioController.activeAlarmTitle.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun `LiveCrashHeaderCard and SettingsAppearanceScreen separate Round ID from Session Crashes and show Pattern Match profiles`() {
        composeRule.setContent {
            AutoPredictorTheme {
                androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column {
                    LiveCrashHeaderCard(
                        gameState = GameState(
                            isDetected = true,
                            displayedGameName = "Aviator",
                            platformName = "BetPawa Aviator",
                            monitoringStatus = MonitoringStatus.WAITING_FOR_GAME,
                            latestCrashMultiplier = null,
                            currentRoundId = null,
                            sessionCrashesRecorded = 0
                        ),
                        automationState = AutomationState.RUNNING
                    )
                    SettingsAppearanceScreen(
                        notificationSettings = NotificationSettings(),
                        onEndSessionAndClearData = {}
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        composeRule.onNodeWithText("LAST CRASH: —").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeRule.onNodeWithText("CURRENT GAME ROUND: —").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeRule.onNodeWithText("SESSION CRASHES RECORDED: 0").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeRule.onNodeWithText("Waiting for first confirmed crash").assertIsDisplayed()

        // Dedicated Section 1 card visible & labeled Pattern Match (never High-Probability)
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("settings_alarm_profiles_card").performScrollTo().assertIsDisplayed()
        composeRule.onNodeWithText("ALARM & NOTIFICATION PROFILES").performScrollTo().assertIsDisplayed()
        composeRule.onNodeWithText("B. Signal Alarm (Pattern Match)").performScrollTo().assertIsDisplayed()
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("settings_test_alarm_btn").performScrollTo().assertIsDisplayed()
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("settings_stop_alarm_btn").performScrollTo().assertIsDisplayed()
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("settings_snooze_alarm_btn").performScrollTo().assertIsDisplayed()
    }

    @Test
    fun `OverlaySettingsPanelComposable saves changes in overlay mode and expands to Full Screen only when tapped`() {
        var savedConfig: StrategyConfig? = null
        var expandCount = 0
        var closeCount = 0
        var stopAlarmCount = 0

        composeRule.setContent {
            AutoPredictorTheme {
                OverlaySettingsPanelComposable(
                    strategyConfig = StrategyConfig(
                        baseStake = 10.0,
                        targetMultiplier = 2.0,
                        isAutoBetEnabled = false
                    ),
                    notificationSettings = NotificationSettings(),
                    isMonitoringRunning = true,
                    isAlarmRinging = true,
                    activeAlarmTitle = "PATTERN MATCH — Aviator",
                    onSaveOverlaySettings = { cfg, _, _, _, _ -> savedConfig = cfg },
                    onStopAlarm = { stopAlarmCount++ },
                    onExpandFullScreen = { expandCount++ },
                    onClose = { closeCount++ }
                )
            }
        }

        composeRule.waitForIdle()
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("overlay_settings_window").assertIsDisplayed()
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("overlay_settings_alarm_banner").assertIsDisplayed()

        // Stop alarm inside overlay settings
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("overlay_settings_stop_alarm_btn").performClick()
        assertEquals(1, stopAlarmCount)

        // Toggle auto-bet and update stake to 1.0 + target 2.50 directly inside overlay
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("overlay_settings_auto_bet_switch").performClick()
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("overlay_settings_base_stake_input").performTextReplacement("1.0")
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("overlay_settings_target_multiplier_input").performTextReplacement("2.50")

        // Save in overlay mode without navigating to Full Screen
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("overlay_settings_save_btn").performClick()
        composeRule.waitForIdle()

        assertEquals(0, expandCount)
        assertTrue(savedConfig != null)
        assertTrue(savedConfig!!.isAutoBetEnabled)
        assertEquals(1.0, savedConfig!!.baseStake, 0.001)
        assertEquals(2.50, savedConfig!!.targetMultiplier, 0.001)

        // Tapping Full Screen explicitly expands
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("overlay_settings_fullscreen_btn").performClick()
        assertEquals(1, expandCount)

        // Tapping Close dismisses overlay settings
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("overlay_settings_close_btn").performClick()
        assertEquals(1, closeCount)
    }
}

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(sdk = [36])
class MasterRebuildTests {

    @get:Rule
    val composeRule = createComposeRule()

    private var db: ScreenEarnerDatabase? = null

    @After
    fun tearDown() {
        AlarmAudioController.stopAlarm()
        AlarmAudioController.clearSnooze()
        AutomationController.cancelTestBackgroundLoops()
        AutomationController.resetTestState()
        AutomationController.engine = null
        AutomationController.repository = null
        db?.close()
        db = null
    }

    private fun setupDbAndRepo(): Pair<Context, ScreenEarnerRepository> {
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        SessionStateManager(context).clearSessionRuntimeState()
        AutomationController.resetTestState()
        AutomationController.bypassMonitoringGuardForTest = true
        AutomationController.engine = null
        AutomationController.repository = null
        val database = Room.inMemoryDatabaseBuilder(context, ScreenEarnerDatabase::class.java)
            .allowMainThreadQueries()
            .build()
        db = database
        val repo = ScreenEarnerRepository(database.dao())
        AutomationController.initialize(repo, context)
        return context to repo
    }

    private fun crashRow(
        gameId: String = "aviator",
        gameName: String = "Aviator",
        sessionId: String = "sess_1",
        mult: Double,
        ts: Long,
        roundId: String? = null,
        hex: String? = null,
        category: CrashColorCategory? = null,
        dedupSuffix: String = "${ts}_$mult"
    ): CrashRecord {
        val cat = category ?: when {
            mult < 2.0 -> CrashColorCategory.Blue
            mult < 10.0 -> CrashColorCategory.Purple
            else -> CrashColorCategory.Pink
        }
        return CrashRecord(
            sessionId = sessionId,
            gameId = gameId,
            gameName = gameName,
            multiplier = mult,
            detectedColorHex = hex ?: cat.defaultHex,
            colorCategory = cat,
            isPixelColorVerified = hex != null,
            crashTimestamp = ts,
            hourStartTimestamp = CalendarHourUtils.hourStartFor(ts),
            sourcePackage = "com.android.chrome",
            roundIdentifier = roundId,
            dedupKey = "${sessionId}_${gameId}_$dedupSuffix"
        )
    }

    private fun detectionFrame(
        phase: String,
        liveMult: Double? = null,
        ribbon: List<Double> = emptyList(),
        roundId: String? = null,
        gameId: String = "aviator",
        gameName: String = "Aviator",
        platformName: String = "Chrome Web",
        expanded: Boolean = false,
        windowAccessStatus: MonitoringStatus = MonitoringStatus.MONITORING,
        liveLost: Boolean = false,
        nowMs: Long = 1_700_000_000_000L
    ): GameDetectionState {
        val items = ribbon.mapIndexed { idx, v ->
            com.example.data.engine.ExtractedHistoryItem(
                multiplier = v,
                orderIndex = idx,
                source = CollectionSource.VISIBLE_RIBBON,
                displayText = "${RibbonHistoryCollector.formatMultKey(v)}x"
            )
        }
        return GameDetectionState(
            isGameDetected = !liveLost && windowAccessStatus == MonitoringStatus.MONITORING,
            gameId = gameId,
            displayedGameName = gameName,
            platformName = platformName,
            isReady = !liveLost,
            gamePhase = phase,
            detectedMultiplier = liveMult,
            liveDetectionLost = liveLost,
            detectionConfidence = if (liveLost) 0f else 0.9f,
            detectedRoundId = roundId,
            roundId = roundId,
            foregroundPackage = "com.android.chrome",
            uiTargets = DetectedUiTargets(
                detectedMultiplier = liveMult,
                ribbonMultipliers = ribbon,
                ribbonItems = items,
                historyPanelExpanded = expanded,
                detectedCurrentRoundId = roundId,
                gamePhase = phase,
                isFlewAwayDetected = phase == "CRASHED"
            ),
            updatedAtMs = nowMs,
            windowAccessStatus = windowAccessStatus,
            gameWindowAccessible = windowAccessStatus == MonitoringStatus.MONITORING && !liveLost,
            gameWindowSuspended = liveLost || windowAccessStatus == MonitoringStatus.GAME_SUSPENDED
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun test01_confirmedCrashOnly_ignoresInFlightMultiplier() = runBlocking {
        val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default + SupervisorJob())
        val emissions = mutableListOf<ConfirmedCrashEmission>()
        try {
            val pipeline = LiveCrashPipeline(scope, debounceWindowMs = 40L) {
                emissions.add(it)
            }
            pipeline.configureSession("sess_t1")
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(detectionFrame("BETTING_OPEN", null, roundId = "R-1"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(detectionFrame("IN_FLIGHT", 1.15, roundId = "R-1"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(detectionFrame("IN_FLIGHT", 3.42, roundId = "R-1"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(detectionFrame("IN_FLIGHT", 5.88, roundId = "R-1"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            delay(80L)
            assertEquals("Live rising multipliers must NEVER be recorded", 0, emissions.size)
            assertEquals(RoundLifecycleState.MULTIPLIER_RISING, pipeline.lifecycleState.value)

            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(detectionFrame("CRASHED", 6.12, roundId = "R-1"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            delay(100L)
            assertEquals(1, emissions.size)
            assertEquals(6.12, emissions.first().multiplier, 0.001)
            assertTrue(emissions.first().crashRecord.isConfirmed)
        } finally {
            scope.cancel()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun test03_consecutiveEqualMultipliersAcrossDistinctRoundsRecorded() = runBlocking {
        val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default + SupervisorJob())
        val emissions = mutableListOf<ConfirmedCrashEmission>()
        try {
            val pipeline = LiveCrashPipeline(scope, debounceWindowMs = 20L) {
                emissions.add(it)
            }
            pipeline.configureSession("sess_t3")

            // Round 1 -> 2.10x
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(detectionFrame("IN_FLIGHT", 2.00, roundId = "R-101"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(detectionFrame("CRASHED", 2.10, roundId = "R-101"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.flushPendingNow()

            // Round 2 -> same 2.10x multiplier, distinct round
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(detectionFrame("BETTING_OPEN", null, roundId = "R-102"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(detectionFrame("IN_FLIGHT", 1.80, roundId = "R-102"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.onDetectionFrame(detectionFrame("CRASHED", 2.10, roundId = "R-102"), MonitoringStatus.MONITORING)
            pipeline.flushPendingNow()

            assertEquals(2, emissions.size)
            assertEquals(2.10, emissions[0].multiplier, 0.001)
            assertEquals(2.10, emissions[1].multiplier, 0.001)
            assertNotEquals(emissions[0].crashRecord.dedupKey, emissions[1].crashRecord.dedupKey)
        } finally {
            scope.cancel()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun test04_ribbonOpenRefreshReposition_zeroDuplicatesOrHistoricalImport() {
        val baseline = listOf(
            PersistedRibbonBaselineItem(2.45, "2.45x", "R-5", null, 0, 0, 0, 10, 10),
            PersistedRibbonBaselineItem(1.30, "1.30x", "R-4", null, 1, 10, 0, 20, 10),
            PersistedRibbonBaselineItem(8.90, "8.90x", "R-3", null, 2, 20, 0, 30, 10)
        )

        // Manual open / expand adding older tail items
        val expanded = listOf(2.45, 1.30, 8.90, 1.15, 4.50).mapIndexed { i, v ->
            com.example.data.engine.ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = v, roundId = "R-${5 - i}", orderIndex = i)
        }
        val expandResult = RibbonHistoryCollector.alignAuthoritativeLiveSnapshot(
            previousBaseline = baseline,
            currentItems = expanded,
            previousExpanded = false,
            currentExpanded = true,
            sawRoundCompletionTransition = false
        )
        assertTrue(expandResult.newCompletedItems.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(expandResult.isScrollOrExpandRejected)

        // Reverse scroll revealing older rounds at head
        val reverseScroll = listOf(1.30, 8.90, 1.15).mapIndexed { i, v ->
            com.example.data.engine.ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = v, roundId = "R-${4 - i}", orderIndex = i)
        }
        val reverseResult = RibbonHistoryCollector.alignAuthoritativeLiveSnapshot(
            previousBaseline = baseline,
            currentItems = reverseScroll,
            previousExpanded = false,
            currentExpanded = false,
            sawRoundCompletionTransition = false
        )
        assertTrue(reverseResult.newCompletedItems.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(reverseResult.isScrollOrExpandRejected)

        // Repeated identical frame (repositioned UI bounds)
        val sameItems = listOf(2.45, 1.30, 8.90).mapIndexed { i, v ->
            com.example.data.engine.ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = v, roundId = "R-${5 - i}", orderIndex = i, bounds = Rect(50 + i * 20, 100, 70 + i * 20, 120))
        }
        val unchangedResult = RibbonHistoryCollector.alignAuthoritativeLiveSnapshot(
            previousBaseline = baseline,
            currentItems = sameItems
        )
        assertTrue(unchangedResult.newCompletedItems.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(unchangedResult.isUnchanged)
    }

    }

    @Test
    fun test10_strategyA_aboveXThreeTimesThenBelowYTwoTimes_triggersAlarm() {
        val engine = PatternDetectionEngine()
        val strategy = CustomPatternStrategy(
            id = 10L,
            name = "3 Above 2x Then 2 Below 2x",
            strategyGroup = StrategyGroup.MULTIPLIER_INTERVAL,
            strategyMode = StrategyMode.STRATEGY_A_CONSECUTIVE_LOWS,
            multiplierRuleSubtype = MultiplierRuleSubtype.ABOVE_THEN_BELOW,
            aboveThresholdX = 2.00,
            aboveConsecutiveCount = 3,
            belowThresholdY = 2.00,
            belowConsecutiveCount = 2,
            inclusiveBounds = false
        )
        val t0 = 1_700_000_000_000L
        val partialRecords = listOf(2.50, 3.10, 4.00, 1.40).mapIndexed { idx, v ->
            crashRow(mult = v, ts = t0 + idx * 5_000L, roundId = "R-$idx", dedupSuffix = "r$idx")
        }
        val batch1 = engine.evaluateStrategiesOnCrashRecords(listOf(strategy), partialRecords, nowMs = t0 + 15_000L)
        assertTrue(batch1.events.any { it.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_APPROACHING })
        assertTrue(batch1.events.none { it.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED })

        val fullRecords = partialRecords + crashRow(mult = 1.85, ts = t0 + 20_000L, roundId = "R-4", dedupSuffix = "r4")
        val batch2 = engine.evaluateStrategiesOnCrashRecords(batch1.updatedStrategies, fullRecords, nowMs = t0 + 20_000L)
        assertEquals(1, batch2.events.count { it.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED })
        assertEquals("ABOVE_THEN_BELOW", batch2.newOccurrences.first().patternType)
    }

    @Test
    fun test11_inclusiveVsExclusiveBounds_andRangeConflictValidator() {
        val engine = PatternDetectionEngine()
        val exclusiveRule = CustomPatternStrategy(
            id = 11L,
            name = "Exclusive Low <2.00",
            strategyGroup = StrategyGroup.MULTIPLIER_INTERVAL,
            strategyMode = StrategyMode.STRATEGY_A_CONSECUTIVE_LOWS,
            multiplierRuleSubtype = MultiplierRuleSubtype.LOW_MULTIPLIER,
            inclusiveBounds = false
        ).withConditions(listOf(PatternCondition(PatternComparator.LESS_THAN, 2.00, consecutiveRounds = 2)))

        val inclusiveRule = CustomPatternStrategy(
            id = 12L,
            name = "Inclusive Low <=2.00",
            strategyGroup = StrategyGroup.MULTIPLIER_INTERVAL,
            strategyMode = StrategyMode.STRATEGY_A_CONSECUTIVE_LOWS,
            multiplierRuleSubtype = MultiplierRuleSubtype.LOW_MULTIPLIER,
            inclusiveBounds = true
        ).withConditions(listOf(PatternCondition(PatternComparator.LESS_OR_EQUAL, 2.00, consecutiveRounds = 2)))

        val recs = listOf(1.50, 2.00).mapIndexed { idx, v -> crashRow(mult = v, ts = 1_700_000_000_000L + idx * 5_000L, dedupSuffix = "b$idx") }
        val res = engine.evaluateStrategiesOnCrashRecords(listOf(exclusiveRule, inclusiveRule), recs, nowMs = 1_700_000_010_000L)
        assertEquals(0, res.events.count { it.strategy.id == 11L && it.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED })
        assertEquals(1, res.events.count { it.strategy.id == 12L && it.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED })

        // Range validation checks overlap & blocking error
        val conflicting = CustomPatternStrategy(
            id = 13L,
            name = "Overlap",
            strategyGroup = StrategyGroup.MULTIPLIER_INTERVAL,
            strategyMode = StrategyMode.CUSTOM_CONDITION
        ).withConditions(
            listOf(
                PatternCondition(PatternComparator.LESS_THAN, 5.0, consecutiveRounds = 1),
                PatternCondition(PatternComparator.GREATER_THAN, 3.0, consecutiveRounds = 1)
            )
        )
        val validation = StrategyRangeValidator.validate(conflicting, emptyList(), configuredLowThreshold = 10.0, configuredBigThreshold = 5.0)
        assertTrue(validation.warnings.isNotEmpty())
        val invalid = StrategyRangeValidator.validate(conflicting.copy(name = ""), emptyList())
        assertFalse(invalid.isValid)
    }

    @Test
    fun test15_strategyReordering_swapsSortOrderInRepository() = runBlocking {
        val (_, repo) = setupDbAndRepo()
        val id1 = repo.insertCustomStrategy(CustomPatternStrategy(name = "Rule Alpha", sortOrder = 0))
        val id2 = repo.insertCustomStrategy(CustomPatternStrategy(name = "Rule Beta", sortOrder = 1))
        val initial = repo.getCustomStrategiesOnce()
        assertEquals(listOf("Rule Alpha", "Rule Beta"), initial.map { it.name })

        repo.swapStrategyOrder(initial[0], initial[1])
        val swapped = repo.getCustomStrategiesOnce()
        assertEquals(listOf("Rule Beta", "Rule Alpha"), swapped.map { it.name })
        assertEquals(id2, swapped[0].id)
        assertEquals(id1, swapped[1].id)
    }
