    @Test
    fun test19_repeatingAlarmEngine_alertsEveryGenuineOccurrence_andRespectsRepeatLimit() = runBlocking {
        val (context, repo) = setupDbAndRepo()
        val fakeDispatcher = object : SystemNotificationDispatcher {
            override fun hasNotificationPermission(context: Context): Boolean = true
            override fun postSystemNotification(
                context: Context,
                notificationId: Int,
                title: String,
                message: String,
                priorityLevel: NotificationPriorityLevel,
                soundEnabled: Boolean,
                vibrationEnabled: Boolean,
                historyRecordId: Long
            ): Boolean = true
        }
        val mgr = StrategyNotificationManager(context, repo, fakeDispatcher)
        val strat = CustomPatternStrategy(id = 41L, name = "RepeatRule", repeatCooldownMinutes = 0, repeatLimit = 2)
        val settings = NotificationSettings(masterEnabled = true, alarmRepeatIntervalMinutes = 0)
        val t0 = 1_700_000_000_000L

        val d1 = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(PatternAlertEvent(strat, StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED, "Hit 1", "Msg 1", "k1", 1.2, "occ_1", t0), settings, t0)
        val dup = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(PatternAlertEvent(strat, StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED, "Hit 1", "Msg 1", "k1", 1.2, "occ_1", t0 + 1_000L), settings, t0 + 1_000L)
        val d2 = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(PatternAlertEvent(strat, StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED, "Hit 2", "Msg 2", "k2", 1.3, "occ_2", t0 + 5_000L), settings, t0 + 5_000L)
        val capped = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(PatternAlertEvent(strat, StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED, "Hit 3", "Msg 3", "k3", 1.1, "occ_3", t0 + 10_000L), settings, t0 + 10_000L)

        assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.DELIVERED, d1.deliveryStatus)
        assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_DUPLICATE, dup.deliveryStatus)
        assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.DELIVERED, d2.deliveryStatus)
        assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_COOLDOWN, capped.deliveryStatus)
    }

    @Test
    fun test20_oneStrategyDoesNotBlockAnotherStrategyAlert() = runBlocking {
        val (context, repo) = setupDbAndRepo()
        val fakeDispatcher = object : SystemNotificationDispatcher {
            override fun hasNotificationPermission(context: Context): Boolean = true
            override fun postSystemNotification(
                context: Context,
                notificationId: Int,
                title: String,
                message: String,
                priorityLevel: NotificationPriorityLevel,
                soundEnabled: Boolean,
                vibrationEnabled: Boolean,
                historyRecordId: Long
            ): Boolean = true
        }
        val mgr = StrategyNotificationManager(context, repo, fakeDispatcher)
        val strat1 = CustomPatternStrategy(id = 51L, name = "Strat One", repeatCooldownMinutes = 10)
        val strat2 = CustomPatternStrategy(id = 52L, name = "Strat Two", repeatCooldownMinutes = 0)
        val settings = NotificationSettings(masterEnabled = true, alarmRepeatIntervalMinutes = 0)
        val t0 = 1_700_000_000_000L

        val s1Hit1 = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(PatternAlertEvent(strat1, StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED, "S1", "M1", "k1", 1.2, "s1_occ1", t0), settings, t0)
        val s1Blocked = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(PatternAlertEvent(strat1, StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED, "S1", "M2", "k2", 1.3, "s1_occ2", t0 + 1_000L), settings, t0 + 1_000L)
        val s2Deliver = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(PatternAlertEvent(strat2, StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED, "S2", "M1", "k3", 12.0, "s2_occ1", t0 + 1_000L), settings, t0 + 1_000L)

        assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.DELIVERED, s1Hit1.deliveryStatus)
        assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_COOLDOWN, s1Blocked.deliveryStatus)
        assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.DELIVERED, s2Deliver.deliveryStatus)
    }

    @Test
    fun test21_roomMigration10To11_and_11To12_preserveExistingRows() {
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        val dbName = "migration_test_v10_v12.db"
        context.deleteDatabase(dbName)
        val helper = FrameworkSQLiteOpenHelperFactory().create(
            SupportSQLiteOpenHelper.Configuration.builder(context)
                .name(dbName)
                .callback(object : SupportSQLiteOpenHelper.Callback(10) {
                    override fun onCreate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
                        db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE crash_records (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, gameId TEXT NOT NULL, gameName TEXT NOT NULL, multiplier REAL NOT NULL, detectedColorHex TEXT NOT NULL, colorCategory TEXT NOT NULL, isPixelColorVerified INTEGER NOT NULL, crashTimestamp INTEGER NOT NULL, hourStartTimestamp INTEGER NOT NULL, sourcePackage TEXT NOT NULL, roundIdentifier TEXT, confidence REAL NOT NULL, manuallyCorrected INTEGER NOT NULL, collectionSource TEXT NOT NULL, dedupKey TEXT NOT NULL)")
                        db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE multiplier_records (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, gameId TEXT NOT NULL, roundId TEXT, multiplier REAL NOT NULL, gameTimestampMs INTEGER, observationTimestampMs INTEGER NOT NULL, crashTimestamp INTEGER NOT NULL, platform TEXT NOT NULL, timestampSource TEXT NOT NULL, collectionSource TEXT NOT NULL, collectionStatus TEXT NOT NULL, dedupKey TEXT NOT NULL, sequenceIndex INTEGER NOT NULL, hasGapBefore INTEGER NOT NULL)")
                        db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE notification_settings (id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, masterEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, approachingEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, reachedEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, invalidatedEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, historyUnavailableEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, pausedEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, hourlySummaryEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, gameDetectionEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, monitoringErrorsEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, soundEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, vibrationEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, repeatIntervalMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL, quietHoursEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, quietStartHour INTEGER NOT NULL, quietStartMinute INTEGER NOT NULL, quietEndHour INTEGER NOT NULL, quietEndMinute INTEGER NOT NULL)")
                        db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE notification_history (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, strategyId INTEGER NOT NULL, strategyName TEXT NOT NULL, notificationType TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL, triggeringRecordKey TEXT, triggeringMultiplier REAL, timestampMs INTEGER NOT NULL, deliveryStatus TEXT NOT NULL, interactionStatus TEXT NOT NULL, channelId TEXT NOT NULL)")
                        db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE custom_pattern_strategies (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, isEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, strategyMode TEXT NOT NULL, logicOperator TEXT NOT NULL, conditionsJson TEXT NOT NULL, waitingPeriodSeconds INTEGER NOT NULL, notificationLevel TEXT NOT NULL, approachingEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, customMessage TEXT NOT NULL, repeatPolicy TEXT NOT NULL, repeatCooldownMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL, notificationEnabled INTEGER NOT NULL, requiredOccurrencesPerHour INTEGER NOT NULL, analysisWindowMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL, minIntervalMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL, maxIntervalMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL, colorSequenceCsv TEXT NOT NULL, targetGameId TEXT NOT NULL, lastEvaluatedRecordKey TEXT, lastTriggeredOccurrenceKey TEXT, lastApproachedOccurrenceKey TEXT, lastNotifiedAtMs INTEGER NOT NULL, currentlyApproaching INTEGER NOT NULL, currentlyReached INTEGER NOT NULL, createdAtMs INTEGER NOT NULL)")

                        db.execSQL("INSERT INTO crash_records VALUES (1, 'aviator', 'Aviator', 4.55, '#8B5CF6', 'Purple', 0, 1700000000000, 1700000000000, 'com.android.chrome', 'R-10', 1.0, 0, 'LIVE_CRASH', 'legacy_key_1')")
                        db.execSQL("INSERT INTO custom_pattern_strategies (id, name, isEnabled, strategyMode, logicOperator, conditionsJson, waitingPeriodSeconds, notificationLevel, approachingEnabled, customMessage, repeatPolicy, repeatCooldownMinutes, notificationEnabled, requiredOccurrencesPerHour, analysisWindowMinutes, minIntervalMinutes, maxIntervalMinutes, colorSequenceCsv, targetGameId, lastEvaluatedRecordKey, lastTriggeredOccurrenceKey, lastApproachedOccurrenceKey, lastNotifiedAtMs, currentlyApproaching, currentlyReached, createdAtMs) VALUES (7, 'Legacy Rule', 1, 'CUSTOM_CONDITION', 'AND', '', 0, 'HIGH', 1, '', 'ONCE_PER_OCCURRENCE', 0, 1, 2, 60, 5, 15, '', 'ALL', NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 1700000000000)")
                    }
                    override fun onUpgrade(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase, oldVersion: Int, newVersion: Int) {}
                })
                .build()
        )
        val sqlite = helper.writableDatabase
        ScreenEarnerDatabase.MIGRATION_10_11.migrate(sqlite)
        ScreenEarnerDatabase.MIGRATION_11_12.migrate(sqlite)

        sqlite.query("SELECT multiplier, isConfirmed, sessionId FROM crash_records WHERE id = 1").use { c ->
            assertTrue(c.moveToFirst())
            assertEquals(4.55, c.getDouble(0), 0.001)
            assertEquals(1, c.getInt(1))
            assertEquals("", c.getString(2))
        }
        sqlite.query("SELECT name, strategyGroup, repeatLimit, sortOrder FROM custom_pattern_strategies WHERE id = 7").use { c ->
            assertTrue(c.moveToFirst())
            assertEquals("Legacy Rule", c.getString(0))
            assertEquals("MULTIPLIER_INTERVAL", c.getString(1))
            assertEquals(0, c.getInt(2))
            assertEquals(0, c.getInt(3))
        }
        sqlite.query("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('alarm_profiles', 'monitoring_sessions')").use { c ->
            assertEquals(2, c.count)
        }
        helper.close()
        context.deleteDatabase(dbName)
    }

    @Test
    fun test23_hourlyAnalysisEngine_supportsAllTimeRangePresets() {
        val now = 1_700_000_000_000L
        val records = listOf(
            crashRow(mult = 1.20, ts = now - 30 * 60_000L, dedupSuffix = "t1"),       // 30m ago
            crashRow(mult = 3.40, ts = now - 2 * 3_600_000L, dedupSuffix = "t2"),    // 2h ago
            crashRow(mult = 12.00, ts = now - 5 * 3_600_000L, dedupSuffix = "t3"),   // 5h ago
            crashRow(mult = 1.80, ts = now - 10 * 3_600_000L, dedupSuffix = "t4"),   // 10h ago
            crashRow(mult = 5.00, ts = now - 20 * 3_600_000L, dedupSuffix = "t5")    // 20h ago
        )
        assertEquals(1, HourlyAnalysisEngine.analyzeTimeRange(HourlyAnalysisEngine.TimeRangePreset.ONE_HOUR, records, nowMs = now).totalRounds)
        assertEquals(2, HourlyAnalysisEngine.analyzeTimeRange(HourlyAnalysisEngine.TimeRangePreset.THREE_HOURS, records, nowMs = now).totalRounds)
        assertEquals(3, HourlyAnalysisEngine.analyzeTimeRange(HourlyAnalysisEngine.TimeRangePreset.SIX_HOURS, records, nowMs = now).totalRounds)
        assertEquals(4, HourlyAnalysisEngine.analyzeTimeRange(HourlyAnalysisEngine.TimeRangePreset.TWELVE_HOURS, records, nowMs = now).totalRounds)
        assertEquals(5, HourlyAnalysisEngine.analyzeTimeRange(HourlyAnalysisEngine.TimeRangePreset.TWENTY_FOUR_HOURS, records, nowMs = now).totalRounds)

        val custom = HourlyAnalysisEngine.analyzeTimeRange(
            preset = HourlyAnalysisEngine.TimeRangePreset.CUSTOM,
            records = records,
            customStartMs = now - 6 * 3_600_000L,
            customEndMs = now - 3_600_000L,
            nowMs = now
        )
        assertEquals(2, custom.totalRounds)
    }

    @Test
    fun test24_clearHistoryByScope_currentArchivedAndAll() = runBlocking {
        val (_, repo) = setupDbAndRepo()
        val start = AutomationController.startMonitoringSession(isAccessibilityConnected = true, nowMs = 1_700_000_000_000L)
        assertTrue(start.started)
        val activeSid = AutomationController.activeSessionId.value

        repo.insertCrashRecord(crashRow(gameId = "aviator", sessionId = activeSid, mult = 1.80, ts = 1_700_000_001_000L, dedupSuffix = "act1"))
        repo.insertCrashRecord(crashRow(gameId = "aviator", sessionId = "archived_s", mult = 4.50, ts = 1_699_000_000_000L, dedupSuffix = "arcAv"))
        repo.insertCrashRecord(crashRow(gameId = "jetx", sessionId = "archived_s", mult = 9.20, ts = 1_699_000_005_000L, dedupSuffix = "arcJx"))

        assertEquals(1, AutomationController.countClearScopeRecords(ClearHistoryScope.CURRENT_SESSION, "aviator"))
        assertEquals(1, AutomationController.countClearScopeRecords(ClearHistoryScope.SELECTED_GAME_ARCHIVED, "aviator"))
        assertEquals(3, AutomationController.countClearScopeRecords(ClearHistoryScope.ALL_HISTORY, "ALL"))

        // Clear archived records ONLY for aviator
        AutomationController.clearHistoryByScope(ClearHistoryScope.SELECTED_GAME_ARCHIVED, "aviator")
        assertEquals(1, repo.getCrashRecordsForSessionOnce(activeSid).size)
        assertEquals(1, repo.getCrashRecordsSinceAsc(0L, "jetx").size)
        assertEquals(0, AutomationController.countClearScopeRecords(ClearHistoryScope.SELECTED_GAME_ARCHIVED, "aviator"))

        // Clear current session only -> jetx archived stays
        AutomationController.clearHistoryByScope(ClearHistoryScope.CURRENT_SESSION, "aviator")
        assertEquals(0, repo.getCrashRecordsForSessionOnce(activeSid).size)
        assertEquals(1, repo.getCrashRecordsSinceAsc(0L, "jetx").size)

        // Clear ALL
        AutomationController.clearHistoryByScope(ClearHistoryScope.ALL_HISTORY, "ALL")
        assertEquals(0, AutomationController.countClearScopeRecords(ClearHistoryScope.ALL_HISTORY, "ALL"))
    }

    }

    @Test
    fun `Save and Close in ViewModel returns to previousTab or Home without exiting app`() {

        val vm = ScreenEarnerViewModel(app)

        // Open Strategy editor from Logs tab -> closing editor must return to Logs tab
        vm.selectTab(MainActivity.TAB_LOGS)
        vm.selectTab(MainActivity.TAB_STRATEGY)
        assertEquals(MainActivity.TAB_STRATEGY, vm.selectedTab.value)

    }

    @Test

        var saveCount = 0
        composeRule.setContent {
            ScreenEarnerTheme {
                StrategyScreen(
                    currentConfig = StrategyConfig(),
                    customStrategies = emptyList(),
                    onSaveConfig = { saveCount++ }
                )
            }
        }

        // Empty state card renders with zero hardcoded strategies
        composeRule.onNodeWithTag("custom_strategies_empty_state").assertIsDisplayed()

    // =========================================================================
    // SECTION 14: Complete Game Ribbon History Collection & Strict Deduplication
    // =========================================================================

    @Test
    fun `RibbonHistoryCollector preserves duplicate multipliers across distinct rounds and ignores unchanged snapshot`() {
        val collector = RibbonHistoryCollector()
        val t0 = 1_700_000_000_000L

        // Snapshot 1: [1.50x, 2.20x, 1.50x] -> preserves both distinct 1.50x rounds
        val firstSync = collector.processVisibleRibbonSnapshot(
            items = listOf(
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 1.50, orderIndex = 0),
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 2.20, orderIndex = 1),
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 1.50, orderIndex = 2)
            ),
            platformName = "BetPawa Aviator",
            isPanelExpanded = false,
            hasExpandableControl = true,
            nowMs = t0
        )
        assertEquals(3, firstSync.newRecordsToPersist.size)
        assertEquals(listOf(1.50, 2.20, 1.50), firstSync.newRecordsToPersist.map { it.multiplier })
        assertTrue(firstSync.newRecordsToPersist.all { it.timestampSource == TimestampSource.LOCAL_OBSERVATION })
        assertEquals(3, firstSync.newRecordsToPersist.map { it.dedupKey }.toSet().size)

        // Exact repeated snapshot -> 0 new records persisted
        val repeatSync = collector.processVisibleRibbonSnapshot(
            items = listOf(
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 1.50, orderIndex = 0),
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 2.20, orderIndex = 1),
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 1.50, orderIndex = 2)
            ),
            platformName = "BetPawa Aviator",
            isPanelExpanded = false,
            hasExpandableControl = true,
            nowMs = t0 + 1_000L
        )
        assertTrue(repeatSync.isRepeatedSnapshot)
        assertEquals(0, repeatSync.newRecordsToPersist.size)

        // Snapshot shifts right because ANOTHER 1.50x crashed! Must capture the new head 1.50x
        val shiftedSync = collector.processVisibleRibbonSnapshot(
            items = listOf(
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 1.50, orderIndex = 0),
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 1.50, orderIndex = 1),
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 2.20, orderIndex = 2),
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 1.50, orderIndex = 3)
            ),
            platformName = "BetPawa Aviator",
            isPanelExpanded = false,
            hasExpandableControl = true,
            nowMs = t0 + 10_000L
        )
        assertFalse(shiftedSync.isRepeatedSnapshot)
        assertEquals(listOf(1.50), shiftedSync.newRecordsToPersist.map { it.multiplier })
    }

    @Test
    fun `RibbonHistoryCollector marks GAME_PROVIDED only when actual game timestamp exists and marks disjoint gaps`() {
        val collector = RibbonHistoryCollector()
        val t0 = 1_700_000_000_000L

        val initial = collector.processVisibleRibbonSnapshot(
            items = listOf(
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 3.10, gameTimestampMs = t0 - 15_000L, roundId = "r101", orderIndex = 0),
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 1.25, gameTimestampMs = null, roundId = "r100", orderIndex = 1)
            ),
            platformName = "SportyBet Aviator",
            isPanelExpanded = true,
            hasExpandableControl = false,
            nowMs = t0
        )
        assertEquals(TimestampSource.GAME_PROVIDED, initial.newRecordsToPersist[0].timestampSource)
        assertEquals(TimestampSource.LOCAL_OBSERVATION, initial.newRecordsToPersist[1].timestampSource)

        // Completely disjoint ribbon refresh marks hasGapBefore = true cleanly without inventing skipped rounds
        val disjoint = collector.processVisibleRibbonSnapshot(
            items = listOf(
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 9.80, roundId = "r205", orderIndex = 0),
                ExtractedHistoryItem(multiplier = 4.40, roundId = "r204", orderIndex = 1)
            ),
            platformName = "SportyBet Aviator",
            isPanelExpanded = true,
            hasExpandableControl = false,
            nowMs = t0 + 120_000L
        )
        assertEquals(2, disjoint.newRecordsToPersist.size)
        assertTrue(disjoint.newRecordsToPersist.last().hasGapBefore)
        assertFalse(disjoint.newRecordsToPersist.first().hasGapBefore)
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // SECTION 15 & 18: User-Defined Pattern Engine Sample Sequence Test
    // =========================================================================

    @Test
    fun `pattern engine triggers approaching at 7 of 8, reached at 8 of 8, deduplicates, and invalidates on 2_45x break`() {
        val engine = PatternDetectionEngine()
        val baseTime = 1_700_000_000_000L

        // Sample rule from Section 18: "8 consecutive < 2.00x"
        val strategy = CustomPatternStrategy(
            id = 10L,
            name = "8 Consecutive Under 2x",
            isEnabled = true,
            logicOperator = PatternLogicOperator.AND,
            approachingEnabled = true,
            notificationLevel = NotificationPriorityLevel.URGENT,
            repeatPolicy = RepeatNotificationPolicy.ONCE_PER_OCCURRENCE
        ).withConditions(
            listOf(
                PatternCondition(
                    comparator = PatternComparator.LESS_THAN,
                    threshold = 2.00,
                    consecutiveRounds = 8
                )
            )
        )

        val sampleMultipliers = listOf(1.22, 1.55, 1.31, 1.80, 1.10, 1.45, 1.72, 1.90)
        val records = sampleMultipliers.mapIndexed { idx, mult ->
            MultiplierRecord(
                id = idx.toLong() + 1L,
                multiplier = mult,
                crashTimestamp = baseTime + idx * 10_000L,
                dedupKey = "sample_round_$idx",
                sequenceIndex = idx
            )
        }

        // Feed rounds 1..6 -> no approaching, no reached yet
        val batchAfter6 = engine.evaluateAllStrategies(listOf(strategy), records.take(6), nowMs = baseTime + 60_000L)
        assertTrue("Rounds 1..6 should emit zero events", batchAfter6.events.isEmpty())

        // Feed round 7 (1.72x) -> emits STRATEGY_APPROACHING ("7 of 8")
        val batchAfter7 = engine.evaluateAllStrategies(batchAfter6.updatedStrategies, records.take(7), nowMs = baseTime + 70_000L)
        assertEquals(1, batchAfter7.events.size)
        assertEquals(StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_APPROACHING, batchAfter7.events.first().notificationType)
        assertTrue(batchAfter7.events.first().message.contains("7 of 8"))
        assertFalse(batchAfter7.events.first().message.contains("guaranteed", ignoreCase = true))

        // Feed round 8 (1.90x) -> emits STRATEGY_REACHED with neutral non-predictive wording
        val batchAfter8 = engine.evaluateAllStrategies(batchAfter7.updatedStrategies, records.take(8), nowMs = baseTime + 80_000L)
        assertEquals(1, batchAfter8.events.size)
        val reachedEvent = batchAfter8.events.first()
        assertEquals(StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED, reachedEvent.notificationType)
        assertTrue(reachedEvent.message.startsWith("PATTERN DETECTED:"))
        assertEquals(1.90, reachedEvent.triggeringMultiplier!!, 0.001)

        // Re-evaluating identical 8 records must produce 0 duplicate notifications
        val duplicateCheck = engine.evaluateAllStrategies(batchAfter8.updatedStrategies, records.take(8), nowMs = baseTime + 85_000L)
        assertTrue("Re-evaluation must not double-count or resend", duplicateCheck.events.isEmpty())

        // Round 9 breaks streak at 2.45x -> emits STRATEGY_INVALIDATED and resets active/approaching state
        val breakingRecord = MultiplierRecord(
            id = 9L,
            multiplier = 2.45,
            crashTimestamp = baseTime + 90_000L,
            dedupKey = "sample_round_8",
            sequenceIndex = 8
        )
        val batchAfterBreak = engine.evaluateAllStrategies(
            duplicateCheck.updatedStrategies,
            records + breakingRecord,
            nowMs = baseTime + 90_000L
        )
        assertEquals(1, batchAfterBreak.events.size)
        assertEquals(StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_INVALIDATED, batchAfterBreak.events.first().notificationType)
        assertFalse(batchAfterBreak.updatedStrategies.first().currentlyReached)
        assertFalse(batchAfterBreak.updatedStrategies.first().currentlyApproaching)
    }

    @Test
    fun `pattern engine supports OR logic, BETWEEN range, time window, and exact sequence`() {
        val engine = PatternDetectionEngine()
        val now = 1_700_000_600_000L

        val seqStrategy = CustomPatternStrategy(
            id = 21L,
            name = "Exact Low Pair OR Between High",
            isEnabled = true,
            logicOperator = PatternLogicOperator.OR,
            approachingEnabled = false
        ).withConditions(
            listOf(
                PatternCondition(sequenceMultipliers = listOf(1.20, 1.50)),
                PatternCondition(
                    comparator = PatternComparator.BETWEEN,
                    threshold = 50.0,
                    upperThreshold = 100.0,
                    consecutiveRounds = 1,
                    timeWindowMinutes = 5
                )
            )
        )

        val records = listOf(
            MultiplierRecord(multiplier = 1.20, crashTimestamp = now - 60_000L, dedupKey = "seq_0"),
            MultiplierRecord(multiplier = 1.50, crashTimestamp = now - 30_000L, dedupKey = "seq_1")
        )
        val batch = engine.evaluateAllStrategies(listOf(seqStrategy), records, nowMs = now)
        assertEquals(1, batch.events.size)
        assertEquals(StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED, batch.events.first().notificationType)
    }

    @Test
    fun `notification manager enforces master, type, strategy, cooldown, quiet hours, permission, and logs delivery`() = runTest {
        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
        val db = Room.inMemoryDatabaseBuilder(context, ScreenEarnerDatabase::class.java)
            .allowMainThreadQueries()
            .build()
        try {
            val repo = ScreenEarnerRepository(db.dao())
            val strat = CustomPatternStrategy(
                id = 55L,
                name = "Test Strategy",
                isEnabled = true,
                notificationEnabled = true,
                repeatCooldownMinutes = 5
            ).withConditions(listOf(PatternCondition(PatternComparator.LESS_THAN, 2.0, consecutiveRounds = 2)))
            repo.insertCustomStrategy(strat)

            val engine = PatternDetectionEngine()
            val now = 1_700_002_000_000L
            val recs = listOf(
                MultiplierRecord(multiplier = 1.20, crashTimestamp = now - 20_000L, dedupKey = "n_1"),
                MultiplierRecord(multiplier = 1.30, crashTimestamp = now - 10_000L, dedupKey = "n_2")
            )
            val batch = engine.evaluateAllStrategies(listOf(strat), recs, nowMs = now)
            assertTrue(batch.events.any { it.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_APPROACHING })
            val event = batch.events.first { it.notificationType == StrategyNotificationType.STRATEGY_REACHED }

            val fakeGrantedDispatcher = object : SystemNotificationDispatcher {
                var postedCount = 0
                override fun hasNotificationPermission(context: Context): Boolean = true
                override fun postSystemNotification(
                    context: Context,
                    notificationId: Int,
                    title: String,
                    message: String,
                    priorityLevel: NotificationPriorityLevel,
                    soundEnabled: Boolean,
                    vibrationEnabled: Boolean,
                    historyRecordId: Long
                ): Boolean {
                    postedCount++
                    return true
                }
            }

            val mgr = StrategyNotificationManager(context, repo, fakeGrantedDispatcher)

            // 1. Master off -> suppressed
            val rMasterOff = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(event, NotificationSettings(masterEnabled = false), now)
            assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_MASTER_OFF, rMasterOff.deliveryStatus)
            assertEquals(0, fakeGrantedDispatcher.postedCount)

            // 2. Type off -> suppressed
            val rTypeOff = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(event, NotificationSettings(reachedEnabled = false), now)
            assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_TYPE_OFF, rTypeOff.deliveryStatus)

            // 3. Per-strategy off -> suppressed
            val stratOffEvent = event.copy(strategy = strat.copy(notificationEnabled = false))
            val rStratOff = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(stratOffEvent, NotificationSettings(), now)
            assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_STRATEGY_OFF, rStratOff.deliveryStatus)

            // 4. Quiet hours (all day 00:00 -> 23:59 around now) -> suppressed
            val rQuiet = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(
                event,
                NotificationSettings(quietHoursEnabled = true, quietStartHour = 0, quietStartMinute = 0, quietEndHour = 23, quietEndMinute = 59),
                now
            )
            assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_QUIET_HOURS, rQuiet.deliveryStatus)

            // 5. Permission denied -> logged as PERMISSION_DENIED
            val deniedMgr = StrategyNotificationManager(
                context,
                repo,
                object : SystemNotificationDispatcher {
                    override fun hasNotificationPermission(context: Context): Boolean = false
                    override fun postSystemNotification(
                        context: Context,
                        notificationId: Int,
                        title: String,
                        message: String,
                        priorityLevel: NotificationPriorityLevel,
                        soundEnabled: Boolean,
                        vibrationEnabled: Boolean,
                        historyRecordId: Long
                    ): Boolean = false
                }
            )
            val rDenied = deniedMgr.dispatchPatternAlert(event, NotificationSettings(), now)
            assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.PERMISSION_DENIED, rDenied.deliveryStatus)

            // 6. Valid + granted -> DELIVERED + second occurrence inside cooldown -> SUPPRESSED_COOLDOWN
            val rDelivered = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(event, NotificationSettings(repeatIntervalMinutes = 10), now)
            assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.DELIVERED, rDelivered.deliveryStatus)
            assertEquals(1, fakeGrantedDispatcher.postedCount)

            val newOccurrenceInsideCooldown = event.copy(occurrenceKey = "different_occ_inside_cooldown")
            val rCooldown = mgr.dispatchPatternAlert(
                newOccurrenceInsideCooldown,
                NotificationSettings(repeatIntervalMinutes = 10),
                now + 60_000L
            )
            assertEquals(NotificationDeliveryStatus.SUPPRESSED_COOLDOWN, rCooldown.deliveryStatus)

            // 7. Marking opened updates interactionStatus
            repo.updateNotificationInteraction(rDelivered.id, NotificationInteractionStatus.OPENED_BY_USER)
            val savedHistory = repo.notificationHistory.first()
            val openedItem = savedHistory.firstOrNull { it.id == rDelivered.id }
            assertNotNull(openedItem)
            assertEquals(NotificationInteractionStatus.OPENED_BY_USER, openedItem!!.interactionStatus)

            // 8. Real AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher posts onto Android NotificationManager when permitted
            val nm = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
            val posted = AndroidSystemNotificationDispatcher.postSystemNotification(
                context = context,
                notificationId = 9001,
                title = "Pattern Detected: Test",
                message = "PATTERN DETECTED: 8 of 8",
                priorityLevel = NotificationPriorityLevel.HIGH,
                soundEnabled = true,
                vibrationEnabled = true,
                historyRecordId = rDelivered.id
            )
            assertTrue(posted)
            val shadowNm = Shadows.shadowOf(nm)
            assertTrue(shadowNm.allNotifications.any { it.extras.getString("android.title")?.contains("Pattern Detected") == true })
        } finally {
            db.close()
        }
    }
}

class StrategyAndAnalyticsTest {

    private fun configWithSingleRule(
        ruleId: StrategyRuleId,
        mode: StakeProgressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.DOUBLE_AMOUNT,
        customAdd: Double = 10.0,
        baseStake: Double = 10.0,
        targetMultiplier: Double = 2.00
    ): StrategyConfig {
        val disabledAll = StrategyRuleId.entries.map {
            StrategyRuleConfig(
                ruleId = it,
                isEnabled = (it == ruleId),
                progressionMode = if (it == ruleId) mode else StakeProgressionMode.DISABLED,
                customAddAmount = if (it == ruleId) customAdd else 10.0,
                targetWinsToFetch = 2
            )
        }
        return StrategyConfig(
            isStrategy1Enabled = false,
            isStrategy2Enabled = false,
            isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = false,
            lossProgressionEnabled = mode != StakeProgressionMode.DISABLED,
            lossProgressionMode = mode,
            lossProgressionAddAmount = customAdd,
            baseStake = baseStake,
            targetMultiplier = targetMultiplier,
            isAutoBetEnabled = true,
            isAutoCashOutEnabled = true
        ).withUpdatedRuleConfigs(disabledAll)
    }

    @Test
    fun `loss recovery rules trigger at exact thresholds 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 14 and reset after 2 verified wins`() {
        val lossRules = listOf(
            StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES to 2,
            StrategyRuleId.AFTER_3_LOSSES to 3,
            StrategyRuleId.AFTER_5_LOSSES to 5,
            StrategyRuleId.AFTER_7_LOSSES to 7,
            StrategyRuleId.AFTER_9_LOSSES to 9,
            StrategyRuleId.AFTER_14_LOSSES to 14
        )

        for ((ruleId, threshold) in lossRules) {
            val engine = StrategyEngine()
            val config = configWithSingleRule(ruleId, baseStake = 20.0)
            engine.reset(config.baseStake)

            for (i in 1 until threshold) {
                val trigger = engine.processCompletedRound(1.35, config, currentTimeMs = i * 10_000L)
                assertTrue("Rule $ruleId triggered too early at $i losses", trigger is StrategyTrigger.None)
                assertFalse(engine.getState().isBettingSessionActive)
            }

            val fired = engine.processCompletedRound(1.50, config, currentTimeMs = threshold * 10_000L)
            assertTrue("Expected LossRecoveryFired for $ruleId", fired is StrategyTrigger.LossRecoveryFired)
            assertTrue(engine.getState().isBettingSessionActive)
            assertEquals(20.0, engine.getState().currentCalculatedStake, 0.001)

            val afterWin1 = engine.processBetOutcome(isWin = true, multiplier = 2.10, config = config)
            assertTrue(afterWin1.isBettingSessionActive)
            assertEquals(1, afterWin1.consecutiveWinsInSession)

            val afterWin2 = engine.processBetOutcome(isWin = true, multiplier = 2.40, config = config)
            assertFalse(afterWin2.isBettingSessionActive)
            assertEquals(0, afterWin2.consecutiveWinsInSession)
            assertEquals(20.0, afterWin2.currentCalculatedStake, 0.001)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `progression Option A adds custom amount and Option B doubles stake on loss`() {
        val addEngine = StrategyEngine()
        val addConfig = configWithSingleRule(
            ruleId = StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES,
            mode = StakeProgressionMode.ADD_AMOUNT,
            customAdd = 15.0,
            baseStake = 10.0
        )
        addEngine.reset(10.0)
        addEngine.processCompletedRound(1.10, addConfig)
        addEngine.processCompletedRound(1.20, addConfig)
        assertEquals(10.0, addEngine.getState().currentCalculatedStake, 0.001)

        addEngine.processBetOutcome(isWin = false, multiplier = 1.40, config = addConfig)
        assertEquals(25.0, addEngine.getState().currentCalculatedStake, 0.001)
        addEngine.processBetOutcome(isWin = false, multiplier = 1.50, config = addConfig)
        assertEquals(40.0, addEngine.getState().currentCalculatedStake, 0.001)

        val doubleEngine = StrategyEngine()
        val doubleConfig = configWithSingleRule(
            ruleId = StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES,
            mode = StakeProgressionMode.DOUBLE_AMOUNT,
            baseStake = 10.0
        )
        doubleEngine.reset(10.0)
        doubleEngine.processCompletedRound(1.10, doubleConfig)
        doubleEngine.processCompletedRound(1.20, doubleConfig)
        doubleEngine.processBetOutcome(isWin = false, multiplier = 1.40, config = doubleConfig)
        assertEquals(20.0, doubleEngine.getState().currentCalculatedStake, 0.001)
        doubleEngine.processBetOutcome(isWin = false, multiplier = 1.50, config = doubleConfig)
        assertEquals(40.0, doubleEngine.getState().currentCalculatedStake, 0.001)
    }

    @Test
    fun `multiplier range waiting rules enforce 10m and 5m delays before fetching 2 wins`() {
        val baseTime = 1_700_000_000_000L

        val engine10 = StrategyEngine()
        val config10 = configWithSingleRule(StrategyRuleId.RANGE_10_TO_100_WAIT_10M, baseStake = 25.0)
        engine10.reset(25.0)

        val trigger10 = engine10.processCompletedRound(45.50, config10, currentTimeMs = baseTime)
        assertTrue(trigger10 is StrategyTrigger.RangeWaitStarted)
        assertFalse(engine10.getState().isBettingSessionActive)
        assertEquals(600_000L, engine10.getState().activeWaitRemainingMs)

        val beforeElapsed = engine10.checkPendingTimers(config10, currentTimeMs = baseTime + 599_000L)
        assertTrue(beforeElapsed is StrategyTrigger.None)
        assertFalse(engine10.getState().isBettingSessionActive)

        val afterElapsed = engine10.checkPendingTimers(config10, currentTimeMs = baseTime + 600_000L)
        assertTrue(afterElapsed is StrategyTrigger.WaitTimerCompleted)
        assertTrue(engine10.getState().isBettingSessionActive)
        assertEquals(2, engine10.getState().targetWinsToFetch)

        val engine100 = StrategyEngine()
        val config100 = configWithSingleRule(StrategyRuleId.RANGE_100_TO_1000_WAIT_5M, baseStake = 30.0)
        engine100.reset(30.0)

        val trigger100 = engine100.processCompletedRound(240.00, config100, currentTimeMs = baseTime)
        assertTrue(trigger100 is StrategyTrigger.RangeWaitStarted)
        assertEquals(300_000L, engine100.getState().activeWaitRemainingMs)

        val completed100 = engine100.checkPendingTimers(config100, currentTimeMs = baseTime + 300_000L)
        assertTrue(completed100 is StrategyTrigger.WaitTimerCompleted)
        assertTrue(engine100.getState().isBettingSessionActive)
    }

    @Test
    fun `exclusive strategy lock prevents overlap and 3 minute timeout guard resets cycle cleanly`() {
        val t0 = 1_700_000_000_000L
        val engine = StrategyEngine()
        val config = StrategyConfig(
            isStrategy1Enabled = false,
            isStrategy2Enabled = false,
            isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = false,
            lossProgressionEnabled = true,
            lossProgressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.DOUBLE_AMOUNT,
            baseStake = 15.0,
            sessionTimeoutMinutes = 3
        ).withUpdatedRuleConfigs(
            listOf(
                StrategyRuleConfig(
                    ruleId = StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES,
                    isEnabled = true
                ),
                StrategyRuleConfig(
                    ruleId = StrategyRuleId.RANGE_10_TO_100_WAIT_10M,
                    isEnabled = true
                )
            )
        )
        engine.reset(15.0)

        // Trigger AFTER_2_LOSSES at t0 + 10s
        engine.processCompletedRound(1.20, config, currentTimeMs = t0)
        val fired = engine.processCompletedRound(1.30, config, currentTimeMs = t0 + 10_000L)
        assertTrue(fired is StrategyTrigger.LossRecoveryFired)
        assertTrue(engine.getState().isBettingSessionActive)
        assertEquals(StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES, engine.getState().activeRuleId)

        // While active, a 45.00x round must NOT start RANGE_10_TO_100_WAIT_10M or override lock
        val blockedTrigger = engine.processCompletedRound(45.00, config, currentTimeMs = t0 + 30_000L)
        assertTrue(blockedTrigger is StrategyTrigger.None)
        assertTrue(engine.getState().isBettingSessionActive)
        assertNull(engine.getState().pendingWaitRuleId)
        assertEquals(StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES, engine.getState().activeRuleId)

        // Simulate 1 loss inside active session so stake progressed to 30.0
        engine.processBetOutcome(isWin = false, multiplier = 1.50, config = config, currentTimeMs = t0 + 40_000L)
        assertEquals(30.0, engine.getState().currentCalculatedStake, 0.001)

        // At 2m59s (179s after session started at t0 + 10s), still active
        val stillActive = engine.checkPendingTimers(config, currentTimeMs = t0 + 10_000L + 179_000L)
        assertTrue(stillActive is StrategyTrigger.None)
        assertTrue(engine.getState().isBettingSessionActive)

        // At 3m00s (180s), 3-minute timeout guard cancels active cycle and resets state cleanly
        val timedOut = engine.checkPendingTimers(config, currentTimeMs = t0 + 10_000L + 180_000L)
        assertTrue(timedOut is StrategyTrigger.SessionTimedOut)
        assertFalse(engine.getState().isBettingSessionActive)
        assertNull(engine.getState().activeRuleId)
        assertEquals(15.0, engine.getState().currentCalculatedStake, 0.001)
        assertEquals(0, engine.getState().consecutiveObservedLosses)
    }

    @Test
    fun `editable rule thresholds and wait durations persist and control triggering`() {
        val baseTime = 1_700_000_000_000L
        val customConfig = StrategyConfig(
            isStrategy1Enabled = false,
            isStrategy2Enabled = false,
            isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = false,
            baseStake = 10.0,
            sessionTimeoutMinutes = 4
        ).withUpdatedRule(
            StrategyRuleConfig(
                ruleId = StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES,
                isEnabled = true,
                progressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.ADD_AMOUNT,
                customAddAmount = 25.0,
                targetWinsToFetch = 3,
                requiredLosses = 4
            )
        ).withUpdatedRule(
            StrategyRuleConfig(
                ruleId = StrategyRuleId.RANGE_10_TO_100_WAIT_10M,
                isEnabled = true,
                waitMinutes = 7,
                minMultiplier = 15.0,
                maxMultiplier = 80.0,
                targetWinsToFetch = 2
            )
        )

        val reparsedLoss = customConfig.getRuleConfig(StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES)
        assertEquals(4, reparsedLoss.requiredLosses)
        assertEquals(3, reparsedLoss.targetWinsToFetch)
        assertEquals(25.0, reparsedLoss.customAddAmount, 0.001)

        val reparsedRange = customConfig.getRuleConfig(StrategyRuleId.RANGE_10_TO_100_WAIT_10M)
        assertEquals(7, reparsedRange.waitMinutes)
        assertEquals(15.0, reparsedRange.minMultiplier, 0.001)
        assertEquals(80.0, reparsedRange.maxMultiplier, 0.001)

        // Verify engine respects edited waitMinutes = 7m and minMultiplier = 15x
        val engine = StrategyEngine()
        engine.reset(10.0)
        // 12x is below edited 15x minMultiplier, so range rule must NOT trigger!
        val belowEditedRange = engine.processCompletedRound(12.00, customConfig, baseTime)
        assertTrue(belowEditedRange is StrategyTrigger.None)

        // 25x is inside edited 15x-80x range, triggers 7m wait (420,000 ms)
        val inEditedRange = engine.processCompletedRound(25.00, customConfig, baseTime + 5_000L)
        assertTrue(inEditedRange is StrategyTrigger.RangeWaitStarted)
        assertEquals(420_000L, engine.getState().activeWaitRemainingMs)
    }

    @Test
    fun `multiplier history analyzer computes 30m 1h 3h 5h windows and 1h spotlight accurately`() {
        val now = 1_700_000_000_000L
        val min = 60_000L

        val records = listOf(
            MultiplierRecord(id = 1, multiplier = 1.45, crashTimestamp = now - 10 * min),
            MultiplierRecord(id = 2, multiplier = 62.50, crashTimestamp = now - 25 * min),
            MultiplierRecord(id = 3, multiplier = 148.20, crashTimestamp = now - 45 * min),
            MultiplierRecord(id = 4, multiplier = 1.12, crashTimestamp = now - 120 * min),
            MultiplierRecord(id = 5, multiplier = 520.00, crashTimestamp = now - 240 * min),
            MultiplierRecord(id = 6, multiplier = 999.00, crashTimestamp = now - 360 * min)
        )

        val stats30m = MultiplierHistoryAnalyzer.analyzeWindow(records, TimeWindowFilter.THIRTY_MINUTES, now)
        assertEquals(2, stats30m.totalRounds)
        assertEquals(1, stats30m.below2xCount)
        assertEquals(1, stats30m.above50xCount)
        assertEquals(0, stats30m.above100xCount)

        val stats1h = MultiplierHistoryAnalyzer.analyzeWindow(records, TimeWindowFilter.ONE_HOUR, now)
        assertEquals(3, stats1h.totalRounds)
        assertEquals(1, stats1h.below2xCount)
        assertEquals(2, stats1h.above50xCount)
        assertEquals(1, stats1h.above100xCount)
        assertEquals(now - 45 * min, stats1h.above100xRecords.first().crashTimestamp)

        val stats3h = MultiplierHistoryAnalyzer.analyzeWindow(records, TimeWindowFilter.THREE_HOURS, now)
        assertEquals(4, stats3h.totalRounds)
        assertEquals(2, stats3h.below2xCount)

        val stats5h = MultiplierHistoryAnalyzer.analyzeWindow(records, TimeWindowFilter.FIVE_HOURS, now)
        assertEquals(5, stats5h.totalRounds)
        assertEquals(3, stats5h.above50xCount)
        assertEquals(2, stats5h.above100xCount)

        val spotlight = MultiplierHistoryAnalyzer.getLastHourSpotlight(records, now)
        assertNotNull(spotlight)
        assertEquals(148.20, spotlight!!.highestMultiplier, 0.001)
        assertEquals(now - 45 * min, spotlight.crashTimestamp)

        assertNull(MultiplierHistoryAnalyzer.getLastHourSpotlight(emptyList(), now))
    }

    @Test
    fun `calculateNextStakeAfterLoss and StakeInstruction obey Master Progression and never auto-double at 13x`() {
        val engine = StrategyEngine()

        // Option 0: Disabled keeps stake flat even when high multiplier flag is passed
        assertEquals(
            10.50,
            engine.calculateNextStakeAfterLoss(
                currentStake = 10.50,
                progressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.DISABLED,
                customAddAmount = 5.25,
                lossMultiplier = 18.00,
                isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = true
            ),
            0.001
        )

        // Option A: Add Amount (whole & decimal)
        assertEquals(
            35.0,
            engine.calculateNextStakeAfterLoss(
                currentStake = 20.0,
                progressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.ADD_AMOUNT,
                customAddAmount = 15.0
            ),
            0.001
        )
        assertEquals(
            15.75,
            engine.calculateNextStakeAfterLoss(
                currentStake = 10.50,
                progressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.ADD_AMOUNT,
                customAddAmount = 5.25
            ),
            0.001
        )

        // Option B: Double Amount
        assertEquals(
            40.0,
            engine.calculateNextStakeAfterLoss(
                currentStake = 20.0,
                progressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.DOUBLE_AMOUNT,
                customAddAmount = 15.0
            ),
            0.001
        )

        // >13.00x High Multiplier Loss MUST NOT silently override Add Amount with Double Amount
        assertEquals(
            15.75,
            engine.calculateNextStakeAfterLoss(
                currentStake = 10.50,
                progressionMode = StakeProgressionMode.ADD_AMOUNT,
                customAddAmount = 5.25,
                lossMultiplier = 14.20,
                isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = true
            ),
            0.001
        )

        assertEquals("25", StrategyEngine.formatStakeAmount(25.0))
        assertEquals("15.75", StrategyEngine.formatStakeAmount(15.75))

        // Verify StakeInstruction stays ADD_AMOUNT across >13.00x crash under Master Progression
        val config = configWithSingleRule(
            ruleId = StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES,
            mode = StakeProgressionMode.ADD_AMOUNT,
            customAdd = 5.25,
            baseStake = 10.50
        ).copy(isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = true)

        engine.reset(10.50)
        assertEquals("10.50", engine.getPendingStakeInstruction().formattedStake)
        assertFalse(engine.getPendingStakeInstruction().isSessionActive)

        // Trigger AFTER_2_LOSSES
        engine.processCompletedRound(1.20, config, 1_000L)
        engine.processCompletedRound(1.30, config, 2_000L)
        val triggeredInstruction = engine.getPendingStakeInstruction()
        assertTrue(triggeredInstruction.isSessionActive)
        assertEquals(10.50, triggeredInstruction.stakeAmount, 0.001)
        assertEquals("10.50", triggeredInstruction.formattedStake)
        assertEquals(StakeProgressionMode.ADD_AMOUNT, triggeredInstruction.progressionMode)
        assertEquals(1, triggeredInstruction.stakeLevel)

        // Loss #1 -> Add 5.25 => 15.75
        engine.processBetOutcome(isWin = false, multiplier = 1.40, config = config, currentTimeMs = 3_000L)
        val afterAddLoss = engine.getPendingStakeInstruction()
        assertEquals(15.75, afterAddLoss.stakeAmount, 0.001)
        assertEquals("15.75", afterAddLoss.formattedStake)
        assertEquals(StakeProgressionMode.ADD_AMOUNT, afterAddLoss.progressionMode)
        assertEquals(2, afterAddLoss.stakeLevel)

        // Loss #2 at 18.50x -> Respects ADD_AMOUNT (15.75 + 5.25 = 21.00), NO hidden doubling!
        engine.processBetOutcome(isWin = false, multiplier = 18.50, config = config, currentTimeMs = 4_000L)
        val afterHighLoss = engine.getPendingStakeInstruction()
        assertEquals(21.00, afterHighLoss.stakeAmount, 0.001)
        assertEquals("21", afterHighLoss.formattedStake)
        assertEquals(StakeProgressionMode.ADD_AMOUNT, afterHighLoss.progressionMode)
        assertEquals(3, afterHighLoss.stakeLevel)

        // 2 Verified Wins -> Reset back to base stake 10.50
        engine.processBetOutcome(isWin = true, multiplier = 2.10, config = config, currentTimeMs = 5_000L)
        engine.processBetOutcome(isWin = true, multiplier = 2.20, config = config, currentTimeMs = 6_000L)
        val afterReset = engine.getPendingStakeInstruction()
        assertFalse(afterReset.isSessionActive)
        assertEquals(10.50, afterReset.stakeAmount, 0.001)
        assertEquals("10.50", afterReset.formattedStake)
        assertEquals(1, afterReset.stakeLevel)
    }

        val recordedApplies = mutableListOf<Pair<Double, StakeProgressionMode>>()
        var betClickCount = 0
        val fakeInteractor = object : com.example.data.engine.TargetUiInteractor {
            override fun applyStake(
                newStake: Double,
                progressionMode: StakeProgressionMode,
                fallbackX: Float?,
                fallbackY: Float?,
                onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit
            ) {
                recordedApplies.add(newStake to progressionMode)
                onComplete(true)
            }

            override fun clickBet(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
                betClickCount++
                onComplete(true)
            }

            override fun clickCashOut(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
                onComplete(true)
            }
        }

        val strategyEngine = StrategyEngine()
        val engine = AutomationEngine(
            repository = ScreenEarnerRepository(fakeDao),
            strategyEngine = strategyEngine,
            riskManager = RiskManager(),

        engine.handleRoundCompleted(1.20, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 1_000L)
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(1.30, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 2_000L)

        // Phase BETTING_OPEN places bet with base stake 10.0 (ADD_AMOUNT)
        engine.handlePhaseUpdate("BETTING_OPEN", 1.00, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 3_000L)
        // Round crashes at 1.40x -> loss increases stake to 25.0
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(1.40, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 4_000L)
        // Next BETTING_OPEN passes 25.0 to TargetUiInteractor
        engine.handlePhaseUpdate("BETTING_OPEN", 1.00, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 5_000L)

        assertEquals(2, recordedApplies.size)

        assertEquals(StakeProgressionMode.ADD_AMOUNT, recordedApplies[0].second)
        assertEquals(25.0, recordedApplies[1].first, 0.001)
        assertEquals(StakeProgressionMode.ADD_AMOUNT, recordedApplies[1].second)
        assertEquals(2, betClickCount)
    }

    @Test
    fun `strategy engine binds single, multiple, or all selected strategies directly`() {
        val engine = StrategyEngine()

        // 1. Bind a SINGLE strategy (After 9 Losses only)
        engine.updateStrategySelection(
            selectedRuleIds = setOf(StrategyRuleId.AFTER_9_LOSSES),
            isStrategy1Enabled = false,
            isStrategy2Enabled = false,
            isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = false
        )
        assertEquals(setOf(StrategyRuleId.AFTER_9_LOSSES), engine.getState().enabledRuleIds)

        // 2 losses and 45x range multiplier should NOT fire because only AFTER_9_LOSSES is bound
        assertTrue(engine.processCompletedRound(1.20, currentTimeMs = 1_000L) is StrategyTrigger.None)
        assertTrue(engine.processCompletedRound(1.20, currentTimeMs = 2_000L) is StrategyTrigger.None)
        assertTrue(engine.processCompletedRound(45.00, currentTimeMs = 3_000L) is StrategyTrigger.None)

        // Reset observed losses then hit 9 consecutive losses using bound config (no explicit config arg)
        engine.reset()
        for (i in 1..8) {
            assertTrue(engine.processCompletedRound(1.30, currentTimeMs = 10_000L + i * 1_000L) is StrategyTrigger.None)
        }
        val fired9 = engine.processCompletedRound(1.40, currentTimeMs = 20_000L)
        assertTrue(fired9 is StrategyTrigger.LossRecoveryFired)
        assertEquals(StrategyRuleId.AFTER_9_LOSSES, (fired9 as StrategyTrigger.LossRecoveryFired).ruleConfig.ruleId)

        // 2. Bind MULTIPLE strategies (After 3 Losses + High-Multiplier Wait 10x-100x)
        engine.reset()
        val multiSet = setOf(StrategyRuleId.AFTER_3_LOSSES, StrategyRuleId.RANGE_10_TO_100_WAIT_10M)
        engine.updateStrategySelection(selectedRuleIds = multiSet)
        assertEquals(multiSet, engine.getState().enabledRuleIds)

        val rangeWait = engine.processCompletedRound(28.00, currentTimeMs = 30_000L)
        assertTrue(rangeWait is StrategyTrigger.RangeWaitStarted)

        // 3. Bind ALL strategies
        engine.reset()
        val allSet = StrategyRuleId.entries.toSet()
        engine.updateStrategySelection(
            selectedRuleIds = allSet,
            isStrategy1Enabled = true,
            isStrategy2Enabled = true,
            isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled = true
        )
        assertEquals(allSet, engine.getState().enabledRuleIds)
        assertTrue(engine.boundConfig.value.isStrategy1Enabled)
        assertTrue(engine.boundConfig.value.isStrategy2Enabled)
        assertTrue(engine.boundConfig.value.isHighMultiplierLossRuleEnabled)
    }

    @Test
    fun `game detection syncs site ribbon shifts into history and resolves BetPawa vs SportyBet URLs`() {
        val detection = GameDetection()
        val recorded = mutableListOf<Double>()

        // Initial ribbon snapshot (only baseline, does not invent a fake round)
        detection.updateFromAccessibilityDetection(
            GameDetectionState(
                isGameDetected = true,
                foregroundPackage = "com.android.chrome",
                platformName = "Chrome Aviator Web",
                gamePhase = "BETTING_OPEN",
                detectedMultiplier = null,
                uiTargets = com.example.service.DetectedUiTargets(
                    detectedUrl = "https://www.sportybet.com/ng/m/aviator",
                    ribbonMultipliers = listOf(15.74, 2.00, 8.14),
                    siteButtonState = com.example.data.model.SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET
                )
            ),
            onRealRoundCompleted = { recorded.add(it) },
            currentTimeMs = 10_000L
        )
        assertEquals("SportyBet Aviator", detection.gameState.value.platformName)
        assertEquals(listOf(15.74, 2.00, 8.14), detection.gameState.value.recentRibbonHistory)
        assertTrue(recorded.isEmpty())

        // Ribbon head shifts with new completed round 4.65x (without requiring Flew Away frame)
        detection.updateFromAccessibilityDetection(
            GameDetectionState(
                isGameDetected = true,
                foregroundPackage = "com.android.chrome",
                platformName = "Chrome Aviator Web",
                gamePhase = "BETTING_OPEN",
                detectedMultiplier = null,
                uiTargets = com.example.service.DetectedUiTargets(
                    detectedUrl = "https://www.sportybet.com/ng/m/aviator",
                    ribbonMultipliers = listOf(4.65, 15.74, 2.00, 8.14),
                    siteButtonState = com.example.data.model.SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET
                )
            ),
            onRealRoundCompleted = { recorded.add(it) },
            currentTimeMs = 20_000L
        )
        assertEquals(listOf(4.65), recorded)
        assertEquals(listOf(4.65), detection.gameState.value.multiplierHistory)

        // Flew Away crash at 2.30x followed by ribbon showing 2.30x must record 2.30x only once
        detection.updateFromAccessibilityDetection(
            GameDetectionState(
                isGameDetected = true,
                foregroundPackage = "com.android.chrome",
                platformName = "SportyBet Aviator",
                gamePhase = "CRASHED",
                detectedMultiplier = 2.30,
                uiTargets = com.example.service.DetectedUiTargets(
                    detectedUrl = "https://www.sportybet.com/ng/m/aviator",
                    ribbonMultipliers = listOf(4.65, 15.74, 2.00),
                    siteButtonState = com.example.data.model.SiteButtonState.CRASHED
                )
            ),
            onRealRoundCompleted = { recorded.add(it) },
            currentTimeMs = 30_000L
        )
        detection.updateFromAccessibilityDetection(
            GameDetectionState(
                isGameDetected = true,
                foregroundPackage = "com.android.chrome",
                platformName = "SportyBet Aviator",
                gamePhase = "BETTING_OPEN",
                detectedMultiplier = null,
                uiTargets = com.example.service.DetectedUiTargets(
                    detectedUrl = "https://www.sportybet.com/ng/m/aviator",
                    ribbonMultipliers = listOf(2.30, 4.65, 15.74),
                    siteButtonState = com.example.data.model.SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET
                )
            ),
            onRealRoundCompleted = { recorded.add(it) },
            currentTimeMs = 31_000L
        )
        assertEquals(listOf(4.65, 2.30), recorded)
    }

    @Test

            override suspend fun clearAllPatternOccurrences() {}

            override suspend fun clearNotificationHistoryForGame(gameId: String) {}
        }

        val betClickCoords = mutableListOf<Pair<Float?, Float?>>()
        val fakeInteractor = object : com.example.data.engine.TargetUiInteractor {
            override fun applyStake(
                newStake: Double,
                progressionMode: StakeProgressionMode,
                fallbackX: Float?,
                fallbackY: Float?,
                onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit
            ) { onComplete(true) }

            override fun clickBet(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
                betClickCoords.add(fallbackX to fallbackY)
                onComplete(true)
            }

            override fun clickCashOut(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
                onComplete(true)
            }
        }

        val engine = AutomationEngine(
            repository = ScreenEarnerRepository(fakeDao),
            strategyEngine = StrategyEngine(),
            riskManager = RiskManager(),
            gameDetection = GameDetection(),
            targetUiInteractor = fakeInteractor
        )
        engine.updateCalibratedShortcuts(
            listOf(
                FloatingShortcut(id = 1, label = "BP BET", type = ShortcutType.BET, targetPlatform = "BetPawa", targetX = 111f, targetY = 222f, isCalibrated = true),
                FloatingShortcut(id = 2, label = "SB BET", type = ShortcutType.BET, targetPlatform = "SportyBet", targetX = 777f, targetY = 888f, isCalibrated = true)
            )
        )

        val config = configWithSingleRule(StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES)
        val limits = RiskLimits()
        engine.updateActivePlatform("SportyBet Aviator")
        engine.startAutomation(config, limits)
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(1.20, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 1_000L)
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(1.30, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 2_000L)

        // When site button shows Cancel (BET_QUEUED), no bet click occurs!
        engine.handlePhaseUpdate(
            phase = "BETTING_OPEN",
            liveMultiplier = 1.00,
            config = config,
            limits = limits,
            currentTimeMs = 3_000L,
            siteButtonState = com.example.data.model.SiteButtonState.BET_QUEUED
        )
        assertTrue(betClickCoords.isEmpty())

        // Once site button is IDLE_READY_TO_BET ("Bet"), engine dispatches bet WITHOUT blindly falling back to stale shortcut coords (777, 888)
        engine.handlePhaseUpdate(
            phase = "BETTING_OPEN",
            liveMultiplier = 1.00,
            config = config,
            limits = limits,
            currentTimeMs = 4_000L,
            siteButtonState = com.example.data.model.SiteButtonState.IDLE_READY_TO_BET
        )
        assertEquals(1, betClickCoords.size)
        assertEquals(null to null, betClickCoords.single())
    }

            override suspend fun countAllCrashRecords(): Int = 0
            override suspend fun clearHourlySummariesForGame(gameId: String) {}
            override suspend fun clearAllHourlySummaries() {}

            override suspend fun clearAllPatternOccurrences() {}
            override fun getAllAlarmProfiles(): Flow<List<com.example.data.model.AlarmProfileEntity>> = emptyFlow()
            override suspend fun getAlarmProfilesOnce(): List<com.example.data.model.AlarmProfileEntity> = emptyList()

            override suspend fun upsertAlarmProfile(profile: com.example.data.model.AlarmProfileEntity) {}
            override suspend fun insertAlarmProfilesIfAbsent(profiles: List<com.example.data.model.AlarmProfileEntity>) {}
            override suspend fun clearNotificationHistoryForGame(gameId: String) {}
        }

        var betClicks = 0
        var cashOutClicks = 0
        val cancelReasons = mutableListOf<String>()
        val fakeInteractor = object : com.example.data.engine.TargetUiInteractor {
            override fun applyStake(
                newStake: Double,
                progressionMode: StakeProgressionMode,
                fallbackX: Float?,
                fallbackY: Float?,
                onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit
            ) { onComplete(true) }

            override fun clickBet(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
                betClicks++
                onComplete(true)
            }

            override fun clickCashOut(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
                cashOutClicks++
                onComplete(true)
            }

            override fun cancelPendingGestures(reason: String) {
                cancelReasons.add(reason)
            }
        }

        val engine = AutomationEngine(
            repository = ScreenEarnerRepository(fakeDao),
            strategyEngine = StrategyEngine(),
            riskManager = RiskManager(),
            gameDetection = GameDetection(),
            targetUiInteractor = fakeInteractor
        )
        engine.updateCalibratedShortcuts(
            listOf(
                FloatingShortcut(id = 1, label = "BET", type = ShortcutType.BET, targetX = 300f, targetY = 1200f, isCalibrated = true),
                FloatingShortcut(id = 2, label = "CASH", type = ShortcutType.CASH_OUT, targetX = 600f, targetY = 1200f, isCalibrated = true)
            )
        )

        val config = configWithSingleRule(
            ruleId = StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES,
            mode = StakeProgressionMode.DOUBLE_AMOUNT,
            baseStake = 10.0,
            targetMultiplier = 2.00
        )
        val limits = RiskLimits(
            profitTarget = 15.0,
            stopOnProfitEnabled = true,
            maxSessionLoss = 500.0,
            stopOnLossEnabled = true
        )

        engine.startAutomation(config, limits)
        // Trigger AFTER_2_LOSSES
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(1.20, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 1_000L)
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(1.30, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 2_000L)

        // Round 1: Bet 10 -> Loss at 1.40x -> 0W / 1L, profit = -10.0, stake doubles to 20.0
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(1.40, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 3_000L)
        assertEquals(0, engine.sessionStats.value.winCount)
        assertEquals(1, engine.sessionStats.value.lossCount)
        assertEquals(-10.0, engine.sessionStats.value.totalProfit, 0.001)
        assertEquals(com.example.data.engine.AutomationState.RUNNING, engine.automationState.value)

        // Round 2: Bet 20 -> Win at 2.50x (net +20) -> 1W / 1L, total profit = +10.0 (< 15.0 target)
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(2.50, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 4_000L)
        assertEquals(1, engine.sessionStats.value.winCount)
        assertEquals(1, engine.sessionStats.value.lossCount)
        assertEquals(10.0, engine.sessionStats.value.totalProfit, 0.001)
        assertEquals(com.example.data.engine.AutomationState.RUNNING, engine.automationState.value)

        // Round 3: Bet 20 -> Win at 2.10x (net +20) -> 2W / 1L, total profit = +30.0 (>= 15.0 target!)
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(2.10, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 5_000L)
        assertEquals(2, engine.sessionStats.value.winCount)
        assertEquals(1, engine.sessionStats.value.lossCount)
        assertEquals(30.0, engine.sessionStats.value.totalProfit, 0.001)
        assertEquals(com.example.data.engine.AutomationState.PAUSED, engine.automationState.value)
        assertNotNull(engine.sessionStats.value.limitHaltReason)
        assertTrue(cancelReasons.any { it.contains("Stop if Profit Reaches", ignoreCase = true) })

        val clicksAtHalt = betClicks
        // Subsequent phases must NOT dispatch any more automation gestures
        engine.handlePhaseUpdate("BETTING_OPEN", 1.0, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 6_000L)
        engine.evaluateInFlightMultiplier(3.0, config, limits = limits)
        assertEquals(clicksAtHalt, betClicks)
        assertEquals(0, cashOutClicks)
    }

            override suspend fun countArchivedCrashRecordsForGame(gameId: String, activeSessionId: String): Int = 0
            override suspend fun countAllCrashRecords(): Int = 0
            override suspend fun clearHourlySummariesForGame(gameId: String) {}
            override suspend fun clearAllHourlySummaries() {}
            override suspend fun clearPatternOccurrencesForGame(gameId: String) {}
            override suspend fun clearAllPatternOccurrences() {}
            override fun getAllAlarmProfiles(): Flow<List<com.example.data.model.AlarmProfileEntity>> = emptyFlow()
            override suspend fun getAlarmProfilesOnce(): List<com.example.data.model.AlarmProfileEntity> = emptyList()
            override suspend fun getAlarmProfile(categoryName: String): com.example.data.model.AlarmProfileEntity? = null
            override suspend fun upsertAlarmProfile(profile: com.example.data.model.AlarmProfileEntity) {}
            override suspend fun insertAlarmProfilesIfAbsent(profiles: List<com.example.data.model.AlarmProfileEntity>) {}
            override suspend fun clearNotificationHistoryForGame(gameId: String) {}
        }

        var betClicks = 0
        val cancelReasons = mutableListOf<String>()
        val fakeInteractor = object : com.example.data.engine.TargetUiInteractor {
            override fun applyStake(
                newStake: Double,
                progressionMode: StakeProgressionMode,
                fallbackX: Float?,
                fallbackY: Float?,
                onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit
            ) { onComplete(true) }

            override fun clickBet(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
                betClicks++
                onComplete(true)
            }

            override fun clickCashOut(fallbackX: Float?, fallbackY: Float?, onComplete: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
                onComplete(true)
            }

            override fun cancelPendingGestures(reason: String) {
                cancelReasons.add(reason)
            }
        }

        val engine = AutomationEngine(
            repository = ScreenEarnerRepository(fakeDao),
            strategyEngine = StrategyEngine(),
            riskManager = RiskManager(),
            gameDetection = GameDetection(),
            targetUiInteractor = fakeInteractor
        )
        engine.updateCalibratedShortcuts(
            listOf(FloatingShortcut(id = 1, label = "BET", type = ShortcutType.BET, targetX = 300f, targetY = 1200f, isCalibrated = true))
        )

        val config = configWithSingleRule(
            ruleId = StrategyRuleId.AFTER_2_LOSSES,
            mode = StakeProgressionMode.DOUBLE_AMOUNT,
            baseStake = 15.0,
            targetMultiplier = 2.00
        )
        val limits = RiskLimits(
            profitTarget = 500.0,
            stopOnProfitEnabled = true,
            maxSessionLoss = 25.0,
            stopOnLossEnabled = true
        )

        engine.startAutomation(config, limits)
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(1.10, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 1_000L)
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(1.20, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 2_000L)

        // Round 1 loss of $15 -> totalProfit = -15.0 (< $25 limit), next proposed stake = $30 -> potential loss $45 > $25
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(1.30, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 3_000L)
        assertEquals(1, engine.sessionStats.value.lossCount)
        assertEquals(-15.0, engine.sessionStats.value.totalProfit, 0.001)

        // Next round attempt triggers Stop if Loss Reaches and cancels pending gestures immediately
        engine.handleRoundCompleted(1.40, config, limits, currentTimeMs = 4_000L)
        assertEquals(com.example.data.engine.AutomationState.PAUSED, engine.automationState.value)
        assertTrue(cancelReasons.any { it.contains("Stop if Loss Reaches", ignoreCase = true) })
        assertEquals(1, betClicks)
    }
}

    private fun setupIsolatedController(): Pair<Context, ScreenEarnerRepository> {

        SessionStateManager(context).clearSessionRuntimeState()
